+# Firebase Authentication setup
+
+1. Open [Firebase Console](https://console.firebase.google.com/), create or select a project, and register a **Web app**.
+2. In **Project settings > General > Your apps**, copy the web app's configuration into `firebase-config.js`. Keep any additional configuration properties supplied by Firebase. Never paste a service-account key into browser code.
+3. In **Authentication > Sign-in method**, enable **Email/Password**.
+4. In **Authentication > Settings > Authorized domains**, add your deployment hostname and `localhost` for development if needed.
+5. Serve this folder over HTTP, for example with VS Code Live Server or `python -m http.server 8000`. Open `http://localhost:8000` instead of double-clicking the HTML file.
+6. Create an account and confirm it appears in **Authentication > Users**. Close the tab, reopen the site, and verify login with the same account. Also check incorrect passwords, duplicate registration, and direct access to `project.html` while signed out.
+
+The app uses Firebase's modular browser SDK, email/password accounts, and tab-scoped session persistence. Successful registration or login opens the intentionally empty workspace. Names are saved to the Firebase user's display name when possible. Existing local-demo accounts are not Firebase accounts; register them again.
+
+The workspace redirect is a navigation guard. When project data is added, protect it with Firebase Security Rules or server-side ID-token validation; browser redirects do not authorize data access.
+
+Reference: [Firebase email/password authentication](https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/web/password-auth), [browser SDK setup](https://firebase.google.com/docs/web/alt-setup).

+import { firebaseConfig } from './firebase-config.js';
+
+let authPromise;
+
+/** Load Firebase once and share the same Authentication instance across callers. */
+export function getFirebaseAuth() {
+  const requiredFields = ['apiKey', 'authDomain', 'projectId', 'appId'];
+
+  if (requiredFields.some(field => !firebaseConfig[field]?.trim())) {
+    const error = new Error('Firebase web configuration is missing.');
+    error.code = 'app/missing-config';
+    return Promise.reject(error);
+  }
+
+  if (!authPromise) {
+    authPromise = initializeAuthentication().catch(error => {
+      // Allow another attempt after a temporary SDK download or startup failure.
+      authPromise = undefined;
+      throw error;
+    });
+  }
+
+  return authPromise;
+}
+
+/** Download the modular SDK and initialize Firebase with the web app settings. */
+async function initializeAuthentication() {
+  const [appSdk, sdk] = await Promise.all([
+    import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.1.0/firebase-app.js'),
+    import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.1.0/firebase-auth.js')
+  ]);
+
+  const app = appSdk.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
+  const auth = sdk.getAuth(app);
+
+  // Keep the user signed in for this browser tab, including page navigation.
+  await sdk.setPersistence(auth, sdk.browserSessionPersistence);
+
+  return { auth, sdk };
+}

+import { getFirebaseAuth } from './firebase-client.js';
+
+/** Wait for Firebase to restore the session before allowing workspace access. */
+async function requireSignIn() {
+  try {
+    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();
+
+    sdk.onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
+      if (!user) {
+        window.location.replace('index.html');
+      }
+    }, () => window.location.replace('index.html'));
+  } catch {
+    // Keep the workspace visually empty; setup and login happen on index.html.
+    window.location.replace('index.html');
+  }
+}
+
+requireSignIn();

+import { getFirebaseAuth } from './firebase-client.js';
+
+// Cache the form elements used by the authentication controls.
+const form = document.querySelector('#auth-form');
+const password = document.querySelector('#password');
+const message = document.querySelector('#message');
+const submit = form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
+let registering = false;
+
+
+/** Switch between login and registration, updating fields and button labels. */
+function toggleAuthMode() {
+  registering = !registering;
+  document.querySelector('#name-field').hidden = !registering;
+  document.querySelector('#name').required = registering;
+  document.querySelector('#password-hint').hidden = !registering;
+  password.minLength = registering ? 8 : 1;
+  password.autocomplete = registering ? 'new-password' : 'current-password';
+  document.querySelector('#form-title').textContent = registering
+    ? 'Welcome to Schale, Sensei'
+    : 'Welcome back, Sensei';
+  document.querySelector('#form-description').textContent = registering
+    ? 'Register your Sensei profile and join Schale.'
+    : 'Log in to Schale and prepare for your next sortie.';
+  document.querySelector('#submit-label').textContent = registering
+    ? 'Create account'
+    : 'Log in';
+  document.querySelector('#switch-prompt').textContent = registering
+    ? 'Already have an account?'
+    : "Don't have an account?";
+  document.querySelector('#switch-mode').textContent = registering
+    ? 'Log in'
+    : 'Create an account';
+  document.title = registering
+    ? 'Schale | Create account'
+    : 'Schale | Log in';
+  message.textContent = '';
+  password.value = '';
+}
+
+/** Show or hide the password and update the button's accessible state. */
+function togglePasswordVisibility(event) {
+  const visible = password.type === 'password';
+  password.type = visible ? 'text' : 'password';
+  event.currentTarget.textContent = visible ? 'Hide' : 'Show';
+  event.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-label', visible ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password');
+  event.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(visible));
+}
+
+/** Translate Firebase failures into useful messages without exposing raw errors. */
+function getAuthErrorMessage(error) {
+  const messages = {
+    'auth/email-already-in-use': 'This email already has an account. Please log in.',
+    'auth/invalid-email': 'Please enter a valid email address.',
+    'auth/invalid-credential': 'Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.',
+    'auth/user-not-found': 'Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.',
+    'auth/wrong-password': 'Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.',
+    'auth/weak-password': 'Choose a stronger password with at least 8 characters.',
+    'auth/password-does-not-meet-requirements': 'Your password does not meet the account password policy.',
+    'auth/too-many-requests': 'Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.',
+    'auth/network-request-failed': 'Unable to connect. Check your internet connection.',
+    'auth/user-disabled': 'This account has been disabled.',
+    'auth/operation-not-allowed': 'Email/password sign-in must be enabled in Firebase Console.',
+    'auth/invalid-api-key': 'Firebase configuration is invalid. Check firebase-config.js.',
+    'app/missing-config': 'Add your Firebase web configuration to firebase-config.js first.'
+  };
+
+  return messages[error.code] || 'Authentication is unavailable. Please try again later.';
+}
+
+/** Register or sign in through Firebase, then open the empty project workspace. */
+async function handleAuthSubmit(event) {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  message.textContent = '';
+
+  const email = document.querySelector('#email').value.trim();
+  const name = document.querySelector('#name').value.trim();
+  const switchButton = document.querySelector('#switch-mode');
+
+  if (registering && !name) {
+    message.textContent = 'Please enter your Sensei name.';
+    return;
+  }
+
+  // Prevent mode changes or repeated submissions while authentication is pending.
+  submit.disabled = true;
+  switchButton.disabled = true;
+  form.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
+
+  try {
+    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();
+
+    if (registering) {
+      const credential = await sdk.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(
+        auth,
+        email,
+        password.value
+      );
+
+      // Account creation already signs the user in. A profile error must not
+      // suggest that registration failed and prompt duplicate registrations.
+      try {
+        await sdk.updateProfile(credential.user, { displayName: name });
+      } catch {
+        console.warn('Account created; display name could not be saved.');
+      }
+    } else {
+      await sdk.signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password.value);
+    }
+
+    password.value = '';
+    window.location.assign('project.html');
+  } catch (error) {
+    message.textContent = getAuthErrorMessage(error);
+  } finally {
+    submit.disabled = false;
+    switchButton.disabled = false;
+    form.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
+  }
+}
+
+// Connect the page controls to their event handlers.
+document.querySelector('#switch-mode').addEventListener('click', toggleAuthMode);
+document.querySelector('.reveal').addEventListener('click', togglePasswordVisibility);
+form.addEventListener('submit', handleAuthSubmit);

+# Development lab
+
+Keep experimental project parts here until they are explicitly approved for integration.
+
+Enter through the Development button on `project.html` while signed in as Firebase UID `k8ncp3tED8YjjxoTXHlYBSoxcFW2`. The hub and movement preview also check the Firebase session when opened directly.
+
+The movement preview uses the shared sprite assets in `../sprites/`.
+
+These browser checks control navigation and visibility. Static HTML, JavaScript, and images remain downloadable from the web server. Any future private development data or privileged operations must enforce the admin identity in Firebase Security Rules or on a server.
+
+## Movement tuning
+
+- `movement.html`: canvas `width` and `height` set the movement area.
+- `movement.js`: `spriteSize` sets display size; `spritePadding` adds display margin; `frameDuration` sets walking cadence; `movementSpeed` sets travel speed. Enable `showSpriteBounds` to inspect frame rectangles.
+- `sprite-layouts.js`: source-pixel `columnEdges` and per-column `rowEdges` control actual frame cropping. The sheets have uneven row spacing. Move a boundary only after checking both frames sharing that edge.
+- Each character's `rows` mapping in `movement.js` selects the source row for each of eight directions. Adjust mappings if an imported pose faces differently.
+
+Hold two perpendicular keys for diagonal movement. Diagonals are normalized to the same speed as cardinal movement. The on-screen pad also supports all eight directions.

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+import { getFirebaseAuth } from '../firebase-client.js';
+import { isAdmin } from '../admin-access.js';
+
+/** Reveal development content only after Firebase confirms the admin session. */
+export async function requireAdmin() {
+  const content = document.querySelector('#development-content');
+
+  try {
+    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();
+
+    return await new Promise(resolve => {
+      sdk.onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
+        const allowed = isAdmin(user);
+        content.hidden = !allowed;
+
+        if (!allowed) {
+          window.location.replace(user ? '../project.html' : '../index.html');
+        }
+
+        resolve(allowed);
+      }, () => {
+        content.hidden = true;
+        window.location.replace('../index.html');
+        resolve(false);
+      });
+    });
+  } catch {
+    content.hidden = true;
+    window.location.replace('../index.html');
+    return false;
+  }
+}

diff --git a/Development/movement.js b/Development/movement.js

@@ -0,0 +1,217 @@
+import { requireAdmin } from './admin-guard.js';
+import { spriteLayouts } from './sprite-layouts.js';
+
+const authorized = await requireAdmin();
+const canvas = document.querySelector('#arena');
+const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
+const status = document.querySelector('#status');
+const heldDirections = new Map();
+const frameCount = 5;
+// EDIT THESE VALUES to tune animation speed and the rendered sprite area.
+const frameDuration = 110; // Milliseconds per walking frame; lower is faster.
+const spriteSize = 130; // Display size in canvas pixels, not source crop size.
+const movementSpeed = 180; // Canvas pixels per second, including diagonals.
+const spritePadding = 8; // Empty display space around the full source frame.
+const showSpriteBounds = false; // Set true to see the rendered frame rectangle.
+
+// Source crop boundaries are editable in sprite-layouts.js. Do not enlarge the
+// canvas to fix source clipping: adjust that frame's row/column edges instead.
+const directionVectors = {
+  up: [0, -1], down: [0, 1], left: [-1, 0], right: [1, 0],
+  upLeft: [-1, -1], upRight: [1, -1],
+  downLeft: [-1, 1], downRight: [1, 1]
+};
+let selected = 'plana';
+let previousTime;
+
+// EDIT rows to change which source row is used for each direction (0 = top).
+// Use mirroredDirections when a sheet contains duplicate left-facing poses
+// instead of a usable right-facing row. This also avoids malformed source rows.
+const characters = {
+  plana: {
+    label: 'Plana',
+    source: '../sprites/Plana Sprite Sheet.png',
+    rows: { down: 0, downLeft: 1, left: 2, upLeft: 3, up: 4, upRight: 5, right: 6, downRight: 7 },
+    layout: spriteLayouts.plana,
+    x: 310, y: 260, direction: 'down', elapsed: 0, moving: false
+  },
+  mob: {
+    label: 'Mob',
+    source: '../sprites/Mob Sprite Sheet.png',
+    // Mob rows 6/7 still face left and overlap nearby artwork. Reuse the
+    // clean left/down-left rows and mirror them for correct rightward poses.
+    rows: { down: 0, downLeft: 1, left: 2, upRight: 3, up: 4, upLeft: 5, right: 2, downRight: 1 },
+    mirroredDirections: ['right', 'downRight'],
+    layout: spriteLayouts.mob,
+    x: 590, y: 260, direction: 'down', elapsed: 0, moving: false
+  }
+};
+
+/** Load a sheet before animation begins and report an actionable loading error. */
+function loadSheet(character) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const image = new Image();
+    image.onload = () => {
+      character.image = image;
+      resolve();
+    };
+    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${character.source}.`));
+    image.src = character.source;
+  });
+}
+
+/** Resolve keyboard input to one of the four supported movement directions. */
+function directionForKey(key) {
+  return {
+    ArrowUp: 'up', w: 'up', ArrowDown: 'down', s: 'down',
+    ArrowLeft: 'left', a: 'left', ArrowRight: 'right', d: 'right'
+  }[key.length === 1 ? key.toLowerCase() : key];
+}
+
+/** Clear held input when focus is lost so characters cannot get stuck moving. */
+function releaseControls() {
+  heldDirections.clear();
+}
+
+window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
+  const direction = directionForKey(event.key);
+  if (!direction) return;
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!event.repeat) heldDirections.set(event.code, direction);
+});
+
+window.addEventListener('keyup', event => {
+  heldDirections.delete(event.code);
+});
+
+window.addEventListener('blur', releaseControls);
+document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', releaseControls);
+
+document.querySelectorAll('[data-character]').forEach(button => {
+  // Switch only the controlled character; both characters stay visible.
+  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
+    selected = button.dataset.character;
+    releaseControls();
+    document.querySelectorAll('[data-character]').forEach(option => {
+      option.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(option === button));
+    });
+  });
+});
+
+document.querySelectorAll('[data-direction]').forEach(button => {
+  // Pointer capture lets touch and mouse controls release outside the button.
+  button.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
+    button.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
+    heldDirections.set(`pointer-${event.pointerId}`, button.dataset.direction);
+  });
+  for (const type of ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture']) {
+    button.addEventListener(type, event => {
+      heldDirections.delete(`pointer-${event.pointerId}`);
+    });
+  }
+});
+
+/** Combine held inputs into eight directions; opposite inputs cancel each other. */
+function getMovementDirection() {
+  let x = 0;
+  let y = 0;
+  // A held W and ArrowUp count as one direction rather than double speed.
+  for (const direction of new Set(heldDirections.values())) {
+    const vector = directionVectors[direction];
+    x += vector[0];
+    y += vector[1];
+  }
+  x = Math.sign(x);
+  y = Math.sign(y);
+  return Object.keys(directionVectors).find(direction => {
+    const vector = directionVectors[direction];
+    return vector[0] === x && vector[1] === y;
+  });
+}
+
+/** Move within canvas bounds, keeping diagonal and cardinal movement equally fast. */
+function updateCharacter(character, delta, direction) {
+  character.moving = Boolean(direction);
+  if (!direction) {
+    character.elapsed = 0;
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (character.direction !== direction) character.elapsed = 0;
+  character.direction = direction;
+  character.elapsed += delta * 1000;
+  const [x, y] = directionVectors[direction];
+  const distance = movementSpeed * delta / Math.hypot(x, y);
+  character.x += x * distance;
+  character.y += y * distance;
+  const margin = spriteSize / 2;
+  character.x = Math.max(margin, Math.min(canvas.width - margin, character.x));
+  character.y = Math.max(margin, Math.min(canvas.height - margin - 25, character.y));
+}
+
+/** Return a source rectangle using the sheet's uneven per-column row boundaries. */
+function getFrameRectangle(character, frame) {
+  const row = character.rows[character.direction];
+  const { columnEdges, rowEdges } = character.layout;
+  return {
+    x: columnEdges[frame],
+    y: rowEdges[frame][row],
+    width: columnEdges[frame + 1] - columnEdges[frame],
+    height: rowEdges[frame][row + 1] - rowEdges[frame][row]
+  };
+}
+
+/** Draw the entire measured frame without stretching, with optional crop debugging. */
+function drawCharacter(character) {
+  const frame = character.moving
+    ? 1 + Math.floor(character.elapsed / frameDuration) % (frameCount - 1)
+    : 0;
+  const crop = getFrameRectangle(character, frame);
+  const scale = (spriteSize - spritePadding * 2) / 215;
+  const width = crop.width * scale;
+  const height = crop.height * scale;
+
+  context.save();
+  context.translate(character.x, character.y);
+  if (character.mirroredDirections?.includes(character.direction)) {
+    context.scale(-1, 1);
+  }
+  context.drawImage(
+    character.image,
+    crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
+    -width / 2, spriteSize / 2 - spritePadding - height, width, height
+  );
+  if (showSpriteBounds) {
+    context.strokeStyle = '#e54b93';
+    context.strokeRect(-width / 2, spriteSize / 2 - spritePadding - height, width, height);
+  }
+  context.restore();
+
+  context.font = '14px system-ui';
+  context.textAlign = 'center';
+  context.fillStyle = character === characters[selected] ? '#087fba' : '#526f87';
+  context.fillText(character.label, character.x, character.y + spriteSize / 2 + 18);
+}
+
+/** Render both characters every frame using the combined held movement inputs. */
+function animate(time) {
+  const delta = previousTime === undefined ? 0 : Math.min((time - previousTime) / 1000, 0.05);
+  previousTime = time;
+  const direction = getMovementDirection();
+  context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+  for (const [name, character] of Object.entries(characters)) {
+    updateCharacter(character, delta, name === selected ? direction : undefined);
+    drawCharacter(character);
+  }
+
+  const description = `${characters[selected].label} / ${direction || 'idle'}`;
+  if (status.textContent !== description) status.textContent = description;
+  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
+}
+
+// Start the preview only for the authorized development account.
+if (authorized) {
+  Promise.all(Object.values(characters).map(loadSheet))
+    .then(() => requestAnimationFrame(animate))
+    .catch(error => { status.textContent = error.message; });
+}

 Hold two perpendicular keys for diagonal movement. Diagonals are normalized to the same speed as cardinal movement. The on-screen pad also supports all eight directions.
+
+## Playarea simulation
+
+The canvas is a 1280 x 720 simulated full-screen view, scaled down by the `.simulated-screen` CSS width. The Playarea image is scaled proportionally to the canvas height and repeated infinitely in both horizontal directions. Only visible tiles are drawn from a single shared image; off-screen tiles have no retained objects. Tile seams may be visible because the supplied illustration is not a seamless texture.
+
+`topMovementPadding` controls optional space above the movement area; its default of zero allows access to the windows. Sprite bounds still keep the character inside the screen. Camera X follows the selected character with no horizontal clamp; camera Y stays zero. Characters still move in eight directions. Toolbar controls sit outside the simulated game screen: Dev Lab, Admin Tools, Reset Scene, and Sprite Bounds.
+
+## Future enemies
+
+Use `world-state.js` to remember enemy IDs, world X/Y, health, and other state independently of tile rendering. `getVisibleEnemies` returns nearby records without deleting off-screen enemies; update movement/state with `rememberEnemy` and explicitly remove defeated enemies with `removeEnemy`. No enemies are spawned yet. This store survives scrolling during the current page session, not browser reloads. Background tiles never own enemy records.

diff --git a/Development/world-state.js b/Development/world-state.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1bef74f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Development/world-state.js
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+// Persistent-in-session enemy state is separate from disposable background tiles.
+// Future enemy spawning should register world coordinates here, never screen X/Y.
+const enemies = new Map();
+
+/** Add or update an enemy's state without tying its lifetime to camera visibility. */
+export function rememberEnemy(id, state) {
+  const enemy = { ...enemies.get(id), ...state, id };
+  enemies.set(id, enemy);
+  return enemy;
+}
+
+/** Read a remembered enemy even after its background tile has left the screen. */
+export function getEnemy(id) {
+  return enemies.get(id);
+}
+
+/** Return enemies near the viewport for future rendering; retain all other records. */
+export function getVisibleEnemies(cameraX, viewportWidth, margin = 160) {
+  return [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy =>
+    enemy.x >= cameraX - margin &&
+    enemy.x <= cameraX + viewportWidth + margin
+  );
+}
+
+/** Remove an enemy deliberately, for example after a confirmed defeat. */
+export function removeEnemy(id) {
+  enemies.delete(id);
+}

+// Row input order used by the test controls; indices are zero-based.
+const directions = ['down', 'downLeft', 'left', 'upLeft', 'up', 'upRight', 'right', 'downRight'];
+
+/** Build a configurable-column/eight-row grid within editable source-image margins. */
+export function makeGrid(width, height, margins, columns = 5) {
+  if (!Number.isInteger(columns) || columns < 1 || columns > 64) {
+    throw new Error('Columns must be an integer from 1 to 64.');
+  }
+  const { left, top, right, bottom } = margins;
+  if (Object.values(margins).some(value => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) ||
+      left + right >= width || top + bottom >= height) {
+    throw new Error('Margins must leave a non-empty sprite area.');
+  }
+  const columnEdges = Array.from({ length: columns + 1 }, (_, i) => left + (width - left - right) * i / columns);
+  const edges = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => top + (height - top - bottom) * i / 8);
+  return { columnEdges, rowEdges: Array.from({ length: columns }, () => [...edges]) };
+}
+
+/** Decode a local image before replacing the currently working sprite. */
+function loadImage(url) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const image = new Image();
+    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
+    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Cannot read this image. Choose a PNG, WebP, or JPEG sprite sheet.'));
+    image.src = url;
+  });
+}
+
+/** Install session-only sprite swapping; built-in assets and crop settings stay intact. */
+export function setupSpriteTester(characters, switchCharacter) {
+  const form = document.querySelector('#sprite-tester');
+  const target = form.elements.namedItem('target');
+  const feedback = document.querySelector('#sprite-feedback');
+  const originals = new Map(Object.entries(characters).map(([name, character]) =>
+    [name, { ...character }]
+  ));
+  const localUrls = new Map();
+
+  /** Populate editable row/mirror controls from the chosen avatar's current setup. */
+  function showSettings() {
+    const character = characters[target.value];
+    form.elements.namedItem('rows').value = directions.map(direction => character.rows[direction]).join(',');
+    form.elements.namedItem('mirrors').value = (character.mirroredDirections || []).join(',');
+    form.elements.namedItem('reference').value = character.referenceSize || 215;
+    form.elements.namedItem('columns').value = character.layout.columnEdges.length - 1;
+  }
+
+  target.addEventListener('change', showSettings);
+  showSettings();
+
+  // Decode first, then atomically apply; failed uploads leave the old sheet usable.
+  form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const name = target.value;
+    const apply = form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
+    let url;
+    apply.disabled = true;
+    feedback.textContent = 'Loading sprite settings…';
+    try {
+      const rows = form.elements.namedItem('rows').value.split(',').map(value => Number(value.trim()));
+      if (rows.length !== 8 || rows.some(row => !Number.isInteger(row) || row < 0 || row > 7)) {
+        throw new Error('Enter eight row indices between 0 and 7.');
+      }
+      const mirrors = form.elements.namedItem('mirrors').value.split(',').map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean);
+      if (mirrors.some(direction => !directions.includes(direction))) throw new Error('Unknown mirrored direction.');
+      const file = form.elements.namedItem('sheet').files[0];
+      if (file) url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
+      const image = url ? await loadImage(url) : characters[name].image;
+      const margins = Object.fromEntries(['left', 'top', 'right', 'bottom'].map(edge =>
+        [edge, Number(form.elements.namedItem(edge).value)]
+      ));
+      const layout = form.elements.namedItem('layout').value === 'grid'
+        ? makeGrid(image.naturalWidth, image.naturalHeight, margins, Number(form.elements.namedItem('columns').value))
+        : originals.get(name).layout;
+      if (layout.columnEdges.at(-1) > image.naturalWidth ||
+          layout.rowEdges.some(edges => edges.at(-1) > image.naturalHeight)) {
+        throw new Error('Built-in crops exceed this image. Choose the regular grid layout.');
+      }
+      const referenceSize = Number(form.elements.namedItem('reference').value);
+      if (!Number.isFinite(referenceSize) || referenceSize <= 0) throw new Error('Display reference size must be positive.');
+      Object.assign(characters[name], {
+        image, layout, rows: Object.fromEntries(directions.map((direction, i) => [direction, rows[i]])),
+        mirroredDirections: mirrors, idleRows: {}, referenceSize,
+        walkFrames: Object.fromEntries(directions.map(direction => [direction, Array.from({ length: layout.columnEdges.length - 1 }, (_, i) => i)])),
+        elapsed: 0, moving: false
+      });
+      if (url) {
+        if (localUrls.has(name)) URL.revokeObjectURL(localUrls.get(name));
+        localUrls.set(name, url);
+        url = undefined;
+      }
+      switchCharacter(name);
+      feedback.textContent = `${characters[name].label}: test sheet applied (${image.naturalWidth} × ${image.naturalHeight}).`;
+    } catch (error) {
+      feedback.textContent = error.message;
+    } finally {
+      if (url) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
+      apply.disabled = false;
+    }
+  });
+
+  /** Restore the selected avatar's built-in sheet without moving the player. */
+  document.querySelector('#restore-sprite').addEventListener('click', () => {
+    const name = target.value;
+    const { x, y, direction } = characters[name];
+    Object.assign(characters[name], originals.get(name), { x, y, direction, moving: false, elapsed: 0 });
+    if (localUrls.has(name)) URL.revokeObjectURL(localUrls.get(name));
+    localUrls.delete(name);
+    form.elements.namedItem('sheet').value = '';
+    showSettings();
+    feedback.textContent = `${characters[name].label}: built-in sprite restored.`;
+  });
+
+  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => {
+    for (const url of localUrls.values()) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
+  });
+}

+# Project integration sizing contract
+
+Do not migrate gameplay into project.html until the user approves it.
+
+## Characters
+
+Use scene-metrics.js in both the development preview and the eventual project renderer:
+
+- Normal player/NPC sprite area: 112 CSS/world pixels.
+- Boss sprite area: 224 CSS/world pixels.
+- Shared sprite display padding: 7 pixels.
+
+These values approximate the apparent size of the former 130/260-pixel actors after the old 1280-pixel canvas was displayed at roughly 1108 pixels wide. Actual visible artwork size still depends on each sheet's referenceSize and transparent padding. Preserve those per-sheet settings and source crops. Do not multiply character size by browser width, fullscreen size, or map zoom.
+
+viewport.js sets canvas dimensions to its displayed CSS dimensions. This makes one world unit equal one displayed pixel; larger views reveal more world. Reuse it in the project screen. Keep the CSS canvas dimensions explicitly controlled by the viewport/container. If high-DPI rendering is added later, apply devicePixelRatio to the backing buffer/context only; keep world and collision coordinates in CSS pixels.
+
+## Maps
+
+- Playarea 1: scale background to viewport height; horizontal scroll only.
+- Playarea 2: scale background to viewport width; vertical scroll only.
+- Playarea 3: retain fixed world tile dimensions, overlap, seed, and source collision scale. Larger viewports display more tiles without enlarging them.
+- Playarea 4: retain islandScale and finite image world dimensions. Larger viewports reveal more of the island; do not automatically fit/stretch the island to fullscreen.
+
+Player/NPC rendering, collision footprints, placement bounds, tower occlusion, and arrow positioning use the same shared character size defaults. NPCs cloned from player sheets still use NPC movement speeds. Keep this distinction when implementing the future player character picker.

+import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
+/** Convert browser pointer coordinates to internal canvas pixels after CSS scaling. */
+export function pointerToCanvas(clientX, clientY, rectangle, width, height) {
+  return {
+    x: (clientX - rectangle.left) * width / rectangle.width,
+    y: (clientY - rectangle.top) * height / rectangle.height
+  };
+}
+
+/** Load the supplied aiming artwork without changing project image files. */
+function loadAimImage(source) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const image = new Image();
+    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
+    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${source}.`));
+    image.src = source;
+  });
+}
+
+/** Manage independent arrow visibility and click-to-toggle cursor aiming. */
+export function createAiming(canvas) {
+  const toggle = document.querySelector('#toggle-arrow');
+  const modeLabel = document.querySelector('#aim-mode');
+  const state = { visible: true, cursorAim: false, inside: false, pointer: { x: 0, y: 0 } };
+  let arrow;
+  let crosshair;
+
+  // EDIT these values to tune the aiming sprites in internal canvas pixels.
+  const arrowWidth = 24.36; // Another 30% smaller than 34.8 pixels.
+  const arrowHeight = 13.02; // Preserve proportions at the reduced size.
+  const crosshairSize = 75.712; // 30% larger than the previous 58.24 pixels.
+  const arrowDistanceMultiplier = 0.9; // Extra clearance below the player sprite.
+  const ready = Promise.all([
+    loadAimImage('../sprites/arrow.png'),
+    loadAimImage('../sprites/crosshair.png')
+  ]).then(images => { [arrow, crosshair] = images; });
+
+  /** Keep UI and native cursor in sync with the selected aiming mode. */
+  function updateControls() {
+    toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.visible));
+    toggle.textContent = state.visible ? 'Arrow: shown' : 'Arrow: hidden';
+    modeLabel.textContent = state.cursorAim ? 'Aim: crosshair' : 'Aim: character facing';
+    canvas.style.cursor = state.cursorAim && state.inside ? 'none' : 'default';
+  }
+
+  /** Track the pointer in screen space, so camera scrolling cannot offset aiming. */
+  function trackPointer(event) {
+    state.pointer = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
+      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
+    state.inside = true;
+    updateControls();
+  }
+
+  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
+    state.visible = !state.visible;
+    updateControls();
+  });
+  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', trackPointer);
+  canvas.addEventListener('pointerenter', trackPointer);
+  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
+    state.inside = false;
+    updateControls();
+  });
+  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
+    if (event.button !== 0) return;
+    trackPointer(event);
+    state.cursorAim = !state.cursorAim;
+    updateControls();
+  });
+
+  /** Draw an upward-native arrow rotated toward facing or the custom cursor. */
+  function draw(context, character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
+    if (!arrow || !crosshair) return;
+    const x = character.x - cameraX;
+    const y = character.y - cameraY;
+    let dx = vector[0];
+    let dy = vector[1];
+    if (state.cursorAim) {
+      dx = state.pointer.x - x;
+      dy = state.pointer.y - y;
+      // Preserve facing if the cursor is precisely on the character anchor.
+      if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) [dx, dy] = vector;
+    }
+    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
+    if (state.visible) {
+      const distance = ((character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 + 25) * arrowDistanceMultiplier;
+      context.save();
+      context.translate(x + Math.cos(angle) * distance, y + Math.sin(angle) * distance);
+      context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
+      context.drawImage(arrow, -arrowWidth / 2, -arrowHeight / 2, arrowWidth, arrowHeight);
+      context.restore();
+    }
+    if (state.cursorAim && state.inside) {
+      context.drawImage(crosshair,
+        state.pointer.x - crosshairSize / 2, state.pointer.y - crosshairSize / 2,
+        crosshairSize, crosshairSize);
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** Return to facing-based aiming without overriding the visibility preference. */
+  function reset() {
+    state.cursorAim = false;
+    updateControls();
+  }
+
+  updateControls();
+  return { ready, draw, reset, state };
+}

+import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';
+
+/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
+export function glyphRectangle(character) {
+  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
+}
+
+/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
+export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3 } = {}) {
+  const image = new Image();
+  let loaded = false;
+  let text = '';
+
+  function render() {
+    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
+    const characters = [...text];
+    const advances = characters.map(character => character === ' '
+      ? spaceWidth : glyphRectangle(character).width - outlineOverlap);
+    canvas.width = Math.max(1, (advances.reduce((sum, width) => sum + width, 0) + outlineOverlap) * scale);
+    canvas.height = 20 * scale;
+    canvas.style.width = `${canvas.width}px`;
+    canvas.style.height = `${canvas.height}px`;
+    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
+    if (!loaded) return;
+    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
+    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
+    let x = 0;
+    for (const [index, character] of characters.entries()) {
+      if (character !== ' ') {
+        const glyph = glyphRectangle(character);
+        context.drawImage(image, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
+          x * scale, glyph.offsetY * scale, glyph.width * scale, glyph.height * scale);
+      }
+      x += advances[index];
+    }
+  }
+
+  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
+  image.src = '../sprites/font.png';
+  return {
+    setText(value) {
+      if (text === value) return;
+      text = value;
+      render();
+    }
+  };
+}
diff --git a/Development/damage-feedback.js b/Development/damage-feedback.js

index 0000000..3b0c6fa

+++ b/Development/damage-feedback.js
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+export const damageFlashDuration = 240; // EDIT total pulse length in milliseconds.
+const riseDuration = 45; // Fast gradual rise, followed by a longer fade out.
+const whiteSprites = new WeakMap();
+
+/** Return a smooth white-tint intensity, never a full-screen or rectangular flash. */
+export function getDamageFlashOpacity(character) {
+  const elapsed = character.damageFlashElapsed;
+  if (elapsed === undefined || elapsed < 0 || elapsed >= damageFlashDuration) return 0;
+  const progress = elapsed < riseDuration
+    ? elapsed / riseDuration
+    : 1 - (elapsed - riseDuration) / (damageFlashDuration - riseDuration);
+  const smooth = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
+  return smooth * 0.85;
+}
+
+/** Advance visual feedback independently of whether movement AI is paused. */
+export function advanceDamageFlash(character, delta) {
+  if (character.damageFlashElapsed === undefined) return;
+  character.damageFlashElapsed += delta * 1000;
+  if (character.damageFlashElapsed >= damageFlashDuration) {
+    delete character.damageFlashElapsed;
+  }
+}
+
+/** Cache a white silhouette retaining the original image's transparent pixels. */
+export function getWhiteSprite(image) {
+  if (!whiteSprites.has(image)) {
+    const surface = document.createElement('canvas');
+    surface.width = image.naturalWidth;
+    surface.height = image.naturalHeight;
+    const context = surface.getContext('2d');
+    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
+    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
+    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
+    context.fillRect(0, 0, surface.width, surface.height);
+    whiteSprites.set(image, surface);
+  }
+  return whiteSprites.get(image);
+}
diff --git a/Development/enemy-death.js b/Development/enemy-death.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..98ce4f6

+++ b/Development/enemy-death.js
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+// Visual remnants are separate from living NPCs: no AI, collisions, or rewards.
+const deaths = new Map();
+export const deathSettings = { duration: 0.38, fadeStart: 0.12, distance: 48 };
+
+/** Freeze the defeated pose and launch it away from the source of the hit. */
+export function beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source) {
+  const dx = source ? enemy.x - source.x : enemy.contactReaction?.nx ?? 1;
+  const dy = source ? enemy.y - source.y : enemy.contactReaction?.ny ?? 0;
+  const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
+  const death = { elapsed: 0, originX: enemy.x, originY: enemy.y,
+    nx: length ? dx / length : 1, ny: length ? dy / length : 0, opacity: 1 };
+  deaths.set(enemy.id, { ...enemy, death, transition: null, moving: false });
+}
+
+/** Advance every remnant, including offscreen ones, and remove after the fade. */
+export function updateEnemyDeaths(delta) {
+  for (const [id, enemy] of deaths) {
+    const death = enemy.death;
+    death.elapsed += delta;
+    const progress = Math.min(1, death.elapsed / deathSettings.duration);
+    const distance = deathSettings.distance * (1 - (1 - progress) ** 3);
+    enemy.x = death.originX + death.nx * distance;
+    enemy.y = death.originY + death.ny * distance;
+    const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
+      (death.elapsed - deathSettings.fadeStart) / (deathSettings.duration - deathSettings.fadeStart)));
+    death.opacity = 1 - fade * fade;
+    if (progress === 1) deaths.delete(id);
+  }
+}
+
+/** Return visual-only remnants for the same camera culling as normal enemies. */
+export function getEnemyDeaths() {
+  return [...deaths.values()];
+}
diff --git a/Development/exp-drops.js b/Development/exp-drops.js

index 0000000..df82fea

+import { addPlayerExp } from './player-stats.js';
+import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';
+
+// World-space records survive camera scrolling and map switches for this session.
+const drops = new Map();
+let nextId = 0;
+const iconWidth = 28; // EDIT ground report size in display pixels.
+const pickupRadius = 26; // EDIT walk-over collection radius in world pixels.
+export const creditDropChance = 1 / 90; // EDIT occasional credit chance (~1.11%).
+export const secretNoteDropChance = 0.001; // 0.1% per defeated enemy.
+const lootTotals = { credits: 0, secretTechNotes: 0 }; // Shared across avatar swaps.
+
+/** Read session inventory; spending and attack upgrades will be implemented later. */
+export function getLootTotals() {
+  return { ...lootTotals };
+}
+
+/** Inspect all ground loot, including credits and Secret Tech Notes. */
+export function getGroundLoot() {
+  return [...drops.values()];
+}
+
+/** Spawn a specific ground pickup for repeatable admin testing. */
+export function spawnTestDrop(kind, value, x, y) {
+  if (!['exp', 'credits', 'secretTechNotes'].includes(kind)) return;
+  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 1) return;
+  const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind, value: Math.floor(value),
+    tier: reportTier(value), x, y, rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
+  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
+  return drop;
+}
+
+/** Apply one pickup's reward without coupling inventory to the controlled avatar. */
+function collectDrop(drop, player) {
+  drops.delete(drop.id);
+  if (drop.kind === 'exp') addPlayerExp(player, drop.value);
+  else lootTotals[drop.kind] += drop.value;
+}
+
+/** Roll independent bonus drops, allowing both rewards on the same defeat. */
+export function dropEnemyLoot(enemy, random = Math.random) {
+  const credits = random() < creditDropChance;
+  const note = random() < secretNoteDropChance;
+  for (const [kind, awarded] of [['credits', credits], ['secretTechNotes', note]]) {
+    if (!awarded) continue;
+    const drop = {
+      id: ++nextId, kind, value: 1,
+      x: enemy.x + (kind === 'credits' ? -18 : 18),
+      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
+      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
+    };
+    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
+  }
+}
+
+/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
+export function reportTier(value) {
+  return value >= 50 ? 3 : value >= 20 ? 2 : value >= 11 ? 1 : 0;
+}
+
+/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
+export function getExpDrops() {
+  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
+}
+
+/** Place one report at the defeated enemy's feet, preserving its exact reward. */
+export function dropEnemyExp(enemy) {
+  const value = Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? 5);
+  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
+  const drop = {
+    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier: reportTier(value), x: enemy.x,
+    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
+    rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
+  };
+  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
+  return drop;
+}
+
+/** Load report graphics once and provide collection/rendering for the preview. */
+export function createExpPickups(getPlayer) {
+  const lootStatus = document.querySelector('#player-loot-status');
+  const tools = document.querySelector('#loot-tools');
+  if (tools) {
+    tools.querySelectorAll('[data-loot-action]').forEach(button => {
+      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
+        const player = getPlayer();
+        const action = button.dataset.lootAction;
+        if (action === 'clear') drops.clear();
+        else if (action === 'collect') {
+          for (const drop of drops.values()) collectDrop(drop, player);
+        } else if (action === 'reset') {
+          lootTotals.credits = 0;
+          lootTotals.secretTechNotes = 0;
+        } else {
+          const amount = Number(tools.querySelector('[name="loot-value"]').value);
+          spawnTestDrop(action, Math.min(1000000, amount), player.x + 80,
+            player.y + (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding);
+        }
+      });
+    });
+  }
+  const icons = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, tier) => {
+    const image = new Image();
+    image.src = `../sprites/icons/Exp_Report_${tier}.png`;
+    return image;
+  });
+  const ready = Promise.all(icons.map(image => image.decode()));
+  const creditIcon = new Image();
+  creditIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/credits.png';
+  const creditReady = creditIcon.decode();
+  // Temporary paper-note graphic until a Secret Tech Note asset is supplied.
+  const noteIcon = document.createElement('canvas');
+  noteIcon.width = 28;
+  noteIcon.height = 28;
+  const noteContext = noteIcon.getContext('2d');
+  noteContext.fillStyle = '#173954';
+  noteContext.fillRect(4, 1, 20, 26);
+  noteContext.fillStyle = '#e2faff';
+  noteContext.fillRect(6, 3, 16, 22);
+  noteContext.fillStyle = '#4aaedc';
+  for (let y = 8; y <= 20; y += 4) noteContext.fillRect(9, y, 10, 2);
+
+  /** Sweep the player's feet so moving over a report cannot skip collection. */
+  function update(player, previous) {
+    const footOffset = (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
+    const start = { x: previous.x, y: previous.y + footOffset };
+    const end = { x: player.x, y: player.y + footOffset };
+    const dx = end.x - start.x, dy = end.y - start.y;
+    const lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
+    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
+      const fraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
+        ((drop.x - start.x) * dx + (drop.y - start.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
+      if (Math.hypot(drop.x - start.x - dx * fraction, drop.y - start.y - dy * fraction) <= pickupRadius) {
+        collectDrop(drop, player);
+      }
+    }
+    if (lootStatus) lootStatus.textContent = `Credits: ${lootTotals.credits} | Secret Tech Notes: ${lootTotals.secretTechNotes} | Ground drops: ${drops.size}`;
+  }
+
+  /** Draw only visible reports beneath actors, keeping their orientation fixed. */
+  function draw(context, camera, width, height) {
+    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
+      const x = drop.x - camera.x, y = drop.y - camera.y;
+      if (x < -iconWidth || y < -iconWidth || x > width + iconWidth || y > height + iconWidth) continue;
+      const icon = drop.kind === 'exp' ? icons[drop.tier]
+        : drop.kind === 'credits' ? creditIcon : noteIcon;
+      const sourceWidth = icon === noteIcon ? icon.width : icon.naturalWidth;
+      const sourceHeight = icon === noteIcon ? icon.height : icon.naturalHeight;
+      if (!sourceWidth) continue;
+      const iconHeight = iconWidth * sourceHeight / sourceWidth;
+      context.save();
+      context.translate(x, y);
+      context.rotate(drop.rotation);
+      context.drawImage(icon, -iconWidth / 2, -iconHeight / 2, iconWidth, iconHeight);
+      context.restore();
+    }
+  }
+  return { ready: Promise.all([ready, creditReady]), update, draw };
+}

+/** Load predecoded GIF display frames while retaining original frame durations. */
+export async function loadGifAnimation(character) {
+  character.animationFrames = await Promise.all(character.gifFrames.map(frame =>
+    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const image = new Image();
+      image.onload = () => resolve({ image, duration: frame.duration });
+      image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${frame.source}.`));
+      image.src = frame.source;
+    })
+  ));
+  character.image = character.animationFrames[0].image;
+}
+
+/** Select the original GIF frame for elapsed playback time, including while idle. */
+export function gifFrameAt(frames, elapsed) {
+  const total = frames.reduce((sum, frame) => sum + frame.duration, 0);
+  let time = elapsed % total;
+  for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
+    time -= frames[i].duration;
+    if (time < 0) return i;
+  }
+  return 0;
+}

+import { createBitmapText } from './bitmap-font.js';
+
+/** Arrange HUD values/portrait without introducing combat or experience mechanics. */
+export function createHud(getFrameRectangle) {
+  const exp = document.querySelector('#hud-exp');
+  const expFill = document.querySelector('#hud-exp-fill');
+  const expEdge = document.querySelector('#hud-exp-edge');
+  const hp = document.querySelector('#hud-hp');
+  const hpFill = document.querySelector('#hud-hp-fill');
+  const portrait = document.querySelector('#hud-portrait');
+  const level = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#hud-level'));
+  const context = portrait.getContext('2d');
+  let previousImage;
+  let previousName;
+  const profiles = new Map();
+  let activeCharacter;
+
+  /** Create six compact slots per row once, then update only changed artwork. */
+  function createSlots(container, type) {
+    return Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => {
+      const slot = document.createElement('div');
+      slot.className = 'hud-slot';
+      slot.setAttribute('role', 'img');
+      const base = document.createElement('img');
+      base.alt = '';
+      const icon = document.createElement('img');
+      icon.className = 'hud-slot-icon';
+      icon.alt = '';
+      icon.hidden = true;
+      slot.append(base, icon);
+      container.append(slot);
+      return { slot, base, icon, type, index, previous: null };
+    });
+  }
+  const attackSlots = createSlots(document.querySelector('#hud-attack-slots'), 'attack');
+  const equipmentSlots = createSlots(document.querySelector('#hud-equipment-slots'), 'equipment');
+
+  /** Occupied slots use a blank base so placeholder swords/clothes never show through. */
+  function updateSlots(slots, items = []) {
+    for (const entry of slots) {
+      const item = items[entry.index];
+      const source = item?.icon || '';
+      const label = source ? item.name || `${entry.type} ${entry.index + 1}`
+        : `Empty ${entry.type} slot ${entry.index + 1}`;
+      const key = `${source}|${label}`;
+      if (entry.previous === key) continue;
+      entry.previous = key;
+      entry.base.src = `../sprites/hud/${source ? 'empty' : entry.type}-slot.png`;
+      entry.icon.hidden = !source;
+      if (source) entry.icon.src = source;
+      else entry.icon.removeAttribute('src');
+      entry.slot.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
+      entry.slot.title = label;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** Assign or clear a future selected item: { name, icon: 'path/to/icon.png' }. */
+  function setSlot(type, index, item) {
+    if (!activeCharacter || !['attack', 'equipment'].includes(type) ||
+        !Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= 6) return;
+    const property = type === 'attack' ? 'attackSlots' : 'equipmentSlots';
+    activeCharacter[property] ??= [];
+    activeCharacter[property][index] = item || null;
+    updateSlots(type === 'attack' ? attackSlots : equipmentSlots, activeCharacter[property]);
+  }
+
+  // Dedicated HUD profiles override sprite-sheet crops for these characters.
+  for (const [label, file] of [['Plana', 'plana.png'], ['Arona', 'arona.png']]) {
+    const image = new Image();
+    image.onload = () => {
+      profiles.set(label, image);
+      previousName = undefined; // Refresh the active portrait on the next render.
+    };
+    // Keep the existing sprite portrait available if a profile cannot be loaded.
+    image.src = `../sprites/hud/${file}`;
+  }
+
+  /** Reflect existing character state; defaults stay full HP and zero EXP for tests. */
+  function update(character) {
+    const playerLevel = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(character.level) || 1));
+    level.setText(`LV: ${playerLevel}`);
+    const maximumHp = Math.max(1, character.maxHp ?? 100);
+    const health = Math.max(0, Math.min(maximumHp, character.hp ?? maximumHp));
+    const maximumExp = Math.max(1, character.maxExp ?? 100);
+    const experience = Math.max(0, Math.min(maximumExp, character.exp ?? 0));
+    hp.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(maximumHp));
+    hp.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(health));
+    exp.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(maximumExp));
+    exp.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(experience));
+    exp.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${experience} / ${maximumExp} EXP`);
+    hpFill.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${100 - health / maximumHp * 100}% 0 0)`;
+    const percent = experience / maximumExp * 100;
+    // Caps use their own filled artwork; only the middle is proportionally clipped.
+    expFill.style.setProperty('--exp-unfilled', `${100 - percent}%`);
+    expFill.dataset.hasExp = String(experience > 0);
+    expFill.dataset.full = String(experience === maximumExp);
+    // The middle starts after the 90px left cap and ends before the 15px right cap.
+    expEdge.style.left = `calc(${percent}% + ${90 - 105 * percent / 100}px)`;
+    expEdge.hidden = experience === 0;
+    activeCharacter = character;
+    updateSlots(attackSlots, character.attackSlots);
+    updateSlots(equipmentSlots, character.equipmentSlots);
+    if (previousImage === character.image && previousName === character.label) return;
+    previousImage = character.image;
+    previousName = character.label;
+    portrait.setAttribute('aria-label', `${character.label} portrait`);
+    context.clearRect(0, 0, portrait.width, portrait.height);
+    const profile = profiles.get(character.label);
+    if (profile) {
+      // Preserve the entire profile and its proportions, with crisp pixel artwork.
+      context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
+      const scale = Math.min(portrait.width / profile.naturalWidth, portrait.height / profile.naturalHeight);
+      const width = profile.naturalWidth * scale;
+      const height = profile.naturalHeight * scale;
+      context.drawImage(profile, (portrait.width - width) / 2, (portrait.height - height) / 2, width, height);
+      return;
+    }
+    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
+    const image = character.animationFrames?.[0].image || character.image;
+    const pose = { ...character, direction: character.defaultDirection || 'down', moving: false, attack: null };
+    const crop = character.animationFrames
+      ? { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight }
+      : getFrameRectangle(pose, 0);
+    // Focus on the upper body/face; use the source sheet without editing the asset.
+    const side = Math.min(crop.width, crop.height * 0.65);
+    context.drawImage(image, crop.x + (crop.width - side) / 2, crop.y,
+      side, side, 0, 0, portrait.width, portrait.height);
+  }
+  return { update, setSlot };
+}

+import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';
+// EDIT zoom and source-pixel polygons to tune this finite, angled map.
+export const islandScale = 2; // EDIT zoom: larger values show a closer view.
+export const islandWidth = 1448 * islandScale;
+export const islandHeight = 1086 * islandScale;
+// Inner seawall/paving edge, including the concave inlet on the south side.
+export const islandBoundary = [
+  [154,309], [267,235], [506,145], [650,145],
+  // Follow the recessed north seawall behind the tower instead of cutting
+  // straight across the ocean to the right-hand promenade.
+  [770,200], [895,176], [1096,145],
+  [1277,345], [1392,502], [1320,671], [1055,822],
+  [981,704], [781,756], [576,851], [208,764], [59,540]
+];
+const shoreClearance = 10; // EDIT extra safety distance from water in source pixels.
+
+// Buildings follow their angled footprints. The center tower has only a LOW
+// ground footprint here, leaving its visually tall roof/back projection walkable.
+export const islandObstacles = [
+  [[235,290],[330,230],[430,290],[440,375],[340,415],[255,370]],
+  [[400,210],[490,170],[575,220],[585,300],[475,340],[420,305]],
+  [[230,470],[305,455],[425,535],[410,605],[270,650],[215,570]],
+  [[1010,275],[1090,240],[1170,315],[1180,380],[1070,420],[1000,365]],
+  [[1110,460],[1190,420],[1260,485],[1250,555],[1155,600],[1090,545]],
+  [[650,398],[730,375],[775,445],[722,490],[650,460]], // Tower foundation only.
+  // Pond and its raised rim, following the angled oval in the map artwork.
+  Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => [
+    890 + 54 * Math.cos(i * Math.PI / 12),
+    300 + 43 * Math.sin(i * Math.PI / 12)
+  ]),
+  // Requested large southwest lawn: follow the curb around the grass/trees.
+  [[456,688],[472,637],[551,603],[672,722],[538,786]],
+  // Requested triangular planted patch southeast of the center tower.
+  [[908,550],[923,520],[980,498],[1048,577],[1038,596]],
+];
+
+const towerSilhouette = [[653,144],[692,70],[758,93],[768,438],[724,484],[652,450]];
+
+/** Test source-space points against an angled polygon. */
+export function pointInPolygon(x,y,polygon) {
+  let inside=false;
+  for(let i=0,j=polygon.length-1;i<polygon.length;j=i++) {
+    const [xi,yi]=polygon[i], [xj,yj]=polygon[j];
+    if((yi>y)!==(yj>y) && x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi) inside=!inside;
+  }
+  return inside;
+}
+
+/** Reject any obstacle intersecting the actor's source-space foot rectangle. */
+function intersectsBox(polygon,left,top,right,bottom) {
+  if([[left,top],[right,top],[right,bottom],[left,bottom]].some(([x,y])=>pointInPolygon(x,y,polygon)))return true;
+  if(polygon.some(([x,y])=>x>=left&&x<=right&&y>=top&&y<=bottom))return true;
+  for(let i=0;i<polygon.length;i++) {
+    const [x,y]=polygon[i], [xx,yy]=polygon[(i+1)%polygon.length];
+    // Parametric clipping of each polygon edge against the rectangle.
+    let enter=0,exit=1;
+    for(const [p,q]of [[-(xx-x),x-left],[xx-x,right-x],[-(yy-y),y-top],[yy-y,bottom-y]]) {
+      if(p===0){if(q<0){enter=2;break;}}else if(p<0)enter=Math.max(enter,q/p);else exit=Math.min(exit,q/p);
+    }
+    if(enter<=exit)return true;
+  }
+  return false;
+}
+
+/** Keep foot corners safely inside the paving, away from the sea-facing wall. */
+function insideShore(x, y) {
+  if (!pointInPolygon(x, y, islandBoundary)) return false;
+  for (let i = 0; i < islandBoundary.length; i++) {
+    const [ax, ay] = islandBoundary[i];
+    const [bx, by] = islandBoundary[(i + 1) % islandBoundary.length];
+    const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
+    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((x - ax) * dx + (y - ay) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy)));
+    if (Math.hypot(x - ax - t * dx, y - ay - t * dy) < shoreClearance) return false;
+  }
+  return true;
+}
+
+/** Validate island containment and all obstacle footprints at an actor location. */
+export function canStandOnIsland(character,x,y,map) {
+  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
+  const sx=(x-map.originX)/islandScale;
+  const sy=(y+size/2-spriteDisplayPadding-map.originY)/islandScale;
+  const rx=size*.12/islandScale, ry=size*.05/islandScale;
+  const corners=[[sx-rx,sy-ry],[sx+rx,sy-ry],[sx+rx,sy+ry],[sx-rx,sy+ry]];
+  return corners.every(([x,y])=>insideShore(x,y)) &&
+    !islandObstacles.some(p=>intersectsBox(p,sx-rx,sy-ry,sx+rx,sy+ry));
+}
+
+/** Find nearby boundary tangents for natural sliding along sloped collision edges. */
+function contactTangents(character, x, y, map) {
+  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
+  const px = (x - map.originX) / islandScale;
+  const py = (y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - map.originY) / islandScale;
+  const reach = Math.hypot(size * .12, size * .05) / islandScale + shoreClearance + 6;
+  const tangents = [];
+  for (const polygon of [islandBoundary, ...islandObstacles]) {
+    for (let i = 0; i < polygon.length; i++) {
+      const [ax, ay] = polygon[i];
+      const [bx, by] = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length];
+      const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
+      const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
+      const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / (length * length)));
+      if (Math.hypot(px - ax - t * dx, py - ay - t * dy) <= reach) {
+        tangents.push([dx / length, dy / length]);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return tangents;
+}
+
+/** Sweep to contact, then project remaining motion onto the actual angled edge. */
+export function resolveIslandMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map) {
+  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(toX - fromX), Math.abs(toY - fromY)) / 6));
+  const dx = (toX - fromX) / steps, dy = (toY - fromY) / steps;
+  let x = fromX, y = fromY;
+  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
+    if (canStandOnIsland(character, x + dx, y + dy, map)) {
+      x += dx; y += dy;
+      continue;
+    }
+    // Reach the edge without crossing it; keep the unapplied movement for sliding.
+    let low = 0, high = 1;
+    for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 10; iteration++) {
+      const fraction = (low + high) / 2;
+      if (canStandOnIsland(character, x + dx * fraction, y + dy * fraction, map)) low = fraction;
+      else high = fraction;
+    }
+    x += dx * low; y += dy * low;
+    const remainingX = dx * (1 - low), remainingY = dy * (1 - low);
+    const candidates = [[remainingX, 0], [0, remainingY]];
+    for (const [tx, ty] of contactTangents(character, x, y, map)) {
+      const along = remainingX * tx + remainingY * ty;
+      candidates.push([tx * along, ty * along]);
+    }
+    let best = [0, 0], bestProgress = 0;
+    for (const [sx, sy] of candidates) {
+      const progress = sx * remainingX + sy * remainingY;
+      if (progress > bestProgress && canStandOnIsland(character, x + sx, y + sy, map)) {
+        best = [sx, sy]; bestProgress = progress;
+      }
+    }
+    x += best[0]; y += best[1];
+  }
+  return { x, y };
+}
+
+/** Draw the entire finite image once; the camera zooms into this world-sized map. */
+export function drawIsland(context,map,camera,debug=false) {
+  context.drawImage(map.image,map.originX-camera.x,map.originY-camera.y,islandWidth,islandHeight);
+  if(debug) {
+    context.save();context.strokeStyle='#ffcf60';context.lineWidth=2;
+    for(const polygon of [islandBoundary,...islandObstacles]) {
+      context.beginPath();polygon.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
+        const args=[map.originX+x*islandScale-camera.x,map.originY+y*islandScale-camera.y];
+        if(i===0)context.moveTo(...args);else context.lineTo(...args);
+      });context.closePath();context.stroke();
+    }context.restore();
+  }
+}
+
+/** Occlude a behind-tower actor only inside its sprite area and the tower silhouette. */
+export function drawTowerOcclusion(context,character,map,camera) {
+  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
+  const foot=(character.y+size/2-spriteDisplayPadding-map.originY)/islandScale;
+  if(foot>=440)return;
+  context.save();
+  context.beginPath();context.rect(character.x-camera.x-size/2,character.y-camera.y-size/2,size,size);context.clip();
+  context.beginPath();towerSilhouette.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
+    const args=[map.originX+x*islandScale-camera.x,map.originY+y*islandScale-camera.y];
+    if(i===0)context.moveTo(...args);else context.lineTo(...args);
+  });context.closePath();context.clip();
+  drawIsland(context,map,camera);context.restore();
+}

+// Stream only the current and fading-out music; never decode whole long tracks.
+export const mapTracks = {
+  first: 'stage 1 - Feverdream.mp3',
+  second: 'stage 2 - PAN PAKA PANNNNNNNNN!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!.mp3',
+  third: 'Stage 3 - new years.mp3',
+  fourth: 'stage 4 - USAGI FLAP.mp3'
+};
+
+// Per-track source volume at 100% on the master slider.
+export const trackVolumeScale = { first: 0.6, second: 1, third: 0.6, fourth: 0.6 };
+
+/** Manage gesture-started looping music, volume, and map-change crossfades. */
+export function createMapAudio(initialMap) {
+  const slider = document.querySelector('#music-volume');
+  const output = document.querySelector('#music-volume-value');
+  const button = document.querySelector('#music-toggle');
+  const status = document.querySelector('#music-status');
+  const fadeDuration = 900; // EDIT milliseconds to match the checkerboard ripple.
+  const tracks = new Map();
+  let mapId = initialMap;
+  let volume = Number(slider.value) / 100;
+  let enabled = true;
+  let unlocked = false;
+  let disposed = false;
+  let blocked = false;
+
+  /** Stop, rewind, and release the media source once its fade has finished. */
+  function stopTrack(id, track) {
+    track.audio.pause();
+    track.audio.currentTime = 0;
+    track.audio.removeAttribute('src');
+    track.audio.load();
+    tracks.delete(id);
+  }
+
+  /** Start only the selected map track, fading every previous one toward silence. */
+  function selectTrack() {
+    for (const track of tracks.values()) {
+      track.from = track.gain;
+      track.target = 0;
+      track.elapsed = 0;
+    }
+    if (!unlocked || !enabled || disposed) return;
+    let track = tracks.get(mapId);
+    if (!track) {
+      const audio = new Audio();
+      audio.preload = 'none';
+      audio.loop = true;
+      audio.volume = 0;
+      audio.src = `../Audio/${encodeURIComponent(mapTracks[mapId])}`;
+      track = { audio, gain: 0, from: 0, target: 1, elapsed: 0, volumeScale: trackVolumeScale[mapId] };
+      tracks.set(mapId, track);
+      const trackMap = mapId;
+      audio.addEventListener('error', () => {
+        if (mapId === trackMap) status.textContent = `Could not load ${mapTracks[trackMap]}.`;
+      });
+    }
+    track.from = track.gain;
+    track.target = 1;
+    track.elapsed = 0;
+    const selectedMap = mapId;
+    track.audio.play().then(() => {
+      if (mapId === selectedMap && enabled) {
+        blocked = false;
+        status.textContent = mapTracks[selectedMap];
+      }
+    }).catch(() => {
+      if (mapId === selectedMap) {
+        blocked = true;
+        button.textContent = 'Play music';
+        status.textContent = 'Press Play music to enable audio.';
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  /** Crossfade to a new map without keeping inactive long recordings playing. */
+  function setMap(id) {
+    if (!mapTracks[id] || id === mapId) return;
+    mapId = id;
+    selectTrack();
+  }
+
+  /** Advance smooth gains and unload tracks that are no longer in use. */
+  function update(delta) {
+    for (const [id, track] of tracks) {
+      track.elapsed += delta * 1000;
+      const t = Math.min(1, track.elapsed / fadeDuration);
+      const eased = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
+      track.gain = track.from + (track.target - track.from) * eased;
+      track.audio.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume * track.volumeScale * track.gain));
+      if (t === 1 && track.target === 0) stopTrack(id, track);
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** Honor browser audio activation by starting on the first user gesture. */
+  function unlock(event) {
+    if (event.target?.closest?.('#music-toggle')) return;
+    if (unlocked || disposed) return;
+    unlocked = true;
+    selectTrack();
+  }
+  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, { once: true });
+  document.addEventListener('keydown', unlock, { once: true });
+
+  slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
+    volume = Number(slider.value) / 100;
+    output.textContent = `${slider.value}%`;
+    for (const track of tracks.values()) track.audio.volume = volume * track.volumeScale * track.gain;
+  });
+  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
+    // The first explicit click enables playback; later clicks toggle it.
+    if (!unlocked || blocked) { unlocked = true; enabled = true; blocked = false; }
+    else enabled = !enabled;
+    button.textContent = enabled ? 'Pause music' : 'Play music';
+    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(enabled));
+    selectTrack();
+  });
+
+  /** Release every track immediately when leaving the preview. */
+  function stopAll() {
+    disposed = true;
+    for (const [id, track] of tracks) stopTrack(id, track);
+  }
+  window.addEventListener('pagehide', stopAll);
+  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
+    if (!document.hidden) return;
+    // Animation frames may pause in background tabs: don't leave old music playing.
+    for (const [id, track] of tracks) {
+      if (track.target === 0) stopTrack(id, track);
+    }
+  });
+  output.textContent = `${slider.value}%`;
+  return { setMap, update, stopAll };
+}

+/** Radial stagger plus checkerboard parity gives each tile its own shrink phase. */
+export function shrinkProgress(elapsed, column, row, columns, rows) {
+  const radius = Math.hypot(column - (columns - 1) / 2, row - (rows - 1) / 2);
+  const delay = radius * 45 + ((column + row) % 2) * 55;
+  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (elapsed - delay) / 420));
+}
+
+/** Capture the old background and shrink its tiles away in a checker ripple. */
+export function createMapTransition(canvas) {
+  let oldScreen;
+  let elapsed = 0;
+  let renderOldBackground;
+  const columns = 12; // EDIT checkerboard density.
+  const rows = 7;
+  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
+
+  /** Snapshot a rendered frame once, rather than allocating images every tick. */
+  function snapshot() {
+    const image = document.createElement('canvas');
+    image.width = canvas.width;
+    image.height = canvas.height;
+    image.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
+    return image;
+  }
+
+  /** Capture the old background after it is drawn without entities or UI. */
+  function begin(renderBackground) {
+    if (oldScreen) return false;
+    oldScreen = snapshot();
+    renderOldBackground = renderBackground;
+    elapsed = 0;
+    return true;
+  }
+
+  /** Shrink old-map squares over the new background; entities/UI are drawn afterward. */
+  function draw(context, delta) {
+    if (!oldScreen) return;
+    elapsed += delta * 1000;
+    if (reducedMotion || elapsed >= 900) {
+      oldScreen = null;
+      renderOldBackground = null;
+      return;
+    }
+    // Reuse one surface, but repaint the outgoing map at the LIVE camera origin.
+    // A frozen snapshot would make characters slide over stationary scenery.
+    if (renderOldBackground) {
+      const layer = oldScreen.getContext('2d');
+      layer.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+      renderOldBackground(layer);
+    }
+    context.save();
+    // The new background is already drawn beneath us; leave the gaps transparent.
+    for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
+      for (let column = 0; column < columns; column++) {
+        const p = shrinkProgress(elapsed, column, row, columns, rows);
+        const x = Math.round(column * canvas.width / columns);
+        const y = Math.round(row * canvas.height / rows);
+        const width = Math.round((column + 1) * canvas.width / columns) - x;
+        const height = Math.round((row + 1) * canvas.height / rows) - y;
+        const scale = 1 - p * p * (3 - 2 * p); // Smoothly shrink from full size to zero.
+        if (scale <= 0) continue;
+        context.save();
+        context.translate(x + width / 2, y + height / 2);
+        context.scale(scale, scale);
+        context.drawImage(oldScreen,
+          x, y, width, height, -width / 2, -height / 2, width, height);
+        context.restore();
+      }
+    }
+    context.restore();
+  }
+
+  /** Discard viewport-sized imagery when the screen is resized. */
+  function cancel() {
+    oldScreen = null;
+    renderOldBackground = null;
+  }
+  return { begin, draw, cancel, get active() { return Boolean(oldScreen); } };
+}

+import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
+import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
+import { damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
+
+// EDIT reaction distance/timing independently of normal chase speed.
+export const contactSettings = {
+  bounce: { distance: 52, travel: 0.18, recovery: 0.6 },
+  push: { distance: 14, travel: 0.09, recovery: 0.18 },
+  cooldown: 0.12,
+  playerDamage: 10, // EDIT default HP lost per accepted contact hit.
+  enemyDamage: 10,
+  iFrameDuration: 0.5 // Seconds; shared protection against every overlapping enemy.
+};
+
+/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
+function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
+  const radius = ((npc.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) +
+    (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)) * 0.18;
+  const fromX = player.x - motion.x, fromY = player.y - motion.y;
+  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
+  const t = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
+    ((npc.x - fromX) * motion.x + (npc.y - fromY) * motion.y) / lengthSquared)) : 1;
+  const dx = npc.x - (fromX + motion.x * t);
+  const dy = npc.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
+  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
+  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
+    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
+  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
+  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
+  return { touching: distance < radius, pushing, radius,
+    nx: distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1,
+    ny: distance > 0.001 ? dy / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.y / fallbackLength : 0 };
+}
+
+/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
+export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move) {
+  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
+  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
+  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0)) {
+    damagePlayer(player, contactSettings.playerDamage);
+    player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;
+    damageEnemy(npc.id, contactSettings.enemyDamage, player);
+    if (npc.hp <= 0) return true;
+  }
+  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
+  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
+    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
+    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
+    const overlap = Math.max(0, hit.radius - Math.hypot(npc.x - player.x, npc.y - player.y));
+    npc.contactReaction = {
+      kind, elapsed: 0, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny,
+      distance: settings.distance + overlap, applied: 0
+    };
+    npc.attack = null;
+  }
+  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
+  if (!reaction) return false;
+  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
+  reaction.elapsed += delta;
+  const t = Math.min(1, reaction.elapsed / settings.travel);
+  const distance = reaction.distance * (1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t));
+  const step = distance - reaction.applied;
+  move(npc, reaction.nx * step, reaction.ny * step);
+  reaction.applied = distance;
+  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
+  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
+  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;
+  if (reaction.elapsed >= recovery) {
+    npc.contactReaction = null;
+    npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
+  }
+  // Bosses still recoil/flash, but do not skip their AI update or wait afterward.
+  return pauseChase;
+}

+  function update(delta, playerMotion = { x: 0, y: 0 }) {

+          const targetY = player.y + (npc.chaseOffsetY || 0);
+          const dx = targetX - npc.x, dy = targetY - npc.y;
+          // Chase the center exactly; quantize only the animation facing.
+          // Physical movement uses the full target vector, including small gaps.
+          if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
+            const angle = Math.atan2(dx, -dy);
+            direction = names[(Math.round(angle / (Math.PI / 4)) + 8) % 8];
+            chaseTarget = { x: targetX, y: targetY };

+          }

+        }
+      }

+        // A chasing NPC can reach contact during this step, even with a stationary player.
+        updateNpcContact(npc, player, playerMotion, 0, moveNpcBy);

+    }
