+import { umbrellaSettings, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
+export { umbrellaSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
+import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+import { umbrellaLevelStats, rollUmbrellaDamage } from './weapon-progression.js';
+import { statMultiplier, ensureCombatStats } from './combat-stats.js';
+
+// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start:
+// 1.5 seconds total = 0.2 seconds swinging + 1.3 seconds before the next swing.
+const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };
+
+/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â° sweep. */
+export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed, duration = umbrellaSettings.duration) {
+  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / duration));
+  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
+  const arc = umbrellaSettings.arcDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
+  return aim - arc / 2 + eased * arc;
+}
+
+/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
+export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle, areaScale = 1) {
+  areaScale *= umbrellaSettings.sizeScale;
+  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
+  const dx = body.x - player.x, dy = body.y - player.y;
+  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
+  const radius = Math.max(body.rx, body.ry);
+  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale + radius) return false;
+  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale) return false;
+  // Subdivide the swept sector into blade segments at most 2 degrees apart.
+  const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(toAngle - fromAngle) / (Math.PI / 90)));
+  for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
+    const angle = fromAngle + (toAngle - fromAngle) * i / samples;
+    const x = Math.cos(angle), y = Math.sin(angle);
+    if (segmentHitsBody(body,
+      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale,
+      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale)) return true;
+  }
+  return false;
+}
+
+/** Load the umbrella and own its repeating attack, hit tracking, and motion trail. */
+export function createUmbrellaAttack() {
+  const image = new Image();
+  image.src = '../sprites/attacks/plana umbrella.png';
+  const ready = image.decode();
+  // Composite the dense trail first, then blur once instead of per afterimage.
+  const trailCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
+  const trailCenter = Math.ceil(umbrellaSettings.reach + umbrellaSettings.trailBlur * 4 + 8);
+  trailCanvas.width = trailCanvas.height = trailCenter * 2;
+  const trailContext = trailCanvas.getContext('2d');
+  let autoattackEnabled = true;
+  let owner;
+  let cycle = 0;
+  let swing;
+  let clock = 0;
+  const hitTimes = new Map();
+
+  /** Cancel attacks on avatar/loadout changes and start one sweep per configured attack interval. */
+  function update(delta, player, aim) {
+    if (!autoattackEnabled) return;
+    const equipped = player.attackSlots?.some(item => item?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
+    if (!equipped) { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); return; }
+    if (owner !== player) { owner = player; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); }
+    clock += delta;
+    for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > umbrellaSettings.interval+umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown) hitTimes.delete(id);
+    cycle = Math.max(0, cycle - delta);
+    if (!swing && cycle <= 0) {
+      const haste = 1; // Haste changes attack intervals, never swing duration or trails.
+      const upgrades = umbrellaLevelStats(player);
+      swing = { aim, areaScale: upgrades.areaScale, awakened: upgrades.awakened, elapsed: 0, previous: umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, 0), hits: new Set(), haste,
+        duration: umbrellaSettings.duration / haste, linger: umbrellaSettings.trailLinger / haste };
+      cycle = attackTimeFormula(umbrellaSettings.interval * upgrades.intervalMultiplier, ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
+    }
+    if (swing) {
+      const wasAttacking = swing.elapsed < swing.duration;
+      swing.elapsed += delta;
+      const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed, swing.duration);
+      for (const enemy of wasAttacking ? getAllEnemies() : []) {
+        if (!swing.hits.has(enemy.id) && clock - (hitTimes.get(enemy.id) ?? -Infinity) >= umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown - 1e-8 && umbrellaHits(player, enemy, swing.previous, angle, swing.areaScale)) {
+          swing.hits.add(enemy.id);
+          hitTimes.set(enemy.id, clock);
+          const hit = rollUmbrellaDamage(player, undefined, Math.random, 1, enemy);
+          damageEnemy(enemy.id, hit.damage, player, hit.type, { canMiss: true });
+        }
+      }
+      swing.previous = angle;
+      if (swing.elapsed >= swing.duration + swing.linger) swing = null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** Draw one handle-anchored closed umbrella pose, pointing along the swing. */
+  function drawBlade(context, angle, alpha) {
+    context.save();
+    context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
+    context.globalAlpha = alpha;
+    const length = umbrellaSettings.reach - umbrellaSettings.baseRadius;
+    const width = length * crop.width / crop.height;
+    if (swing.awakened && alpha === 1) { context.shadowColor = '#ffe271'; context.shadowBlur = 5; }
+    context.drawImage(image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
+      -width / 2, -umbrellaSettings.reach, width, length);
+    context.restore();
+  }
+
+  /** Blur original umbrella sprite afterimages across the full sweep, without color overlays. */
+  function draw(outputContext, camera) {
+    if (!swing || !image.naturalWidth) return;
+    const context = trailContext;
+    context.clearRect(0, 0, trailCanvas.width, trailCanvas.height);
+    context.save();
+    context.translate(trailCenter, trailCenter);
+    const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed, swing.duration);
+    const visualTime = Math.min(swing.elapsed, swing.duration);
+    const fade = (1 - Math.max(0, (swing.elapsed - swing.duration) / swing.linger)) ** 1.5;
+    // Sample by ANGLE, not time: fast parts of the swing need more overlapping
+    // poses, otherwise evenly timed ghosts separate into individual umbrellas.
+    // Retain sprite afterimages across the whole travelled sweep. Their natural
+    // dark/magenta colors come directly from the umbrella artwork, with no tint.
+    const trailStart = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, 0, swing.duration);
+    const span = angle - trailStart;
+    const samples = Math.min(umbrellaSettings.maxAfterimages,
+      Math.ceil(span / umbrellaSettings.trailAngleStep));
+    for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
+      const weight = i / samples;
+      drawBlade(context, trailStart + span * weight,
+        (0.018 + 0.032 * weight * weight) * fade);
+    }
+    context.restore();
+    outputContext.save();
+    outputContext.translate(owner.x - camera.x, owner.y - camera.y);
+    const size = swing.areaScale * umbrellaSettings.sizeScale;
+    outputContext.scale(size, size);
+    outputContext.filter = `blur(${umbrellaSettings.trailBlur}px)`;
+    outputContext.drawImage(trailCanvas, -trailCenter, -trailCenter);
+    outputContext.filter = 'none';
+    // The actual umbrella ends on time; only its soft trail lingers afterward.
+    if (swing.elapsed < swing.duration) drawBlade(outputContext, angle, 1);
+    outputContext.restore();
+  }
+
+  /** Clear a pending swing when the scene is reset. */
+  function reset() { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); }
+  return { ready, update, draw, reset,
+    /** Stop the current swing immediately; this toggle does not control EX skills. */
+    setAutoattackEnabled(enabled) { autoattackEnabled=Boolean(enabled); if(!autoattackEnabled) reset(); }
+  };
+}

+import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, umbrellaSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
+
+/** Locate Plana's equipped umbrella without selecting or switching active weapons. */
+export function getUmbrella(player) {
+  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
+}
+
+/** Cumulative weapon-level bonuses; awakening is a separate state after level seven. */
+export function umbrellaLevelStats(player) {
+  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, getUmbrella(player)?.level || 1));
+  const damageTiers = Number(level >= 2) + Number(level >= 5);
+  const areaTiers = Number(level >= 3) + Number(level >= 6);
+  return {
+    level, damageMultiplier: (1 + umbrellaUpgradeSettings.damageIncrease) ** damageTiers,
+    areaScale: Math.sqrt(1 + areaTiers * umbrellaUpgradeSettings.areaIncrease),
+    intervalMultiplier: level >= 4 ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.intervalMultiplier : 1,
+    guaranteedCritical: level >= 7,
+    awakened: Boolean(getUmbrella(player)?.awakened)
+  };
+}
+
+/** Nominal weapon damage only; all variation is applied after character ATK. */
+export function umbrellaBaseDamage() {
+  return umbrellaSettings.damage * umbrellaSettings.damageMultiplier;
+}
+
+/** Apply weapon upgrades first, then player ATK and the appropriate critical multiplier. */
+export function rollUmbrellaDamage(player, base = umbrellaBaseDamage(), random = Math.random, damageMod = 1, target) {
+  const stats = umbrellaLevelStats(player);
+  const hit=rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'plana-umbrella', base / 10,
+    [ (stats.damageMultiplier - 1) * 100 ], { projectileCount: 1, hitCooldownFrames: umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, {
+    damageMod, target, forceCritical: stats.guaranteedCritical,
+    criticalMultiplier: stats.guaranteedCritical ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.finalCriticalMultiplier : undefined
+  });
+  if(stats.guaranteedCritical && hit.critical)hit.type='supercritical';
+  return hit;
+}

+}

+/** At 90% capacity, remove farthest non-bosses until population reaches 70%. */
+export function trimEnemyPopulation(player) {
+  const settings = enemyPopulationSettings;
+  if (enemies.size < Math.ceil(settings.limit * settings.trimAt)) return 0;
+  const target = Math.floor(settings.limit * settings.trimTo);
+  const candidates = [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy => !isBossEnemy(enemy) && !enemy.campaignRowId && !['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type))
+    .sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(b.x - player.x, b.y - player.y) - Math.hypot(a.x - player.x, a.y - player.y));
+  let removed = 0;
+  for (const enemy of candidates) {
+    if (enemies.size <= target) break;
+    enemies.delete(enemy.id);
+    removed++;
+  }
+  return removed;
+}
+
+
+/** Rescale health proportionally, keeping admin1HP baselines synchronized for later restore. */
+export function rescaleEnemyHealth(enemy, maxHp) {
+  const health = savedEnemyHealth.get(enemy) ?? enemy;
+  const ratio = health.maxHp > 0 ? health.hp/health.maxHp : 1;
+  const updated = {maxHp, hp:Math.max(1, Math.round(maxHp*ratio))};
+  if (savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, updated);
+  else Object.assign(enemy, updated);
+}

+import { enemyViewportDistance } from './world-state.js';
+import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
+import { yuukaSpawnChanceFormula, yuukaSpawnSettings, harmlessEnemySettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { yuukaHpFormula } from './game-config.js';
+import { yuukaSettings } from './game-config.js';
+export { yuukaSettings } from './game-config.js';
+// Balance and automatic spawn probability live in game-config.js.
+
+
+/** Harmless enemies use fixed HP; running offscreen normally ends their visit. */
+export function yuukaHealth(playerDamage) {
+  return harmlessEnemySettings.hp;
+}
+
+/** Frequently change heading, steering back toward the player when wandering too far. */
+export function yuukaMotion(enemy, player, delta, random = Math.random) {
+  enemy.erraticTimer = (enemy.erraticTimer || 0) - delta;
+  if (enemy.erraticTimer <= 0) {
+    enemy.erraticTimer = yuukaSettings.turnMin + random() * (yuukaSettings.turnMax - yuukaSettings.turnMin);
+    const dx = player.x - enemy.x, dy = player.y - enemy.y;
+    enemy.erraticAngle = Math.hypot(dx, dy) > yuukaSettings.roamRadius
+      ? Math.atan2(dy, dx) + (random() - 0.5) * 2 : random() * Math.PI * 2;
+  }
+  const angle = enemy.erraticAngle;
+  const names = ['right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft','up','upRight'];
+  return { direction: names[(Math.round(angle / (Math.PI / 4)) + 8) % 8],
+    target: { x: enemy.x + Math.cos(angle) * 10000, y: enemy.y + Math.sin(angle) * 10000 } };
+}
+
+/** Track eligible kills since Yuuka last spawned; successful spawns reset cooldown and pity. */
+export function createYuukaSpawnCharge() {
+  let kills = 0;
+  let hasSpawned = false;
+  return {
+    recordKill() { kills++; },
+    recordSpawn() { kills = 0; hasSpawned = true; },
+    get kills() { return kills; },
+    get remainingCooldown() {
+      return Math.max(0, (hasSpawned ? Math.max(yuukaSpawnSettings.unlockKills, yuukaSpawnSettings.cooldownKills)
+        : yuukaSpawnSettings.unlockKills) - kills);
+    },
+    get chance() { return yuukaSpawnChanceFormula(kills, hasSpawned); },
+    chanceWithBoss(bossActive) { return yuukaSpawnChanceFormula(kills, hasSpawned, bossActive); },
+    roll(random = Math.random, bossActive = false) {
+      return this.remainingCooldown === 0 && random() < this.chanceWithBoss(bossActive);
+    }
+  };
+}
+
+/** Roam until lifetime expiry, then run toward an edge before despawning. */
+export function updateYuukaPresence(enemy, camera, width, height, delta, random = Math.random) {
+  if (!['yuuka', 'sensei'].includes(enemy.type) || delta <= 0) return false;
+  enemy.yuukaAge = (enemy.yuukaAge || 0) + delta;
+  const distance = enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height);
+  if (enemy.yuukaAge >= harmlessEnemySettings.lifetimeSeconds) {
+    enemy.harmlessEscaping = true;
+    enemy.ai = true;
+    // Choose the nearest screen edge and continue running out instead of popping away.
+    enemy.erraticAngle ??= 0;
+    if (enemy.escapeAngle === undefined) {
+      const edges = [
+        {distance: Math.abs(enemy.x-camera.x), angle: Math.PI},
+        {distance: Math.abs(enemy.x-camera.x-width), angle: 0},
+        {distance: Math.abs(enemy.y-camera.y), angle: -Math.PI/2},
+        {distance: Math.abs(enemy.y-camera.y-height), angle: Math.PI/2}
+      ].sort((a,b)=>a.distance-b.distance);
+      enemy.escapeAngle = edges[0].angle;
+    }
+    enemy.erraticAngle = enemy.escapeAngle;
+    enemy.erraticTimer = 1;
+    return distance > 0; // Only remove once the entire sprite is beyond the viewport.
+  }
+  if (distance > yuukaSettings.protectedOffscreenLimit) {
+    enemy.erraticAngle = Math.atan2(playerCenterY(camera,height)-enemy.y, camera.x+width/2-enemy.x);
+    enemy.erraticTimer = 1;
+  }
+  return false;
+}
+
+/** Automatic spawning waits until all living Yuukas, including manual instances, are gone. */
+export function canSpawnYuuka(enemies) {
+  return !enemies.some(enemy => enemy.type === 'yuuka');
+}
+
+
+function playerCenterY(camera, height) { return camera.y + height / 2; }
+
+/** Each timestamp is rolled once; a frame crossing the timestamp cannot miss the roll. */
+export function createHarmlessSpawnSchedule(random = Math.random) {
+  const used = new Set();
+  return {
+    update(seconds, spawn) {
+      for (const type of ['yuuka', 'sensei']) {
+        for (const timestamp of harmlessEnemySettings[`${type}SpawnSeconds`]) {
+          const key = `${type}:${timestamp}`;
+          if (seconds < timestamp || used.has(key)) continue;
+          used.add(key);
+          if (random() < harmlessEnemySettings[`${type}Chance`]) spawn(type);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  };
+}

+The login page offers **Continue as guest**, followed by an explicit warning that upgrades, progress and other game data will not be saved. +// This tab-scoped marker identifies guest navigation; it never stores game progress.
+const guestSessionKey = 'schale.guestSession';
+
+/** Check whether this tab entered through the confirmed guest option. */
+export function isGuestSession() {
+  try { return sessionStorage.getItem(guestSessionKey) === '1'; }
+  catch { return false; }
+}
+
+/** Begin guest access without creating a Firebase account or saving upgrades. */
+export function startGuestSession() {
+  sessionStorage.setItem(guestSessionKey, '1');
+}
+
+/** Return to account mode after a successful sign-in or registration. */
+export function endGuestSession() {
+  try { sessionStorage.removeItem(guestSessionKey); }
+  catch { /* Storage may be disabled; an absent guest marker is already account mode. */ }
+}

+/** Rotate the login art without disturbing the form or its diagonal background fade. */
+function startLoginSplash() {
+  const container=document.querySelector('.login-splash');
+  if(!container)return;
+  const images=[...container.querySelectorAll('img')];
+  let current=0,timer=null,transitioning=false;
+
+  /** Reveal the next decoded image from the left over the still-visible current artwork. */
+  function showNext() {
+    if(document.hidden||transitioning)return;
+    const next=(current+1)%images.length;
+    if(!images[next].complete||!images[next].naturalWidth)return;
+    transitioning=true;
+    images[next].classList.add('is-entering');
+  }
+
+  /** Promote the incoming layer only after its reveal finishes, avoiding a blank frame. */
+  container.addEventListener('animationend',event=>{
+    if(!event.target.classList.contains('is-entering'))return;
+    images[current].classList.remove('is-current');
+    current=images.indexOf(event.target);
+    images[current].classList.add('is-current');
+    images[current].classList.remove('is-entering');
+    transitioning=false;
+  });
+
+  /** Restart the ten-second interval after returning to the tab; never queue missed changes. */
+  function resume() {
+    clearInterval(timer);
+    if(!document.hidden)timer=setInterval(showNext,10000);
+  }
+  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',resume);
+  window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>clearInterval(timer));
+  window.addEventListener('pageshow',resume);
+  // Decode up front so a large splash cannot flash or stall when first revealed.
+  Promise.allSettled(images.map(image=>image.decode())).then(resume);
+}
+
+startLoginSplash();

diff --git a/Development/enemy-spatial-index.js b/Development/enemy-spatial-index.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ea3763f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Development/enemy-spatial-index.js
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+/** Conservative broadphase only; callers retain their existing exact collision tests. */
+export function createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies, getBounds, cellSize=128) {
+  const cells=new Map();
+  enemies.forEach((enemy,order)=>{
+    const b=getBounds(enemy),entry={enemy,order};
+    for(let y=Math.floor((b.y-b.ry)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((b.y+b.ry)/cellSize);y++)
+      for(let x=Math.floor((b.x-b.rx)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((b.x+b.rx)/cellSize);x++) {
+        const key=x+','+y;
+        let bucket=cells.get(key);if(!bucket)cells.set(key,bucket=[]);
+        bucket.push(entry);
+      }
+  });
+  return {querySegment(from,to,padding=0) {
+    const found=new Set();
+    for(let y=Math.floor((Math.min(from.y,to.y)-padding)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.y,to.y)+padding)/cellSize);y++)
+      for(let x=Math.floor((Math.min(from.x,to.x)-padding)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.x,to.x)+padding)/cellSize);x++)
+        for(const entry of cells.get(x+','+y)||[])found.add(entry);
+    // Preserve Map insertion order: piercing limits and random damage rolls depend on it.
+    return [...found].sort((a,b)=>a.order-b.order).map(entry=>entry.enemy);
+  }};
+}

+/** Switch only the background/scrolling axis; entities keep their world positions. */
+function switchMap(targetMap = null) {
+  if (!mapTransition || mapTransition.active || !maps.first.image) return;
+  planaSkill?.reset();
+  arisAttack?.reset();
+  luminousAttack?.reset();
+  princessAttack?.reset();
+  princessSkill?.reset();
+  // Snapshot BACKGROUND ONLY. Characters, NPCs, and aim graphics are drawn later.
+  context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+  drawPlayarea();
+  const outgoingMap = currentMap;
+  mapTransition.begin(layer => drawPlayarea(layer, outgoingMap));
+  const player = characters[selected];
+  // Retain the current camera origin and player screen position on the new axis.
+  cameraAnchor.x = player.x - camera.x;
+  cameraAnchor.y = player.y - camera.y;
+  const mapOrder = ['first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth'].filter(id => !maps[id].disabled);
+  const requested = typeof targetMap === 'string' && maps[targetMap] && !maps[targetMap].disabled
+    ? targetMap : mapOrder[(mapOrder.indexOf(currentMap) + 1) % mapOrder.length];
+  if (currentMap !== requested) stageEnteredAt = survivalClock.seconds;
+  currentMap = requested;
+  if (campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode) campaignSchedule.setStage(currentMap);
+  if (currentMap === 'fourth' && !maps.fourth.placed) {
+    // Anchor the island's open central plaza under the player on first entry.
+    // This positions the MAP, preserving existing player/NPC world coordinates.
+    maps.fourth.originX = player.x - 740 * islandScale;
+    maps.fourth.originY = player.y + (player.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2 - spritePadding - 620 * islandScale;
+    maps.fourth.placed = true;
+  }
+  // Align the new map on its locked axis at the retained camera origin.
+  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'vertical') maps[currentMap].originX = camera.x;
+  else if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'horizontal') maps[currentMap].originY = camera.y;
+  updateCamera();
+  npcTools?.cleanup();
+  expPickups?.clear();
+  crafters?.clear();
+  goldenCrafters?.clear();
+  awaitingFileStageAdvance=false;
+  gachaFiles?.clear();
+  mapAudio?.setMap(currentMap);
+  // Keep held inputs, attack timers, AI and aiming live throughout the transition.
+  document.querySelector('#switch-map').textContent = `Switch map (current: ${maps[currentMap].label})`;
+  return true;
+}

+document.querySelector('#switch-map').addEventListener('click', switchMap);

+/** Reset character positions and horizontal camera without changing sprite settings. */
+function resetScene() {
+  planaSkill?.reset();
+  arisAttack?.reset();
+  luminousAttack?.reset();
+  princessAttack?.reset();
+  princessSkill?.reset();
+  umbrellaAttack?.reset();
+  aiming?.reset();
+  releaseControls();
+  for (const character of Object.values(characters)) {
+    character.x = canvas.width * 0.4;
+    character.y = canvas.height * 0.6;
+    if (currentMap === 'first') character.y += maps.first.originY;
+    if (currentMap === 'second') character.x += maps.second.originX;
+    if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
+      character.x = maps.fourth.originX + 740 * islandScale;
+      character.y = maps.fourth.originY + 620 * islandScale - (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2 + spritePadding;
+    }
+    character.direction = character.defaultDirection || 'down';
+    if (character.horizontalFacingOnly) character.facing = character.direction;
+    character.elapsed = 0;
+    character.moving = false;
+    character.attack = null;
+    character.transition = null;
+  }
+  camera.x = 0;
+  camera.y = 0;
+  cameraAnchor.x = canvas.width / 2;
+  cameraAnchor.y = canvas.height / 2;
+  updateCamera();
+  updateAttackControls();
+}
+
+/** Follow the active character through positive and negative world coordinates. */
+function updateCamera(delta = 0) {
+  // Ease the retained screen anchor toward center after changing map axes.
+  // World coordinates never change; the entire scene follows the same camera.
+  const blend = 1 - Math.exp(-cameraRecenterSpeed * delta);
+  cameraAnchor.x += (canvas.width / 2 - cameraAnchor.x) * blend;
+  cameraAnchor.y += (canvas.height / 2 - cameraAnchor.y) * blend;
+  camera.x = characters[selected].x - cameraAnchor.x;
+  camera.y = characters[selected].y - cameraAnchor.y;
+  clampStripCamera(maps[currentMap], camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
+    const map = maps.fourth;
+    camera.x = Math.max(map.originX, Math.min(map.originX + islandWidth - canvas.width, camera.x));
+    camera.y = Math.max(map.originY, Math.min(map.originY + islandHeight - canvas.height, camera.y));
+  }
+}
+
+/** Compute only visible tile indices, including negative indices left of origin. */
+function getVisibleTileRange(cameraX, viewportWidth, tileWidth) {
+  return {
+    first: Math.floor(cameraX / tileWidth),
+    last: Math.ceil((cameraX + viewportWidth) / tileWidth) - 1
+  };
+}
+
+/** Render a bounded number of tiles from one shared image, however far we travel. */
+function drawPlayarea(target = context, mapId = currentMap) {
+  const map = maps[mapId];
+  if (mapId === 'first') {
+    drawOfficeWorld(target, map, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (mapId === 'second') {
+    drawPalaceWorld(target, map, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (map.axis === 'island') {
+    target.fillStyle = '#087fb9';
+    target.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+    drawIsland(target, map, camera);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (map.axis === 'both') {
+    drawTileWorld(target, map.tiles, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+    return;
+  }
+  const scale = map.axis === 'horizontal'
+    ? canvas.height * mapSizeMultiplier / map.image.naturalHeight
+    : canvas.width * mapSizeMultiplier / map.image.naturalWidth;
+  const tileWidth = map.image.naturalWidth * scale;
+  const tileHeight = map.image.naturalHeight * scale;
+  const offsetX = camera.x - map.originX;
+  const offsetY = camera.y - map.originY;
+  const columns = getVisibleTileRange(offsetX, canvas.width, tileWidth);
+  const rows = getVisibleTileRange(offsetY, canvas.height, tileHeight);
+  // Only the long axis repeats. Outgoing transition layers may repeat for coverage.
+  if (mapId === currentMap && map.axis === 'horizontal') rows.first = rows.last = 0;
+  if (mapId === currentMap && map.axis === 'vertical') columns.first = columns.last = 0;
+  // Normally only the map's scrolling axis changes. During a transition the
+  // outgoing map also follows the new camera axis; visible repeats avoid gaps.
+  for (let row = rows.first; row <= rows.last; row++) {
+    for (let column = columns.first; column <= columns.last; column++) {
+      const left = Math.round(column * tileWidth - offsetX);
+      const top = Math.round(row * tileHeight - offsetY);
+      const right = Math.round((column + 1) * tileWidth - offsetX);
+      const bottom = Math.round((row + 1) * tileHeight - offsetY);
+      target.drawImage(map.image, left, top, right - left, bottom - top);
+    }
+  }
+}

+/** Load a sheet before animation begins and report an actionable loading error. */
+async function loadSheet(character) {
+  if (character.gifFrames) {
+    await loadGifAnimation(character);
+    const actions=character.label==='Arisu Boss'?{charge:bossActionFrames.arisuCharge}:
+      character.label==='Neru Boss'?{shoot:bossActionFrames.neruShoot}:{};
+    character.actionAnimations={};
+    await Promise.all(Object.entries(actions).map(async ([name,gifFrames])=>{
+      const clip={gifFrames};await loadGifAnimation(clip);character.actionAnimations[name]=clip.animationFrames;
+    }));
+    return;
+  }
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const image = new Image();
+    image.onload = () => {
+      character.image = image;
+      resolve();
+    };
+    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${character.source}.`));
+    image.src = character.source;
+  });
+}
+
+/** Resolve keyboard input to one of the four supported movement directions. */
+function directionForKey(key) {
+  return {
+    ArrowUp: 'up', w: 'up', ArrowDown: 'down', s: 'down',
+    ArrowLeft: 'left', a: 'left', ArrowRight: 'right', d: 'right'
+  }[key.length === 1 ? key.toLowerCase() : key];
+}
+
+/** Clear held input when focus is lost so characters cannot get stuck moving. */
+function releaseControls() {
+  heldDirections.clear();
+}
+
+window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
+  if (isGameplayPaused()) return;
+  // Let admin form fields use their own arrow keys and text input.
+  if (event.target?.closest('input, select, textarea')) return;
+  const direction = directionForKey(event.key);
+  if (!direction) return;
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!event.repeat) heldDirections.set(event.code, direction);
+});
+
+window.addEventListener('keyup', event => {
+  heldDirections.delete(event.code);
+});
+
+window.addEventListener('blur', releaseControls);
+document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', releaseControls);
+
+/** Swap the development avatar in place, keeping one visible camera target. */
+function switchCharacter(name) {
+  if (!characters[name] || name === selected) return;
+  const previous = characters[selected];
+  const next = characters[name];
+
+  // Carry the player position across so swapping does not jump the camera.
+  next.x = previous.x;
+  next.y = previous.y;
+  next.direction = previous.direction;
+  if (next.horizontalFacingOnly) {
+    const horizontal = directionVectors[previous.direction][0];
+    if (horizontal) next.facing = horizontal > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
+  }
+  next.elapsed = 0;
+  next.moving = false;
+  previous.elapsed = 0;
+  previous.moving = false;
+  previous.attack = null;
+  previous.transition = null;
+  next.attack = null;
+  next.transition = null;
+  selected = name;
+  releaseControls();
+  updateCamera();
+  updateAttackControls();
+
+  document.querySelectorAll('[data-character]').forEach(button => {
+    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.character === selected));
+  });
+}
+
+/** Reveal boss-only attack buttons and prevent overlapping attack cycles. */
+function updateAttackControls() {
+  const character = characters[selected];
+  document.querySelector('#boss-attacks').hidden = !character.attacks;
+  document.querySelectorAll('[data-attack]').forEach(button => {
+    button.disabled = Boolean(character.attack) || !character.attacks?.[button.dataset.attack];
+  });
+}
+
+/** Play one complete facing-specific attack animation, holding the boss in place. */
+function startBossAttack(name) {
+  const character = characters[selected];
+  if (!character.attacks?.[name] || character.attack) return;
+  beginPoseTransition(character);
+  character.attack = { name, facing: character.facing, elapsed: 0, walkElapsed: character.elapsed };
+  character.moving = false;
+  updateAttackControls();
+}
+
+document.querySelectorAll('[data-attack]').forEach(button => {
+  button.addEventListener('click', () => startBossAttack(button.dataset.attack));
+});
+
+document.querySelectorAll('[data-character]').forEach(button => {
+  // Development-only selection; the future game character picker is not built yet.
+  button.addEventListener('click', () => switchCharacter(button.dataset.character));
+});
+
+document.querySelectorAll('[data-direction]').forEach(button => {
+  // Pointer capture lets touch and mouse controls release outside the button.
+  button.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
+    button.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
+    heldDirections.set(`pointer-${event.pointerId}`, button.dataset.direction);
+  });
+  for (const type of ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture']) {
+    button.addEventListener(type, event => {
+      heldDirections.delete(`pointer-${event.pointerId}`);
+    });
+  }
+});
+
+/** Combine held inputs into eight directions; opposite inputs cancel each other. */
+function getMovementDirection() {
+  let x = 0;
+  let y = 0;
+  // A held W and ArrowUp count as one direction rather than double speed.
+  for (const direction of new Set(heldDirections.values())) {
+    const vector = directionVectors[direction];
+    x += vector[0];
+    y += vector[1];
+  }
+  x = Math.sign(x);
+  y = Math.sign(y);
+  return Object.keys(directionVectors).find(direction => {
+    const vector = directionVectors[direction];
+    return vector[0] === x && vector[1] === y;
+  });
+}
+
+/** Stop at walls without relocating a player already outside after switching maps. */
+function constrainWithoutTeleport(previous, next, minimum, maximum) {
+  if (previous < minimum) return Math.min(minimum, Math.max(previous, next));
+  if (previous > maximum) return Math.max(maximum, Math.min(previous, next));
+  return Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, next));
+}
+
+/** Move within canvas bounds, keeping diagonal and cardinal movement equally fast. */
+function updateCharacter(character, delta, direction, chaseTarget) {
+  if (character.attack) {
+    character.attack.elapsed += delta * 1000;
+    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
+    const frames = character.layout.columnEdges.length - 1;
+    if (character.attack.elapsed >= frames * attack.frameDuration) {
+      const walkElapsed = character.attack.walkElapsed;
+      beginPoseTransition(character);
+      character.attack = null;
+      character.elapsed = walkElapsed;
+      updateAttackControls();
+    } else {
+      return;
+    }
+  }
+  character.moving = Boolean(direction);
+  if (!direction) {
+    character.elapsed = 0;
+    return;
+  }
+
+  // Arona turns at the current stride phase rather than snapping to frame zero.
+  if (character.direction !== direction && !character.preserveWalkPhase) {
+    character.elapsed = 0;
+  }
+  character.direction = direction;
+  if (character.horizontalFacingOnly) {
+    const horizontal = directionVectors[direction][0];
+    if (horizontal) {
+      const facing = horizontal > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
+      if (facing !== character.facing) beginPoseTransition(character);
+      character.facing = facing;
+    }
+  }
+  character.elapsed += delta * 1000;
+  // Chase uses the precise center-to-center vector; facing stays eight-way.
+  const [x, y] = chaseTarget
+    ? [chaseTarget.x - character.x, chaseTarget.y - character.y]
+    : directionVectors[direction];
+  const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
+  const baseSpeed = movementSpeed * (character.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(character, 'spdPercent');
+  const step = Math.max(baseSpeed, character.catchupSpeed || 0) * delta;
+  const distance = (chaseTarget ? Math.min(step, length) : step) / (length || 1);
+  const previousX = character.x;
+  const previousY = character.y;
+  character.x += x * distance;
+  character.y += y * distance;
+  if (chaseTarget && step >= length) {
+    character.x = chaseTarget.x;
+    character.y = chaseTarget.y;
+  }
+  const isEnemy = character !== characters[selected];
+  if (character.harmlessEscaping || character.behavior === 'horde') return; // Escape animations may cross the shoreline/walls to leave view.
+  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
+    const resolved = resolveIslandMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.fourth, isEnemy);
+    character.x = resolved.x;
+    character.y = resolved.y;
+    return;
+  }
+  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'both') {
+    if (isEnemy) return; // Enemies cross props; the player still collides normally.
+    const resolved = resolveObstacleMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y);
+    character.x = resolved.x;
+    character.y = resolved.y;
+    return;
+  }
+  if (currentMap === 'first' && !isEnemy) {
+    const resolved = resolveOfficeMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.first, canvas.height);
+    character.x = resolved.x;
+    character.y = resolved.y;
+  }
+  if (currentMap === 'second' && !isEnemy) {
+    const resolved = resolvePalaceMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.second, canvas.width);
+    character.x = resolved.x;
+    character.y = resolved.y;
+  }
+  // Neither map's locked-axis limits should interrupt diagonal input while the
+  // backgrounds are changing. Apply destination walls only after the ripple.
+  // Existing outside positions are preserved by constrainWithoutTeleport below.
+  if (mapTransition?.active) return;
+  const margin = (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2;
+  const bounds = stripMapBounds(maps[currentMap], canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
+  // X is an unbounded world position, not a canvas position. Never wrap it:
+  // future enemy positions must remain stable when background tiles disappear.
+  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'horizontal') {
+    character.y = constrainWithoutTeleport(previousY, character.y, bounds.top + margin, bounds.bottom - margin);
+  } else {
+    character.x = constrainWithoutTeleport(previousX, character.x, bounds.left + margin, bounds.right - margin);
+  }
+}
+
+/** Return a source rectangle using the sheet's uneven per-column row boundaries. */
+function getFrameRectangle(character, frame) {
+  const facing = character.horizontalFacingOnly ? character.facing : character.direction;
+  const row = character.attack
+    ? character.attacks[character.attack.name].rows[character.attack.facing]
+    : !character.moving && character.idleRows?.[facing] !== undefined
+    ? character.idleRows[facing]
+    : character.rows[facing];
+  // Attack artwork can exceed the grid cell. Custom rectangles keep the tank's
+  // anchor fixed even when a muzzle flash needs a wider crop.
+  const custom = character.layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
+  if (custom) return custom;
+  const { columnEdges, rowEdges } = character.layout;
+  return {
+    x: columnEdges[frame],
+    y: rowEdges[frame][row],
+    width: columnEdges[frame + 1] - columnEdges[frame],
+    height: rowEdges[frame][row + 1] - rowEdges[frame][row],
+    anchorX: character.layout.anchorX?.[row]?.[frame],
+    footY: character.layout.footY?.[frame]?.[row] ?? rowEdges[frame][row + 1]
+  };
+}
+
+/** Select a direction-specific walking cycle, or hold frame zero when idle. */
+function getAnimationFrame(character) {
+  if (character.attack) {
+    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
+    return Math.min(character.layout.columnEdges.length - 2,
+      Math.floor(character.attack.elapsed / attack.frameDuration));
+  }
+  if (!character.moving) return 0;
+  const frames = character.walkFrames?.[character.direction] ||
+    character.frameSequence || [1, 2, 3, 4];
+  const duration = character.frameDuration || frameDuration;
+  return frames[Math.floor(character.elapsed / duration) % frames.length];
+}
+
+/** Blend from the last visible pose without moving the character's world anchor. */
+function beginPoseTransition(character) {
+  if (character.transitionDuration && character.lastPose) {
+    character.transition = { from: character.lastPose, elapsed: 0 };
+  }
+}
+
+/** Render one pose with shared scale and measured foot anchors, including effects. */
+function drawPose(character, pose, opacity) {
+  opacity *= character.death?.opacity ?? 1;
+  const crop = pose.crop;
+  const displaySize = character.spriteSize || spriteSize;
+  const scale = (displaySize - spritePadding * 2) / (character.referenceSize || 215);
+  const width = crop.width * scale;
+  const height = crop.height * scale;
+  const drawY = displaySize / 2 - spritePadding - (crop.footY - crop.y) * scale + enemyBounceOffset(character);
+  const drawX = crop.anchorX === undefined ? -width / 2 : -(crop.anchorX - crop.x) * scale;
+  // Match attack hurtboxes to the rendered pose without changing contact-damage hitboxes.
+  character.spriteHurtbox=animationSpriteHurtbox(character,getFrameRectangle,spritePadding);
+  context.save();
+  context.globalAlpha = opacity;
+  context.translate(character.x - camera.x, character.y - camera.y + (character.bossVisualOffsetY||0));
+  if(character.bossSquash) context.scale(1+(1-character.bossSquash)*.3,character.bossSquash);
+  if (pose.mirrored) context.scale(-1, 1);
+  context.drawImage(character.image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
+    drawX, drawY, width, height);
+  const flash = character.death
+    ? 0.95 * Math.min(1, character.death.elapsed / 0.035)
+    : getDamageFlashOpacity(character);
+  if (flash > 0) {
+    context.globalAlpha = opacity * flash;
+    context.drawImage(getWhiteSprite(character.image), crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
+      drawX, drawY, width, height);
+    context.globalAlpha = opacity;
+  }
+  if (showSpriteBounds) {
+    context.strokeStyle = '#e54b93';
+    context.strokeRect(drawX, drawY, width, height);
+    const body = getCombatHitbox(character, character !== characters[selected]);
+    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
+    context.beginPath();
+    context.ellipse(body.x - character.x, body.y - character.y, body.rx, body.ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
+    context.stroke();
+  }
+  context.restore();
+}
+
+/** Put tall map objects in front of actors walking behind their solid bases. */
+function drawCharacterOcclusion(character) {
+  if (enemyRenderLayer(character) !== 'normal') return; // Specials and bosses appear above map foregrounds.
+  const opacity = character === characters[selected] ? obstacleVisibility.playerOpacity : 1;
+  if (currentMap === 'first') drawOfficeMonumentOcclusion(context, character, maps.first, camera, canvas.height, opacity);
+  if (currentMap === 'fourth') drawTowerOcclusion(context, character, maps.fourth, camera, opacity);
+  if (currentMap === 'second') drawPalaceOcclusion(context, character, maps.second, camera, canvas.width, opacity);
+}
+
+/** Draw animation poses with a short blend when entering/leaving boss actions. */
+function drawCharacter(character) {
+  if (character.death && character.lastPose && !character.animationFrames) {
+    drawPose(character, character.lastPose, 1);
+    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (character.animationFrames) {
+    const frames=character.actionAnimations?.[character.bossAction?.clip] || character.animationFrames;
+    const frame = frames[gifFrameAt(frames, character.bossAction?.clip ? (character.bossAction.elapsed||0)*1000 : character.gifElapsed || 0)];
+    const image = frame.image;
+    const animatedCharacter={...character,image};
+    drawPose(animatedCharacter, {
+      crop: { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight, footY: image.naturalHeight },
+      mirrored: character.facing !== (character.nativeFacing || 'left')
+    }, 1);
+    character.spriteHurtbox=animatedCharacter.spriteHurtbox;
+    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
+    return;
+  }
+  const pose = {
+    crop: getFrameRectangle(character, getAnimationFrame(character)),
+    mirrored: character.mirroredDirections?.includes(character.direction)
+  };
+  const transition = character.transition;
+  if (transition) {
+    const progress = Math.min(1, transition.elapsed / character.transitionDuration);
+    drawPose(character, transition.from, 1 - progress);
+    drawPose(character, pose, progress);
+    if (progress === 1) character.transition = null;
+  } else {
+    drawPose(character, pose, 1);
+  }
+  character.lastPose = pose;
+  drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
+}
+
+/** Score and queue one campaign transition after its full checkpoint/clock conditions are met. */
+function advanceStageAfterClear() {
+  if(gachaFiles?.active||gachaFiles?.count){awaitingFileStageAdvance=true;return;}
+  if(pendingStageTransition) return;
+        if (!endlessMode) {
+          const result = runScore.complete({character:characters[selected],elapsedSeconds:survivalClock.seconds,
+            stage:currentMap,hardcore:characters[selected].hardcore === true});
+          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run-score-calculated',{detail:result}));
+        }
+        const next = nextStageAfterBoss(currentMap, endlessMode,
+          Object.keys(maps).filter(id => !maps[id].disabled));
+        if (next.endless && !endlessMode) {
+          endlessMode = true;
+          endlessStartedAt = survivalClock.seconds; // Stage 4 completion starts endless timers exactly once.
+        }
+        pendingStageTransition = next.mapId;
+}
+
+/** Update and render only the active avatar; the inactive character stays hidden. */
+function animate(time) {
+  const delta = previousTime === undefined ? 0 : Math.min((time - previousTime) / 1000, 0.05);
+  previousTime = time;
+  mapAudio?.update(delta);
+  const activeCharacter = characters[selected];
+  levelUpMenu?.update();
+  survivalClock.advance(delta, isGameplayPaused(), !isPlayerDefeated(activeCharacter));
+  if (endlessMode && isPlayerDefeated(activeCharacter)) {
+    const result = runScore.complete({character: activeCharacter, elapsedSeconds:survivalClock.seconds,
+      stage:currentMap,endless:true,hardcore:activeCharacter.hardcore === true});
+    if (result) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run-score-calculated',{detail:result}));
+  }
+  const direction = isGameplayPaused() ? undefined : getMovementDirection();
+  if (!isGameplayPaused()) {
+    // Queue progression until any existing background ripple finishes; never lose a boss-clear transition.
+    if (pendingStageTransition && !mapTransition?.active && switchMap(pendingStageTransition)) {
+      pendingStageTransition = null;
+    }
+    skillCasting?.update(delta);
+    updateDamageNumbers(delta);
+    playerStatsTools?.update();
+    advanceDamageFlash(characters[selected], delta);
+    hud?.update(characters[selected]);
+    if (activeCharacter.animationFrames) activeCharacter.gifElapsed = (activeCharacter.gifElapsed || 0) + delta * 1000 * (activeCharacter.animationSpeed || 1);
+    if (activeCharacter.transition) activeCharacter.transition.elapsed += delta * 1000;
+    const playerBefore = { x: activeCharacter.x, y: activeCharacter.y };
+    updateCharacter(activeCharacter, delta, direction);
+    const playerMotion = { x: activeCharacter.x - playerBefore.x, y: activeCharacter.y - playerBefore.y };
+    updateCamera(delta);
+    npcTools?.cleanup(); // Reclaim distant/invalid NPC slots before the next spawn batch.
+    if (campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode && !pendingStageTransition && !isPlayerDefeated(activeCharacter)) {
+      campaignSchedule.update(delta, row=>Boolean(playtestSpawner?.running)&&npcTools.spawnCampaignEncounter(row));
+      if(campaignSchedule.readyToAdvance) advanceStageAfterClear();
+    }
+    const campaignStatus=document.querySelector('#campaign-clock-status');
+    if(campaignStatus) campaignStatus.textContent=`Internal chart: ${Math.floor(campaignSchedule.seconds/60)}:${String(Math.floor(campaignSchedule.seconds)%60).padStart(2,'0')}${campaignSchedule.frozen?' (frozen)':''}`;
+    endlessBuildup.update(delta, { endless: endlessMode && eventTriggerSettings.enabled,
+      bossAlive: getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy), spawning: Boolean(playtestSpawner?.running) });
+    const buildupStatus = document.querySelector('#endless-buildup-status');
+    if (buildupStatus) buildupStatus.textContent = endlessMode || endlessBuildup.active
+      ? `Event: ${endlessBuildup.name} (${endlessBuildup.phase}). Cycle time: ${Math.floor(endlessBuildup.seconds)}s. Elite chance: ${(endlessBuildup.eliteChance * 100).toFixed(1)}%.`
+      : 'Endless buildup: available after Stage 4.';
+    bossSpawner?.update(delta);
+    playtestSpawner?.update(delta, playerMotion);
+    npcTools?.update(delta, playerMotion);
+    const attackFacing = activeCharacter.horizontalFacingOnly
+      ? activeCharacter.facing : activeCharacter.direction;
+    const aimAngle = aiming.getAngle(activeCharacter, camera.x, directionVectors[attackFacing], camera.y);
+    luminousSkill?.update(delta,activeCharacter);
+    princessSkill?.update(delta,activeCharacter,aimAngle);
+    luminousAttack?.setSkillFinishing(Boolean(luminousSkill?.finishing));
+    umbrellaAttack?.update(delta, activeCharacter, aimAngle);
+    arisAttack?.update(delta, activeCharacter, aimAngle);
+    luminousAttack?.update(delta,activeCharacter,aimAngle);
+    princessAttack?.setExMode(Boolean(princessSkill?.casting),Boolean(princessSkill?.sprayActive));
+    princessAttack?.update(delta,activeCharacter,aimAngle,{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height});
+    planaSkill?.update(delta);
+    expPickups?.update(activeCharacter, playerBefore, delta);
+    levelUpMenu?.update();
+    if(!levelUpMenu?.active) {
+      crafters?.update(activeCharacter,playerBefore);
+      if(!crafters?.active)goldenCrafters?.update(activeCharacter,playerBefore);
+      if(!crafters?.active&&!goldenCrafters?.active)gachaFiles?.update(activeCharacter,playerBefore);
+    }
+    hud?.update(activeCharacter);
+  }
+  context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+  drawPlayarea();
+  mapTransition?.draw(context, isGameplayPaused() ? 0 : delta);
+  if (currentMap === 'fourth' && showSpriteBounds) drawIsland(context, maps.fourth, camera, true);
+  if (currentMap === 'third' && showSpriteBounds) {
+    context.save();
+    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
+    for (const box of obstaclesIn(camera.x, camera.y, camera.x + canvas.width, camera.y + canvas.height)) {
+      context.strokeRect(box.left - camera.x, box.top - camera.y, box.right - box.left, box.bottom - box.top);
+    }
+    context.restore();
+  }
+  if (currentMap === 'first' && showSpriteBounds) {
+    context.save();
+    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
+    for (const box of officeObstaclesIn(maps.first, canvas.height, camera.x, camera.y,
+      camera.x + canvas.width, camera.y + canvas.height)) {
+      context.strokeRect(box.left - camera.x, box.top - camera.y, box.right - box.left, box.bottom - box.top);
+    }
+    context.restore();
+  }
+  if (currentMap === 'second' && showSpriteBounds) {
+    context.save();
+    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
+    for (const box of palaceObstaclesIn(maps.second, canvas.width, camera.x, camera.y,
+      camera.x + canvas.width, camera.y + canvas.height)) {
+      context.strokeRect(box.left - camera.x, box.top - camera.y, box.right - box.left, box.bottom - box.top);
+    }
+    context.restore();
+  }
+  expPickups?.draw(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+  crafters?.draw(context,camera,canvas.width,canvas.height);
+  goldenCrafters?.draw(context,camera,canvas.width,canvas.height);
+  gachaFiles?.draw(context,camera);
+  npcTools?.draw(context);
+  npcTools?.drawSpecials(); // Specials render above regular enemies.
+  npcTools?.drawBosses(); // Bosses render above other enemies, below the controlled player.
+  arisAttack?.draw(context, camera);
+  luminousAttack?.draw(context,camera);
+  princessAttack?.draw(context,camera);
+  princessSkill?.draw(context,camera);
+  luminousSkill?.draw(context,camera);
+  planaSkill?.draw(context, camera); // EX umbrella and its trail stay behind the player.
+  // Canvas shadows follow the current frame's alpha silhouette, keeping the aura on the sprite.
+  context.save();
+  if(luminousSkill?.auraActive||princessSkill?.auraActive) {
+    context.shadowColor='rgba(255,105,215,.85)';
+    context.shadowBlur=12;
+  }
+  drawCharacter(activeCharacter); // The player is the highest-priority actor.
+  context.restore();
+  umbrellaAttack?.draw(context, camera);
+  survivalDisplay?.draw(context, survivalClock.seconds, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+  drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+  const facing = activeCharacter.horizontalFacingOnly ? activeCharacter.facing : activeCharacter.direction;
+  aiming?.draw(context, activeCharacter, camera.x, directionVectors[facing], camera.y);
+  for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('[data-admin-skill-slot]')) {
+    const slot = Number(button.dataset.adminSkillSlot);
+    button.disabled = !adminSkillResult(activeCharacter, slot).valid;
+  }
+  document.querySelector('#switch-map').disabled = Boolean(mapTransition?.active);
+
+  const action = activeCharacter.attack
+    ? activeCharacter.attacks[activeCharacter.attack.name].label
+    : direction || 'idle';
+  const description = `${activeCharacter.label} / ${action} / camera X ${Math.round(camera.x)} / Y ${Math.round(camera.y)} / ${maps[currentMap].label}`;
+  if (status.textContent !== description) status.textContent = description;
+  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
+}
+
+/** Knockback collides with solid map props even though ordinary enemy walking ignores them. */
+function canKnockbackStand(enemy, x, y) {
+  const body = getCombatHitbox({ ...enemy, x, y }, true);
+  const map = maps[currentMap];
+  if (currentMap === 'fourth') return canPlaceIslandLoot(body.x, body.y, Math.max(body.rx, body.ry), map);
+  const bounds = stripMapBounds(map, canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
+  if (body.x-body.rx < bounds.left || body.x+body.rx > bounds.right ||
+      body.y-body.ry < bounds.top || body.y+body.ry > bounds.bottom) return false;
+  const boxes = currentMap === 'first'
+    ? officeObstaclesIn(map, canvas.height, body.x-body.rx, body.y-body.ry, body.x+body.rx, body.y+body.ry)
+    : currentMap === 'second'
+      ? palaceObstaclesIn(map, canvas.width, body.x-body.rx, body.y-body.ry, body.x+body.rx, body.y+body.ry)
+      : obstaclesIn(body.x-body.rx, body.y-body.ry, body.x+body.rx, body.y+body.ry);
+  return boxes.every(box => body.x+body.rx <= box.left || body.x-body.rx >= box.right ||
+    body.y+body.ry <= box.top || body.y-body.ry >= box.bottom);
+}
+
+/** Validate loot ground footprints against player obstacles, never the enemy obstacle bypass. */
+function isLootLandingClear(x, y, radius) {
+  const map = maps[currentMap];
+  if (currentMap === 'fourth') return canPlaceIslandLoot(x, y, radius, map);
+  const bounds = stripMapBounds(map, canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
+  if (x-radius < bounds.left || x+radius > bounds.right ||
+      y-radius < bounds.top || y+radius > bounds.bottom) return false;
+  const boxes = currentMap === 'first'
+    ? officeObstaclesIn(map, canvas.height, x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius)
+    : currentMap === 'second'
+      ? palaceObstaclesIn(map, canvas.width, x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius)
+      : obstaclesIn(x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius);
+  return boxes.every(box => x+radius <= box.left || x-radius >= box.right ||

+import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
+import { princessKeySettings as settings, luminousNovaSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';

+import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';
+
+/** Stagger four independently critting rounds across each three-frame cycle; ignore Haste. */
+export function createPrincessKeyAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
+  let bullets=[],owner=null,cooldown=0,enabled=true,shots=0,gaps=[],shotIndex=0,exMode='normal';
+  function reset(){bullets=[];owner=null;cooldown=0;shots=0;gaps=[];shotIndex=0;}
+  function update(delta,player,aim=0,viewport=null) {
+    if(!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='princess-key')){reset();return;}
+    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
+    if((!enabled&&exMode==='normal')||delta<=0)return;
+    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
+    const view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
+    let remaining=delta;
+    while(remaining>1e-8) {
+      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
+        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
+        if(shotIndex===0) {
+          // Positive randomized gaps sum to exactly one base cycle, preserving total fire rate.
+          const weights=Array.from({length:settings.attackCount},()=>.7+random()*.6);
+          const total=weights.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0);
+          gaps=weights.map(value=>settings.interval*value/total/(exMode==='beam' ? settings.exFireRateMultiplier : 1));
+        }
+        {
+          const angle=aim+(random()-.5)*settings.spreadRadians*(exMode==='beam'?settings.exSpreadMultiplier:1);
+          const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
+          const offset=1/Math.hypot(dx/body.rx,dy/body.ry)+3+settings.diameter*1.8;
+          bullets.push({x:body.x+dx*offset,y:body.y+dy*offset,angle,color:exMode==='beam'?'blue':'pink',
+            pierceLimit:exMode==='beam'?Infinity:settings.hitLimit,speed:settings.speed,age:0,hits:new Map(),hitCount:0});shots++;
+        }
+        cooldown=gaps[shotIndex];shotIndex=(shotIndex+1)%settings.attackCount;
+      }
+      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,1/60);
+      const index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
+      for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
+        const bullet=bullets[i],from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y},dt=step;
+        bullet.age+=dt;bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;
+        for(const enemy of index.querySegment(from,bullet,settings.diameter*1.8)) {
+          if(bullet.hitCount>=bullet.pierceLimit)break;
+          if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<settings.hitCooldown||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet,settings.diameter*1.8))continue;
+          bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age);bullet.hitCount++;
+          const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'princess-key',settings.damageMultiplier,[],{projectileCount:4,hitCooldownFrames:15}),random,{target:enemy});
+          const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,damageGroup:'princess-key'}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
+          if(landed!==false&&living)applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,
+            Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds);
+        }
+        if(princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view)||bullet.hitCount>=bullet.pierceLimit)bullets.splice(i,1);
+      }
+      remaining-=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
+    }
+  }
+  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,
+    setExMode(active,shooting) {
+      const next=active&&shooting?'beam':'normal';
+      if(next===exMode)return;
+      // Preserve all in-flight rounds and the current firing phase while changing new shots.
+      const oldRate=exMode==='beam'?settings.exFireRateMultiplier:1;
+      const newRate=next==='beam'?settings.exFireRateMultiplier:1;
+      cooldown*=oldRate/newRate;gaps=gaps.map(gap=>gap*oldRate/newRate);
+      exMode=next;
+    },
+    // Reuse Kei's actual plasma renderer: identical pink bloom and continuous tapered tail.
+    draw(context,camera){for(const bullet of bullets)drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,settings.diameter,Infinity);},
+    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)bullets=[];},
+    get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;}};
+}
+
+/** Despawn only after the complete head bloom and continuous tail clear the current camera. */
+export function princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view) {
+  const radius=settings.diameter/2,padding=radius*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale;
+  const length=Math.min(radius*(1+luminousNovaSettings.trailLengthRatio),settings.speed*bullet.age);
+  const tailX=bullet.x-Math.cos(bullet.angle)*length,tailY=bullet.y-Math.sin(bullet.angle)*length;
+  return Math.max(bullet.x,tailX)+padding<view.x||Math.min(bullet.x,tailX)-padding>view.x+view.width||
+    Math.max(bullet.y,tailY)+padding<view.y||Math.min(bullet.y,tailY)-padding>view.y+view.height;
+}

+Tuning Parts foundation: catalog intentionally empty until parts are supplied.
+Definitions live in Development/tuning-parts.js: id, name, icon path, three level descriptions/perks and three sellCredits values. Perk consumers will be connected once effects are specified; global character stats and other weapons are not modified.
+Enemies roll 1/780; Yuuka always requests an eligible part. No placeholder parts drop with an empty catalog. Equipped/ground types are excluded from duplicate rolls.
+Three slots, max level3. Swapping preserves levels and moves the replaced part to Found. Any consumed part grants exactly one level, regardless of consumed level. Consumed/sold types are excluded for the rest of the run.
+Finish drops Found on safe ground at its current level; leave its pickup area to reopen. Pause > Tuning Parts manages equipped parts, including consuming another equipped part.
+Sale = floor(level sell value * stageCoinMultiplier * (1 + moneyUpBonus/100)). Prices await definitions.
+Menus pause only the game. Equipped inventory persists across maps; ground parts clear on map change. Reload resets the run.

+Power Tuning is the first defined Tuning Part (temporary descriptive name, user supplied no name). Icon: sprites/icons/Event 06 - Buff 1.png. Relative pool weight4. Levels1/2/3: base weapon damage +15/+20/+25%, critical damage +5/+10/+15 percentage points. Sell prices50/100/150 Credits before stage/shop multipliers. Damage is an independent multiplicative base-weapon factor applied before flat enhancements/Growth; critical damage adds to the weapon critical modifier. Only the starting weapon receives these effects (currently Plana umbrella, including its shared damage calculation). No global ATK/CRT changes. The catalogue is no longer empty; drops and Yuuka guaranteed part rolls are enabled when this type is eligible.

+Terminology clarification: every earlier gameplay reference to "Mod" or "Mods" (the temporary system name) refers to Tuning Parts. This is one system, not a separate future mechanic. Any historical statement that Mods are deferred is superseded by the implemented Tuning Parts system. Earlier weapon-damage and projectile-count references to Mod bonuses mean eligible Tuning Part bonuses; these apply only to the character's starting weapon. Yuuka's previously promised Mod reward means her guaranteed Tuning Part drop, using the current eligible pool and run exclusions. Undefined part effects still await individual definitions. Sensei's separately mentioned future item-box reward is not renamed to Tuning Parts.

+Malkuth's Hat (first equipment item)
+- Unlock: defeat the Arisu boss. Unlocks persist locally per signed-in account; guest/no-account unlocks do not persist. No cloud save is implemented here.
+- Icon: sprites/icons/items/malkuth.png. Normal levels 1/2/3 multiply damage by 1.2/1.3/1.4 and subtract 20 percentage points of crit chance before clamping.
+- Damage multiplier joins the additive Damage Bonus family (1.4 plus another 1.3 effect gives 1.7).
+- At MAX, a normal Crafter can spend 1 Secret Tech Note to awaken the hat. A Super File can also grant its awakened form, replacing an owned normal hat without using another slot.
+- Awakened: level 1/MAX, damage multiplier 1.5, no crit penalty. Never offered as a normal level-up awakening.
+- Future MAX penalty-negation equipment can declare negatesItemPenalties; no such item is activated yet.
+- Verification: 84 test files passed; Development module graph linked. Browser visuals/playthrough not verified.
+
+Item unlock clarification
+- Locked items are unavailable on a fresh profile. Meeting an unlock condition permanently adds them to subsequent runs' reward pools; the condition need not be repeated.
+- Unlocking grants eligibility, not an automatic equipped item or guaranteed drop.
+- Future Customize/armory exclusions are separate from unlocks. disabledItemIds filters normal and Super File rewards without erasing unlock progress; re-enabling restores eligibility.
+- Customize remains an inactive upgrade definition until its UI/mechanics are requested.

+Decagrammaton - Super Synnergy 1
+- Recipe: The Princess and the Key + MAX Malkuth's Hat (or awakened/Super Hat), using the existing Golden Hammer and Golden Crafter requirements. Consumes the hat, frees its equipment slot, and retains the ingredients' reward exclusions. One Super Synnergy per run.
+- Icon: sprites/attacks/Decagrammaton_Icon.png. Description: Spits plasma which contain the strength of god(?). All attack damage is also multiplied 1.3 times.
+- Three primary blue shots per 7 frames, each accompanied by a secondary pink shot. Each hit rolls its own crit. Pink shots follow the aimed cone; blue shots select visible enemies, home and wrap around their target until duration, hit limit or target death ends them.
+- Blue: 60% damage, 7-hit limit, 15-frame hit cooldown, 200% area, 20-frame lifetime. Pink: 90% damage, 3-hit limit, 60-frame hit cooldown, 125% area, 40-frame lifetime. Both speed 15 px/frame; knockback duration 5 frames, speed 3 px/frame. Times convert at 60 FPS. Interval is fixed at its 7-frame minimum.
+- Enhancements split across the three primary blue projectiles; secondary pink projectiles do not increase that split count.
+- Passive 1.3 Damage Bonus affects all attack rolls. Consumed Malkuth's Hat no longer applies its crit penalty.
+- The Princess and the Key EX pattern/effect remains usable on Decagrammaton with an independent 3-minute cooldown; enhancements resolve from the current Super weapon.

+/** Solve horizontal shell interception, including windup, travel time and player velocity. */
+export function irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
+  const s=settings.iroha,body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
+  const vx=delta>0?(motion.x||0)/delta:0,vy=delta>0?(motion.y||0)/delta:0;
+  const barrelY=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY,clearance=s.cannonWarningWidth/2+body.ry;
+  const earliest=s.cannonWindupSeconds+s.cannonFireDelay;
+  const options=[];
+  for(const side of [-1,1]) {
+    const muzzle=npc.x+side*(npc.spriteSize||200)*.35;
+    const relativeSpeed=side*s.cannonSpeed-vx;
+    if(Math.abs(relativeSpeed)>1e-8) {
+      const impactTime=(body.x-muzzle+side*s.cannonSpeed*earliest)/relativeSpeed;
+      if(impactTime>=earliest&&impactTime-earliest<=settings.projectileLifetime&&Math.abs(body.y+vy*impactTime-barrelY)<=clearance)
+        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt:earliest,impactTime});
+    }
+    if(Math.abs(vy)>1e-8) {
+      const impactTime=(barrelY-body.y)/vy;
+      const flight=(body.x+vx*impactTime-muzzle)/(side*s.cannonSpeed);
+      const fireAt=impactTime-flight;
+      if(flight>=0&&flight<=settings.projectileLifetime&&fireAt>=earliest&&fireAt<=earliest+s.cannonMaxInterceptWait)
+        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt,impactTime});
+    }
+  }
+  return options.sort((a,b)=>a.fireAt-b.fireAt||a.impactTime-b.impactTime)[0]||null;
+}

+/** Position-based pool, recalculated once when Iroha starts an attack. */
+export function irohaAttackChances(npc,player) {
+  const dx=Math.abs(player.x-npc.x),dy=Math.abs(player.y-npc.y);
+  // Symmetric sigmoid over each quadrant: rapid change through 30?60deg, 50/50 at 45deg.
+  const position=Math.atan2(dy,dx)/(Math.PI/2),power=settings.iroha.attackAngleExponent;
+  const horizontal=(1-position)**power,vertical=position**power;
+  const cannon=dx===0&&dy===0?.5:horizontal/(horizontal+vertical);
+  return {cannon,artillery:1-cannon};
+}
+export function irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0},random=Math.random) {
+  const pool=irohaAttackChances(npc,player,delta,motion);
+  return random()<pool.cannon?'cannon':'artillery';
+}
+
+/** Cardinal movement produces +; diagonal movement produces X. */
+export function irohaArtilleryPoints(npc,player,motion={x:0,y:0},viewport={width:1280,height:720}) {
+  const dx=Math.abs(motion.x||0),dy=Math.abs(motion.y||0);
+  const diagonal=Math.max(dx,dy)>1e-6&&Math.min(dx,dy)/Math.max(dx,dy)>.4;
+  const s=settings.iroha;
+  // Keep a compact cluster of equal circles, with neighboring edges slightly overlapping.
+  // Fit the + footprint using the configured coverage of the shorter visible dimension; X is its 45deg rotation.
+  const radius=Math.min(viewport.width,viewport.height)*s.artilleryCoverage/(2*(1+s.artilleryCircleSpacing));
+  const spacing=radius*s.artilleryCircleSpacing,angle=diagonal?Math.PI/4:0;
+  return [{x:player.x,y:player.y,radius},...Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>({
+    x:player.x+Math.cos(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*spacing,
+    y:player.y+Math.sin(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*spacing,radius}))];
+}

+/** Continuous same-direction movement, measured once per simulation tick, not per boss. */
+export function createSteadyMovementTracker() {
+  let owner=null,seconds=0,heading=null,vx=0,vy=0;
+  return {update(delta,player,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
+    if(delta<=0)return;
+    if(owner!==player){owner=player;seconds=0;heading=null;}
+    const length=Math.hypot(motion.x||0,motion.y||0);
+    if(length<.01){seconds=0;heading=null;vx=vy=0;return;}
+    const direction={x:motion.x/length,y:motion.y/length};
+    if(!heading||direction.x*heading.x+direction.y*heading.y<.995){seconds=0;heading=direction;}
+    seconds+=delta;vx=motion.x/delta;vy=motion.y/delta;
+  },get seconds(){return seconds;},get velocity(){return {x:vx,y:vy};}};
+}

+/** List only equipped targets, keeping upgrades capped and offering only defined awakening paths. */
+export function crafterChoices(player) {
+  const choices=[],loot=getLootTotals();
+  for(const [kind,slots] of [['weapon',player.attackSlots||[]],['item',player.equipmentSlots||[]]]) {
+    slots.forEach((target,index)=>{
+      if(!target)return;
+      const max=target.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
+        target.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:target.maxLevel;
+      if(!Number.isFinite(max))return;
+      const prefix=`${kind}:${index}`,name=target.name||target.id||'Item',level=target.level||1;
+      if(!target.isSynergy&&level<max)choices.push({id:`${prefix}:level`,target,kind,name,label:`Upgrade to LV ${level+1}`,cost:0,disabled:false});
+      else if(kind==='weapon') {
+        const rank=(target.enhancementRank||0)+1,cost=crafterEnhancementCost(rank);
+        const chance=crafterEnhancementChance(rank,player.enhancementRateBonusPercent||0);
+        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:enhance`,target,kind,name,label:`Enhance +${rank} — ${cost} Credits — ${Math.round(chance*100)}% success`,cost,chance,rank,disabled:loot.credits<cost});
+      }
+      if(kind==='item'&&target.id==='malkuth-hat'&&level>=max&&!target.awakened)
+        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:'Awaken - 1 Secret Tech Note',disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<1});
+      const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
+      if(kind==='weapon'&&target.id==='plana-umbrella'&&main===target.id&&level>=max&&!target.awakened) {
+        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:`Awaken — ${umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note`,disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost});
+      }
+    });
+  }
+  return choices;

+/** A valid attempt consumes one Crafter even when a paid enhancement fails. */
+export function applyCrafterChoice(player,id,random=Math.random) {
+  const choice=crafterChoices(player).find(c=>c.id===id);
+  if(!choice||choice.disabled)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'That upgrade is unavailable.'};
+  const action=id.split(':').at(-1),target=choice.target;
+  if(action==='level') {target.level=(target.level||1)+1;if(choice.kind==='weapon')recordWeaponMax(player,target);return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} upgraded to LV ${target.level}.`};}

+export function rememberPlasmaTrail(bullet,from,maxLength) {
+  const trail=bullet.trail??=[{x:from.x,y:from.y,distance:0}];

+/** Convert actual traveled positions to the plasma head's local coordinates, newest first. */
+export function plasmaTrailPoints(bullet,maxLength) {
+  if(!(bullet.trail?.length>1)||!(maxLength>1e-8))return null;
+  const points=[{x:0,y:0,distance:0}],cos=Math.cos(bullet.angle),sin=Math.sin(bullet.angle);
+  let previous={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y},distance=0;
+  for(let i=bullet.trail.length-1;i>=0;i--){
+    const p=bullet.trail[i],length=Math.hypot(p.x-previous.x,p.y-previous.y);if(length<1e-8)continue;
+    const fraction=Math.min(1,(maxLength-distance)/length),x=previous.x+(p.x-previous.x)*fraction,y=previous.y+(p.y-previous.y)*fraction;
+    distance+=length*fraction;const dx=x-bullet.x,dy=y-bullet.y;
+    points.push({x:dx*cos+dy*sin,y:-dx*sin+dy*cos,distance});
+    if(fraction<1||distance>=maxLength)break;previous=p;
+  }
+  return points.length>1?points:null;

# Project activity memory

- Work in Development unless the user explicitly requests another target. Preserve existing edits.
- `Memory Activity Log.txt` is the reading-order guide for the user's exhaustive recoverable activity archive in numbered `Memory Activity Log Parts/*.txt` files, beginning October 30, 2026 at 8:54 AM. Use it as additional memory after context loss.
- Start with the reading-order guide and `Memory Activity Log.index.json`; search for relevant prompts, corrections, file paths and record numbers. Use index file/part_line/part_byte to read only relevant ranges. Read numbered parts in order when tracing context; a record may continue across parts. Do not load the entire log into context.
- Later user corrections override earlier historical decisions. Verify current code instead of assuming an old logged implementation is still current.
- Keep `chat_log.txt` updated with the prompt, visible responses, changes and validation. Preserve its existing encoding by appending.
- Before ending project work, refresh the archive with `python tools/update_memory_activity_log.py`. The optional `--final-response` records the exact prepared final answer before it is sent. A subsequent refresh also picks up that answer from its original session record.
- Preserve verbatim visible messages, recorded patches and code-writing commands. Do not substitute summaries for recoverable content, fabricate missing intermediate code, or claim source-truncated output is complete.
- Do not include private reasoning or system/developer messages in the archive. Its generator filters those record types.

# Firebase Authentication setup

1. Open [Firebase Console](https://console.firebase.google.com/), create or select a project, and register a **Web app**.
2. In **Project settings > General > Your apps**, copy the web app's configuration into `firebase-config.js`. Keep any additional configuration properties supplied by Firebase. Never paste a service-account key into browser code.
3. In **Authentication > Sign-in method**, enable **Email/Password**.
4. In **Authentication > Settings > Authorized domains**, add your deployment hostname and `localhost` for development if needed.
5. Serve this folder over HTTP, for example with VS Code Live Server or `python -m http.server 8000`. Open `http://localhost:8000` instead of double-clicking the HTML file.
6. Create an account and confirm it appears in **Authentication > Users**. Close the tab, reopen the site, and verify login with the same account. Also check incorrect passwords, duplicate registration, and direct access to `project.html` while signed out.

The app uses Firebase's modular browser SDK, email/password accounts, and tab-scoped session persistence. Successful registration or login opens the intentionally empty workspace. Names are saved to the Firebase user's display name when possible. Existing local-demo accounts are not Firebase accounts; register them again.

The workspace redirect is a navigation guard. When project data is added, protect it with Firebase Security Rules or server-side ID-token validation; browser redirects do not authorize data access.

Reference: [Firebase email/password authentication](https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/web/password-auth), [browser SDK setup](https://firebase.google.com/docs/web/alt-setup).

## Guest access

The login page offers **Continue as guest**, followed by an explicit warning that upgrades, progress and other game data will not be saved. Cancel/Escape leaves the login page unchanged; confirmation opens the empty project workspace without Firebase sign-in or an anonymous account. Only a tab-scoped guest marker is stored; no game data is stored by guest access. Guest sessions never expose the admin Development link and are rejected by the Development guard, even if an account session exists in the browser. Successful account login/registration clears guest mode. When persistent gameplay storage is implemented, all save/load paths must respect `isGuestSession()` and keep guest runs transient.

Verification: `node tests/guest-session.test.cjs`. Guest access does not require enabling Firebase Anonymous Authentication.

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: firebase-client.js | sha256=f89488ef04945d220e3f51df00e4b9071a671d0f7764bf05ac294fbef1158ba0 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { firebaseConfig } from './firebase-config.js';

let authPromise;

/** Load Firebase once and share the same Authentication instance across callers. */
export function getFirebaseAuth() {
  const requiredFields = ['apiKey', 'authDomain', 'projectId', 'appId'];

  if (requiredFields.some(field => !firebaseConfig[field]?.trim())) {
    const error = new Error('Firebase web configuration is missing.');
    error.code = 'app/missing-config';
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }

  if (!authPromise) {
    authPromise = initializeAuthentication().catch(error => {
      // Allow another attempt after a temporary SDK download or startup failure.
      authPromise = undefined;
      throw error;
    });
  }

  return authPromise;
}

/** Download the modular SDK and initialize Firebase with the web app settings. */
async function initializeAuthentication() {
  const [appSdk, sdk] = await Promise.all([
    import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.1.0/firebase-app.js'),
    import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.1.0/firebase-auth.js')
  ]);

  const app = appSdk.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const auth = sdk.getAuth(app);

  // Keep the user signed in for this browser tab, including page navigation.
  await sdk.setPersistence(auth, sdk.browserSessionPersistence);

  return { auth, sdk };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: guest-session.js | sha256=fae2c9ea6ebb8605d36930a6ffd4f8e40dc3d0745f779ef4751c71d603837390 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
// This tab-scoped marker identifies guest navigation; it never stores game progress.
const guestSessionKey = 'schale.guestSession';

/** Check whether this tab entered through the confirmed guest option. */
export function isGuestSession() {
  try { return sessionStorage.getItem(guestSessionKey) === '1'; }
  catch { return false; }
}

/** Begin guest access without creating a Firebase account or saving upgrades. */
export function startGuestSession() {
  sessionStorage.setItem(guestSessionKey, '1');
}

/** Return to account mode after a successful sign-in or registration. */
export function endGuestSession() {
  try { sessionStorage.removeItem(guestSessionKey); }
  catch { /* Storage may be disabled; an absent guest marker is already account mode. */ }
}
