## Plana umbrella attack
The equipped plana-umbrella attack automatically starts a 180-degree sweep every 1 second (start to start). Each swing takes 0.2 seconds and snapshots the arrow angle at its start, including cursor aim; hiding the arrow does not disable attacks. The closed umbrella pose uses handle-centered rotation, eased movement, fading prior poses and a subtle curved trail, with no brightness flashing. Plana can keep moving during attacks. Swapping to an avatar without the umbrella cancels its swing; Reset Scene resets attack timing.

Edit umbrellaSettings in umbrella-attack.js: interval=1s, duration=0.2s, baseRadius=64px, reach=176px, damage=23 HP. Swept sector checks cover the angles between frames and allow only one hit per enemy per swing. Damage uses the regular enemy damage/death/loot path. These are initial test balance values; no upgrade scaling or Arona starting attack is introduced. The arrow and umbrella share aiming.getAngle so crosshair and facing behavior agree.

Umbrella handle now orbits 64px outside the player center, preserving its 112px blade length (176px outer reach). Damage follows this outer annular sweep rather than hitting the center. The 0.2s swing uses thicker, more opaque pink arcs, longer trail history and stronger afterimages. Interval remains 1 second; baseRadius and reach are editable in umbrellaSettings.

Umbrella blur now uses dense angular sampling instead of five time-spaced ghost poses. Each ghost overlaps the next at roughly 0.7-degree spacing with low, tapered opacity. The fast midpoint renders about 124 poses for a continuous blur. Tune trailDuration (0.09s), trailAngleStep (0.012 radians), and maxAfterimages (192) in umbrellaSettings. Swing timing, damage and reach are unchanged.

Umbrella blur refinement: afterimages are composited onto a reusable offscreen canvas and blurred together by 3px, merging individual poses into a softer slash. Trail history is 0.13s and the blurred trail fades for 0.18s after the 0.2s attack ends. The lingering trail is visual-only and cannot damage enemies. Edit trailBlur/trailLinger/trailDuration in umbrellaSettings. The blur is applied once to the composite rather than individually to each afterimage.

Umbrella sweep arc is now 190 degrees, centered on the arrow direction (95 degrees to either side). Edit arcDegrees in umbrellaSettings. The damage sweep and blur use the same arc; duration remains 0.2s and interval remains 1s.

## Floating damage numbers
Player HP loss shows red bitmap numbers; enemy HP loss shows white numbers using the supplied font sheet. A 1-HP hit shows 1; other hits show actual HP lost, capped by remaining HP. Popups rise, fall and fade over 0.55s with slight horizontal drift, anchored in world coordinates. They continue after enemy death and while AI is paused. Contact I-frames prevent duplicate damage/popups; zero HP loss produces no number. Edit damageNumberSettings in damage-numbers.js for duration, fade, jumpHeight (14.0625px, half the previous height) and population cap. Cached text graphics and one shared font avoid loading an image per hit. All real damage paths, including admin test damage, use these helpers.

Enemy EXP, credits and Secret Tech Notes now toss out in independently random directions, landing 40-80 world pixels from the defeat position. Plana's attraction and Arona's direct collection then work normally. Admin spawn-drop buttons use the same toss for testing; Collect All can still collect airborne loot. Edit dropScatter in exp-drops.js for distance, duration and hop height. Offscreen flight advances normally and rewards/chances are unchanged.


Current balance: basic Mob contact deals 1 HP to the player; other NPCs retain the editable 10 HP default. The admin panel has a separate Mob contact damage field. Plana's starting umbrella deals 23 HP per enemy per swing.

Pickup arrival: attraction and walk-over triggers now begin an accelerating flight to the active player's actual center (x/y), not the feet or a 26px collection boundary. Items grant rewards and vanish only within 0.5px of that center. They render beneath the player, so the sprite hides the final approach naturally. Arona still has zero attraction range: walking over a drop triggers the center-bound collection flight. Swapping avatars cancels the old avatar's pending attraction. Drop-scatter flights still complete before pickup begins.

Current contact rule: enemies do not lose HP from touching the player. Contact applies player damage and 0.5s I-frames only; enemy push/bounce reactions remain. Removed the enemy contact-damage setting and admin field. Umbrella attacks and explicit admin damage still damage enemies normally. This supersedes earlier bilateral-contact notes.

Enemy damage numbers display full hit damage, including overkill: a 23-damage umbrella hit on an 8-HP enemy still shows 23. Enemy HP remains clamped to zero and defeat rewards remain once-only. Player damage numbers continue to show HP actually lost.

Plana pickup magnet now detects loot around the sprite center rather than the feet. Starting pickupRange is 99px, 10% above 90px. Swept center detection handles movement between frames. Walk-over detection stays at feet, Arona retains zero magnet range, and attracted items still fly to the player center before collection.

## Dynamic HP and level-up healing

## Updated elite HP and report rewards
Elite Mob now has 500 HP (5x normal Mob's 100 HP), retaining double size, double contact damage and 3% spawn chance. Every elite defeat drops three independently scattered EXP reports. Each rolls 80% Report 1 with random 11-20 EXP, or 20% Report 2 with random 21-49 EXP. Normal enemies retain one report with 90% gray Report 0, now worth random 1-9 EXP, or 10% Report 1 (11-20 EXP). ## Elite report floor and size update
Elite Mob size is now 150% of normal (168px vs 112px); HP remains 500 and contact damage remains 2. Each elite drops five scattered reports totaling at least 150 EXP. ## Sprite-shaped combat hitboxes
combat-hitboxes.js now defines larger stable body ellipses rather than the former 18%-size circles. ## Variable percentage combat stats
The EXP / HP panel now includes ATK%, SPD%, CRIT%, PICKUP% and Haste% fields. Stats are independent per controlled character and session-only. Finish editing a field to apply; changing avatars refreshes the fields. Reset Player Stats restores all percentages to zero. NPC clones get separate base stats rather than inheriting player upgrades.

ATK/SPD/PICKUP/Haste are bonuses, starting at 0%; multiplier = 1 + bonus/100. ATK scales umbrella damage (base 23), SPD scales movement (base Plana/Arona 240px/s), PICKUP scales attraction radius (Plana base99px, Arona base0, so percentage alone does not grant her a magnet), and Haste scales attack frequency and swing duration inversely. +100% Haste gives a swing every 0.5s lasting 0.1s. Trail timing scales with the attack so visual tails do not block high-speed attacks. Haste snapshots at swing start. CRIT is direct chance, from 0% to 100%, with 2x damage on a successful per-enemy hit roll. Attack damage rounds to whole HP. ATK/SPD/PICKUP/Haste admin values are limited to 0-1000%; CRIT to 0-100%.

Edit defaultCombatStats, statMultiplier and rollAttackDamage in combat-stats.js to tune defaults/critical behavior. Each character stores values under combatStats: atkPercent, spdPercent, critPercent, pickupPercent, hastePercent. Base attack timing/damage remains in umbrellaSettings. No level-up choices or automatic stat growth are added yet.

## Automatic playtesting spawns
A Playtesting sidebar sits outside the simulated screen on its right (below it on narrow displays). Random spawning starts enabled. ## Visible crowd spawn threshold
The spawner now uses a 50-visible-enemy soft threshold. Below 50, the default is 5 enemies/s; at 50 or more, it slows to 1 enemy/s, restoring 5/s when the visible count falls. The sidebar displays visible count and current rate live. ## Crowded-spawn direction priority
At the 50-visible-enemy threshold, 1/s spawns now prioritize the least populated legal direction relative to the player. Count all living session enemies, including offscreen approaching enemies, by direction. Stage 1 compares left/right; Stage 2 compares top/bottom; free maps compare four cardinal sectors by dominant X/Y offset. Exact-center enemies do not bias a direction. Ties are randomized. Placement retries begin on the least-populated side, then fall back to other sides in population order if obstacles/shore block that entrance. Below the threshold, normal 5/s spawning remains random. Visibility threshold, population cap and stage collision checks are unchanged.

The supplied sprites/icons/Crew Whistle.png is now present and used for the pause-menu SPD row. Removed the temporary SVG whistle fallback. Reload the development page to display the new artwork.

## New-game local-time seed
Procedural maps no longer use the fixed 20261101 seed. run-seed.js generates a 32-bit seed once at each page/game start by hashing browser-local date/time (including milliseconds and timezone offset) with random entropy. Stage 1/2/3 all share this seed, keeping each run's tiles consistent regardless of exploration order. Monument/statue guarantees continue normally.

New Game (New Seed) reloads the development run, clearing session enemies, drops, stats and counters and generating a fresh seed. Reset Scene, map switching, pause and preview sizing preserve the current run/seed. The playtesting sidebar shows the run seed and local start time. Stage 4 remains a fixed island image. This supersedes earlier fixed-seed/reload-consistency notes.

## Population cap and continuous despawning
Enemy/NPC population cap is now 400. Before each active-play spawn update, cleanup removes living NPCs whose sprite bounds are more than 100px from the gameplay viewport, or whose position is invalid in the current playable map (including obstacles/shore/walls). Map changes update the camera and run the same cleanup immediately against the destination map. Distance is measured from sprite edges, preserving the existing 100px-offscreen spawn entrances. Cleanup frees slots before spawn batches and does not grant kills, EXP, credits, notes or death effects. Players and collected/ground loot are not part of the NPC population cleanup. Pause freezes active cleanup with the rest of gameplay. Tune limit/despawnDistance in enemyPopulationSettings in world-state.js. The separate 50-visible crowd threshold and 1/s throttle remain unchanged.

## Population pressure, protected bosses and drop lifetime
At 90% of the 400 population cap (360 living NPCs), cleanup sorts non-boss enemies by distance from the player, removing the farthest until total population reaches 70% (280). Bosses remain counted but cannot be removed; if protected bosses alone exceed the target, they are retained. Cleanup still removes distant/invalid regular enemies and never grants kills, loot or death effects. Both Iroha and Shiroko carry explicit boss flags; elite size does not imply boss identity.

Bosses are now exempt from all automatic population/distance/play-area despawning, including map changes. When a chasing AI boss is more than 150px from the visible viewport (measured from sprite edges), it receives catch-up speed greater than current player movement speed. Boost lasts until the boss re-enters view, avoiding repeated threshold toggling. Speed is max(2x boss base speed, 1.35x current player speed +60px/s), accounting for SPD bonuses. Normal player speed240 yields384px/s catch-up. AI-off, wander/idle and paused movement remain under developer control. Edit bossCatchupSettings in boss-catchup.js.

Ground items/reports are entirely outside population/distance cleanup and persist offscreen during active play. Switching maps clears all uncollected drops (including airborne/attracted ones); collected credits/notes/EXP remain. Explicit admin clear and starting a new run still work. This supersedes previous shared-across-maps drop persistence notes.

## Kill-based boss spawning and pity
boss-spawner.js maintains an internal boss-charge counter separate from HUD total kills. Each real enemy defeat while no boss was alive adds one charge. Starting at charge1000, each eligible kill rolls a 0.01% chance. The chance stays at that value through2500, then rises linearly toward100% at3000. A successful roll queues a randomly selected Iroha or Shiroko chasing boss at a valid offscreen entrance. Placement retries once per second if no location/slot is currently available; pending progress is not lost. Boss spawning is updated before ordinary spawn batches.

Any successful boss spawn, including manual admin spawns, resets the internal charge to0. Charge never accumulates while any boss lives, including the kill that defeats that boss. Cleanup/admin deletion grants no charge. This freeze also applies in endless mode, per user clarification. Before endless, all spawn paths enforce one living boss. In the development cycle, advancing from Stage4 back to Stage1 marks endless mode, where manual multi-boss tests are allowed; automatic progression still waits for all bosses to die. New Game resets the mode/counter. The playtesting sidebar shows charge, chance, pending state and boss-alive freeze. No boss spawn changes the HUD's lifetime kill total.

Tune bossSpawnSettings (1000 unlock,0.0001 base probability,2500 pity start,3000 guarantee) in boss-spawner.js. Boss HP/combat behavior retains its existing development settings. The standard pause freezes this system with all gameplay.

## Spawning and testing rules

- Ordinary stream:5?8/s based on nearby density;2/s once50 visible population slots are reached. Overall cap400, with population cleanup at360 trimming to280. Mega enemies consume3 slots.
- Regular stream samples eligible roster entries. During boss combat each regular spawn has0.5% chance to become a Mega. A matching dedicated mini-boss profile is used when available; otherwise HPx10/ATKx2 applies. At the frozen06:00 pool this means Highlander Mega rolls.
- Bosses are exempt from ordinary population cleanup. Drops clear on map changes, except the newly preserved Stage1 Gacha File reward.
- Default Development seed0 sets enemies to1HP; random spawning defaults off, and invincibility defaults on. Reroll seed and enable spawning to test actual balance.
- Legacy automatic events, including the harmless-enemy timestamp schedule, are disabled. The replacement campaign events above are enabled. No generated random formations before17:00.

## Stage clear

Defeating the scheduled Shiroko marks Stage1 cleared and automatically queues the background transition to Stage2. Stage2 internal clock starts06:30. Unopened Gacha Files now carry to a safe spot near the player in Stage2 instead of blocking transition. If a File dialog is already open, it resolves before gameplay/transition resumes. EXP and other ground drops follow the existing map-change cleanup rule.

## Verification limits

Campaign schedule, Gacha File rules and File UI tests passed. This is a configuration/code audit, not a completed six-minute browser playthrough. Visual formation alignment, encounter difficulty, and drop balance still need playtesting before calling Stage1 fully complete.

# Synergy recipes for Golden Crafters

Golden Crafters are implemented. The live recipe list in `synergy-recipes.js` includes **Supernova + Luminous Nova ? The Princess and the Key**. Both ingredients must be MAX level. The synergy has no EX skill yet.

A recipe needs:

- `id`: unique recipe identifier.
- `ingredients`: two weapon IDs. Both must be equipped and at their own MAX level.
- `result`: the synergy weapon descriptor, including `id`, `name`, `icon` and `maxLevel`.
- Optional `description` for the fusion preview.
- Optional `createWeapon()` returning a fresh, fully initialized result weapon. Its ID must match `result.id`.

Weapon damage/attacks and any new EX skill still need their normal weapon-controller implementation; a recipe only defines a valid fusion. Do not register a recipe for an unimplemented weapon.

On confirmation the two ingredients become one result weapon in the earlier slot; the second slot becomes empty. No Credits or pending level-up choices are spent. One Golden Crafter is consumed. Cancellation or a stale/invalid pair leaves it intact. One enchantment from each ingredient is preserved, including duplicate enchantments, for a maximum of two inherited enchantments.

Automatic drops roll `(1 + fullRunMinutes / 20) / 100` per enemy defeat, only while an eligible recipe exists and no Golden Crafter is on the ground. The admin **Spawn Golden Crafter** button bypasses recipe eligibility for visual/menu testing, while retaining the one-drop limit. Without a valid recipe its menu cannot fuse or consume weapons.

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/admin-guard.js | sha256=7ba15d5386c054ada83e47cc25fd9a3014422eae7d490d7869e5784dd96e5ebb | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { getFirebaseAuth } from '../firebase-client.js';
import { isAdmin } from '../admin-access.js';
import { isGuestSession } from '../guest-session.js';

/** Reveal development content only after Firebase confirms the admin session. */
export async function requireAdmin() {
  const content = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  if (isGuestSession()) {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../project.html');
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();

    return await new Promise(resolve => {
      sdk.onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
        const allowed = isAdmin(user);
        content.hidden = !allowed;

        if (!allowed) {
          window.location.replace(user ? '../project.html' : '../index.html');
        }

        resolve(allowed);
      }, () => {
        content.hidden = true;
        window.location.replace('../index.html');
        resolve(false);
      });
    });
  } catch {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../index.html');
    return false;
  }
}

export const adminDigitTemplates = {
  1: [path([[30, 20], [50, 0], [50, 100]])],
  2: [path([[0, 15], [20, 0], [70, 0], [95, 20], [90, 40], [0, 100], [100, 100]])],

/** Match handwritten 1Ã¢â‚¬â€œ6 locally, without downloading or calling either AI model. */
export function recognizeAdminDigit(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (height > 0 && width / height < .18) return 1;
  const ranked = Object.entries(adminDigitTemplates).map(([digit, template]) =>
    ({ digit: Number(digit), score: drawingAccuracy(strokes, template) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return ranked[0].score >= .45 && ranked[0].score - ranked[1].score >= .025 ? ranked[0].digit : null;
}

/** Resolve a slot only when it contains a weapon with an implemented EX effect. */
export function adminSkillResult(player, slot) {
  const weapon = player.attackSlots?.[slot];
  const skillId = skillIds[weapon?.id];
  return skillId ? { valid: true, adminTest: true, weapon, skillId,
    label: weapon.name || weapon.id, score: 1, accuracy: skillCastSettings.accuracyAverage,
    damageMultiplier: skillCastSettings.damageAverage, components: [] }
    : { valid: false, reason: `Slot ${slot + 1} has no implemented EX skill.` };
}

import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
/** Convert browser pointer coordinates to internal canvas pixels after CSS scaling. */
export function pointerToCanvas(clientX, clientY, rectangle, width, height) {
  return {
    x: (clientX - rectangle.left) * width / rectangle.width,
    y: (clientY - rectangle.top) * height / rectangle.height
  };
}

/** Load the supplied aiming artwork without changing project image files. */
function loadAimImage(source) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${source}.`));
    image.src = source;
  });
}

/** Manage independent arrow visibility and click-to-toggle cursor aiming. */
export function createAiming(canvas) {
  const toggle = document.querySelector('#toggle-arrow');
  const modeLabel = document.querySelector('#aim-mode');
  const state = { visible: true, cursorAim: false, directionalOverride: false, inside: false, pointer: { x: 0, y: 0 } };
  let arrow;
  let crosshair;

  // EDIT these values to tune the aiming sprites in internal canvas pixels.
  const arrowWidth = 24.36; // Another 30% smaller than 34.8 pixels.
  const arrowHeight = 13.02; // Preserve proportions at the reduced size.
  const crosshairSize = 75.712; // 30% larger than the previous 58.24 pixels.
  const arrowDistanceMultiplier = 0.9; // Extra clearance below the player sprite.
  const ready = Promise.all([
    loadAimImage('../sprites/arrow.png'),
    loadAimImage('../sprites/crosshair.png')
  ]).then(images => { [arrow, crosshair] = images; });

  /** Keep UI and native cursor in sync with the selected aiming mode. */
  function updateControls() {
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.visible));
    toggle.textContent = state.visible ? 'Arrow: shown' : 'Arrow: hidden';
    modeLabel.textContent = state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride ? 'Aim: crosshair' : 'Aim: character facing';
    canvas.style.cursor = state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride && state.inside ? 'none' : 'default';
  }

  /** Track the pointer in screen space, so camera scrolling cannot offset aiming. */
  function trackPointer(event) {
    state.pointer = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
    state.inside = true;
    updateControls();
  }

  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.visible = !state.visible;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerenter', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    state.inside = false;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    trackPointer(event);
    state.cursorAim = !state.cursorAim;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Share the exact arrow angle with attacks, including cursor aiming. */
  function getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    let dx = vector[0];
    let dy = vector[1];
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride) {
      dx = state.pointer.x - x;
      dy = state.pointer.y - y;
      // Preserve facing if the cursor is precisely on the character anchor.
      if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) [dx, dy] = vector;
    }
    return Math.atan2(dy, dx);
  }

  /** Draw an upward-native arrow rotated toward facing or the custom cursor. */
  function draw(context, character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    if (!arrow || !crosshair) return;
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    const angle = getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY);
    if (state.visible) {
      const distance = ((character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 + 25) * arrowDistanceMultiplier;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x + Math.cos(angle) * distance, y + Math.sin(angle) * distance);
      context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
      context.drawImage(arrow, -arrowWidth / 2, -arrowHeight / 2, arrowWidth, arrowHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride && state.inside) {
      context.drawImage(crosshair,
        state.pointer.x - crosshairSize / 2, state.pointer.y - crosshairSize / 2,
        crosshairSize, crosshairSize);
    }
  }

  /** Return to facing-based aiming without overriding the visibility preference. */
  function reset() {
    state.cursorAim = false;
    updateControls();
  }

  updateControls();
  return { ready, draw, reset, state, getAngle, trackPointer,
    setPointerInside(inside) { state.inside = inside; updateControls(); },
    setDirectionalOverride(enabled) { state.directionalOverride = Boolean(enabled); updateControls(); }
  };
}

/** Fit the whole sheet once; narrower attack crops must never enlarge individual frames. */
export function lineupSheetScale(template) {
  const layout=template.layout;
  let width=0,height=0;
  for(let frame=0;frame<layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++) {
    for(let row=0;row<layout.rowEdges[frame].length-1;row++) {
      const crop=layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
      width=Math.max(width,crop?.width ?? layout.columnEdges[frame+1]-layout.columnEdges[frame]);
      height=Math.max(height,crop?.height ?? layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]-layout.rowEdges[frame][row]);
    }
  }
  return Math.min(((template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)-spriteDisplayPadding*2)/(template.referenceSize||215),200/width,205/height);
}

    },
    draw(context, camera) {
      const visible = [...volleys];
      const phase = special ? supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed) : null;
      if (special && image.naturalWidth) {
        // This entire pass is drawn before the player: the gun emerges from behind her.
        const pose = supernovaWeaponPose(special.elapsed, special.player, special.angle);
        context.save();
        const anchor = arisBeamAnchor(special.player);
        context.translate(anchor.x-camera.x, anchor.y-camera.y);
        context.rotate(special.angle);
        context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
        const height = pose.length * image.naturalHeight/image.naturalWidth;
        context.shadowColor = '#63eaff'; context.shadowBlur = 12*pose.opacity;
        context.drawImage(image, pose.offset-pose.length/2, -height/2, pose.length, height);
        if(special.elapsed>=arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds&&phase.beamAge<0) {
          const charge=Math.min(1,(special.elapsed-arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds)/arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds);
          const muzzle=arisBeamOffset(anchor,special.angle,true)+supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment;
          const radius=4+12*charge;
          context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.shadowBlur=0;
          const light=context.createRadialGradient(muzzle,0,0,muzzle,0,radius*2);
          light.addColorStop(0,'rgba(235,255,255,.85)');light.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(90,215,255,.4)');light.addColorStop(1,'rgba(50,160,255,0)');
          context.fillStyle=light;context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
          context.strokeStyle='rgba(160,240,255,.6)';context.lineWidth=1;
          context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle,0,24*(1-charge)+3,0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();
          for(let i=0;i<5;i++) {
            const angle=i*Math.PI*2/5+special.elapsed*2,distance=8+(1-charge)*24;
            context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle+Math.cos(angle)*distance,Math.sin(angle)*distance,1.2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
          }
        }
        context.restore();
      }
      if(special&&phase.beamAge>=0) {
        const anchor=arisBeamAnchor(special.player),muzzle=arisBeamOffset(anchor,special.angle,true)+supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment;
        drawFiringRings(context,anchor.x-camera.x+Math.cos(special.angle)*muzzle,
          anchor.y-camera.y+Math.sin(special.angle)*muzzle,special.angle,phase.beamAge,supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth*.55,true);
      }
      if (special && phase.beamAge >= 0 && !phase.beamFinished) visible.push({ elapsed: phase.beamAge, angles: [special.angle], origin: arisBeamAnchor(special.player),
        width: supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth, special: true });
      for (const volley of visible) {
        const activeDuration = volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.duration : s.beamSeconds;
        const visualDuration = activeDuration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier;
        const collapse = Math.max(.06, visualDuration-activeDuration);
        const pulse = 1 + arisBeamVisualSettings.pulseDepth *
          Math.sin(volley.elapsed*Math.PI*2*arisBeamVisualSettings.pulsesPerSecond) ** 8;
        const thickness = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volley.elapsed/.025,
          (visualDuration-volley.elapsed)/collapse)) * pulse;
        for (const angle of volley.angles) {
          context.save();
          context.translate(volley.origin.x - camera.x, volley.origin.y - camera.y);
          context.rotate(angle);
          // Shift only the EX light cone toward the gun; the weapon emergence stays anchored.
          const offset = arisBeamOffset(volley.origin,angle,volley.special) +
            (volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment : 0);
          const cone = arisBeamVisualSettings.coneLength;
          // Additive bloom spreads blue/cyan light around the beam without changing its hit area.
          const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
          const layers = [
            [visual.bloomSpread, `rgba(36,151,255,${visual.bloomOpacity})`, visual.bloomBlur, 'lighter'],
            [2.1, `rgba(112,243,255,${visual.bloomOpacity})`, visual.bloomBlur*.5, 'lighter'],
            [2.2, '#219bff88', visual.outerBlur, 'source-over'],
            [1.3, '#51e6ffdd', visual.innerBlur, 'source-over'],
            [.55, '#f1ffff', 1.5, 'source-over']
          ];
          for (const [scale, color, blur, blend] of layers) {
            context.globalCompositeOperation = blend;
            const half = volley.width * scale * thickness / 2;
            context.filter = `blur(${blur}px)`;
            const rainbow=owner?.tuningParts&&rgbTuningActive(owner)&&scale>.6;
            context.fillStyle = rainbow?rainbowTrailGradient(context,offset,-volley.width,offset+600,volley.width):color;
            context.globalAlpha=rainbow?(scale>2?.35:.75):1;
            // Curved shoulders and a rounded nose soften the former triangular opening.
            context.beginPath(); context.moveTo(offset, 0);
            context.bezierCurveTo(offset, -half*.35, offset+cone*.45, -half, offset+cone, -half);
            context.lineTo(s.beamLength, -half); context.lineTo(s.beamLength, half);
            context.lineTo(offset+cone, half);
            context.bezierCurveTo(offset+cone*.45, half, offset, half*.35, offset, 0);
            context.closePath(); context.fill();
          }
          context.restore();
        }
      }
    }
  };
}


/** Sweep toward the closest beam edge, plus a small forward shove.
 * Include projected body radius so even large enemies clear the beam at zero resistance.
 * Shared knockback still respects resistance, collisions and absolute immunity.
 */
export function supernovaKnockback(enemy, origin, angle, width) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  const forwardX = Math.cos(angle), forwardY = Math.sin(angle);
  const sideX = -forwardY, sideY = forwardX;
  const offset = (body.x-origin.x)*sideX + (body.y-origin.y)*sideY;
  const sign = offset < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  const radius = Math.hypot(body.rx*sideX, body.ry*sideY);
  const distance = Math.max(0, width/2 + radius + supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackClearance - Math.abs(offset));
  return {
    x: sideX*sign*distance + forwardX*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback,
    y: sideY*sign*distance + forwardY*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback
  };
}


/** Pure presentation timing; only the active3seconds authorize EX damage. */
export function supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed) {
  const openingDuration = arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds + arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds;
  const beamAge = elapsed-openingDuration;
  return { openingDuration, beamAge,
    damaging: beamAge >= 0 && beamAge < supernovaSkillSettings.duration,
    beamFinished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier,
    finished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier +
      arisBeamVisualSettings.weaponReturnSeconds };
}


/** Fade and slide out from the player's center, hold through firing/tail, then return. */
export function supernovaWeaponPose(elapsed, player = {label:'Plana',x:0,y:0}, angle = 0) {
  const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
  const phase = supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed);
  const smooth = value => { const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)); return t*t*(3-2*t); };
  const emerge = smooth(elapsed/visual.openingSeconds);
  const returnStart = phase.openingDuration + supernovaSkillSettings.duration*visual.durationMultiplier;
  const returning = smooth((elapsed-returnStart)/visual.weaponReturnSeconds);
  const progress = emerge*(1-returning);
  return {opacity:progress, offset:(arisBeamOffset(arisBeamAnchor(player),angle,true)-visual.weaponLength/2)*progress,
    length:visual.weaponLength};
}


/** Use the real player collider center, including its vertical sprite offset. */
export function arisBeamAnchor(player) { return getCombatHitbox(player, false); }

/** Automatic beam starts 10px beyond the collider; EX adds its independent muzzle gap. */
export function arisBeamOffset(anchor, angle, special = false) {
  const rx = Math.max(anchor.rx || 0, 0.000001), ry = Math.max(anchor.ry || 0, 0.000001);
  return 1/Math.hypot(Math.cos(angle)/rx,Math.sin(angle)/ry) + supernovaSkillSettings.hitboxGap + (special ? supernovaSkillSettings.extraMuzzleGap : 0);
}

import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { badCookingSettings, badCookingLevelStats } from './game-config.js';
import { totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Persistent miasma: renewal replaces the old field and never overlaps another copy. */
export function createBadCookingAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
  let owner=null,active=false,enabled=true,elapsed=0,cycle=0,time=0,hits=new Map(),mist=null;
  function reset(){owner=null;active=false;elapsed=0;cycle=0;time=0;hits.clear();}
  function update(delta,player){
    const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');
    if(!weapon){reset();return;}if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(delta<=0)return;if(!enabled){active=false;return;}
    active=true;elapsed=(elapsed+delta)%badCookingSettings.interval;cycle+=delta;
    const stats=badCookingLevelStats(weapon.level),radius=stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    let left=delta;
    while(left>1e-8){const step=Math.min(left,1/60);left-=step;time+=step;
      const enemies=getAllEnemies(),liveIds=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
      for(const id of hits.keys())if(!liveIds.has(id))hits.delete(id);
      for(const enemy of enemies){
        if(time-(hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<stats.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;
        const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=body.x-target.x,dy=body.y-target.y;
        // Closest point on the sprite hurtbox, rather than contact hitbox.
        const distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/target.rx,dy/distance/target.ry):0;
        if(distance>radius+extent)continue;
        hits.set(enemy.id,time);
        const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'bad-cooking',badCookingSettings.damage,stats.damageBonuses,
          {projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:stats.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'bad-cooking'});
        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
        if(stats.knockback&&landed!==false&&living){const angle=Math.atan2(-dy,-dx),duration=badCookingSettings.knockbackSeconds;
          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(angle)*badCookingSettings.knockbackSpeed*duration*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player),Math.sin(angle)*badCookingSettings.knockbackSpeed*duration*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player),duration,duration);}
      }
    }
  }
  function draw(context,camera){
    if(!active||!owner)return;
    if(!mist){mist=document.createElement('canvas');mist.width=mist.height=256;const c=mist.getContext('2d'),g=c.createRadialGradient(128,128,0,128,128,128);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(192,143,231,.13)');g.addColorStop(.88,'rgba(192,143,231,.13)');g.addColorStop(.98,'rgba(192,143,231,.1)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(192,143,231,0)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,256,256);}
    const body=getCombatHitbox(owner,false),weapon=owner.attackSlots.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');
    const radius=badCookingLevelStats(weapon?.level).radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(owner),x=body.x-camera.x,y=body.y-camera.y;
    context.save();context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,cycle/.3);
    context.drawImage(mist,x-radius,y-radius,radius*2,radius*2);
    context.beginPath();context.arc(x,y,radius,0,Math.PI*2);
    context.lineWidth=1.25;context.strokeStyle='rgba(187,124,227,.38)';context.stroke();
    // Fixed particle seeds: softly fade in, rise vertically, then fade out and repeat.
    // Only their phase changes; no orbiting, expanding cloud blobs or per-frame allocations.
    for(let i=0;i<32;i++){
      const phase=(cycle/(1.5+(i%5)*.15)+i*.61803398875)%1;
      const angle=i*2.399963,r=radius*Math.sqrt((i+.5)/32)*.76;
      const px=Math.cos(angle)*r,py=Math.sin(angle)*r;
      const rise=Math.min(radius*.36,52),size=4+i%3;
      context.fillStyle=`rgba(192,103,238,${.85*Math.sin(Math.PI*phase)})`;
      context.fillRect(x+px-size/2,y+py-rise*phase-size/2,size,size);
    }
    context.restore();
  }
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)active=false;},get active(){return active;}};
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/bitmap-font.js | sha256=fabb366d4fadd605209c783622c2000414a811d3b704a08b320102892b84fecf | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { font21Metrics } from './font21-metrics.js';
import { font2Metrics } from './font2-metrics.js';
import { thinFontMetrics } from './font-thin-metrics.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';
const highlightedGlyphs=new Map();

/** Important EX values/effects use yellow ink, without changing the wording or wrapping. */
export function statHighlightRanges(text) {
  return [...text.matchAll(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:%|×|x\b)?|\b(?:seconds?|critical chance|noncritical|stunning|knocking enemies aside|unlimited piercing|stored[- ]charge|ATK)\b/gi)]
    .map(match=>({start:match.index,end:match.index+match[0].length}));
}

/** Tint bright glyph ink once and preserve the original dark outline and transparency. */
function yellowGlyph(image,glyph,variant,character) {
  const key=`${variant}:${character}`;if(highlightedGlyphs.has(key))return highlightedGlyphs.get(key);
  const tile=document.createElement('canvas');tile.width=glyph.width;tile.height=glyph.height;
  const context=tile.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  context.drawImage(image,glyph.x,glyph.y,glyph.width,glyph.height,0,0,glyph.width,glyph.height);
  const pixels=context.getImageData(0,0,tile.width,tile.height);
  for(let i=0;i<pixels.data.length;i+=4)if(pixels.data[i]>160&&pixels.data[i+1]>160&&pixels.data[i+2]>160) {
    pixels.data[i]=255;pixels.data[i+1]=225;pixels.data[i+2]=90;
  }
  context.putImageData(pixels,0,0);highlightedGlyphs.set(key,tile);return tile;
}

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null, variant = 'regular', maxWidth = null, wrap = true, highlightStats = false } = {}) {
  canvas.setAttribute('data-bitmap-text','');
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';
  const sourceScale = variant === 'font21' ? .25 : 1;
  const lineHeight = variant === 'font21' ? 24 : 20;
  const glyphFor = character => variant === 'font21' ? font21Metrics[character] || font21Metrics['?'] : variant === 'font2' ? font2Metrics[character] || font2Metrics['?'] : variant === 'thin' ? thinFontMetrics[character] || thinFontMetrics['?'] : glyphRectangle(character);

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const lines = [''];
    const measure = value => [...value].reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(c).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap), outlineOverlap) * scale;
    for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
      const index = lines.length - 1;
      const next = lines[index] ? `${lines[index]} ${word}` : word;
      if (wrap && maxWidth && lines[index] && measure(next) > maxWidth) lines.push(word);
      else lines[index] = next;
    }
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, ...lines.map(measure));
    canvas.height = lineHeight * scale * lines.length;
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    lines.forEach((line, row) => {
      let x = 0,index=0;const highlights=highlightStats?statHighlightRanges(line):[];
      for (const character of line) {
        if (character !== ' ') {
          const glyph = glyphFor(character);
          const highlighted=highlights.some(range=>index>=range.start&&index<range.end);
          const source=highlighted?yellowGlyph(image,glyph,variant,character):image;
          context.drawImage(source, highlighted?0:glyph.x, highlighted?0:glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
            x * scale, (row * lineHeight + glyph.offsetY * sourceScale) * scale, glyph.width * sourceScale * scale, glyph.height * sourceScale * scale);
        }
        x += character === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(character).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap;
        index+=character.length;
      }
    });
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = new URL(variant === 'font21' ? '../sprites/font2.1.png' : variant === 'font2' ? '../sprites/font2.png' : variant === 'thin' ? '../sprites/font-thin.png' : '../sprites/font.png', import.meta.url).href;
  return {
    setMaxWidth(value) { maxWidth = value; render(); },
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}

import {weakenedAttackMultiplier} from './weak-tuning.js';
import {eraseTuningProjectiles} from './neutralization-tuning.js';
import { drawArtilleryExplosion, artilleryExplosionDuration } from './artillery-explosion.js';
import { drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js?plasma-orange=2';
import { arisuBodyCenterOffsetY, neruBodyCenterOffsetY } from './game-config.js';
import { bossBehaviorSettings as settings, contactSettings, spriteDisplayPadding, normalSpriteSize } from './game-config.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Solve horizontal shell interception, including windup, travel time and player velocity. */
export function irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
  const s=settings.iroha,body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
  const vx=delta>0?(motion.x||0)/delta:0,vy=delta>0?(motion.y||0)/delta:0;
  const barrelY=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY,clearance=s.cannonWarningWidth/2+body.ry;
  const earliest=s.cannonWindupSeconds+s.cannonFireDelay;
  const options=[];
  for(const side of [-1,1]) {
    const muzzle=npc.x+side*(npc.spriteSize||200)*.35;
    const relativeSpeed=side*s.cannonSpeed-vx;
    if(Math.abs(relativeSpeed)>1e-8) {
      const impactTime=(body.x-muzzle+side*s.cannonSpeed*earliest)/relativeSpeed;
      if(impactTime>=earliest&&impactTime-earliest<=settings.projectileLifetime&&Math.abs(body.y+vy*impactTime-barrelY)<=clearance)
        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt:earliest,impactTime});
    }
    if(Math.abs(vy)>1e-8) {
      const impactTime=(barrelY-body.y)/vy;
      const flight=(body.x+vx*impactTime-muzzle)/(side*s.cannonSpeed);
      const fireAt=impactTime-flight;
      if(flight>=0&&flight<=settings.projectileLifetime&&fireAt>=earliest&&fireAt<=earliest+s.cannonMaxInterceptWait)
        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt,impactTime});
    }
  }
  return options.sort((a,b)=>a.fireAt-b.fireAt||a.impactTime-b.impactTime)[0]||null;
}

/** Position-based pool, recalculated once when Iroha starts an attack. */
export function irohaAttackChances(npc,player) {
  const dx=Math.abs(player.x-npc.x),dy=Math.abs(player.y-npc.y);
  // Symmetric sigmoid over each quadrant: rapid change through 30?60deg, 50/50 at 45deg.
  const position=Math.atan2(dy,dx)/(Math.PI/2),power=settings.iroha.attackAngleExponent;
  const horizontal=(1-position)**power,vertical=position**power;
  const cannon=dx===0&&dy===0?.5:horizontal/(horizontal+vertical);
  return {cannon,artillery:1-cannon};
}
export function irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0},random=Math.random) {
  const pool=irohaAttackChances(npc,player,delta,motion);
  return random()<pool.cannon?'cannon':'artillery';
}

/** Cardinal movement produces +; diagonal movement produces X. */
export function irohaArtilleryPoints(npc,player,motion={x:0,y:0},viewport={width:1280,height:720}) {
  const dx=Math.abs(motion.x||0),dy=Math.abs(motion.y||0);
  const diagonal=Math.max(dx,dy)>1e-6&&Math.min(dx,dy)/Math.max(dx,dy)>.4;
  const s=settings.iroha;
  // Keep a compact cluster of equal circles, with neighboring edges slightly overlapping.
  // Fit the + footprint using the configured coverage of the shorter visible dimension; X is its 45deg rotation.
  const radius=Math.min(viewport.width,viewport.height)*s.artilleryCoverage/(2*(1+s.artilleryCircleSpacing));
  const spacing=radius*s.artilleryCircleSpacing,angle=diagonal?Math.PI/4:0;
  return [{x:player.x,y:player.y,radius},...Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>({
    x:player.x+Math.cos(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*spacing,
    y:player.y+Math.sin(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*spacing,radius}))];
}

/** Continuous same-direction movement, measured once per simulation tick, not per boss. */
export function createSteadyMovementTracker() {
  let owner=null,seconds=0,heading=null,vx=0,vy=0;
  return {update(delta,player,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
    if(delta<=0)return;
    if(owner!==player){owner=player;seconds=0;heading=null;}
    const length=Math.hypot(motion.x||0,motion.y||0);
    if(length<.01){seconds=0;heading=null;vx=vy=0;return;}
    const direction={x:motion.x/length,y:motion.y/length};
    if(!heading||direction.x*heading.x+direction.y*heading.y<.995){seconds=0;heading=direction;}
    seconds+=delta;vx=motion.x/delta;vy=motion.y/delta;
  },get seconds(){return seconds;},get velocity(){return {x:vx,y:vy};}};
}

/** Boss action state, projectiles and warned area attacks; Shiroko keeps ordinary chase AI. */
export function createBossBehaviors({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const bullets=[],zones=[],warnings=new Map(),landingShadows=new Map(),movement=createSteadyMovementTracker();
  let shakeRemaining=0,shakeElapsed=0;
  function hit(player,amount,attacker) {
    if(player.contactIFrames>0)return false;
    if(damagePlayer(player,attacker?.weakRemaining>0?Math.floor(amount*weakenedAttackMultiplier(attacker)):amount)){player.contactIFrames=contactSettings.iFrameDuration;if(attacker)attacker.secondsSincePlayerHit=0;return true;}
    return false;
  }
  function fire(npc,angle,speed,radius=5,options={}) {
    if(bullets.length>=settings.projectileLimit)return;
    bullets.push({owner:npc.id,ownerType:npc.type,x:npc.x,y:npc.y,previousX:npc.x,previousY:npc.y,
      vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,radius,age:0,damage:npc.contactDamage||1,...options});
  }
  function zone(npc,x,y,delay,radius) { zones.push({owner:npc.id,x,y,remaining:delay,radius,damage:npc.contactDamage||1}); }
  function begin(npc,name,extra={}) { npc.bossAction={name,elapsed:0,...extra};npc.gifElapsed=0;npc.moving=false; }
  function finish(npc) {landingShadows.delete(npc.id);npc.bossAction=null;npc.bossSquash=1;npc.bossVisualOffsetY=0;npc.attack=null;}
  function startIroha(npc,name,player,delta,motion,extra={}) {
    const s=settings.iroha;
    const intercept=name==='cannon'?(irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,motion)||{
      angle:player.x<npc.x?Math.PI:player.x>npc.x?0:npc.facing==='right'?0:Math.PI,
      fireAt:s.cannonWindupSeconds+s.cannonFireDelay
    }):null;
    if(intercept)npc.facing=Math.cos(intercept.angle)<0?'left':'right';
    begin(npc,name,{...intercept,...extra});
    npc.attack={name,facing:npc.facing||'left',elapsed:0,walkElapsed:npc.elapsed||0};
  }
  /** Return true while this controller owns movement; otherwise use ordinary chasing. */
  function updateNpc(npc,player,delta,viewport,playerMotion={x:0,y:0},chaseDuringAction=()=>{}) {
    const s=settings[npc.type];
    if(!s||!npc.ai||delta<=0)return false;
    npc.bossCooldown=(npc.bossCooldown??s.interval)-delta;
    if(!npc.bossAction&&npc.bossCooldown<=0) {
      npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;npc.bossMoveIndex=(npc.bossMoveIndex||0)+1;
      if(npc.type==='arisu')begin(npc,'chargeUp',{clip:'charge',angle:Math.atan2(player.y-npc.y,player.x-npc.x)});
      if(npc.type==='iroha') {
        const name=irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,playerMotion,random);
        const before=name==='cannon'&&random()>=1-s.artilleryBeforeCannonChance;
        startIroha(npc,before?'artillery':name,player,delta,playerMotion,before?{nextAction:'cannon'}:{});
      }
      if(npc.type==='neru')begin(npc,npc.bossMoveIndex%2?'shoot':'compress',npc.bossMoveIndex%2?{clip:'shoot',nextBullet:0,pattern:npc.bossMoveIndex%4===3?'stream':'radial',streamIndex:0}:{});
    }
    const action=npc.bossAction;if(!action)return false;
    action.elapsed+=delta;npc.moving=false;
    if(npc.type==='iroha')chaseDuringAction(npc);
    if(action.name==='chargeUp') {
      const center={x:npc.x+(npc.spriteHurtbox?.offsetX||0),y:npc.y+arisuBodyCenterOffsetY(npc)};
      if(!action.aimLocked) {
        action.angle=Math.atan2(player.y-center.y,player.x-center.x);
        action.targetX=player.x;action.targetY=player.y;
        if(action.elapsed>=s.trackingSeconds-1e-8)action.aimLocked=true;
      }
      npc.facing=Math.cos(action.angle)<0?'left':'right';
      warnings.set(npc.id,{x:center.x,y:center.y,angle:action.angle,progress:Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.chargeUpSeconds),length:Math.hypot(viewport.width,viewport.height)+npc.spriteSize,width:s.warningWidth});
    }
    if(action.name==='chargeUp'&&action.elapsed>=s.chargeUpSeconds-1e-8) {
      const angle=action.angle;warnings.delete(npc.id);
      // Measure along the warned ray from the same visible body center used for aiming.
      // Dividing by a nearly horizontal/vertical component can create enormous dash ranges.
      const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
      const originX=npc.x+(npc.spriteHurtbox?.offsetX||0);
      const originY=npc.y+arisuBodyCenterOffsetY(npc);
      const targetDistance=Math.max(0,(player.x-originX)*dx+(player.y-originY)*dy);
      // Preserve the full dash launch speed at every distance; braking remains timed.
      const launchSpeed=s.chargeSpeed;
      const brakeAt=targetDistance;
      begin(npc,'charge',{angle,travelled:0,targetDistance,brakeAt,launchSpeed,speed:launchSpeed,brakingElapsed:0});
    } else if(action.name==='charge') {
      // Keep the direction locked, but pass the player's current position along that ray.
      // Otherwise a fleeing player can move beyond the old warning-time braking point.
      if(action.brakingElapsed===0) {
        const centerX=npc.x+(npc.spriteHurtbox?.offsetX||0);
        const centerY=npc.y+arisuBodyCenterOffsetY(npc);
        const remaining=(player.x-centerX)*Math.cos(action.angle)+(player.y-centerY)*Math.sin(action.angle);
        action.brakeAt=action.travelled+Math.max(0,remaining);
      }
      // Once braking begins, retain its bounded travel and timed return to chase.
      const before=Math.min(delta,Math.max(0,action.brakeAt-action.travelled)/action.launchSpeed);
      const after=delta-before;
      let travel=before*action.launchSpeed;
      if(after>0) {
        // Front-load braking while retaining a continuous 1.5s ease to zero.
        // Analytic integration bounds post-target travel to the configured distance.
        const duration=s.decelerationSeconds;
        const power=Math.max(1,action.launchSpeed*duration/s.brakingDistance-1);
        const previous=Math.min(duration,action.brakingElapsed);
        const next=Math.min(duration,previous+after);
        travel+=action.launchSpeed*duration/(power+1)*
          ((1-previous/duration)**(power+1)-(1-next/duration)**(power+1));
        action.brakingElapsed=next;
        action.speed=action.launchSpeed*(1-next/duration)**power;
      }
      const distance=travel;action.travelled+=distance;
      const x=npc.x,y=npc.y;npc.x+=Math.cos(action.angle)*distance;npc.y+=Math.sin(action.angle)*distance;
      npc.facing=Math.cos(action.angle)<0?'left':'right';npc.moving=true;
      const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),dx=npc.x-x,dy=npc.y-y;
      const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((body.x-x)*dx+(body.y-y)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1)));
      if(Math.hypot(body.x-x-dx*t,body.y-y-dy*t)<body.rx+s.chargeRadius)hit(player,s.chargeDamage,npc);
      if(action.brakingElapsed>=s.decelerationSeconds-1e-8) {
        finish(npc);npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;npc.moving=false;
        npc.gifElapsed=0;npc.contactReaction=null;
        return false; // Resume ordinary chase in this same NPC update, with the normal animation.
      }
    } else if(action.name==='recover') {
      if(npc.type==='neru'&&action.squashFrom!=null){
        const t=Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.recoverySeconds);npc.bossSquash=action.squashFrom+(1-action.squashFrom)*(1-(1-t)**3);
      }
      if(action.elapsed>=s.recoverySeconds){finish(npc);if(npc.type==='neru'){npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;return false;}}
    } else if(npc.type==='iroha') {
      const cannon=action.name==='cannon',windup=cannon?s.cannonWindupSeconds:.4;
      const fireAt=cannon?(action.fireAt??windup+s.cannonFireDelay):windup;
      if(npc.attack) {
        // The supplied cannon sheet first flashes at frame 2; release the shell on that pose.
        const frameSeconds=(npc.attacks?.cannon?.frameDuration||110)/1000;
        const animationStart=cannon?fireAt-s.cannonFireFrame*frameSeconds:0;
        npc.attack.elapsed=Math.max(0,action.elapsed-animationStart)*1000+1e-6;
      }
      if(cannon&&!action.fired) {
        const x=npc.x+Math.cos(action.angle)*(npc.spriteSize||200)*.35;
        const y=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY;
        warnings.set(npc.id,{x,y,angle:action.angle,progress:Math.min(1,action.elapsed/fireAt),
          length:viewport.width+(npc.spriteSize||200),width:s.cannonWarningWidth,back:(npc.spriteSize||200)*.55});
      }
      if(!action.fired&&action.elapsed>=fireAt-1e-8) {
        action.fired=true;warnings.delete(npc.id);
        if(cannon)fire(npc,action.angle,s.cannonSpeed,s.cannonWarningWidth/2,{
          x:npc.x+Math.cos(action.angle)*(npc.spriteSize||200)*.35,y:npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY,cannon:true,angle:action.angle,speed:s.cannonSpeed,color:'orange'});
        else {
          let target=player;
          if(movement.seconds>=s.artilleryLeadAfter-1e-8&&random()<s.artilleryLeadChance) {
            const velocity=movement.velocity,length=Math.hypot(velocity.x,velocity.y);
            const seconds=Math.min(s.artilleryLeadSeconds,length?s.artilleryMaxLead/length:0);
            target={x:player.x+velocity.x*seconds,y:player.y+velocity.y*seconds};
          }
          for(const [index,point] of irohaArtilleryPoints(npc,target,playerMotion,viewport).entries())zones.push({owner:npc.id,...point,
          radius:point.radius,damage:npc.contactDamage||1,artillery:true,age:0,impactOffset:index*s.artilleryStaggerSeconds,
          side:npc.x<=point.x?-1:1,detonated:false});
        }
      }
      if(action.elapsed>=(cannon?fireAt+s.cannonSeconds-s.cannonWindupSeconds-s.cannonFireDelay:s.artillerySeconds)) {
        if(action.nextAction==='cannon')startIroha(npc,'cannon',player,delta,playerMotion);
        else if(cannon&&random()>=1-s.artilleryAfterCannonChance)startIroha(npc,'artillery',player,delta,playerMotion);
        else {finish(npc);npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;}
      }
    } else if(action.name==='shoot') {
      while(action.nextBullet<=Math.min(action.elapsed,s.shootSeconds)) {
        if(action.pattern==='stream') {
          const target=getCombatHitbox(player);
          const originY=npc.y+neruBodyCenterOffsetY(npc);
          const angle=Math.atan2(target.y-originY,target.x-npc.x);
          const lane=(action.streamIndex++%2===0?-1:1)*s.streamLaneOffset;
          fire(npc,angle,s.streamBulletSpeed,s.bulletRadius,{plasma:true,piercing:true,angle,speed:s.streamBulletSpeed,color:'orange',
            x:npc.x-Math.sin(angle)*lane,y:originY+Math.cos(angle)*lane});
        } else {
          for(let i=0;i<s.bulletCount;i++){const angle=i/s.bulletCount*Math.PI*2+action.nextBullet*1.3;fire(npc,angle,s.bulletSpeed,s.bulletRadius,{plasma:true,angle,speed:s.bulletSpeed,color:'orange',piercing:true});}
        }
        action.nextBullet+=action.pattern==='stream'?s.streamBulletInterval:s.bulletInterval;
      }
      if(action.elapsed>=s.shootSeconds)finish(npc);
    } else if(action.name==='compress') {
      const squish=Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.compressSeconds);
      npc.bossSquash=1-.45*squish*squish*(3-2*squish);
      if(action.elapsed>=s.compressSeconds-1e-8) {
        begin(npc,'leap',{fromX:npc.x,fromY:npc.y,targetX:npc.x,targetY:npc.y+(npc.spriteSize||300)/2-spriteDisplayPadding,aimLocked:false});

      }
    } else if(action.name==='leap') {
      const trackStart=s.leapRiseSeconds+s.shadowFadeSeconds;
      const trackEnd=trackStart+s.leapTrackingSeconds;
      const fallStart=trackEnd+s.leapLockSeconds;
      if(!action.aimLocked){
        const playerFeet=player.y+(player.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize)/2-spriteDisplayPadding;
        const dx=player.x-action.targetX,dy=playerFeet-action.targetY,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        const trackingDelta=Math.max(0,Math.min(action.elapsed,trackEnd)-Math.max(action.elapsed-delta,trackStart));
        const speed=Math.max(s.shadowChaseSpeed,Math.hypot(playerMotion.x||0,playerMotion.y||0)/delta*1.5);
        const step=Math.min(length,speed*trackingDelta);
        if(length>0){action.targetX+=dx/length*step;action.targetY+=dy/length*step;}
        if(action.elapsed>=trackEnd-1e-8)action.aimLocked=true;
      }
      const height=viewport.height+(npc.spriteSize||300)+Math.max(0,npc.y-viewport.y);
      if(action.elapsed<s.leapRiseSeconds) {
        const rise=Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.leapRiseSeconds),ease=rise*rise*(3-2*rise);
        npc.bossVisualOffsetY=-height*ease;
        npc.bossSquash=.55+.45*ease;
      } else {
        npc.bossSquash=1;
        npc.x=action.targetX;npc.y=action.targetY-(npc.spriteSize||300)/2+spriteDisplayPadding;
        if(action.airHeight==null)action.airHeight=height;
        const drop=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(action.elapsed-fallStart)/s.leapFallSeconds));
        npc.bossVisualOffsetY=-action.airHeight*(1-drop*drop);
      }
      if(action.elapsed>=s.leapRiseSeconds&&npc.y+(npc.spriteSize||300)/2-spriteDisplayPadding+npc.bossVisualOffsetY<=viewport.y) {
        landingShadows.set(npc.id,{x:action.targetX,y:action.targetY,radius:s.landingRadius*s.shadowScale,
          opacity:Math.min(1,(action.elapsed-s.leapRiseSeconds)/s.shadowFadeSeconds),
          growth:Math.min(1,(action.elapsed-s.leapRiseSeconds)/s.shadowFadeSeconds),locked:action.aimLocked});
      } else if(action.elapsed<s.leapRiseSeconds)landingShadows.delete(npc.id);
      if(action.elapsed>=fallStart+s.leapFallSeconds-1e-8) {
        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
        if(Math.hypot(body.x-action.targetX,body.y-action.targetY)<s.landingRadius+body.rx)hit(player,npc.contactDamage||1,npc);
        landingShadows.delete(npc.id);npc.bossVisualOffsetY=0;
        npc.bossSquash=s.impactSquash;begin(npc,'recover',{squashFrom:s.impactSquash});
        shakeRemaining=s.impactShakeSeconds;shakeElapsed=0;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }
  /** Advance attacks with swept projectile checks and the player's shared damage I-frames. */
  function updateEffects(delta,player,alive,playerMotion={x:0,y:0}) {
    movement.update(delta,player,playerMotion);
    shakeRemaining=Math.max(0,shakeRemaining-delta);shakeElapsed+=delta;
    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),live=new Set(alive.map(n=>n.id));
    const frozenOwners=new Set(alive.filter(owner=>owner.frozenRemaining>0).map(owner=>owner.id));
    for(const id of landingShadows.keys())if(!alive.some(n=>n.id===id&&n.bossAction?.name==='leap'))landingShadows.delete(id);
    for(const id of warnings.keys())if(!live.has(id)||!alive.find(n=>n.id===id&&(n.bossAction?.name==='chargeUp'||n.bossAction?.name==='cannon'&&!n.bossAction.fired)))warnings.delete(id);
    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
      const b=bullets[i];if(frozenOwners.has(b.owner))continue;
      b.age+=delta;b.previousX=b.x;b.previousY=b.y;b.x+=b.vx*delta;b.y+=b.vy*delta;
      const dx=b.x-b.previousX,dy=b.y-b.previousY;
      const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((body.x-b.previousX)*dx+(body.y-b.previousY)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1)));
      const touching=Math.hypot(body.x-b.previousX-dx*t,body.y-b.previousY-dy*t)<body.rx+b.radius;
      if(touching&&delta>0&&(!(b.cannon||b.piercing)||!b.hitPlayer)){
        const landed=hit(player,b.damage,alive.find(owner=>owner.id===b.owner));if((b.cannon||b.piercing)&&landed)b.hitPlayer=true;
      }
      if(touching&&delta>0&&!b.cannon&&!b.piercing||b.age>settings.projectileLifetime||!live.has(b.owner))bullets.splice(i,1);
    }
    for(let i=zones.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
      const z=zones[i];if(frozenOwners.has(z.owner))continue;
      if(!z.artillery)z.remaining-=delta;
      if(!live.has(z.owner)){zones.splice(i,1);continue;}
      if(z.artillery) {
        z.age+=delta;
        const impact=settings.iroha.artilleryDelay+(z.impactOffset||0)+settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds;
        if(!z.detonated&&z.age>=impact){z.detonated=true;if(Math.hypot(body.x-z.x,body.y-z.y)<z.radius+body.rx)hit(player,z.damage,alive.find(owner=>owner.id===z.owner));}
        if(z.age>=impact+artilleryExplosionDuration)zones.splice(i,1);
        continue;
      }
      if(z.remaining<=0){if(Math.hypot(body.x-z.x,body.y-z.y)<z.radius+body.rx)hit(player,z.damage,alive.find(owner=>owner.id===z.owner));zones.splice(i,1);}
    }
  }
  /** Draw attack cues and bullets in world space, with no hitstop or gameplay pauses. */
  function draw(context,camera) {
    context.save();context.lineWidth=2;
    for(const shadow of landingShadows.values()) {
      if(shadow.opacity<=0)continue;
      const x=shadow.x-camera.x,y=shadow.y-camera.y;
      context.fillStyle=`rgba(15,12,28,${.35*(shadow.opacity??1)})`;
      const grow=shadow.growth??1,scale=.35+.65*grow*grow*(3-2*grow);
      context.beginPath();context.ellipse(x,y,shadow.radius*scale,shadow.radius*.45*scale,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();

    }
    for(const w of warnings.values()) {
      context.save();context.translate(w.x-camera.x,w.y-camera.y);context.rotate(w.angle);
      const half=w.width/2,back=w.back||0;
      context.fillStyle='rgba(255,45,70,.16)';context.fillRect(-back,-half,w.length+back,w.width);
      context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,85,100,.65)';context.strokeRect(-back,-half,w.length+back,w.width);
      // Twin inner lines converge on the dash axis as the windup expires.
      const closing=half*(1-w.progress);
      context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,160,165,.85)';context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(-back,-closing);context.lineTo(w.length,-closing);
      context.moveTo(-back,closing);context.lineTo(w.length,closing);context.stroke();
      context.restore();
    }
    for(const z of zones){
      const localAge=z.artillery?z.age-(z.impactOffset||0):0;
      if(z.artillery&&localAge<0)continue;
      const impact=settings.iroha.artilleryDelay+settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds;
      // Each ring starts with its shell's stagger and remains until that shell lands.
      if(!z.artillery||localAge<impact) {
        context.strokeStyle='#ff5264';context.fillStyle='rgba(255,60,90,.12)';context.beginPath();
        context.arc(z.x-camera.x,z.y-camera.y,z.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();
        if(z.artillery){
          const progress=Math.min(1,localAge/impact);
          context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,180,185,.9)';context.lineWidth=3;context.beginPath();
          context.arc(z.x-camera.x,z.y-camera.y,Math.max(1,z.radius*(1-progress)),0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();context.lineWidth=2;
        }
      }
      if(z.artillery&&localAge>=settings.iroha.artilleryDelay) {
        const elapsed=localAge-settings.iroha.artilleryDelay;
        if(elapsed<settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds) {
          const t=elapsed/settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds;
          const x=z.x+z.side*260*(1-t),y=z.y-500*(1-t);
          drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,{x,y,angle:Math.atan2(500,-z.side*260),
            speed:Math.hypot(260,500)/settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds,age:elapsed,color:'orange'},
            settings.iroha.cannonWarningWidth/3.6*settings.iroha.artilleryShellScale,Infinity);
        } else drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,z,elapsed-settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds);
      }
    }
    for(const b of bullets){
      if(b.plasma){drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,b,settings.neru.bulletDiameter,settings.projectileLifetime);continue;}
      if(b.cannon){drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,{...b,color:'orange'},settings.iroha.cannonWarningWidth/3.6,settings.projectileLifetime);continue;}
      context.fillStyle='#61deff';context.strokeStyle='#e5fcff';context.beginPath();context.arc(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y,b.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();}

    context.restore();
  }
  return {eraseProjectiles:args=>eraseTuningProjectiles({...args,projectiles:bullets}),updateNpc,updateEffects,draw,get screenShake(){
    if(shakeRemaining<=0)return {x:0,y:0};
    const strength=settings.neru.impactShakeStrength*shakeRemaining/settings.neru.impactShakeSeconds;
    return {x:Math.sin(shakeElapsed*91+1)*strength,y:Math.cos(shakeElapsed*113)*strength};
  },get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get zoneCount(){return zones.length;}};
}

import { bossCatchupSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { bossCatchupSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { isBossEnemy, enemyViewportDistance } from './world-state.js';
import { statMultiplier } from './combat-stats.js';



/** Boost distant chasing bosses above player speed until their sprite re-enters view. */
export function updateBossCatchup(enemy, player, camera, width, height, baseSpeed = 180) {
  if (!isBossEnemy(enemy) && !enemy.campaignGuardian) return;
  const distance = enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height);
  if (distance > bossCatchupSettings.distance) enemy.catchingUp = true;
  if (distance === 0) enemy.catchingUp = false;
  const playerSpeed = baseSpeed * (player.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(player, 'spdPercent');
  const enemySpeed = baseSpeed * (enemy.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(enemy, 'spdPercent');
  enemy.catchupSpeed = enemy.catchingUp && enemy.ai && enemy.behavior === 'chase'
    ? Math.max(enemySpeed * bossCatchupSettings.baseMultiplier,
      playerSpeed * bossCatchupSettings.playerMultiplier + bossCatchupSettings.extraSpeed) : 0;
}

import { bossChanceFormula, bossPityThresholds, enemyTypeStats, eventTriggerSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { bossSpawnSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { bossSpawnSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { bossSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { getAllEnemies, isBossEnemy, onEnemySpawn, onEnemyDefeat } from './world-state.js';
import { offscreenSpawnPoint } from './playtest-spawner.js';



/** Endless kill totals are separate from the boss-charge counter. */
export function bossWaveLimit(endlessKills) {
  return endlessKills >= bossSpawnSettings.thirdBossUnlockKills
    ? bossSpawnSettings.unlockedWaveSize : bossSpawnSettings.waveSize;
}

/** Pick distinct bosses only; missing future roster entries never become duplicates. */
export function selectBossWave(stage, endless, endlessKills, roster, random = Math.random) {
  const available = [...new Set(roster)];
  if (!endless) {
    const preferred = bossTypeForStage(stage, random);
    return available.includes(preferred) ? [preferred] : available.slice(0, 1);
  }
  for (let i = available.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
    [available[i], available[j]] = [available[j], available[i]];
  }
  return available.slice(0, bossWaveLimit(endlessKills));
}

/** Stage 1 always uses Shiroko; unassigned stages retain the current test roster. */
export function bossTypeForStage(stage, random = Math.random) {
  return stage.id === 'first' ? 'shiroko' : random() < 0.5 ? 'iroha' : 'shiroko';
}

/** Chance per eligible kill; switch to the shorter pity curve at 5 minutes after Stage 4. */
export function bossChance(kills, endlessSeconds = null) {
  return bossChanceFormula(kills, endlessSeconds);
}

/** Keep progression separate from total run kills and freeze it while bosses live. */
export function createBossCharge(random = Math.random, getEndlessSeconds = () => null) {
  let kills = 0, pending = false;
  return {
    recordDefeat(bossWasAlive) {
      if (bossWasAlive || pending) return;
      kills++;
      const chance = bossChance(kills, getEndlessSeconds());
      if (chance > 0 && (chance >= 1 || random() < chance)) pending = true;
    },
    // Reaching 5 endless minutes can make the existing kill count immediately guaranteed.
    refresh(bossAlive = false) {
      if (!bossAlive && kills >= bossPityThresholds(getEndlessSeconds()).guaranteedKills) pending = true;
    },
    get thresholds() { return bossPityThresholds(getEndlessSeconds()); },
    reset() { kills = 0; pending = false; },
    get kills() { return kills; },
    get pending() { return pending; },
    get chance() { return bossChance(kills, getEndlessSeconds()); }
  };
}

/** Spawn an offscreen chasing boss after a successful kill roll, retrying blocked spots. */
export function createBossSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnBoss, slotsRemaining, onSpawn, isEndless,
  getSurvivalSeconds = () => 0, automaticEnabled = () => true, getBossTypes = () => ['shiroko', 'iroha'], getEndlessSeconds = () => null, canSpawnWave = () => true }) {
  const charge = createBossCharge(Math.random, getEndlessSeconds);
  const status = document.querySelector('#boss-spawn-status');
  const details = document.querySelector('#boss-spawn-details');
  let retry = 0;
  let endlessKills = 0;
  let waveQueue = [];
  let firstBossSpawned = false;
  const timedFirstStage = () => !isEndless() && getStage().id === 'first';

  function updateStatus() {
    const alive = getAllEnemies().filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    const state = alive ? `Frozen: ${alive} boss alive.` : !eventTriggerSettings.enabled && !waveQueue.length ? 'Legacy automatic event triggers disabled.' : timedFirstStage() && !waveQueue.length ? 'Shiroko scheduled at 05:00.' : alive ? `Frozen: ${alive} boss alive.` : waveQueue.length || charge.pending ? 'Boss wave ready.'
      : `${(charge.chance * 100).toFixed(2)}% chance per kill.`;
    const text = `Boss charge: ${charge.kills}/${charge.thresholds.guaranteedKills}\n${state}\n${isEndless() ? `Endless kills: ${endlessKills}` : 'Stages 1–4'}`;
    if (status.textContent !== text) status.textContent = text;
    if (details) details.textContent = `Boss wave: ${isEndless() ? Math.min(bossWaveLimit(endlessKills), new Set(getBossTypes()).size) : 1}. Unlocked slots: ${isEndless() ? bossWaveLimit(endlessKills) : 1}. Pity starts: ${charge.thresholds.pityStart} kills. Unique boss types: ${new Set(getBossTypes()).size}. Waiting to place: ${waveQueue.length}.`;
  }
  const stopSpawn = onEnemySpawn(enemy => {
    if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) {
      if (timedFirstStage() && enemy.type === 'shiroko') firstBossSpawned = true;
      charge.reset();
      waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(type => type !== enemy.type);
      updateStatus();
    }
  });
  const stopDefeat = onEnemyDefeat(({ bossesAliveBefore }) => {
    if (isEndless()) endlessKills++;
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && !timedFirstStage()) charge.recordDefeat(bossesAliveBefore > 0 || waveQueue.length > 0);
    updateStatus();
  });

  /** Keep guaranteed spawns pending until a valid offscreen spot and slot exist. */
  function update(delta) {
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && !timedFirstStage()) charge.refresh(getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy) || waveQueue.length > 0);
    updateStatus();
    retry = Math.max(0, retry - delta);
    if (retry > 0 || slotsRemaining() <= 0) return;
    if (!waveQueue.length) {
      if (!eventTriggerSettings.enabled) return;
      if (!canSpawnWave()) return;
      if (getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy)) return;
      if (timedFirstStage()) {
        if (firstBossSpawned || !automaticEnabled() || getSurvivalSeconds() < enemyTypeStats.shiroko.spawnAtSeconds) return;
      } else if (!charge.pending) return;
      waveQueue = selectBossWave(getStage(), isEndless(), endlessKills, getBossTypes());
    }
    if (!waveQueue.length) return;
    retry = bossSpawnSettings.retryInterval;
    const stage = { ...getStage(), spawnMargin: 150, spawnRadius: bossSpriteSize / 2 };
    let spawned = false;
    for (const type of [...waveQueue]) {
      if (slotsRemaining() <= 0) break;
      if (getAllEnemies().some(enemy => isBossEnemy(enemy) && enemy.type === type)) {
        waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(entry => entry !== type);
        continue;
      }
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < bossSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        if (point && spawnBoss(type, point.x, point.y)) {
          waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(entry => entry !== type);
          charge.reset();
          spawned = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (spawned) onSpawn();
    updateStatus();
  }
  updateStatus();
  return { update,
    requestWave() {
      if (getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy) || waveQueue.length) return false;
      waveQueue = selectBossWave(getStage(), isEndless(), endlessKills, getBossTypes());
      charge.reset();
      retry = 0;
      return waveQueue.length > 0;
    },
    get hasPendingWave() { return waveQueue.length > 0; },
    get endlessKills() { return endlessKills; }, dispose() { stopSpawn(); stopDefeat(); } };
}

/** Return an ordinary arrival profile; Midori joins the evenly mixed pool at 30:00. */
export function pickEndlessEnemy(seconds, random = Math.random) {
  const settings = endlessEnemySettings;
  if (seconds < settings.startSeconds) return null;
  const pool = seconds >= settings.midoriStartSeconds ? [...settings.enemies, 'midori'] : settings.enemies;
  const type = pool[Math.min(pool.length - 1, Math.floor(random() * pool.length))];
  const mega = type !== 'midori';
  return {type, mega:false, scheduled:false,
    row:{id:`endless-${type}`, stage:'endless', kind:'regular', enemies:[type],
      ...(mega ? settings.mega : settings.midori), mega, endless:true, start:settings.startSeconds}};
}

  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'targetPercent')>0)shareTargetTuningDamage({player,enemy,damage:Math.min(hpBefore,hit.damage),hitType:hit.type});
  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'repairMaxHpPercent')>0)tryRepairTuningHit({player});
  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'creditChancePercent')>0)tryLuxeryTuningHit({player,enemy,damage:hit.damage});
  return true;
}
