import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03, playerOffsetY: 6, playerRadiusScale: 0.72 }, // Pixels downward for the controlled player.
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.28, y: 0.04, eliteOffsetY: 6, normalOffsetY: 6 }, // Circular Mob collider; elite variants scale the same profile.
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.30, y: 0.05 } // Center on the visible body below the halo.
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale * (enemy ? 1 : profile.playerRadiusScale || 1);
  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = !enemy ? (profile.playerOffsetY || 0) : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  const eliteOffsetY = enemy ? (character.elite ? profile.eliteOffsetY || 0 : profile.normalOffsetY || 0) : 0;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY + eliteOffsetY, rx, ry };
}

/** Damage-receiving sprite bounds are separate from the small contact-damage ellipse. */
export function getEnemyHurtbox(character) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const bounds=character.spriteHurtbox||{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2,height:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2};
  const oval=bounds.mask?.ellipse;
  if(oval)return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX+(oval.x-.5)*bounds.width*(bounds.mirrored?-1:1),
    y:character.y+bounds.offsetY+(oval.y-.5)*bounds.height,
    rx:oval.rx*bounds.width,ry:oval.ry*bounds.height,shape:'ellipse',
    coverage:oval.coverage,emptyFraction:oval.emptyFraction,meetsTargets:oval.meetsTargets};
  return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX,y:character.y+bounds.offsetY,
    rx:Math.max(1,bounds.width/2),ry:Math.max(1,bounds.height/2),shape:'rectangle',
    mask:bounds.mask,mirrored:bounds.mirrored,maskWidth:bounds.width,maskHeight:bounds.height};
}

/** Test a segment against sprite rectangles or the existing contact ellipses. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  if(body.shape==='rectangle') {
    let near=0,far=1;
    for(const [start,end,center,radius] of [[x1,x2,body.x,body.rx],[y1,y2,body.y,body.ry]]) {
      const delta=end-start;
      if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-10){if(start<center-radius||start>center+radius)return false;continue;}
      let a=(center-radius-start)/delta,b=(center+radius-start)/delta;
      if(a>b)[a,b]=[b,a];near=Math.max(near,a);far=Math.min(far,b);
      if(near>far)return false;
    }
    if(!body.mask)return true;
    // The broad crop rectangle overlaps; now require actual opaque sprite pixels.
    const padX=Math.max(0,body.rx-body.maskWidth/2),padY=Math.max(0,body.ry-body.maskHeight/2);
    return body.mask.some(run=>segmentHitsBody({shape:'rectangle',
      x:body.x+(run.x-.5)*body.maskWidth*(body.mirrored?-1:1),
      y:body.y+(run.y-.5)*body.maskHeight,
      rx:run.width*body.maskWidth/2+padX,ry:run.height*body.maskHeight/2+padY},x1,y1,x2,y2));
  }
  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;
  const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const t = length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(x * dx + y * dy) / length)) : 0;
  return (x + dx * t) ** 2 + (y + dy * t) ** 2 <= 1;
}

import { itemCritPenalty, itemDamageBonus, overclockingStats, itemSkillDamageMultiplier } from './item-catalog.js';
import { tuningPerk, startingWeaponProjectileCount, emptyWeaponSlotCount, weaponTuningDamageBonus, stationaryTuningActive } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { percentBonusFormula, attackDamageFormula, weaponDamageFormula, growthSettings, totalATKFormula, attackStatSettings, totalCritModFormula, bonusDamageTakenFormula, damageBonusFormula, damageReductionFormula, haloDamageFormula, damageModifiersFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { defaultCombatStats, combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.


/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= key==='critPercent'?(character.baseCritPercent??value):value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
  return percentBonusFormula(value+(key==='spdPercent'?(character.baseSPD??100)-100:0)+(key==='spdPercent'&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,'characterSpeedPercent'):0));
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target, weaponId, skillAttack = false } = {}) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);
  const bonusCrit=buffs.reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff.critPercent)||0),0);
  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus - itemCritPenalty(character) + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critChancePercent'))) / 100;
  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critDamagePercent')) : 1,
    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula([].concat(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent??[],target?.weakRemaining>0?target.weakDefensePercent:0)),
    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,itemDamageBonus(character),...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),
    halo: characterHaloMultiplier(character, target),
    attackModifier: damageMod*(skillAttack?itemSkillDamageMultiplier(character):1) // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.
  });
  return { damage: attackDamageFormula(totalWeaponDamage, totalCharacterATK(character), combinedModifier, random),
    critical, type: critical ? 'critical' : 'normal' };
}

/** Parts affect only the explicitly identified character starting weapon. */
export function startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,key) {
  const main=character.mainWeaponId??(character.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  return main&&weaponId===main&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,key):0;
}

/** Build weapon damage with independent level bonuses and optional purchased Growth.
 * mainWeaponId can explicitly identify a character main weapon; Plana defaults to her umbrella.
 */
export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
  const soloBonus=character.tuningParts&&options.soloTuningEligible!==false&&weapon?.soloTuningEligible!==false?startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'soloDamagePerEmptyPercent')*emptyWeaponSlotCount(character):0;
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, [...bonusesPercent,startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'damagePercent'),-startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'weaponDamagePenaltyPercent'),soloBonus,character.tuningParts&&stationaryTuningActive(character)?startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'stationaryDamagePercent'):0,character.tuningParts?weaponTuningDamageBonus(character,weaponId):0], {
    ...options, projectileCount:character.tuningParts?startingWeaponProjectileCount(character,weaponId,options.projectileCount??weapon?.attackCount??1):(options.projectileCount??weapon?.attackCount??1), enhancementRank:weapon?.enhancementRank ?? 0, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
    growthRank: options.growthEligible===false?0:(character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank), playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}


/** Add the accumulated item/skill ATK bonus to the character's independent base ATK. */
export function totalCharacterATK(character) {
  return totalATKFormula(character.baseATK ?? attackStatSettings.baseATK,
    [Number(ensureCombatStats(character).atkPercent),overclockingStats(character).atk]);
}


/** Add character and weapon critical damage bonuses; overrides replace only the base.
 * criticalMultiplier is an optional weapon base override (e.g. Umbrella LV7=3).
 * critDamagePercent contains accumulated bonuses, separate from critical chance.
 */
export function characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponBonus = 0) {
  const base = criticalMultiplier !== undefined ? (criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100 :
    (character.baseCritMod ?? (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100);
  const bonus = ensureCombatStats(character).critDamagePercent;
  return Math.max(0, 1 + totalCritModFormula(base, [bonus, weaponBonus]) / 100);
}


/** Measure character-to-target world distance at the hit, never from projectile origin. */
export function characterHaloMultiplier(character, target) {
  if (!target || ![character.x, character.y, target.x, target.y].every(Number.isFinite)) return 1;
  return haloDamageFormula(Math.hypot(target.x - character.x, target.y - character.y), character.haloLevel ?? 0);
}

import { createMalkuthHat } from './item-catalog.js';
import { crafterSettings, crafterEnhancementCost, crafterEnhancementChance, umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List only equipped targets, keeping upgrades capped and offering only defined awakening paths. */
export function crafterChoices(player) {
  const choices=[],loot=getLootTotals();
  for(const [kind,slots] of [['weapon',player.attackSlots||[]],['item',player.equipmentSlots||[]]]) {
    slots.forEach((target,index)=>{
      if(!target)return;
      const max=target.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
        target.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:target.maxLevel;
      if(!Number.isFinite(max))return;
      const prefix=`${kind}:${index}`,name=target.name||target.id||'Item',level=target.level||1;
      if(!target.isSynergy&&level<max)choices.push({id:`${prefix}:level`,target,kind,name,label:`Upgrade to LV ${level+1}`,cost:0,disabled:false});
      else if(kind==='weapon') {
        const rank=(target.enhancementRank||0)+1,cost=crafterEnhancementCost(rank);
        const chance=crafterEnhancementChance(rank,player.enhancementRateBonusPercent||0);
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:enhance`,target,kind,name,label:`Enhance +${rank} — ${cost} Credits — ${Math.round(chance*100)}% success`,cost,chance,rank,disabled:loot.credits<cost});
      }
      if(kind==='item'&&target.id==='malkuth-hat'&&level>=max&&!target.awakened)
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:'Awaken - 1 Secret Tech Note',disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<1});
      const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
      if(kind==='weapon'&&target.id==='plana-umbrella'&&main===target.id&&level>=max&&!target.awakened) {
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:`Awaken — ${umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note`,disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost});
      }
    });
  }
  return choices;
}

/** A valid attempt consumes one Crafter even when a paid enhancement fails. */
export function applyCrafterChoice(player,id,random=Math.random) {
  const choice=crafterChoices(player).find(c=>c.id===id);
  if(!choice||choice.disabled)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'That upgrade is unavailable.'};
  const action=id.split(':').at(-1),target=choice.target;
  if(action==='level') {target.level=(target.level||1)+1;if(choice.kind==='weapon')recordWeaponMax(player,target);return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} upgraded to LV ${target.level}.`};}
  if(action==='awaken') {
    if(!spendSecretTechNotes(choice.kind==='item'?1:umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
    if(choice.kind==='item')Object.assign(target,createMalkuthHat(true));
    target.awakened=true;return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} awakened!`};
  }
  if(!spendCredits(choice.cost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
  const success=random()<choice.chance;
  if(success)target.enhancementRank=choice.rank;
  return {consumed:true,success,message:success?`${choice.name} enhanced to +${choice.rank}!`:`Enhancement failed. ${choice.cost} Credits and the Crafter were consumed.`};
}

import { createPickupReentryGuard } from './pickup-reentry.js';

/** Shared draw/contact rectangle, including the icon's scale and upward ground offset. */
export function crafterSpriteBounds(drop) {
  const scale=crafterSettings.iconScale;
  return {left:drop.x-18*scale,right:drop.x+18*scale,top:drop.y-46*scale,bottom:drop.y+scale};
}

/** Inclusive swept segment/rectangle test, so fast movement cannot skip a Crafter. */
function segmentTouchesRectangle(from,to,box) {
  let enter=0,exit=1;
  for(const [start,end,min,max] of [[from.x,to.x,box.left,box.right],[from.y,to.y,box.top,box.bottom]]) {
    const delta=end-start;
    if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-10){if(start<min||start>max)return false;continue;}
    const a=(min-start)/delta,b=(max-start)/delta;
    enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(a,b));exit=Math.min(exit,Math.max(a,b));
    if(enter>exit)return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** Sweep the real player ellipse against the visible icon, with rounded-corner accuracy. */
export function crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,previous=player,padding=0) {
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),from=getCombatHitbox({...player,x:previous.x,y:previous.y},false);
  const sprite=crafterSpriteBounds(drop);
  const box={left:sprite.left-padding,right:sprite.right+padding,top:sprite.top-padding,bottom:sprite.bottom+padding};
  // The Minkowski sum of a rectangle and ellipse is two bars plus four elliptical corners.
  if(segmentTouchesRectangle(from,body,{...box,left:box.left-body.rx,right:box.right+body.rx})||
    segmentTouchesRectangle(from,body,{...box,top:box.top-body.ry,bottom:box.bottom+body.ry}))return true;
  return [box.left,box.right].some(x=>[box.top,box.bottom].some(y=>
    segmentHitsBody({x,y,rx:body.rx,ry:body.ry},from.x,from.y,body.x,body.y)));
}

/** Steady white ground glow and soft cyan-white pillar; purely visual, with no flashing. */
export function drawCrafterGlow(context,x,y,golden=false,pillarHeight=crafterSettings.glow.pillarHeight) {
  const glow={...crafterSettings.glow,pillarHeight};
  context.save();context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.globalAlpha=glow.opacity;
  if(golden)context.filter='sepia(1) saturate(4)';
  // Stretch a radial falloff into a narrow pillar, extending below and above the icon.
  context.save();context.translate(x,y-glow.pillarHeight*.45);
  context.scale(glow.pillarWidth/(glow.pillarHeight+24),1);
  const pillar=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,glow.pillarHeight*.6);
  pillar.addColorStop(0,'rgba(235,255,255,.6)');pillar.addColorStop(.35,'rgba(135,245,255,.32)');pillar.addColorStop(1,'rgba(100,235,255,0)');
  context.fillStyle=pillar;context.fillRect(-glow.pillarHeight,-glow.pillarHeight,glow.pillarHeight*2,glow.pillarHeight*2);context.restore();
  const core=context.createLinearGradient(0,y-glow.pillarHeight,0,y+8);
  core.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');core.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(235,255,255,.12)');core.addColorStop(.85,'rgba(255,255,255,.45)');core.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  context.fillStyle=core;context.fillRect(x-3,y-glow.pillarHeight,6,glow.pillarHeight+8);
  // Flatten the base into a luminous pool of light on the ground.
  context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,glow.opacity*1.2);
  context.translate(x,y+2);context.scale(1,.32);
  const base=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,glow.baseRadius);
  base.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.95)');base.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(255,255,255,.65)');base.addColorStop(.65,'rgba(150,245,255,.3)');base.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,235,255,0)');
  context.fillStyle=base;context.fillRect(-glow.baseRadius,-glow.baseRadius,glow.baseRadius*2,glow.baseRadius*2);
  context.restore();
}

/** Always-visible pickup marker, pointing toward the drop at viewport edges. */
export function drawCrafterMarker(context,x,y,width,height,golden=false,pillarHeight=crafterSettings.glow.pillarHeight) {
      const offscreen=x<20||x>width-20||y<20||y>height-20;
      let ax=x,ay=Math.max(28,y-pillarHeight-18),angle=Math.PI/2;
      if(offscreen) {
        const dx=x-width/2,dy=y-height/2;
        const scale=Math.min((width/2-30)/Math.max(.001,Math.abs(dx)),(height/2-30)/Math.max(.001,Math.abs(dy)));
        ax=width/2+dx*scale;ay=height/2+dy*scale;angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
      }
      context.save();context.translate(ax,ay);context.rotate(angle);context.fillStyle=golden?'#ffeaa0':'#fff';context.strokeStyle=golden?'#b88b20':'#1d719c';context.lineWidth=2;
      // Local +X is the tip; rotation points down at visible Crafters or toward offscreen ones.
      context.beginPath();context.moveTo(22,0);context.lineTo(-14,-17);context.lineTo(-14,17);context.closePath();context.fill();context.stroke();context.restore();
}

/** Run-scoped, non-magnetic Crafter drops and the paused, cancellable upgrade menu. */
export function createCrafterSystem({getPlayer,canvas,onOpen=()=>{},onChange=()=>{},onResult=()=>{},golden=false,getMinuteTimer=()=>0}) {
  const drops=new Map();let nextId=0,active=null;const reentry=createPickupReentryGuard();
  const toast=document.createElement('div');toast.className='crafter-toast';toast.setAttribute('role','status');toast.hidden=true;canvas.parentElement.append(toast);let toastTimer;
  const icon=new Image();icon.src=crafterSettings.icon.source;
  const ready=icon.decode();
  /** Closing an unused Crafter requires full separation plus 1.5 seconds before reopening. */
  function close() {if(active!==null&&drops.has(active))reentry.block(active);active=null;menu.close();canvas.focus({preventScroll:true});}
  const menu=createCrafterMenu({canvas,getPlayer,golden,onCancel:close,onAction:id=>{
    if(active===null||!drops.has(active))return;
    const result=golden?applyGoldenCrafterChoice(getPlayer(),id):applyCrafterChoice(getPlayer(),id);
    if(!result.consumed){menu.refresh();return;}
    drops.delete(active);close();onChange();
    // Successful upgrades, enhancements and fusions are reflected directly in inventory.
    if(result.success)return;
    onResult(result.message);
    toast.textContent=result.message;toast.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>{toast.hidden=true},4000);
  }});
  function open(drop) {active=drop.id;onOpen();menu.open();}
  /** Place on safe ground, respecting the twenty-Crafter limit even for test drops. */
  function spawn(x,y) {
    if(drops.size>=(golden?crafterSettings.goldenMaxGround:crafterSettings.maxGround))return false;
    const point=safeDropLanding(x,y);if(!point)return false;
    const drop={id:++nextId,...point};drops.set(drop.id,drop);return drop;
  }
  function roll(enemy,random=Math.random) {
    if(drops.size>=(golden?crafterSettings.goldenMaxGround:crafterSettings.maxGround))return false;
    // Credit Card can later supply this multiplier without changing the base drop chance.
    if(golden&&!goldenCrafterChoices(getPlayer()).length)return false;
    const chance=golden?goldenCrafterChance(getMinuteTimer()):Math.min(1,crafterSettings.dropChance*Math.max(0,getPlayer().crafterDropMultiplier??1));
    return random()<chance?spawn(enemy.x,enemy.y):false;
  }
  /** Walk onto a Crafter to open it; cancellation does not destroy the ground object. */
  function update(player,previous=player,delta=0) {
    if(active!==null)return;
    for(const drop of drops.values()) {
      if(reentry.blocked(drop.id,crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,player,crafterSettings.reentryPadding),delta))continue;
      if(crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,previous||player)){open(drop);break;}
    }
  }

  /** Draw the source-sheet icon and a large white directional triangle, clamped at screen edges. */
  function draw(context,camera,width,height) {
    if(!icon.naturalWidth)return;
    const crop=crafterSettings.icon;
    for(const drop of drops.values()) {
      const x=drop.x-camera.x,y=drop.y-camera.y;
      if(x>-40&&x<width+40&&y>-60&&y<height+crafterSettings.glow.pillarHeight)drawCrafterGlow(context,x,y,golden);
      const bounds=crafterSpriteBounds(drop);
      if(x>-40&&x<width+40&&y>-60&&y<height+40) {
        context.save();if(golden)context.filter='sepia(1) saturate(4)';
        context.drawImage(icon,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,
          bounds.left-camera.x,bounds.top-camera.y,bounds.right-bounds.left,bounds.bottom-bounds.top);context.restore();
      }
      drawCrafterMarker(context,x,y,width,height,golden);
    }
  }
  return {ready,spawn,roll,update,draw,get active(){return active!==null;},get count(){return drops.size;},
    clear(){if(active!==null)close();drops.clear();reentry.clear();}};
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/damage-feedback.js | sha256=380ea80bf1377d8a27fd25c850f1cdfd0019e5cf0f3b08b60f2a66cd8f233f16 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
export const damageFlashDuration = 240; // EDIT total pulse length in milliseconds.
const riseDuration = 45; // Fast gradual rise, followed by a longer fade out.
const whiteSprites = new WeakMap();

/** Return a smooth white-tint intensity, never a full-screen or rectangular flash. */
export function getDamageFlashOpacity(character) {
  const elapsed = character.damageFlashElapsed;
  if (elapsed === undefined || elapsed < 0 || elapsed >= damageFlashDuration) return 0;
  const progress = elapsed < riseDuration
    ? elapsed / riseDuration
    : 1 - (elapsed - riseDuration) / (damageFlashDuration - riseDuration);
  const smooth = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
  return smooth * 0.85;
}

/** Advance visual feedback independently of whether movement AI is paused. */
export function advanceDamageFlash(character, delta) {
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed === undefined) return;
  character.damageFlashElapsed += delta * 1000;
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed >= damageFlashDuration) {
    delete character.damageFlashElapsed;
  }
}

/** Cache a white silhouette retaining the original image's transparent pixels. */
export function getWhiteSprite(image) {
  if (!whiteSprites.has(image)) {
    const surface = document.createElement('canvas');
    surface.width = image.naturalWidth;
    surface.height = image.naturalHeight;
    const context = surface.getContext('2d');
    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, surface.width, surface.height);
    whiteSprites.set(image, surface);
  }
  return whiteSprites.get(image);
}

import { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

const numbers = [];
const textCache = new Map();
let font;

/** Load one shared bitmap font for all damage numbers. */
export function loadDamageNumberGraphics() {
  font = new Image();
  font.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return font.decode();
}

/** Format normal hits, yellow critical hits, or red supercrit visuals. */
export function damageNumberStyle(amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if (hitType === 'miss') return { text: 'MISS', color: '#ffffff', italic: true };
  const text = String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);
  if (hitType === 'shield') return { text, color: '#62cfff', italic: false };
  if (player) return { text, color: '#ff5265', italic: false };
  if (hitType === 'supercritical') return { text: `${text}!!!`, color: '#ff5265', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  if (hitType === 'critical') return { text: `${text}!`, color: '#ffe15a', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  return { text, color: '#ffffff', italic: false };
}

/** Queue a damage popup; supercritical styling does not define its trigger. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal', group = null) {
  if ((!(amount > 0) && hitType !== 'miss') || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  // Only the synergy accumulates rapid hits, independently for each enemy and damage source.
  if(group&&hitType!=='miss') {
    const existing=numbers.findLast(number=>number.target===target&&number.group===group&&!number.closed);
    if(existing&&existing.hitType===hitType&&existing.sinceHit<=.3) {
      existing.amount+=amount;existing.sinceHit=0;existing.elapsed=0;
      Object.assign(existing,{scale:1},damageNumberStyle(existing.amount,player,existing.hitType));
      existing.x=target.x;existing.y=target.y-(target.spriteSize||112)*.4;return;
    }
    // A changed hit type ends this run permanently; its popup continues its existing fade.
    if(existing)existing.closed=true;
  }
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ ...damageNumberStyle(amount, player, hitType), elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    target,group,amount,hitType,closed:false,sinceHit:0,drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
export function damageNumberPose(number) {
  const t = number.elapsed;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / damageNumberSettings.duration));
  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
    y: number.y - 4 * damageNumberSettings.jumpHeight * progress * (1 - progress),
    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
}

/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
    numbers[i].sinceHit += delta;
    if (numbers[i].elapsed >= damageNumberSettings.duration) numbers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/** Cache compact tinted bitmap numbers, preserving the font's dark outline. */
function numberGraphic(text, color) {
  const key = `${text}:${color}`;
  if (textCache.has(key)) return textCache.get(key);
  const glyphs = [...text].map(letter => fontMetrics[letter] || fontMetrics['?']);
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = glyphs.reduce((sum, glyph) => sum + glyph.width - 1, 1);
  canvas.height = 20;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let x = 0;
  for (const glyph of glyphs) {
    context.drawImage(font, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
      x, glyph.offsetY, glyph.width, glyph.height);
    x += glyph.width - 1;
  }
  if (color !== '#ffffff') {
    const mask = document.createElement('canvas');
    mask.width = canvas.width;
    mask.height = canvas.height;
    mask.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    context.fillStyle = color;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    context.drawImage(mask, 0, 0);
  }
  if (textCache.size >= 128) textCache.delete(textCache.keys().next().value);
  textCache.set(key, canvas);
  return canvas;
}

/** Draw world-anchored numbers above actors, leaving the HUD unaffected. */
export function drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, width, height) {
  if (!font?.naturalWidth) return;
  context.save();
  context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  for (const number of numbers) {
    const pose = damageNumberPose(number);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (x < -100 || y < -50 || x > width + 100 || y > height + 50) continue;
    const graphic = numberGraphic(number.text, number.color);
    context.save();
    context.translate(x, y);
    context.scale(number.scale ?? 1, number.scale ?? 1);
    if (number.italic) context.transform(1, 0, -0.18, 1, 0, 0);
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(graphic, -graphic.width * 0.625, 0, graphic.width * 1.25, 25);
    context.restore();
  }
  context.restore();
}

/** Own a worker and route recognition results without blocking animation or uploading sketches. */
export function createDrawingRecognizer() {
  let worker, nextId = 0;
  const pending = new Map();
  function getWorker() {
    if (!worker) {
      worker = new Worker(new URL('./drawing-recognizer.worker.js', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' });
      worker.addEventListener('message', ({ data }) => {
        const job = pending.get(data.id);
        if (!job) return;
        pending.delete(data.id); clearTimeout(job.timeout);
        if (data.error) job.reject(new Error(data.error)); else job.resolve(data.predictions || []);
      });
      worker.addEventListener('error', () => {
        for (const job of pending.values()) { clearTimeout(job.timeout); job.reject(new Error('Drawing recognition could not start. Check your connection and retry.')); }
        pending.clear(); worker.terminate(); worker = null;
      });
    }
    return worker;
  }
  function request(type, image) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const id = ++nextId;
      try { const target = getWorker(); const timeout = setTimeout(() => { pending.delete(id); reject(new Error('Drawing recognition timed out. Please retry.')); }, 120000); pending.set(id, { resolve, reject, timeout }); target.postMessage({ id, type, image }); }
      catch (error) { const job = pending.get(id); if (job) clearTimeout(job.timeout); pending.delete(id); reject(error); }
    });
  }
  return {
    warmup: () => request('warmup'),
    recognize: image => request('classify', image),
    recognizeSymbol: image => request('symbol', image),
    dispose() {
      worker?.terminate(); worker = null;
      for (const job of pending.values()) { clearTimeout(job.timeout); job.reject(new Error('Recognition closed.')); }
      pending.clear();
    }
  };
}

import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

let classifier, clipClassifier, RawImage;
/** Load the quantized QuickDraw classifier once, off the gameplay/UI thread. */
async function loadClassifier() {
  if (!classifier) {
    classifier = (async () => {
      const transformers = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.8.1');
      const { pipeline, env } = transformers;
      RawImage = transformers.RawImage;
      env.allowLocalModels = false;
      env.backends.onnx.wasm.numThreads = 1;
      return pipeline('image-classification', skillCastSettings.model, { device: 'wasm', dtype: 'q8' });
    })().catch(error => { classifier = null; throw error; });
  }
  return classifier;
}

/** Load CLIP lazily in the same worker; cache weights between casts. */
async function loadClipClassifier() {
  if (!clipClassifier) {
    clipClassifier = (async () => {
      const { pipeline, env } = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.8.1');
      env.allowLocalModels = false;
      env.backends.onnx.wasm.numThreads = 1;
      return pipeline('zero-shot-image-classification', skillCastSettings.clipModel,
        { device: 'wasm', dtype: 'q8' });
    })().catch(error => { clipClassifier = null; throw error; });
  }
  return clipClassifier;
}

// Explicit alternatives prevent a single candidate from always receiving a perfect score.
const symbolLabels = [
  'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross',
  'a hand drawn empty circle',
  'a hand drawn circle with only an arrow inside',
  'a hand drawn circle with only an X inside',
  'a hand drawn circle with an X above an arrow',
  'random scribbles and unrelated shapes'
];

/** Receive normalized black-on-white PNGs and return ranked QuickDraw predictions. */
self.addEventListener('message', async ({ data }) => {
  try {
    if (data.type === 'symbol') {
      const pipe = await loadClipClassifier();
      const predictions = await pipe(data.image, symbolLabels);
      self.postMessage({ id: data.id, predictions });
      return;
    }
    const pipe = await loadClassifier();
    if (data.type === 'warmup') { self.postMessage({ id: data.id, ready: true }); return; }
    // QuickDraw expects one channel; RGBA canvas PNGs must be explicitly converted.
    const image = (await RawImage.read(data.image)).grayscale();
    // QuickDraw bitmap training uses light strokes on a dark background.
    for (let i = 0; i < image.data.length; i++) image.data[i] = 255 - image.data[i];
    const predictions = await pipe(image, { top_k: 3 });
    self.postMessage({ id: data.id, predictions });
  } catch (error) {
    self.postMessage({ id: data.id, error: error.message || 'Drawing recognition failed.' });
  }
});

import { endlessEliteSettings, eliteChance, eliteChanceFormula } from './game-config.js';

/** Own one repeatable endless elite buildup, followed by a forced boss wave. */
export function createEndlessBuildup(onBossReady) {
  let seconds = 0;
  let ready = false;
  return {
    get phase() {
      if (ready) return 'ready';
      if (seconds < endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds) return 'normal';
      if (seconds < endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds) return 'ramp';
      return 'elites';
    },
    get seconds() { return seconds; },
    // Admin shortcut starts the constant elite phase immediately.
    startElites() { seconds = endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds; ready = false; },
    get eliteChance() { return ready ? eliteChance : eliteChanceFormula(seconds); },
    spawnRate(normalRate) {
      if (ready || seconds < endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds) return normalRate;
      const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (seconds - endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds) /
        Math.max(1, endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds - endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds)));
      return Math.round(normalRate + (endlessEliteSettings.maxSpawnRate - normalRate) * progress);
    },
    update(delta, { endless, bossAlive, spawning }) {
      if (!endless || bossAlive) { seconds = 0; ready = false; return; }
      if (!spawning || ready || !Number.isFinite(delta)) return;
      seconds += Math.max(0, delta);
      if (seconds >= endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds + endlessEliteSettings.constantEliteSeconds) {
        ready = true; // Restore ordinary arrivals before killing elites or requesting the boss.
        onBossReady();
      }
    }
  };
}

import { endlessEventSettings, eliteChance, midoriSettings } from './game-config.js';

export const endlessEventRegistry = {

/** Manage elite surges and their boss-or-Midori outcome; admin triggers bypass campaign timing. */
export function createEndlessEvents(onBossReady, random = Math.random, onMidoriStart = () => {}, onEventEnd = () => {}) {
  let event = null, definition = null, bossWasAlive = false;
  let midoriRemaining = 0, manual = false;
  let eventKey = null, eventSequence = 0;
  function endCurrent() {
    if (eventKey) onEventEnd(eventKey);
    eventKey = null;
  }

  /** Begin a Midori-only stream in place of requesting the boss wave. */

    endCurrent();
    eventKey = `midori-${++eventSequence}`;

    definition = endlessEventRegistry.midori;
    onMidoriStart();
  }

  function chooseEvent() {

    midoriRemaining = 0;
    const ids = endlessEventSettings.enabledEvents.filter(id => endlessEventRegistry[id]?.create);

  }

    get name() { return definition?.name || 'None'; },
    get phase() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : event?.phase || 'normal'; },

    get active() { return manual || midoriRemaining > 0; },
    get eliteChance() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 0 : event?.eliteChance ?? eliteChance; },
    get spawnEventKey() { return midoriRemaining > 0 || ['ramp', 'elites'].includes(event?.phase) ? eventKey : null; },
    get spawnType() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : null; },
    get allowsBossWave() { return midoriRemaining <= 0 && (!event || event.phase === 'ready'); },
    spawnRate(normalRate) { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? normalRate : event ? event.spawnRate(normalRate) : normalRate; },
    /** Start either event immediately for testing without enabling endless progression. */
    trigger(id) {
      if (!['midori', 'eliteSurge'].includes(id)) return false;
      manual = true;
      if (id === 'midori') startMidori();
      else if (id === 'eliteSurge') {
        endCurrent();
        eventKey = `eliteSurge-${++eventSequence}`;
        midoriRemaining = 0;
        definition = endlessEventRegistry.eliteSurge;
        event = definition.create(finishElites);
        event.startElites();
      } else { manual = false; return false; }
      return true;
    },
    stop() { manual = false; chooseEvent(); },
    end() { manual = false; chooseEvent(); },
    update(delta, state) {
      if (bossWasAlive && !state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
      bossWasAlive = state.bossAlive;
      if (midoriRemaining > 0) {
        if (state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); return; }

        if (midoriRemaining <= 0) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
        return;
      }
      event?.update(delta, { ...state, endless: state.endless || manual });
    }

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  if(enemy.frozenRemaining>0){
    enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(0,enemy.frozenRemaining-delta);
    if(enemy.frozenRemaining<1e-6)enemy.frozenRemaining=0;
    enemy.moving=false;return true; // Freeze also holds knockback and attack timers.
  }
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if(stunned)enemy.stunVisualElapsed=(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)+delta;
  else delete enemy.stunVisualElapsed;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}

import { deathSettings, gachaSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { deathSettings, gachaSettings } from './game-config.js';
// Visual remnants are separate from living NPCs: no AI, collisions, or rewards.
const deaths = new Map();
const gachaEffects = new Map();
let gachaIcon;



/** Load the supplied gacha artwork before the preview begins. */
export function loadEnemyDeathGraphics() {
  gachaIcon = new Image();
  gachaIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Gacha_Ticket.png';
  return gachaIcon.decode();
}

/** Calculate a fast eased rise, brief stop, then expansion and disappearance. */
export function gachaPose(effect) {
  const rise = Math.min(1, effect.elapsed / gachaSettings.rise);
  const pop = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    (effect.elapsed - gachaSettings.rise - gachaSettings.hold) / gachaSettings.pop));
  return { x: effect.x, y: effect.y - effect.height * (1 - (1 - rise) ** 3),
    scale: 0.75 + 0.25 * rise + 0.65 * pop,
    opacity: 1 - pop, behind: rise < 0.55 };
}

/** Freeze the defeated pose and launch it away from the source of the hit. */
export function beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source, { knockback = true } = {}) {
  const dx = source ? enemy.x - source.x : enemy.contactReaction?.nx ?? 1;
  const dy = source ? enemy.y - source.y : enemy.contactReaction?.ny ?? 0;
  const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const death = { elapsed: 0, originX: enemy.x, originY: enemy.y,
    nx: length ? dx / length : 1, ny: length ? dy / length : 0, opacity: 1, knockback };
  deaths.set(enemy.id, { ...enemy, death, transition: null, moving: false });
  gachaEffects.set(enemy.id, { x: enemy.x, y: enemy.y, elapsed: 0,
    height: (enemy.spriteSize || 112) / 2 + 28 });
}

/** Advance every remnant, including offscreen ones, and remove after the fade. */
export function updateEnemyDeaths(delta) {
  for (const [id, effect] of gachaEffects) {
    effect.elapsed += delta;
    if (effect.elapsed >= gachaSettings.rise + gachaSettings.hold + gachaSettings.pop) gachaEffects.delete(id);
  }
  for (const [id, enemy] of deaths) {
    const death = enemy.death;
    death.elapsed += delta;
    const progress = Math.min(1, death.elapsed / deathSettings.duration);
    const distance = death.knockback === false ? 0 : deathSettings.distance * (1 - (1 - progress) ** 3);
    enemy.x = death.originX + death.nx * distance;
    enemy.y = death.originY + death.ny * distance;
    const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
      (death.elapsed - deathSettings.fadeStart) / (deathSettings.duration - deathSettings.fadeStart)));
    death.opacity = 1 - fade * fade;
    if (progress === 1) deaths.delete(id);
  }
}

/** Render the rising icon behind bodies first, then above them as it pops. */
export function drawGachaDeaths(context, camera, width, height, behind) {
  if (!gachaIcon?.naturalWidth) return;
  for (const effect of gachaEffects.values()) {
    const pose = gachaPose(effect);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (pose.behind !== behind || x < -100 || x > width + 100 || y < -100 || y > height + 100) continue;
    const w = gachaSettings.width * pose.scale;
    const h = w * gachaIcon.naturalHeight / gachaIcon.naturalWidth;
    context.save();
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(gachaIcon, x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
    context.restore();
  }
}

/** Return visual-only remnants for the same camera culling as normal enemies. */
export function getEnemyDeaths() {
  return [...deaths.values()];
}

/** Visual hop only: collision and world positions stay grounded while Pedrozilla skips. */
export function enemyBounceOffset(character) {
  const bounce=character.movementBounce;
  if (!bounce || !character.moving || character.death) return 0;
  const seconds=character.eventMotionAge ?? (character.elapsed || 0)/1000;
  const period=bounce.periodSeconds*(character.bouncePeriodScale ?? 1);
  const phase=((seconds/period+(character.bouncePhase ?? 0))%1+1)%1;
  return -bounce.height*Math.sin(Math.PI*phase)**2;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/enemy-spatial-index.js | sha256=9f8bb912630cea22cc737e463222980d821a8c337069f167efdd6b80d0d098c3 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Conservative broadphase only; callers retain their existing exact collision tests. */
export function createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies, getBounds, cellSize=128) {
  const cells=new Map();
  enemies.forEach((enemy,order)=>{
    const b=getBounds(enemy),entry={enemy,order};
    for(let y=Math.floor((b.y-b.ry)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((b.y+b.ry)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((b.x-b.rx)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((b.x+b.rx)/cellSize);x++) {
        const key=x+','+y;
        let bucket=cells.get(key);if(!bucket)cells.set(key,bucket=[]);
        bucket.push(entry);
      }
  });
  return {querySegment(from,to,padding=0) {
    const found=new Set();
    for(let y=Math.floor((Math.min(from.y,to.y)-padding)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.y,to.y)+padding)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((Math.min(from.x,to.x)-padding)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.x,to.x)+padding)/cellSize);x++)
        for(const entry of cells.get(x+','+y)||[])found.add(entry);
    // Preserve Map insertion order: piercing limits and random damage rolls depend on it.
    return [...found].sort((a,b)=>a.order-b.order).map(entry=>entry.enemy);
  }};
}

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = template.miniBoss === true || type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.hp : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;

    type === 'megaSweeper' || (['whiteSweeper','heavySweeper'].includes(type) && elite) ? 'megaSweeper' : null;

  const profile = enemyTypeStats[megaType || type];
  const scaled = profile ? enemyStatsScalingFormula(profile, campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds)) : null;

    elite,
    miniBoss: template.miniBoss === true || (elite && type !== 'midori'),
    label: dedicatedMega ? (megaType === 'megaSweeper' ? 'Mega Sweeper' : 'Mega Mob') : elite && type !== 'midori' ? `Mega ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' && !template.miniBoss ? (template.megaSizeMultiplier ?? eliteSizeMultiplier) : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite && !dedicatedMega ? 2 : 1,
    ...(profile ? { hp: Math.round(maxHp), maxHp: Math.round(maxHp), perTypeStats: true,
      contactDamage: scaled.atk, expReward: profile.expValue,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: scaled.spd * playerSettings.speed / playerSettings.movementBase } : {})
  };
}

/** Pick from the configured standard enemy pool while keeping Mob most common. */
export function chooseStandardEnemy(random = Math.random, elapsedSeconds = 0, stageId = null) {
  const weights = stageId && enemyStagePools[stageId] ? Object.fromEntries(enemyStagePools[stageId].map(type=>[type,1])) : standardEnemyWeights;
  const entries = Object.entries(weights).filter(([type, weight]) => {
    const profile = enemyTypeStats[type];
    return weight > 0 && (!profile || (elapsedSeconds >= profile.spawnStartSeconds && elapsedSeconds < profile.spawnEndSeconds));
  });
  let roll = random() * entries.reduce((sum, [, weight]) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (const [type, weight] of entries) { roll -= weight; if (roll < 0) return type; }
  return entries.at(-1)?.[0] ?? null;
}

/** Find walkable ground near the intended landing, even if an enemy died inside an obstacle. */
export function safeDropLanding(x, y) {
  if (isLandingClear(x, y, lootLandingRadius)) return { x, y };
  for (let radius = 24; radius <= 2048; radius += 24) {
    const samples = Math.min(64, Math.ceil(radius / 12) * 8);
    for (let index = 0; index < samples; index++) {
      const angle = index / samples * Math.PI * 2;
      const px = x + Math.cos(angle) * radius, py = y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
      if (isLandingClear(px, py, lootLandingRadius)) return { x: px, y: py };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** Redirect a scatter to safe ground; retain unplaceable loot for a later retry. */
export function constrainDropLanding(drop) {
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  const landing = safeDropLanding(flight.x + flight.dx, flight.y + flight.dy);
  drop.pendingLanding = !landing;
  if (landing) {
    flight.dx = landing.x - flight.x;
    flight.dy = landing.y - flight.y;
  }
}

/** Launch loot toward a random nearby landing spot with a small airborne hop. */
export function launchDrop(drop, random = Math.random) {
  const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const distance = dropScatter.minDistance + random() * (dropScatter.maxDistance - dropScatter.minDistance);
  drop.scatter = { elapsed: 0, x: drop.x, y: drop.y,
    dx: Math.cos(angle) * distance, dy: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
    rotation: drop.rotation, spin: (random() - 0.5) * Math.PI };
  constrainDropLanding(drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Animate the outward toss before enabling pickup attraction or collection. */
export function updateDropScatter(drop, delta) {
  if (!drop.scatter) return false;
  if (drop.pendingLanding) {
    drop.landingRetry = (drop.landingRetry || 0) - delta;
    if (drop.landingRetry <= 0) { constrainDropLanding(drop); drop.landingRetry = 0.5; }
    if (drop.pendingLanding) return true;
  }
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  flight.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const t = Math.min(1, flight.elapsed / dropScatter.duration);
  const progress = 1 - (1 - t) ** 2;
  drop.x = flight.x + flight.dx * progress;
  drop.y = flight.y + flight.dy * progress;
  drop.lift = 4 * dropScatter.hopHeight * t * (1 - t);
  drop.rotation = flight.rotation + flight.spin * progress;
  if (t === 1) { delete drop.scatter; drop.lift = 0; }
  return true;
}

/** Read a snapshot of collected session inventory, including spendable awakening notes. */
export function getLootTotals() {
  return { ...lootTotals };
}

/** Award File Credits once when its opening completes. */
export function gainCredits(amount) {
  if(!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<0)return false;
  lootTotals.credits+=Math.floor(amount);return true;
}

/** Spend run Credits atomically; rejected purchases never modify the balance. */
export function spendCredits(amount) {
  if(!Number.isInteger(amount)||amount<0||lootTotals.credits<amount)return false;
  lootTotals.credits-=amount;return true;
}

/** Spend collected notes atomically; failed awakenings never consume currency. */
export function spendSecretTechNotes(amount) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(amount) || amount <= 0 || lootTotals.secretTechNotes < amount) return false;
  lootTotals.secretTechNotes -= amount;
  return true;
}

/** Inspect all ground loot, including credits and Secret Tech Notes. */
export function getGroundLoot() {
  return [...drops.values()];
}

/** Discard uncollected loot on a map change; collected inventory remains intact. */
export function clearGroundLoot() {
  drops.clear();
}

/** Spawn a specific ground pickup for repeatable admin testing. */
export function spawnTestDrop(kind, value, x, y) {
  if (!['exp', 'credits', 'secretTechNotes'].includes(kind)) return;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 1) return;
  const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind, value: Math.floor(value),
    tier: reportTier(value), x, y, rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Apply one pickup's reward without coupling inventory to the controlled avatar. */
function collectDrop(drop, player) {
  drops.delete(drop.id);
  if (drop.kind === 'exp') addPlayerExp(player, drop.value);
  else lootTotals[drop.kind] += drop.value;
}

/** Burst Yuuka credits throughout a disk, with angular coverage in every direction. */
export function dropYuukaCredits(enemy, defeated = false, random = Math.random) {
  const count = defeated ? yuukaSettings.deathCredits : yuukaSettings.hitCredits;
  const radius = bossExpRewards.maxDistance * yuukaSettings.burstRadiusMultiplier;
  const angleOffset = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const rewards = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
    const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind: 'credits', value: 1, x: enemy.x,
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2 };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
    launchDrop(drop, random);
    if (defeated) {
      const angle = angleOffset + (index + random()) / count * Math.PI * 2;
      // Square root distributes credits by area, throughout the whole radius.
      const distance = Math.sqrt(random()) * radius;
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
      constrainDropLanding(drop);
    }
    rewards.push(drop);
  }
  return rewards;
}

/** Roll independent bonus drops, allowing both rewards on the same defeat. */
export function dropEnemyLoot(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  if (['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type)) return dropYuukaCredits(enemy, true, random);
  const credits = random() < (enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.creditChance : creditDropChance);
  const note = random() < (enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.noteChance : secretNoteDropChance);
  for (const [kind, awarded] of [['credits', credits], ['secretTechNotes', note]]) {
    if (!awarded) continue;
    const drop = {
      id: ++nextId, kind, value: kind === 'credits' && enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.creditAmount : 1,
      x: enemy.x,
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
    };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
    launchDrop(drop, random);
  }
}

/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
export function reportTier(value) {
  return value > reportSettings.thirdMax ? 3 : value >= reportSettings.thirdMin ? 2 : value >= reportSettings.secondMin ? 1 : 0;
}

/** Roll a report's EXP value: elites get Report 1 (80%) or Report 2 (20%). */
export function rollEnemyExp(random = Math.random, elite = false) {
  if (elite) {
    return random() < reportSettings.eliteSecondChance
      ? reportSettings.secondMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.secondMax - reportSettings.secondMin + 1))
      : reportSettings.thirdMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.thirdMax - reportSettings.thirdMin + 1));
  }
  const uncommon = random() >= reportSettings.commonChance;
  return uncommon ? reportSettings.secondMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.secondMax - reportSettings.secondMin + 1))
    : reportSettings.firstMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.firstMax - reportSettings.firstMin + 1));
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}



/** Scale elite rewards down, cap their combined EXP, and preserve positive report pickups. */
export function rollEliteReports(random = Math.random, override, player = getActivePlayer()) {
  const values = Array.from({ length: eliteExpRewards.count }, () =>
    Math.max(reportSettings.secondMin, Math.floor(override ?? rollEnemyExp(random, true))));
  let deficit = eliteExpRewards.minimumTotal - values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const indices = values.map((_, index) => index).sort((a, b) => values[b] - values[a]);
  for (const index of indices) {
    if (deficit <= 0) break;
    const extra = Math.min(deficit, Math.max(0, reportSettings.thirdMax - values[index]));
    values[index] += extra;
    deficit -= extra;
  }
  const rolledTotal = values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const total = eliteExpTotalFormula(rolledTotal, player?.level || 1);
  const count = Math.min(values.length, total);
  if (!count) return [];
  // Give every report one point, then share the remainder by its original roll weight.
  const weights = values.slice(0, count);
  const weightTotal = weights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const rewards = weights.map(weight => 1 + Math.floor((total - count) * weight / weightTotal));
  let remaining = total - rewards.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  for (let index = 0; remaining > 0; index = (index + 1) % count, remaining--) rewards[index]++;
  return rewards;
}

// Boss reward settings live in game-config.js.


/** Split a level-scaled boss reward into positive reports without losing EXP. */
export function rollBossReports(player, random = Math.random, fixedTotal) {
  if (Number.isFinite(fixedTotal) && fixedTotal > 0) {
    const total = Math.round(fixedTotal);
    const count = Math.min(total, Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total/reportSettings.thirdMax)));
    return Array.from({length:count}, (_,i)=>Math.floor(total/count)+(i<total%count?1:0));
  }
  const requirement = experienceForLevel(player?.level || 1);
  const minimum = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports,
    Math.ceil(requirement * bossExpRewards.minLevels));
  const maximum = Math.max(minimum, Math.floor(requirement * bossExpRewards.maxLevels));
  const total = minimum + Math.floor(random() * (maximum - minimum + 1));
  const count = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total / reportSettings.thirdMax));
  const base = Math.floor(total / count), remainder = total % count;
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));
}

/** Divide player level by (2 + report tier), add 3, then round halves upward. */
export function standardMobExp(player, tier = 0) {
  return mobExpFormula(player?.level || 1, tier);
}

/** Drop a full-circle boss burst, five elite reports, or one ordinary report. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const reports = [];
  if (['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type)) return reports;
  const boss = enemy.boss === true || (enemy.boss !== false && ['iroha', 'shiroko'].includes(enemy.type));
  // Roll artwork first so its tier bonus does not depend on the resulting EXP.
  const standardMob = (enemy.type === 'mob' || enemy.standard) && !boss && !enemy.elite && enemy.expReward == null;
  const mobTier = standardMob ? (random() < reportSettings.commonChance ? 0 : 1) : undefined;
  const values = boss ? rollBossReports(getActivePlayer(), random, enemy.expReward) : (enemy.elite && !enemy.miniBoss) || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? rollEliteReports(random, enemy.expReward)
    : [Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? ((enemy.type === 'mob' || enemy.standard)
      ? standardMobExp(getActivePlayer(), mobTier) : rollEnemyExp(random)))];
  const burstAngle = boss ? random() * Math.PI * 2 : 0;
  for (const [index, value] of values.entries()) {
    const drop = dropExpReport(enemy, random, value, mobTier);
    if (!drop) continue;
    if (boss) {
      // One report per angular sector guarantees coverage in every direction.
      const angle = burstAngle + (index + random() * 0.5) / values.length * Math.PI * 2;
      const distance = bossExpRewards.minDistance + random() *
        (bossExpRewards.maxDistance - bossExpRewards.minDistance);
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
      constrainDropLanding(drop);
    }
    reports.push(drop);
  }
  return reports;
}

/** Create one scattered report; explicit admin EXP overrides remain supported. */
function dropExpReport(enemy, random, value, tier = reportTier(value)) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier, x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop, random);
  return drop;
}

/** Load report graphics once and provide collection/rendering for the preview. */
export function createExpPickups(getPlayer, options = {}) {
  isLandingClear = options.isLandingClear || (() => true);
  getActivePlayer = getPlayer; // Resolve the controlled avatar at the moment a boss dies.
  const lootStatus = document.querySelector('#player-loot-status');
  const tools = document.querySelector('#loot-tools');
  if (tools) {
    tools.querySelectorAll('[data-loot-action]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const player = getPlayer();
        const action = button.dataset.lootAction;
        if (action === 'clear') drops.clear();
        else if (action === 'collect') {
          for (const drop of drops.values()) collectDrop(drop, player);
        } else if (action === 'reset') {
          lootTotals.credits = 0;
          lootTotals.secretTechNotes = 0;
        } else {
          const amount = Number(tools.querySelector('[name="loot-value"]').value);
          spawnTestDrop(action, Math.min(1000000, amount), player.x + 80,
            player.y + (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding);
        }
      });
    });
  }
  const icons = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, tier) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.src = `../sprites/icons/Exp_Report_${tier}.png`;
    return image;
  });
  const ready = Promise.all(icons.map(image => image.decode()));
  const creditIcon = new Image();
  creditIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/credits.png';
  const creditReady = creditIcon.decode();
  const noteIcon = new Image();
  noteIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Ultimate_Skill_Book.png';
  const noteReady = noteIcon.decode();

  /** Sweep direct pickups, then accelerate attracted loot toward the active avatar. */
  function update(player, previous, delta = 0) {
    const footOffset = (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
    const start = { x: previous.x, y: previous.y + footOffset };
    const end = { x: player.x, y: player.y + footOffset };
    const dx = end.x - start.x, dy = end.y - start.y;
    const lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      // Let the toss finish so contact kills cannot instantly swallow the drops.
      if (updateDropScatter(drop, delta)) continue;
      const fraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - start.x) * dx + (drop.y - start.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const sweptDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - start.x - dx * fraction, drop.y - start.y - dy * fraction);
      if (drop.pickupTarget !== player) {
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.walkOverPickup = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        drop.pickupTarget = player;
      }
      // Walking over loot begins the same center-bound flight as a magnet pickup.
      // Arona can finish these pickups without gaining any attraction radius.
      if (sweptDistance <= pickupRadius) drop.walkOverPickup = true;
      const range = pickupRangeFormula(ensureCombatStats(player).pickupPercent+racerPassBonuses(player).pickup, player.pickupRange ?? 40);
      if (!range && !drop.walkOverPickup) {
        // Swapping to an avatar without attraction stops pending magnets immediately.
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        continue;
      }
      // Magnet detection follows the sprite center; walk-over detection stays at feet.
      const centerFraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - previous.x) * dx + (drop.y - previous.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const centerDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - previous.x - dx * centerFraction,
        drop.y - previous.y - dy * centerFraction);
      if (drop.walkOverPickup || centerDistance <= range) drop.attracted = true;
      if (drop.attracted) {
        const targetX = player.x - drop.x, targetY = player.y - drop.y;
        const distance = Math.hypot(targetX, targetY);
        const time = Math.max(0, delta);
        const speed = drop.pickupSpeed || 0;
        drop.pickupSpeed = Math.min(pickupMagnet.maxSpeed, speed + pickupMagnet.acceleration * time);
        const travel = Math.min(distance, (speed + drop.pickupSpeed) / 2 * time);
        if (distance > 0) {
          drop.x += targetX / distance * travel;
          drop.y += targetY / distance * travel;
        }
        // Rendered beneath actors: disappear only on arrival at the actual center.
        if (distance - travel <= 0.5) collectDrop(drop, player);
      }
    }
    if (lootStatus) lootStatus.textContent = `Credits: ${lootTotals.credits} | Secret Tech Notes: ${lootTotals.secretTechNotes} | Ground drops: ${drops.size}`;
  }

  /** Draw only visible reports beneath actors, keeping their orientation fixed. */
  function draw(context, camera, width, height) {
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      if (drop.pendingLanding) continue;
      const x = drop.x - camera.x, y = drop.y - camera.y - (drop.lift || 0);
      if (x < -iconWidth || y < -iconWidth || x > width + iconWidth || y > height + iconWidth) continue;
      const icon = drop.kind === 'exp' ? icons[drop.tier]
        : drop.kind === 'credits' ? creditIcon : noteIcon;
      const sourceWidth = icon.naturalWidth;
      const sourceHeight = icon.naturalHeight;
      if (!sourceWidth) continue;
      const iconHeight = iconWidth * sourceHeight / sourceWidth;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x, y);
      context.rotate(drop.rotation);
      context.drawImage(icon, -iconWidth / 2, -iconHeight / 2, iconWidth, iconHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
  }
  return { ready: Promise.all([ready, creditReady, noteReady]), update, draw, clear: clearGroundLoot };
}

/** Common growth keeps the outer rings strictly larger despite their staggered appearances. */
export function firingRingPoses(elapsed,size) {
  const growth=1+Math.min(1,Math.max(0,elapsed)/.5)*1.5;
  return Array.from({length:3},(_,i)=>{
    const age=elapsed-i*.045,t=age/.42;
    return {visible:age>=0&&t<1,x:i*22+Math.max(0,elapsed)*55,
      radius:size*(.65+i*.5)*growth,opacity:Math.max(0,1-t)**2*.75};
  });
}

/** Soft double-stroked muzzle shock rings; local impact only, no screen flash. */
export function drawFiringRings(context,x,y,angle,elapsed,size,blue=false) {
  const rings=firingRingPoses(elapsed,size);if(!rings.some(r=>r.visible))return;
  context.save();context.translate(x,y);context.rotate(angle);context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.shadowBlur=0;
  for(const ring of rings) {
    if(!ring.visible)continue;context.globalAlpha=ring.opacity;context.beginPath();
    for(let point=0;point<=32;point++) {
      const a=point/32*Math.PI*2,px=ring.x+Math.cos(a)*ring.radius*.3,py=Math.sin(a)*ring.radius;
      if(point===0)context.moveTo(px,py);else context.lineTo(px,py);
    }
    context.strokeStyle=blue?'rgba(75,190,255,.4)':'rgba(255,100,220,.4)';context.lineWidth=6;context.stroke();
    context.strokeStyle=blue?'#e5fcff':'#ffe9fc';context.lineWidth=1.6;context.stroke();
  }
  context.restore();
}

import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
export const frozenSettings={duration:3,opacity:.55,coverageScale:1.65,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/frozen.png'};
let ice;
export const frozenReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ice=new Image();ice.onload=resolve;ice.onerror=reject;ice.src=frozenSettings.source;});
export function applyFrozen(enemy,seconds=frozenSettings.duration){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(enemy.frozenRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function freezeVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyFrozen(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawFrozenStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.frozenRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!ice?.naturalWidth)return;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),size=enemy.spriteSize||Math.max(body.rx,body.ry)*2,
    height=size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,
    width=Math.max(size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,height*ice.naturalWidth/ice.naturalHeight);
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=frozenSettings.opacity;
  context.drawImage(ice,enemy.x-camera.x-width/2,enemy.y-camera.y-height/2,width,height);context.restore();
}
export function createFrozenAdmin({root,getEnemies,getCamera,getSize}){

  root.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click',()=>{const {width,height}=getSize();const count=freezeVisibleEnemies(getEnemies(),getCamera(),width,height);status.textContent=`Frozen ${count} onscreen enemies for 3 seconds.`;});
}

/** Visual pursuit continues while the control layer holds world movement/attacks. */
export function animateFrozenEnemy(enemy,player,delta){
  const dx=player.x-enemy.x,dy=player.y-enemy.y;
  const directions=['up','upRight','right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft'];
  if(dx||dy)enemy.direction=directions[(Math.round(Math.atan2(dx,-dy)/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8];
  if(dx)enemy.facing=dx>0?'right':'left';
  enemy.moving=true;enemy.elapsed=(enemy.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.attack)enemy.attack.elapsed=(enemy.attack.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.bossAction?.clip)enemy.frozenPoseElapsed=(enemy.frozenPoseElapsed??(enemy.bossAction.elapsed||0)*1000)+delta*1000;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/fullscreen-preview.js | sha256=d9a000a7f3ffe91282aa8cfb6a7bff89040a2b058777ed98d9df0da26b3f4a57 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Center the reference 1280x720 game area in a dark surround, preserving the session. */
export function setupFullscreenPreview(canvas, releaseControls) {
  const enter = document.querySelector('#enter-fullscreen-preview');
  const exit = document.querySelector('#exit-fullscreen-preview');
  const layout = document.querySelector('.playtest-layout');
  const main = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  const sidebar = document.querySelector('.playtest-sidebar');
  let active = false;
  let previousInert = [];

  /** Resize via CSS/ResizeObserver; never scale actors or reset world positions. */
  function setFullscreen(enabled) {
    if (active === enabled) return;
    active = enabled;
    releaseControls();
    document.body.classList.toggle('fullscreen-preview', active);
    enter.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
    exit.hidden = !active;
    if (active) {
      // Background admin controls should not receive hidden keyboard focus.
      const controls = [...main.children].filter(element => element !== layout).concat(sidebar);
      previousInert = controls.map(element => [element, element.inert]);
      for (const [element] of previousInert) element.inert = true;
      canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } else {
      for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
      previousInert = [];
      enter.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }

  enter.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(true));
  exit.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(false));
}

import { createMalkuthHat, createRacerPass, createSafetyHelmet, createLifeJacket, createOverheatedOverclocking, overclockingDescription, isContentUnlocked, lifeJacketDescription, safetyHelmetDescription, racerPassDescription, malkuthDescription, isItemUnlocked, isItemRewardEnabled } from './item-catalog.js';

// Super rewards respect item unlocks; unavailable pools fall back to normal Files.
export const superFileItems=[createMalkuthHat(true),createRacerPass(true),createSafetyHelmet(true),createLifeJacket(true),createOverheatedOverclocking(true)];
export const fileSettings={superChance:.05,tripleChance:.09,newChance:.1,weaponChance:.7,
  dropChance:0,bossGuaranteed:true,icon:'../sprites/icons/3 Stars Character Icon.png',maxGround:20,
  creditReplacementPerMax:.05,creditReplacementCap:.6};

/** Inclusive integer rolls and the supplied nested-floor Credits formula. */
export function fileCredits(type,random=Math.random,moneyUpBonus=0,stageMultiplier=1) {
  const [a,b]=type==='super'?[399,5]:type==='triple'?[399,3]:[301,1];
  const integer=max=>Math.min(max,Math.floor(random()*(max+1)));
  const multiplier=(1+moneyUpBonus/100)*stageMultiplier;
  return Math.floor(Math.floor(a/(3+integer(2)))*multiplier*(1+b*(20+integer(10))/100*multiplier));
}

/** Apply one accepted product without spending level-up choices; dropping never applies it. */
export function acceptFileProduct(player,product) {
  const slots=product.kind==='item'?(player.equipmentSlots??=[]):(player.attackSlots??=[]);
  const owned=slots.find(item=>item?.id===product.weapon.id);
  if(owned) {
    if(product.kind==='item'&&product.weapon.isSuper&&!owned.isSuper&&!owned.awakened){Object.assign(owned,{...product.weapon});return true;}
    if(owned.isSynergy)return false;
    const max=owned.maxLevel||7;if((owned.level||1)>=max)return false;
    owned.level=(owned.level||1)+1;if(product.kind!=='item')recordWeaponMax(player,owned);return true;
  }
  const index=slots.findIndex(item=>!item);
  if(index<0&&slots.filter(Boolean).length>=6)return false;
  const item={...product.weapon};if(index>=0)slots[index]=item;else slots.push(item);return true;
}

/** Generate products using a shadow inventory so triple rewards cannot overfill or overlevel it. */
export function rollFileRewards(player,{random=Math.random,forceType,getOptions=rollLevelUpgrades,superItems=superFileItems}={}) {
  const roll=random();let type=forceType||(roll<fileSettings.superChance?'super':roll<fileSettings.superChance+fileSettings.tripleChance?'triple':'normal');
  const supers=superItems.filter(item=>{
    if(!isItemRewardEnabled(player,item.id))return false;
    const owned=player.equipmentSlots?.find(owned=>owned?.id===item.id);
    if(item.id==='malkuth-hat'&&!isItemUnlocked(item.id)&&!owned)return false;
    if(item.defaultUnlocked===false&&!isContentUnlocked(item.id)&&!owned)return false;
    return owned?!owned.isSuper&&!owned.awakened:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6;
  });
  if(type==='super'&&!supers.length)type='normal';
  const result={type,products:[],credits:fileCredits(type,random,player.moneyUpBonus||0,player.stageCoinMultiplier??1)};
  if(type==='super') {
    const item=supers[Math.min(supers.length-1,Math.floor(random()*supers.length))];
    const description=item.id==='overheated-overclocking'?overclockingDescription(item):item.id==='life-jacket'?lifeJacketDescription(item):item.id==='safety-helmet'?safetyHelmetDescription(item):item.id==='racer-pass'?racerPassDescription(item):item.id==='malkuth-hat'?malkuthDescription(item):undefined;
    result.products.push({kind:'item',weapon:{...item,level:1},name:item.name,super:true,description});return result;
  }
  const shadow={...player,attackSlots:(player.attackSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null),equipmentSlots:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null)};
  const free={weapon:6-shadow.attackSlots.filter(Boolean).length,item:6-shadow.equipmentSlots.filter(Boolean).length};
  for(let index=0;index<(type==='triple'?3:1);index++) {
    const maxed=[...shadow.attackSlots,...shadow.equipmentSlots].filter(w=>w&&(w.isSynergy||(w.level||1)>=(w.maxLevel||7))).length;
    // Editable saturation behavior: each MAX slot adds 5 percentage points toward the 100-Credit substitution.
    if(random()<Math.min(fileSettings.creditReplacementCap,maxed*fileSettings.creditReplacementPerMax)){result.credits+=100;continue;}
    const options=getOptions(shadow,{all:true}).filter(choice=>choice.weapon&&!choice.weapon.isSynergy);
    let selected=null;
    const allowNew=random()<fileSettings.newChance;
    for(let attempt=0;attempt<5&&!selected;attempt++) {
      let kind=random()<fileSettings.weaponChance?'weapon':'item';
      const pool=k=>options.filter(option=>{
        const category=/item|equipment/i.test(option.category||'')?'item':'weapon';
        const owned=(k==='item'?shadow.equipmentSlots:shadow.attackSlots).some(w=>w?.id===option.weapon.id);
        return category===k&&(owned||(allowNew&&free[k]>index));
      });
      let candidates=pool(kind);if(!candidates.length&&kind==='weapon'){kind='item';candidates=pool(kind);}
      if(candidates.length){
        const weights=candidates.map(c=>Math.max(0,Number(c.weapon?.weight??1)||0)),total=weights.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);let roll=random()*total,pick=candidates.length-1;
        for(let i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){roll-=weights[i];if(roll<0){pick=i;break;}}
        selected={...candidates[pick],kind};
      }
    }
    if(selected&&acceptFileProduct(shadow,selected))result.products.push(selected);else result.credits+=100;
  }
  return result;
}
