/** Load a sheet before animation begins and report an actionable loading error. */
async function loadSheet(character) {
  if (character.gifFrames) {
    await loadGifAnimation(character);
    const actions=character.label==='Arisu Boss'?{charge:bossActionFrames.arisuCharge}:
      character.label==='Neru Boss'?{shoot:bossActionFrames.neruShoot}:{};
    character.actionAnimations={};
    await Promise.all(Object.entries(actions).map(async ([name,gifFrames])=>{
      const clip={gifFrames};await loadGifAnimation(clip);character.actionAnimations[name]=clip.animationFrames;
    }));
    return;
  }
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => {
      character.image = image;
      resolve();
    };
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${character.source}.`));
    image.src = character.source;
  });
}

/** Resolve keyboard input to one of the four supported movement directions. */
function directionForKey(key) {
  return {
    ArrowUp: 'up', w: 'up', ArrowDown: 'down', s: 'down',
    ArrowLeft: 'left', a: 'left', ArrowRight: 'right', d: 'right'
  }[key.length === 1 ? key.toLowerCase() : key];
}

/** Clear held input when focus is lost so characters cannot get stuck moving. */
function releaseControls() {
  heldDirections.clear();
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
  if (isGameplayPaused()) return;
  // Let admin form fields use their own arrow keys and text input.
  if (event.target?.closest('input, select, textarea')) return;
  const direction = directionForKey(event.key);
  if (!direction) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  if (!event.repeat) heldDirections.set(event.code, direction);
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', event => {
  heldDirections.delete(event.code);
});

window.addEventListener('blur', releaseControls);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', releaseControls);

/** Swap the development avatar in place, keeping one visible camera target. */
function switchCharacter(name) {
  if (!characters[name] || name === selected) return;
  const previous = characters[selected];
  const next = characters[name];

  // Carry the player position across so swapping does not jump the camera.
  next.x = previous.x;
  next.y = previous.y;
  next.direction = previous.direction;
  if (next.horizontalFacingOnly) {
    const horizontal = directionVectors[previous.direction][0];
    if (horizontal) next.facing = horizontal > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
  }
  next.elapsed = 0;
  next.moving = false;
  previous.elapsed = 0;
  previous.moving = false;
  previous.attack = null;
  previous.transition = null;
  next.attack = null;
  next.transition = null;
  selected = name;
  releaseControls();
  updateCamera();
  updateAttackControls();

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-character]').forEach(button => {
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.character === selected));
  });
}

/** Reveal boss-only attack buttons and prevent overlapping attack cycles. */
function updateAttackControls() {
  const character = characters[selected];
  document.querySelector('#boss-attacks').hidden = !character.attacks;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-attack]').forEach(button => {
    button.disabled = Boolean(character.attack) || !character.attacks?.[button.dataset.attack];
  });
}

/** Play one complete facing-specific attack animation, holding the boss in place. */
function startBossAttack(name) {
  const character = characters[selected];
  if (!character.attacks?.[name] || character.attack) return;
  beginPoseTransition(character);
  character.attack = { name, facing: character.facing, elapsed: 0, walkElapsed: character.elapsed };
  character.moving = false;
  updateAttackControls();
}

document.querySelectorAll('[data-attack]').forEach(button => {
  button.addEventListener('click', () => startBossAttack(button.dataset.attack));
});

document.querySelectorAll('[data-character]').forEach(button => {
  // Development-only selection; the future game character picker is not built yet.
  button.addEventListener('click', () => switchCharacter(button.dataset.character));
});

document.querySelectorAll('[data-direction]').forEach(button => {
  // Pointer capture lets touch and mouse controls release outside the button.
  button.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
    button.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    heldDirections.set(`pointer-${event.pointerId}`, button.dataset.direction);
  });
  for (const type of ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture']) {
    button.addEventListener(type, event => {
      heldDirections.delete(`pointer-${event.pointerId}`);
    });
  }
});

/** Combine held inputs into eight directions; opposite inputs cancel each other. */
function getMovementDirection() {
  let x = 0;
  let y = 0;
  // A held W and ArrowUp count as one direction rather than double speed.
  for (const direction of new Set(heldDirections.values())) {
    const vector = directionVectors[direction];
    x += vector[0];
    y += vector[1];
  }
  x = Math.sign(x);
  y = Math.sign(y);
  return Object.keys(directionVectors).find(direction => {
    const vector = directionVectors[direction];
    return vector[0] === x && vector[1] === y;
  });
}

/** Stop at walls without relocating a player already outside after switching maps. */
function constrainWithoutTeleport(previous, next, minimum, maximum) {
  if (previous < minimum) return Math.min(minimum, Math.max(previous, next));
  if (previous > maximum) return Math.max(maximum, Math.min(previous, next));
  return Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, next));
}

/** Move within canvas bounds, keeping diagonal and cardinal movement equally fast. */
function updateCharacter(character, delta, direction, chaseTarget) {
  if (character.attack) {
    character.attack.elapsed += delta * 1000;
    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
    const frames = character.layout.columnEdges.length - 1;
    if (character.attack.elapsed >= frames * attack.frameDuration) {
      const walkElapsed = character.attack.walkElapsed;
      beginPoseTransition(character);
      character.attack = null;
      character.elapsed = walkElapsed;
      updateAttackControls();
    } else {
      return;
    }
  }
  character.moving = Boolean(direction);
  if (!direction) {
    character.elapsed = 0;
    return;
  }

  // Arona turns at the current stride phase rather than snapping to frame zero.
  if (character.direction !== direction && !character.preserveWalkPhase) {
    character.elapsed = 0;
  }
  character.direction = direction;
  if (character.horizontalFacingOnly) {
    const horizontal = directionVectors[direction][0];
    if (horizontal) {
      const facing = horizontal > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
      if (facing !== character.facing) beginPoseTransition(character);
      character.facing = facing;
    }
  }
  character.elapsed += delta * 1000;
  // Chase uses the precise center-to-center vector; facing stays eight-way.
  const [x, y] = chaseTarget
    ? [chaseTarget.x - character.x, chaseTarget.y - character.y]
    : directionVectors[direction];
  const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
  const baseSpeed = movementSpeed * (character.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(character, 'spdPercent');
  const step = Math.max(baseSpeed, character.catchupSpeed || 0) * delta * slowdownMultiplier(character);
  const distance = (chaseTarget ? Math.min(step, length) : step) / (length || 1);
  const previousX = character.x;
  const previousY = character.y;
  character.x += x * distance;
  character.y += y * distance;
  if (chaseTarget && step >= length) {
    character.x = chaseTarget.x;
    character.y = chaseTarget.y;
  }
  const isEnemy = character !== characters[selected];
  // Boss bodies can cross props, shoreline, and strip edges while pursuing the player.
  if (isBossEnemy(character)) return;
  if (character.harmlessEscaping || character.behavior === 'horde') return; // Escape animations may cross the shoreline/walls to leave view.
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    const resolved = resolveIslandMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.fourth, isEnemy);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
    return;
  }
  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'both') {
    if (isEnemy) return; // Enemies cross props; the player still collides normally.
    const resolved = resolveObstacleMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
    return;
  }
  if (currentMap === 'first' && !isEnemy) {
    const resolved = resolveOfficeMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.first, canvas.height);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
  }
  if (currentMap === 'second' && !isEnemy) {
    const resolved = resolvePalaceMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.second, canvas.width);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
  }
  // Neither map's locked-axis limits should interrupt diagonal input while the
  // backgrounds are changing. Apply destination walls only after the ripple.
  // Existing outside positions are preserved by constrainWithoutTeleport below.
  if (mapTransition?.active) return;
  const margin = (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2;
  const bounds = stripMapBounds(maps[currentMap], canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
  // X is an unbounded world position, not a canvas position. Never wrap it:
  // future enemy positions must remain stable when background tiles disappear.
  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'horizontal') {
    character.y = constrainWithoutTeleport(previousY, character.y, bounds.top + margin, bounds.bottom - margin);
  } else {
    character.x = constrainWithoutTeleport(previousX, character.x, bounds.left + margin, bounds.right - margin);
  }
}

/** Return a source rectangle using the sheet's uneven per-column row boundaries. */
function getFrameRectangle(character, frame) {
  const facing = character.horizontalFacingOnly ? character.facing : character.direction;
  const row = character.attack
    ? character.attacks[character.attack.name].rows[character.attack.facing]
    : !character.moving && character.idleRows?.[facing] !== undefined
    ? character.idleRows[facing]
    : character.rows[facing];
  // Attack artwork can exceed the grid cell. Custom rectangles keep the tank's
  // anchor fixed even when a muzzle flash needs a wider crop.
  const custom = character.layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
  if (custom) return custom;
  const { columnEdges, rowEdges } = character.layout;
  return {
    x: columnEdges[frame],
    y: rowEdges[frame][row],
    width: columnEdges[frame + 1] - columnEdges[frame],
    height: rowEdges[frame][row + 1] - rowEdges[frame][row],
    anchorX: character.layout.anchorX?.[row]?.[frame],
    footY: character.layout.footY?.[frame]?.[row] ?? rowEdges[frame][row + 1]
  };
}

/** Select a direction-specific walking cycle, or hold frame zero when idle. */
function getAnimationFrame(character) {
  if (character.attack) {
    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
    return Math.min(character.layout.columnEdges.length - 2,
      Math.floor(character.attack.elapsed / attack.frameDuration));
  }
  if (!character.moving) return 0;
  const frames = character.walkFrames?.[character.direction] ||
    character.frameSequence || [1, 2, 3, 4];
  const duration = character.frameDuration || frameDuration;
  return frames[Math.floor(character.elapsed / duration) % frames.length];
}

/** Blend from the last visible pose without moving the character's world anchor. */
function beginPoseTransition(character) {
  if (character.transitionDuration && character.lastPose) {
    character.transition = { from: character.lastPose, elapsed: 0 };
  }
}

/** Render one pose with shared scale and measured foot anchors, including effects. */
function drawPose(character, pose, opacity) {
  opacity *= character.death?.opacity ?? 1;
  const crop = pose.crop;
  const displaySize = character.spriteSize || spriteSize;
  const scale = (displaySize - spritePadding * 2) / (character.referenceSize || 215);
  const width = crop.width * scale;
  const height = crop.height * scale;
  const drawY = displaySize / 2 - spritePadding - (crop.footY - crop.y) * scale + enemyBounceOffset(character);
  const drawX = crop.anchorX === undefined ? -width / 2 : -(crop.anchorX - crop.x) * scale;
  // Match attack hurtboxes to the rendered pose without changing contact-damage hitboxes.
  character.spriteHurtbox=animationSpriteHurtbox(character,getFrameRectangle,spritePadding);
  context.save();
  context.globalAlpha = opacity;
  context.translate(character.x - camera.x, character.y - camera.y + (character.bossVisualOffsetY||0));
  if(character.bossSquash) {
    const feet=drawY+(crop.footY-crop.y)*scale;
    context.translate(0,feet);
    context.scale(1+(1-character.bossSquash)*.3,character.bossSquash);
    context.translate(0,-feet);
  }
  if (pose.mirrored) context.scale(-1, 1);
  if ((character===characters[selected]||character.isPlayerVisual)&&character.tuningParts&&reverseTuningUpsideDown(character)) {
    const centerY=drawY+height/2;
    context.translate(0,centerY);context.scale(1,-1);context.translate(0,-centerY);
  }
  context.drawImage(character.image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
    drawX, drawY, width, height);
  const flash = character.death
    ? 0.95 * Math.min(1, character.death.elapsed / 0.035)
    : Math.max(character.ultimateWhite||0,getDamageFlashOpacity(character));
  if (flash > 0) {
    context.globalAlpha = opacity * flash;
    context.drawImage(getWhiteSprite(character.image), crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
      drawX, drawY, width, height);
    context.globalAlpha = opacity;
  }
  if (showSpriteBounds) {
    context.strokeStyle = '#e54b93';
    context.strokeRect(drawX, drawY, width, height);
    const body = getCombatHitbox(character, character !== characters[selected]);
    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
    context.beginPath();
    context.ellipse(body.x - character.x, body.y - character.y, body.rx, body.ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    context.stroke();
  }
  context.restore();
}

/** Put tall map objects in front of actors walking behind their solid bases. */
function drawCharacterOcclusion(character) {
  if (enemyRenderLayer(character) !== 'normal') return; // Specials and bosses appear above map foregrounds.
  const opacity = character === characters[selected] ? obstacleVisibility.playerOpacity : 1;
  if (currentMap === 'first') drawOfficeMonumentOcclusion(context, character, maps.first, camera, canvas.height, opacity);
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') drawTowerOcclusion(context, character, maps.fourth, camera, opacity);
  if (currentMap === 'second') drawPalaceOcclusion(context, character, maps.second, camera, canvas.width, opacity);
}

/** Draw animation poses with a short blend when entering/leaving boss actions. */
function drawCharacter(character) {
  if (character.death && character.lastPose && !character.animationFrames) {
    drawPose(character, character.lastPose, 1);
    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
    return;
  }
  if (character.animationFrames) {
    const frames=character.actionAnimations?.[character.bossAction?.clip] || character.animationFrames;
    const frame = frames[gifFrameAt(frames, character.frozenPoseElapsed ?? (character.bossAction?.clip ? (character.bossAction.elapsed||0)*1000 : character.gifElapsed || 0))];
    const image = frame.image;
    const animatedCharacter={...character,image,isPlayerVisual:character===characters[selected]};
    const anchor=character.gifPoseAnchors?.[character.bossAction?.clip||'normal'];
    drawPose(animatedCharacter, {
      crop: { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight, footY: anchor?.footY??image.naturalHeight,anchorX:anchor?.anchorX },
      mirrored: character.facing !== (character.nativeFacing || 'left')
    }, 1);
    character.spriteHurtbox=animatedCharacter.spriteHurtbox;
    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
    return;
  }
  const pose = {
    crop: getFrameRectangle(character, getAnimationFrame(character)),
    mirrored: character.mirroredDirections?.includes(character.direction)
  };
  const transition = character.transition;
  if (transition) {
    const progress = Math.min(1, transition.elapsed / character.transitionDuration);
    drawPose(character, transition.from, 1 - progress);
    drawPose(character, pose, progress);
    if (progress === 1) character.transition = null;
  } else {
    drawPose(character, pose, 1);
  }
  character.lastPose = pose;
  drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
}

/** Score and queue one campaign transition after its full checkpoint/clock conditions are met. */
function advanceStageAfterClear() {
  if(gachaFiles?.active){awaitingFileStageAdvance=true;return;}
  if(pendingStageTransition) return;
        if (!endlessMode) {
          unlockStageClearRewards(characters[selected]);
          const result = runScore.complete({character:characters[selected],elapsedSeconds:survivalClock.seconds,
            stage:currentMap,hardcore:characters[selected].hardcore === true});
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run-score-calculated',{detail:result}));
        }
        const next = nextStageAfterBoss(currentMap, endlessMode,
          Object.keys(maps).filter(id => !maps[id].disabled));
        if (next.endless && !endlessMode) {
          endlessMode = true;
          endlessStartedAt = survivalClock.seconds; // Stage 4 completion starts endless timers exactly once.
        }
        pendingStageTransition = next.mapId;
        stageTransitionDelay = stageProgressionSettings.bossClearDelay;
}

/** Update and render only the active avatar; the inactive character stays hidden. */
function animate(time) {
  const delta = previousTime === undefined ? 0 : Math.min((time - previousTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  previousTime = time;
  mapAudio?.update(delta);
  const activeCharacter = characters[selected];
  levelUpMenu?.update();
  survivalClock.advance(delta, isGameplayPaused(), !isPlayerDefeated(activeCharacter));
  characterSurvivalUnlocks.update(delta,activeCharacter,{paused:isGameplayPaused(),alive:!isPlayerDefeated(activeCharacter)});
  if (endlessMode && isPlayerDefeated(activeCharacter)) {
    const result = runScore.complete({character: activeCharacter, elapsedSeconds:survivalClock.seconds,
      stage:currentMap,endless:true,hardcore:activeCharacter.hardcore === true});
    if (result) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run-score-calculated',{detail:result}));
  }
  const direction = isGameplayPaused() ? undefined : getMovementDirection();
  if (!isGameplayPaused()) {
    // Queue progression until any existing background ripple finishes; never lose a boss-clear transition.
    if(pendingStageTransition)stageTransitionDelay=Math.max(0,stageTransitionDelay-delta);
    if (pendingStageTransition && stageTransitionDelay<=1e-8 && !mapTransition?.active && switchMap(pendingStageTransition)) {
      pendingStageTransition = null;
    }
    skillCasting?.update(delta);
    updateDamageNumbers(delta);
    playerStatsTools?.update();
    advanceDamageFlash(characters[selected], delta);
    hud?.update(characters[selected]);
    if (activeCharacter.animationFrames) activeCharacter.gifElapsed = (activeCharacter.gifElapsed || 0) + delta * 1000 * (activeCharacter.animationSpeed || 1);
    if (activeCharacter.transition) activeCharacter.transition.elapsed += delta * 1000;
    const playerBefore = { x: activeCharacter.x, y: activeCharacter.y };
    updateCharacter(activeCharacter, delta, direction);
    const playerMotion = { x: activeCharacter.x - playerBefore.x, y: activeCharacter.y - playerBefore.y };
    activeCharacter.stationaryForTuning=Math.hypot(playerMotion.x,playerMotion.y)<1e-6;
    updateCamera(delta);
    npcTools?.cleanup(); // Reclaim distant/invalid NPC slots before the next spawn batch.
    if (campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode && !pendingStageTransition && !isPlayerDefeated(activeCharacter)) {
      campaignSchedule.update(delta, row=>Boolean(playtestSpawner?.running)&&npcTools.spawnCampaignEncounter(row));
      if(campaignSchedule.readyToAdvance) advanceStageAfterClear();
    }
    const campaignStatus=document.querySelector('#campaign-clock-status');
    if(campaignStatus) campaignStatus.textContent=`Internal chart: ${Math.floor(campaignSchedule.seconds/60)}:${String(Math.floor(campaignSchedule.seconds)%60).padStart(2,'0')}${campaignSchedule.frozen?' (frozen)':''}`;
    endlessBuildup.update(delta, { endless: endlessMode && eventTriggerSettings.enabled,
      bossAlive: getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy), spawning: Boolean(playtestSpawner?.running) });
    const buildupStatus = document.querySelector('#endless-buildup-status');
    if (buildupStatus) buildupStatus.textContent = endlessMode || endlessBuildup.active
      ? `Event: ${endlessBuildup.name} (${endlessBuildup.phase}). Cycle time: ${Math.floor(endlessBuildup.seconds)}s. Elite chance: ${(endlessBuildup.eliteChance * 100).toFixed(1)}%.`
      : 'Endless buildup: available after Stage 4.';
    bossSpawner?.update(delta);
    playtestSpawner?.update(delta, playerMotion);
    npcTools?.update(delta, playerMotion);
    const attackFacing = activeCharacter.horizontalFacingOnly
      ? activeCharacter.facing : activeCharacter.direction;
    const aimAngle = aiming.getAngle(activeCharacter, camera.x, directionVectors[attackFacing], camera.y);
    updateLifeJacket(activeCharacter,delta);
    updateOverclocking(activeCharacter,delta);
    updateChiseDamage(activeCharacter,delta);
    safetyHelmetEffects?.update(delta);
    updateTrumpetTuning(delta);
    updateNeutralizationTuning(delta);
    updateRepairTuning(activeCharacter,delta);
    luminousSkill?.update(delta,activeCharacter);
    princessSkill?.update(delta,activeCharacter,aimAngle);
    luminousAttack?.setSkillFinishing(Boolean(luminousSkill?.finishing));
    umbrellaAttack?.update(delta, activeCharacter, aimAngle,npcTools?.eraseProjectiles);
    arisAttack?.update(delta, activeCharacter, aimAngle);
    luminousAttack?.update(delta,activeCharacter,aimAngle);
    badCookingAttack?.update(delta,activeCharacter);
    molotovAttack?.update(delta,activeCharacter,{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height});
    saintPredatorAttack?.update(delta,activeCharacter,{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height});
    princessAttack?.setExMode(Boolean(princessSkill?.casting),Boolean(princessSkill?.sprayActive));
    princessAttack?.update(delta,activeCharacter,aimAngle,{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height});
    decagrammatonAttack?.setExMode(Boolean(princessSkill?.casting),Boolean(princessSkill?.sprayActive));
    decagrammatonAttack?.update(delta,activeCharacter,aimAngle,{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height});
    decagrammatonUltimate?.update(delta,activeCharacter,{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height});
    planaSkill?.update(delta,npcTools?.eraseProjectiles);
    updateTuningExplosions(delta);
    superSynergy?.update(activeCharacter,playerBefore);
    expPickups?.update(activeCharacter, playerBefore, delta);
    levelUpMenu?.update();
    if(!levelUpMenu?.active) {
      crafters?.update(activeCharacter,playerBefore,delta);
      if(!crafters?.active)goldenCrafters?.update(activeCharacter,playerBefore,delta);
      if(!crafters?.active&&!goldenCrafters?.active)gachaFiles?.update(activeCharacter,playerBefore);
      if(!crafters?.active&&!goldenCrafters?.active&&!gachaFiles?.active)tuningParts?.update(activeCharacter,playerBefore,delta);
    }
    hud?.update(activeCharacter);
  }
  // A frozen game frame needs no repeated sprite/effect rendering. Browser UI continues normally.
  const frozenKey=isGameplayPaused()?`${canvas.width}x${canvas.height}`:null;
  if(frozenKey&&frozenCanvasFrame===frozenKey){requestAnimationFrame(animate);return;}
  frozenCanvasFrame=frozenKey;
  context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  context.save();
  const shake=npcTools?.screenShake||{x:0,y:0};context.translate(shake.x,shake.y);
  drawPlayarea();
  molotovAttack?.drawGround(context,camera);
  mapTransition?.draw(context, isGameplayPaused() ? 0 : delta);
  if (currentMap === 'fourth' && showSpriteBounds) drawIsland(context, maps.fourth, camera, true);
  if (currentMap === 'third' && showSpriteBounds) {
    context.save();
    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
    for (const box of obstaclesIn(camera.x, camera.y, camera.x + canvas.width, camera.y + canvas.height)) {
      context.strokeRect(box.left - camera.x, box.top - camera.y, box.right - box.left, box.bottom - box.top);
    }
    context.restore();
  }
  if (currentMap === 'first' && showSpriteBounds) {
    context.save();
    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
    for (const box of officeObstaclesIn(maps.first, canvas.height, camera.x, camera.y,
      camera.x + canvas.width, camera.y + canvas.height)) {
      context.strokeRect(box.left - camera.x, box.top - camera.y, box.right - box.left, box.bottom - box.top);
    }
    context.restore();
  }
  if (currentMap === 'second' && showSpriteBounds) {
    context.save();
    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
    for (const box of palaceObstaclesIn(maps.second, canvas.width, camera.x, camera.y,
      camera.x + canvas.width, camera.y + canvas.height)) {
      context.strokeRect(box.left - camera.x, box.top - camera.y, box.right - box.left, box.bottom - box.top);
    }
    context.restore();
  }
  expPickups?.draw(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  crafters?.draw(context,camera,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  goldenCrafters?.draw(context,camera,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  gachaFiles?.draw(context,camera);
  tuningParts?.draw(context,camera);
  superSynergy?.draw(context,camera);
  npcTools?.draw(context);
  npcTools?.drawSpecials(); // Specials render above regular enemies.
  npcTools?.drawBosses(); // Bosses render above other enemies, below the controlled player.
  arisAttack?.draw(context, camera);
  badCookingAttack?.draw(context,camera);
  safetyHelmetEffects?.draw(context,camera);
  molotovAttack?.drawThrows(context,camera);
  saintPredatorAttack?.draw(context,camera);
  luminousAttack?.draw(context,camera);
  princessAttack?.draw(context,camera);
  princessSkill?.draw(context,camera);
  decagrammatonAttack?.draw(context,camera);decagrammatonUltimate?.draw(context,camera);
  luminousSkill?.draw(context,camera);
  drawTuningExplosions(context,camera);
  planaSkill?.draw(context, camera); // EX umbrella and its trail stay behind the player.
  // Canvas shadows follow the current frame's alpha silhouette, keeping the aura on the sprite.
  context.save();
  if(luminousSkill?.auraActive||princessSkill?.auraActive) {
    context.shadowColor='rgba(255,105,215,.85)';
    context.shadowBlur=12;
  }
  drawCharacter(activeCharacter); // The player is the highest-priority actor.
  context.restore();
  umbrellaAttack?.draw(context, camera);
  context.restore(); // Shake world rendering only; HUD and world positions remain stable.
  survivalDisplay?.draw(context, survivalClock.seconds, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  const facing = activeCharacter.horizontalFacingOnly ? activeCharacter.facing : activeCharacter.direction;
  aiming?.draw(context, activeCharacter, camera.x, directionVectors[facing], camera.y);
  for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('[data-admin-skill-slot]')) {
    const slot = Number(button.dataset.adminSkillSlot);
    button.disabled = !adminSkillResult(activeCharacter, slot).valid;
  }
  document.querySelector('#switch-map').disabled = Boolean(mapTransition?.active);

  const action = activeCharacter.attack
    ? activeCharacter.attacks[activeCharacter.attack.name].label
    : direction || 'idle';
  const description = `${activeCharacter.label} / ${action} / camera X ${Math.round(camera.x)} / Y ${Math.round(camera.y)} / ${maps[currentMap].label}`;
  if (status.textContent !== description) status.textContent = description;
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

/** Knockback collides with solid map props even though ordinary enemy walking ignores them. */
function canKnockbackStand(enemy, x, y) {
  if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) return true;
  const body = getCombatHitbox({ ...enemy, x, y }, true);
  const map = maps[currentMap];
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') return canPlaceIslandLoot(body.x, body.y, Math.max(body.rx, body.ry), map);
  const bounds = stripMapBounds(map, canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
  if (body.x-body.rx < bounds.left || body.x+body.rx > bounds.right ||
      body.y-body.ry < bounds.top || body.y+body.ry > bounds.bottom) return false;
  const boxes = currentMap === 'first'
    ? officeObstaclesIn(map, canvas.height, body.x-body.rx, body.y-body.ry, body.x+body.rx, body.y+body.ry)
    : currentMap === 'second'
      ? palaceObstaclesIn(map, canvas.width, body.x-body.rx, body.y-body.ry, body.x+body.rx, body.y+body.ry)
      : obstaclesIn(body.x-body.rx, body.y-body.ry, body.x+body.rx, body.y+body.ry);
  return boxes.every(box => body.x+body.rx <= box.left || body.x-body.rx >= box.right ||
    body.y+body.ry <= box.top || body.y-body.ry >= box.bottom);
}

/** Validate loot ground footprints against player obstacles, never the enemy obstacle bypass. */
function isLootLandingClear(x, y, radius) {
  const map = maps[currentMap];
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') return canPlaceIslandLoot(x, y, radius, map);
  const bounds = stripMapBounds(map, canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
  if (x-radius < bounds.left || x+radius > bounds.right ||
      y-radius < bounds.top || y+radius > bounds.bottom) return false;
  const boxes = currentMap === 'first'
    ? officeObstaclesIn(map, canvas.height, x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius)
    : currentMap === 'second'
      ? palaceObstaclesIn(map, canvas.width, x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius)
      : obstaclesIn(x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius);
  return boxes.every(box => x+radius <= box.left || x-radius >= box.right ||
    y+radius <= box.top || y-radius >= box.bottom);
}

        onPause: () => skillCasting?.cancel('pause') });
      document.querySelector('#run-seed-status').textContent = `Run seed: ${runSeed} | Started: ${runStartedAt.toLocaleString()}`;
      window.restoreDevSession?.();
      window.pageLoading?.finish();
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    })
    .catch(error => { status.textContent = error.message; window.pageLoading?.fail('Unable to load game assets. Please reload to try again.'); });
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/neutralization-tuning.js | sha256=adfdb6de395ed539c0da618a046c30b42bda1d2488bdb0695ecf00885c6f2e24 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
const attempts=new WeakMap();let clock=0;
export function updateNeutralizationTuning(delta){clock+=Math.max(0,delta);}
function enabled(player){return player.tuningParts&&(player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null))==='plana-umbrella';}
export function tryNeutralizationHit({player,enemy,random=Math.random}){
  if(!enabled(player)||enemy.hp<=0)return false;
  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'stunChance');if(!chance||random()>=chance)return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining=Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining||0,1);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function canEraseEnemyProjectile(projectile){
  return projectile.erasable!==false&&!['neru','iroha'].includes(projectile.ownerType)&&
    !['ground-pound','smash','ram','self-destruct','explosion'].includes(projectile.kind);
}
/** The whole attack shares one attempt per second, on success or failure. */
export function eraseTuningProjectiles({player,attack,projectiles,intersects,random=Math.random}){
  if(!enabled(player)||clock-(attempts.get(attack)??-Infinity)<1-1e-8)return false;
  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'eraseChance');if(!chance)return false;
  for(let i=0;i<projectiles.length;i++){
    if(!canEraseEnemyProjectile(projectiles[i])||!intersects(projectiles[i]))continue;
    attempts.set(attack,clock);if(random()>=chance)return false;
    projectiles.splice(i,1);return true;
  }return false;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/npc-contact.js | sha256=ebe863b6072edc6461a3d5f5e36657b8290cae1c702e69747a41919316d18064 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import {weakenedAttackMultiplier} from './weak-tuning.js';
import { enemyContactDamageFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

// Contact reaction settings live in game-config.js.
/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
  const enemyBody = getCombatHitbox(npc, true), playerBody = getCombatHitbox(player, false);
  const rx = enemyBody.rx + playerBody.rx, ry = enemyBody.ry + playerBody.ry;
  const fromX = playerBody.x - motion.x, fromY = playerBody.y - motion.y;
  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
  const scaledLength = (motion.x / rx) ** 2 + (motion.y / ry) ** 2;
  const t = scaledLength ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    ((enemyBody.x - fromX) * motion.x / rx ** 2 +
      (enemyBody.y - fromY) * motion.y / ry ** 2) / scaledLength)) : 1;
  const dx = enemyBody.x - (fromX + motion.x * t);
  const dy = enemyBody.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
  const nx = distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1;
  const ny = distance > 0.001 ? dy / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.y / fallbackLength : 0;
  const radius = 1 / Math.hypot(nx / rx, ny / ry);
  return { touching: (dx / rx) ** 2 + (dy / ry) ** 2 < 1, pushing, radius, nx, ny,
    overlap: Math.max(0, radius - Math.hypot(enemyBody.x - playerBody.x, enemyBody.y - playerBody.y)) };
}

/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move, survivalSeconds = 0) {
  if(npc.frozenRemaining>0)return false;
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  // Per-enemy attack cooldown is separate from recoil and the player's global I-frames.
  npc.playerHitCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.playerHitCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0) && !(npc.playerHitCooldown > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.contactDamage ?? (npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage);
    const damage = npc.perTypeStats ? Math.floor(baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1)) :
      enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, player.level || 1, survivalSeconds, npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1);
    const damaged = damagePlayer(player, npc.weakRemaining>0?Math.floor(damage*weakenedAttackMultiplier(npc)):damage);
    if (damaged && npc.type === 'yuuka') npc.playerHitCooldown = yuukaSettings.contactHitInterval;
    if (damaged) {player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;npc.secondsSincePlayerHit=0;}
  }
  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
    const overlap = hit.overlap;
    const knockback = beginKnockback(npc, hit.nx * (settings.distance + overlap),
      hit.ny * (settings.distance + overlap), settings.travel);
    npc.contactReaction = knockback ? { ...knockback, kind, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny } : null;
    if (!knockback) npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
    npc.attack = null;
  }
  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
  if (!reaction) return false;
  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
  advanceKnockback(npc, reaction, delta, move);
  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;
  if (reaction.elapsed >= recovery) {
    npc.contactReaction = null;
    npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
  }
  // Bosses still recoil/flash, but do not skip their AI update or wait afterward.
  return pauseChase;
}

  const yuukaStatus = document.querySelector('#yuuka-spawn-status');

  /** Refresh selection only when population changes, retaining the current ID. */
  function refresh() {
    list.replaceChildren();
    for (const npc of records()) {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = npc.id;
      option.textContent = `${npc.id} / ${npc.label}`;
      list.append(option);
    }
    if (!records().some(npc => npc.id === selectedId)) selectedId = records()[0]?.id || '';
    list.value = selectedId;

  }

  /** Clone an animation configuration into independent world-space NPC state. */
  function spawn(x, y, options = {}) {
    if (getAllEnemies().length >= cap) {
      feedback.textContent = `Population limit (${cap}) reached. Delete NPCs before spawning more.`;
      return;
    }
    const type = options.type ?? field('npc-type').value;
    const template = characters[type];
    if(!template) return false;
    const campaignEntry=options.campaignEntry || (!options.automatic && getCampaignProfile(type)?{row:getCampaignProfile(type),mega:false,scheduled:false}:null);
    if (type === 'yuuka' && options.automatic && !canSpawnYuuka(records())) {
      feedback.textContent = 'Only one Yuuka can be alive at a time. Remove or defeat her before spawning another.';
      return false;
    }
    if (isBossEnemy({ ...template, type }) && (!campaignEntry || campaignEntry.row.kind === 'boss')) {
      const bosses = records().filter(isBossEnemy);
      const limit = getBossLimit ? getBossLimit() : allowMultipleBosses() ? Infinity : 1;
      if (bosses.some(enemy => enemy.type === type) || bosses.length >= limit) {
        feedback.textContent = 'Boss limit reached: one of each type, within the current wave size.';
        return false;
      }
    }
    const variant = enemyVariant(type, template, options.variant ?? field('npc-variant').value, Math.random, getSurvivalSeconds(), getEndlessSeconds(), getEliteChance?.());
    if (['yuuka','sensei'].includes(type)) {
      variant.hp = variant.maxHp = yuukaHealth(getPlayerDamage());
      variant.hitsToDefeat = harmlessEnemySettings[`${type}HitsToDefeat`] ??
        harmlessHitsToDefeatFormula(getPlayer().level ?? 1);
      variant.receivedHits = 0;
    }
    Object.assign(variant,timedEventStatOverrides(options.timedEvent,variant));
    if(campaignEntry) Object.assign(variant,campaignEnemyOverrides(campaignEntry,template,baseMovementSpeed));
    const size = variant.spriteSize;
    const unboundedBoss = isBossEnemy({ ...template, ...variant, type });
    // Recheck at insertion time: the camera may have moved during warnings or capacity retries.
    if (options.timedEvent) {
      const point=offscreenEventPoint({x,y},{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height},size);
      x=point.x; y=point.y;
    }
    x = !unboundedBoss && !options.automatic && isVertical() ? Math.max(camera.x + size / 2, Math.min(camera.x + canvas.width - size / 2, x)) : x;
    y = unboundedBoss || options.automatic || isVertical() || isFreeScroll() ? y : Math.max(camera.y + size / 2, Math.min(camera.y + canvas.height - size / 2, y));
    if (!isPlacementClear({ ...template, ...variant }, x, y)) return false;
    const npc = rememberEnemy(`npc-${++counter}`, {
      ...template, type, eventKey: options.eventKey,
      x: !unboundedBoss && !options.automatic && isVertical() ? Math.max(camera.x + size / 2, Math.min(camera.x + canvas.width - size / 2, x)) : x,
      y: unboundedBoss || options.automatic || isVertical() || isFreeScroll() ? y : Math.max(camera.y + size / 2, Math.min(camera.y + canvas.height - size / 2, y)),
      direction: template.defaultDirection || 'down', facing: template.defaultDirection || 'left',
      moving: false, elapsed: 0, attack: null, transition: null, lastPose: null,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: type === 'midori' ? midoriSpeed(getPlayer(), baseMovementSpeed) / baseMovementSpeed
        : ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(type) ? yuukaSettings.speed / baseMovementSpeed : playerSettings.npcSpeed / baseMovementSpeed,
      ai: options.ai ?? field('npc-ai').checked, behavior: ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(type) ? 'erratic' : options.behavior ?? field('npc-behavior').value,
      eventExpiresAt: !options.timedEvent?.runtimeManaged && options.timedEvent?.lifetimeSeconds != null ? options.timedEvent.timeSeconds+options.timedEvent.lifetimeSeconds : null,
      // Irrational per-spawn phases and slightly varied cadence keep group skipping staggered.
      bouncePhase:(counter*0.618033988749895)%1,
      bouncePeriodScale:.9+((counter*0.754877666246693)%1)*.2,
      eventPattern:options.timedEvent?.pattern, eventMotionAge:0, chargeWait:['fastball','ambush'].includes(options.timedEvent?.pattern)?.65:0,
      chargeAngle: options.chargeAngle, spawnArrivalPending: options.timedArrival === true, spawnArrivalGrace: 10,
      wanderTimer: 0, wanderDirection: undefined, invincible: false,
      combatStats: {}, // NPCs do not inherit the controlled avatar's test upgrades.
      ...variant,
      // Default rewards roll on defeat; explicit admin overrides remain available.
      expReward: !options.automatic && field('npc-exp-override').checked
        ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(Number(field('npc-exp').value) || 0))) : variant.expReward
    });
    if (!options.automatic) selectedId = npc.id;
    return true;
  }

  /** Spawn a bounded batch in the current visible world area. */
  function spawnBatch(position) {
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, Number(field('npc-count').value) || 1));
    let missed = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      let placed = false;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < (position ? 1 : 30); attempt++) {
        placed = spawn(position ? position.x : camera.x + 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.width - 280),
          position ? position.y : camera.y + 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.height - 280));
        if (placed || getAllEnemies().length >= cap) break;
      }
      if (!placed) missed++;
    }
    refresh();
    if (missed) feedback.textContent += ` ${missed} spawn(s) blocked by obstacles or population limit.`;
  }

  /** Force the button's variant for random placement, or arm cursor placement. */
  function spawnFromButton(variant) {
    if (variant === 'elite' && !(field('npc-type').value === 'mob' || characters[field('npc-type').value]?.standard)) return;
    field('npc-variant').value = variant;
    if (field('npc-mode').value === 'random') spawnBatch();
    else {
      field('npc-mode').value = 'cursor';
      feedback.textContent = `${variant === 'elite' ? 'Mega' : 'Normal'} cursor spawn armed: left-click inside the game screen. Choose Inspect to stop spawning.`;
    }
  }
  panel.querySelector('#spawn-npc').addEventListener('click', () => spawnFromButton('normal'));
  eliteButton.addEventListener('click', () => spawnFromButton('elite'));
  list.addEventListener('change', () => { selectedId = list.value; });

  // Capture before aiming's click handler. NPC tool clicks never toggle aiming.
  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    const mode = field('npc-mode').value;
    if (mode === 'random') return;
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    const point = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
    point.x += camera.x;
    point.y += camera.y;
    if (mode === 'cursor') spawnBatch(point);
    else {
      const closest = records().filter(npc =>
        Math.hypot(npc.x - point.x, npc.y - point.y) < (npc.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2
      ).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - point.x, a.y - point.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - point.x, b.y - point.y))[0];
      if (closest) {
        selectedId = closest.id;
        if (mode === 'delete') removeEnemy(selectedId);
        refresh();
      }
    }
  }, true);

  /** Dispatch selected-NPC and population actions from the admin panel. */
  panel.querySelectorAll('[data-npc-action]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const npc = getEnemy(selectedId);
      switch (button.dataset.npcAction) {
        case 'delete': if (npc) removeEnemy(npc.id); break;
        case 'clear': for (const entry of records()) removeEnemy(entry.id); break;
        case 'delete-visible':
          for (const entry of visible(0)) removeEnemy(entry.id);
          break;
        case 'apply-ai':
          if (npc) { npc.ai = field('npc-ai').checked; npc.behavior = field('npc-behavior').value; }
          break;
        case 'all-ai-on': for (const entry of records()) entry.ai = true; break;
        case 'all-ai-off': for (const entry of records()) entry.ai = false; break;
        case 'damage': if (npc) damageEnemy(npc.id, 25, getPlayer()); break;
        case 'heal': if (npc) npc.hp = npc.maxHp; break;
        case 'bring': if (npc) { npc.x = getPlayer().x + 160; npc.y = getPlayer().y; } break;
        case 'pause': paused = !paused; button.textContent = paused ? 'Resume AI' : 'Pause AI'; break;
        case 'step': step = true; paused = true; panel.querySelector('[data-npc-action="pause"]').textContent = 'Resume AI'; break;
      }
      refresh();
    });
  });

  /** Advance simple chase/wander AI; records stay alive even when off-screen. */
  function update(delta, playerMotion = { x: 0, y: 0 }) {
    updateEnemyDeaths(delta); // Finish visual fades even while AI is paused.
    const time = step ? 1 / 60 : paused ? 0 : delta;
    step = false;
    const player = getPlayer();
    for(const enemy of records())enemy.secondsSincePlayerHit=(enemy.secondsSincePlayerHit||0)+time;
    bossBehaviors.updateEffects(time,player,records(),playerMotion);
    campaignEvents.update(getInternalSeconds(),delta,{stage:getEventStage(),enabled:time>0&&timedSpawnsEnabled()});
    const eventStatus=document.querySelector('#campaign-event-status');
    if(eventStatus) eventStatus.textContent=`Events: ${campaignEvents.activeGroups} active groups. Seeded events: ${campaignEvents.generatedSlots}.`;
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && time && timedSpawnsEnabled()) timedEvents.update(getSurvivalSeconds());
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && time && timedSpawnsEnabled()) miniBossSchedule.update(getSurvivalSeconds(), type => {
      const size = characters[type].spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
      const outside = size/2 + 24;
      const spots = [
        [camera.x-outside, player.y], [camera.x+canvas.width+outside,player.y],
        [player.x,camera.y-outside], [player.x,camera.y+canvas.height+outside]
      ];
      return spots.some(([x,y])=>spawn(x,y,{type,variant:'normal',ai:true,behavior:'chase',automatic:true}));
    });
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && time && timedSpawnsEnabled()) harmlessSchedule.update(getSurvivalSeconds(), type => {
      if (type === 'yuuka' && !canSpawnYuuka(records())) return;
      // Retry placement around the player so map walls cannot silently cancel a successful roll.
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 16; attempt++) {
        const angle = attempt * Math.PI / 8;
        const radius = Math.min(200, canvas.width / 4) * (1 - Math.floor(attempt / 8) * .5);
        if (spawn(player.x + Math.cos(angle)*radius, player.y + Math.sin(angle)*radius,
          {type, variant:'normal',ai:true,automatic:true})) break;
      }
    });
    // Tick once per simulation update, never once per enemy or contact check.
    player.contactIFrames = Math.max(0, (player.contactIFrames || 0) - time);
    const names = ['up', 'upRight', 'right', 'downRight', 'down', 'downLeft', 'left', 'upLeft'];
    for (const npc of records()) {
      if (npc.eventExpiresAt != null && getSurvivalSeconds()>=npc.eventExpiresAt) {
        endEventEnemies(npc.eventKey,player);continue;
      }
      npc.eventMotionAge=(npc.eventMotionAge||0)+time;
      updateKnockbackResistance(npc, time);
      updateSlowdown(npc,time);
      updateWeakTuning(npc,time);
      updateRateUpWindow(npc,time);
      if (npc.spawnArrivalPending) npc.spawnArrivalGrace = Math.max(0,(npc.spawnArrivalGrace ?? 10)-time);
      if (npc.type === 'midori' && !npc.campaignOverride) npc.movementSpeedMultiplier = midoriSpeed(player, baseMovementSpeed) / baseMovementSpeed;
      updateBossCatchup(npc, player, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, baseMovementSpeed);
      advanceDamageFlash(npc, delta);
      if (npc.animationFrames) npc.gifElapsed = (npc.gifElapsed || 0) + delta * 1000 * (npc.animationSpeed || 1);
      const wasFrozen=npc.frozenRemaining>0;
      if(!wasFrozen)delete npc.frozenPoseElapsed;
      if (time && updateEnemyControl(npc, time, moveKnockback)) {
        if(wasFrozen)animateFrozenEnemy(npc,player,time);
        if (updateYuukaPresence(npc, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, time)) { removeEnemy(npc.id); refresh(); }
        continue; // Stun suppresses movement AI, attacks and both contact checks.
      }
      if(time && bossBehaviors.updateNpc(npc,player,time,{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height},playerMotion,attacker=>{
        const target={x:player.x+(attacker.chaseOffsetX||0),y:player.y+(attacker.chaseOffsetY||0)};
        const dx=target.x-attacker.x,dy=target.y-attacker.y;
        const direction=dx||dy?names[(Math.round(Math.atan2(dx,-dy)/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8]:undefined;
        // Move through the normal chase path without advancing/resetting the attack animation.
        const pose=attacker.attack;attacker.attack=null;
        updateCharacter(attacker,time,direction,target);
        attacker.attack=pose;
        if(pose)attacker.facing=pose.facing; // Keep the barrel and warning on the chosen side.
      })) {
        if(npc.bossAction?.name!=='leap'&&!(npc.type==='arisu'&&npc.bossAction?.name==='charge')) {
          const attack=npc.attack;
          updateNpcContact(npc,player,playerMotion,time,moveKnockback,getSurvivalSeconds());
          if(npc.type==='iroha')npc.attack=attack; // Contact must not erase an active tank action pose.
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (time && updateNpcContact(npc, player, playerMotion, time, moveKnockback, getSurvivalSeconds())) continue;
      let direction;
      let chaseTarget;
      if (time && npc.ai) {
        if (npc.behavior === 'horde') {
          if(npc.chargeWait>0){npc.chargeWait=Math.max(0,npc.chargeWait-time);continue;}
          const motion=hordeMotion(npc);direction=motion.direction;chaseTarget=motion.target;
          if(npc.eventPattern==='wave') {
            // Oscillate the crossing direction; speed still uses the enemy's configured SPD.
            const angle=(npc.chargeAngle||0)+Math.sin(npc.eventMotionAge*4)*.65;
            chaseTarget={x:npc.x+Math.cos(angle)*10000,y:npc.y+Math.sin(angle)*10000};
          }
        } else if (npc.behavior === 'erratic') {
          const motion = yuukaMotion(npc, player, time);
          direction = motion.direction;
          chaseTarget = motion.target;
        } else if (npc.behavior === 'chase') {
          const target = npc.type === 'midori' ? midoriChaseTarget(npc, player)
            : { x: player.x + (npc.chaseOffsetX || 0), y: player.y + (npc.chaseOffsetY || 0) - (npc.type==='arisu'?arisuBodyCenterOffsetY(npc):npc.type==='neru'?neruBodyCenterOffsetY(npc):0) };
          const targetX = target.x, targetY = target.y;
          const dx = targetX - npc.x, dy = targetY - npc.y;
          // Chase the center exactly; quantize only the animation facing.
          // Physical movement uses the full target vector, including small gaps.
          if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
            const angle = Math.atan2(dx, -dy);
            direction = names[(Math.round(angle / (Math.PI / 4)) + 8) % 8];
            chaseTarget = { x: targetX, y: targetY };
          }
        } else if (npc.behavior === 'wander') {
          npc.wanderTimer -= time;
          if (npc.wanderTimer <= 0) {
            npc.wanderTimer = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.5;
            npc.wanderDirection = names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)];
          }
          direction = npc.wanderDirection;
        }
      }
      if (time) {
        if (npc.transition) npc.transition.elapsed += time * 1000;
        updateCharacter(npc, time, direction, chaseTarget);
        // A chasing NPC can reach contact during this step, even with a stationary player.
        updateNpcContact(npc, player, playerMotion, 0, moveKnockback, getSurvivalSeconds());
        if (updateYuukaPresence(npc, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, time)) {
          removeEnemy(npc.id); // Escaping grants no kills, EXP or credits.
          refresh();
        }
      }
    }
    const selected = getEnemy(selectedId);
    document.querySelector('#npc-inspector').textContent = selected
      ? `${selected.id} | X ${selected.x.toFixed(1)} Y ${selected.y.toFixed(1)} | HP ${selected.hp}/${selected.maxHp}${selected.hitsToDefeat ? ` | Hits ${selected.receivedHits || 0}/${selected.hitsToDefeat}` : ''} | AI ${selected.ai ? selected.behavior : 'off'}`
      : 'No NPC selected.';
  }

  /** Cull rendering only; sprite outlines use the shared Sprite Bounds toggle. */
  function draw(layer = 'normal') {
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if(layer==='boss')bossBehaviors.draw(context,camera);
    if (layer === 'normal') {
      for (let i=formationWarnings.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
        const warning=formationWarnings[i];
        if((warning.eventClock?campaignEvents.activeSeconds:getSurvivalSeconds())>=warning.expiresAt) {formationWarnings.splice(i,1);continue;}
        context.save();
        context.translate(Math.max(28,Math.min(canvas.width-28,warning.x-camera.x)),
          Math.max(28,Math.min(canvas.height-28,warning.y-camera.y)));
        context.rotate(warning.angle);
        context.fillStyle='#ff5264';context.strokeStyle='#fff';context.lineWidth=2;
        if(['airdrop','ambush'].includes(warning.pattern)) {
          context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,22,0,Math.PI*2);context.strokeStyle='#ff5264';context.stroke();
        }
        if(['fastball','ambush'].includes(warning.pattern)) {
          context.beginPath();context.moveTo(0,0);context.lineTo(Math.hypot(canvas.width,canvas.height),0);
          context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,82,100,.55)';context.stroke();
        }
        context.beginPath();context.moveTo(18,0);context.lineTo(-14,-16);context.lineTo(-14,16);context.closePath();context.fill();context.stroke();
        context.restore();
      }
    }
    if (layer === 'normal') drawGachaDeaths(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, true);
    const remnants = getEnemyDeaths().filter(npc =>
      npc.x >= camera.x - 300 && npc.x <= camera.x + canvas.width + 300 &&
      npc.y >= camera.y - 300 && npc.y <= camera.y + canvas.height + 300);
    for (const npc of [...visible(300), ...remnants].filter(enemy => enemyRenderLayer(enemy) === layer).sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y)) {
      if(['airdrop','ambush'].includes(npc.eventPattern)&&npc.eventMotionAge<.35) {
        // Visual descent only; the event still enters outside the viewport.
        drawCharacter({...npc,y:npc.y-100*(1-npc.eventMotionAge/.35)});
      } else drawCharacter(npc);
      drawFrozenStatus(context,camera,npc);
      drawStunnedStatus(context,camera,npc);
      drawTargetTuningMark(context,camera,npc,getPlayer());
    }
    if (layer === 'normal') drawGachaDeaths(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, false);
  }

  refresh();
  /** Clean up before spawning, or immediately after entering another map. */
  function cleanup() {
    let removed = trimEnemyPopulation(getPlayer());
    removed += despawnDistantEnemies(camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, isPlacementClear);
    if (removed) refresh();
    return removed;
  }

  return { eraseProjectiles:bossBehaviors.eraseProjectiles, get screenShake(){return bossBehaviors.screenShake;}, seekInternalClock(seconds){campaignEvents.seek(seconds);formationWarnings.length=0;}, update, draw: () => draw('normal'), drawSpecials: () => draw('special'), drawBosses: () => draw('boss'), refresh, cleanup, getEnemies: records,
    slotsRemaining: () => Math.max(0, cap - records().length),
    spawnCampaignEncounter: row => {
      const type=row.enemies[0],size=characters[type]?.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
      const margin=size/2+32,player=getPlayer();
      const spots=[[camera.x-margin,player.y],[camera.x+canvas.width+margin,player.y],
        [player.x,camera.y-margin],[player.x,camera.y+canvas.height+margin]];
      return spots.some(([x,y])=>spawn(x,y,{type,variant:'normal',ai:true,behavior:'chase',automatic:true,
        campaignEntry:{row,mega:false,scheduled:true}}));
    },
    spawnBoss: (type, x, y) => spawn(x, y, { type, variant: 'normal', ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true }),
    spawnEnemy: (x, y, forcedType, eventKey) => {
      if(campaignActive() && !forcedType) {
        const entry=getCampaignSpawn();
        return entry ? spawn(x,y,{type:entry.type,variant:'normal',ai:true,behavior:'chase',automatic:true,campaignEntry:entry}) : false;
      }
      if (forcedType === 'midori') return spawn(x, y, { type: 'midori', eventKey, ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true });
      // Harmless enemies now use scheduled rolls, never ordinary kill/arrival rolls.
      const type = chooseStandardEnemy(Math.random, getStageSeconds(), getStageId());
      return type ? spawn(x, y, { type, eventKey, variant: 'random', ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true }) : false;
    } };
}

/** Stable coordinate-based random values independent of exploration order. */
function officeRandom(column, salt, seed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(column | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(salt, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
  return ((hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

/** Build deterministic left/right pity streams, caching only monument indices. */
export function createOfficeTileSelector(seed = worldSeed) {
  if (seed === 0) return column => Math.abs(column) % officeTileFiles.length;
  const streams = { left: [0], right: [0] }; // Zero is a virtual anchor, not a monument.
  return function tileAt(column) {
    if (column === 0) return 0; // Keep the starting office clear.
    const sign = column < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    const distance = Math.abs(column);
    const monuments = sign < 0 ? streams.left : streams.right;
    while (monuments[monuments.length - 1] < distance) {
      const previous = monuments[monuments.length - 1];
      let step = 1;
      for (; step < officeMonument.pityDistance; step++) {
        if (officeRandom(sign * (previous + step), 1, seed) < officeMonument.chance) break;
      }
      monuments.push(previous + step);
    }
    let low = 1, high = monuments.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
      if (monuments[mid] === distance) return officeMonument.index;
      if (monuments[mid] < distance) low = mid + 1;
      else high = mid - 1;
    }
    let weight = officeRandom(column, 2, seed) * officeTileWeights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
    for (let index = 0; index < officeTileWeights.length; index++) {
      weight -= officeTileWeights[index];
      if (weight < 0) return index;
    }
    return 0;
  };
}

export const officeTileIndex = createOfficeTileSelector();

/** Match Stage 1's enlarged height while overlapping horizontal seams by 2px. */
export function officeMetrics(viewportHeight) {
  const scale = viewportHeight * mapSizeMultiplier / 1086;
  const width = 1448 * scale;
  return { scale, width, height: 1086 * scale, stride: width - overlap };
}

/** Query only obstacle boxes near a world region; tiles own no enemy records. */
export function officeObstaclesIn(map, viewportHeight, left, top, right, bottom) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(viewportHeight);
  const boxes = [];
  const first = Math.floor((left - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((right - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of officeObstacleBoxes[officeTileIndex(column)]) {
      const box = { left: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x1 * metrics.scale,
        right: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x2 * metrics.scale,
        top: map.originY + y1 * metrics.scale, bottom: map.originY + y2 * metrics.scale };
      if (box.bottom >= top && box.top <= bottom) boxes.push(box);
    }
  }
  return boxes;
}

/** Validate spawns against the office obstacle artwork. */
export function canStandInOffice(character, x, y, map, height) {
  return canStand(character, x, y, (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
}

/** Reuse Stage 3 substepped collision and wall sliding for the office. */
export function resolveOfficeMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, height) {
  return resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY,
    (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
}

/** Render only visible columns; horizontal position alone determines their layout. */
export function drawOfficeWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(height);
  const first = Math.floor((camera.x - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((camera.x + width - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    const x = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride - camera.x);
    const right = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride + metrics.width - camera.x);
    const y = Math.round(map.originY - camera.y);
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[officeTileIndex(column)].image, x, y, right - x, Math.round(metrics.height));
  }
}

/** Draw letters and halo over actors behind the monument, without blocking movement. */
export function drawOfficeMonumentOcclusion(context, character, map, camera, height, opacity = 1) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(height), size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const footY = character.y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
  if (footY >= map.originY + officeObstacleBoxes[8][0][3] * metrics.scale) return;
  const first = Math.floor((character.x - size - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((character.x + size - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    if (officeTileIndex(column) !== officeMonument.index) continue;
    context.save();
    context.globalAlpha *= opacity;
    context.beginPath();
    context.rect(character.x - camera.x - size / 2, character.y - camera.y - size / 2, size, size);
    context.clip();
    context.translate(map.originX + column * metrics.stride - camera.x, map.originY - camera.y);
    context.scale(metrics.scale, metrics.scale);
    const polygon = points => {
      points.forEach(([x,y], i) => { if (i === 0) context.moveTo(x,y); else context.lineTo(x,y); });
      context.closePath();
    };
    const drawRegion = buildPath => {
      context.save();
      context.beginPath();
      buildPath();
      context.clip('evenodd');
      context.drawImage(map.tiles[officeMonument.index].image, 0, 0);
      context.restore();
    };
    drawRegion(() => {
      polygon(officeMonumentSilhouette.letters);
      officeMonumentSilhouette.holes.forEach(polygon);
    });
    drawRegion(() => {
      for (const [rx, ry] of [[231,62],[214,44]]) {
        context.moveTo(712 + rx * Math.cos(0.3), 378 + rx * Math.sin(0.3));
        context.ellipse(712,378,rx,ry,0.3,0,Math.PI*2);
        context.closePath();
      }
    });
    drawRegion(() => polygon(officeMonumentSilhouette.star));
    context.restore();
  }
}

import { overclockingStats, itemHpDrainNegated, syncLifeJacketShield } from './item-catalog.js';
/** HP loss, never a hit: bypasses shields except the explicitly enabled Luminous/Life Jacket pair. */
export function updateOverclocking(player,delta){
 const stats=overclockingStats(player);
 if(!stats.drainPercent||itemHpDrainNegated(player)){player.overclockDrainElapsed=0;return;}
 if(!(delta>0)||!Number.isFinite(delta))return;
 player.overclockDrainElapsed=(player.overclockDrainElapsed||0)+delta;
 while(player.overclockDrainElapsed>=1-1e-8){
  player.overclockDrainElapsed-=1;
  let loss=player.maxHp*stats.drainPercent/100;
  if(player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='luminous-nova')&&player.equipmentSlots?.some(i=>i?.id==='life-jacket')){
   syncLifeJacketShield(player);const state=player.lifeJacketState;
   const absorbed=Math.min(state?.remaining||0,loss);if(state){state.remaining-=absorbed;if(state.remaining<state.capacity)state.healElapsed=0;}loss-=absorbed;
   const shield=Math.min(Math.max(0,player.shield||0),loss);player.shield=(player.shield||0)-shield;loss-=shield;
  }
  if(player.hp>1)player.hp=Math.max(1,player.hp-loss);
 }
}

  [palaceRareStart]: { baseBottom: 1015, polygon: [[560,470],[615,515],[680,485],[720,545],[795,580],[740,630],[810,690],[785,800],[710,875],[675,925],[675,1015],[490,1015],[490,925],[430,860],[400,760],[420,655],[470,585],[435,535],[510,550]] },
  [palaceRareStart + 1]: { baseBottom: 910, polygon: [[440,495],[475,535],[500,505],[535,560],[575,590],[535,640],[520,730],[505,835],[510,910],[390,910],[390,835],[360,760],[385,660],[400,575]] },
  [palaceRareStart + 2]: { baseBottom: 975, polygon: [[400,565],[440,595],[460,570],[500,620],[550,605],[590,660],[650,675],[620,730],[680,790],[635,845],[615,900],[615,975],[325,975],[325,900],[270,850],[250,765],[290,685],[340,635],[370,655]] },
  [palaceRareStart + 3]: { baseBottom: 900, polygon: [[380,425],[420,465],[425,520],[465,570],[470,670],[495,745],[470,825],[495,900],[295,900],[295,825],[255,775],[235,690],[255,610],[300,565],[330,480]] }
};

/** Coordinate hash shared in spirit and seed with the other procedural stages. */
function palaceRandom(row, salt, seed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(row | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(salt, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
  return ((hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

/** Choose within a weighted pool without altering the pool's overall chance. */
function weightedIndex(value, weights) {
  let remaining = value * weights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
    remaining -= weights[i];
    if (remaining < 0) return i;
  }
  return weights.length - 1;
}

/** Resolve the exact 5% rare pool followed by its conditional 10/5/5/10/35/35 split. */
export function palaceTileFromRolls(poolRoll, variantRoll) {
  return poolRoll < palaceRareChance ? palaceRareStart + weightedIndex(variantRoll, palaceRareWeights)
    : weightedIndex(variantRoll, palaceCommonWeights);
}

/** Preserve the original natural 5% rare-pool rolls before guarantee overrides. */
export function palaceBaseTileIndex(row, seed = worldSeed) {
  return palaceTileFromRolls(palaceRandom(row, 11, seed), palaceRandom(row, 12, seed));
}

/** Share one pity stream between the duo and decagrammaton statues in each direction. */
export function createPalaceTileSelector(seed = worldSeed) {
  if (seed === 0) return row => Math.abs(row) % palaceTileFiles.length;
  const streams = { up: [{ distance: 0 }], down: [{ distance: 0 }] };
  const eligible = index => palaceStatueGuarantee.indices.includes(index);
  return function tileAt(row) {
    if (row === 0) return palaceBaseTileIndex(0, seed);
    const sign = row < 0 ? -1 : 1, distance = Math.abs(row);
    const statues = sign < 0 ? streams.up : streams.down;
    while (statues[statues.length - 1].distance < distance) {
      const previous = statues[statues.length - 1].distance;
      let next;
      for (let step = 1; step <= palaceStatueGuarantee.pityDistance; step++) {
        const column = sign * (previous + step);
        const index = palaceBaseTileIndex(column, seed);
        if (eligible(index) || step === palaceStatueGuarantee.pityDistance) {
          // Both variants have equal natural weights (5% of the rare pool each).
          next = { distance: previous + step, index: eligible(index) ? index
            : palaceStatueGuarantee.indices[Math.floor(palaceRandom(column, 13, seed) * palaceStatueGuarantee.indices.length)] };
          break;
        }
      }
      statues.push(next);
    }
    let low = 1, high = statues.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
      if (statues[mid].distance === distance) return statues[mid].index;
      if (statues[mid].distance < distance) low = mid + 1;
      else high = mid - 1;
    }
    return palaceBaseTileIndex(row, seed);
  };
}

const palaceSelectors = new Map();
/** Stable seeded choice with shared statue guarantees and no dependence on visit order. */
export function palaceTileIndex(row, seed = worldSeed) {
  if (!palaceSelectors.has(seed)) palaceSelectors.set(seed, createPalaceTileSelector(seed));
  return palaceSelectors.get(seed)(row);
}

/** Keep the enlarged width and a 2px seam overlap while scrolling vertically. */
export function palaceMetrics(viewportWidth) {
  const scale = viewportWidth * mapSizeMultiplier / 941;
  const height = 1672 * scale;
  return { scale, width: 941 * scale, height, stride: height - 2 };
}

/** Return obstacle rectangles only for nearby vertical tiles. */
export function palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, left, top, right, bottom) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width), boxes = [];
  const first = Math.floor((top - map.originY - 2) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((bottom - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of palaceObstacleBoxes[palaceTileIndex(row)]) {
      const box = { left: map.originX + x1 * metrics.scale, right: map.originX + x2 * metrics.scale,
        top: map.originY + row * metrics.stride + y1 * metrics.scale,
        bottom: map.originY + row * metrics.stride + y2 * metrics.scale };
      if (box.right >= left && box.left <= right) boxes.push(box);
    }
  }
  return boxes;
}

/** Reject NPC spawns inside the same obstacle boxes used by movement. */
export function canStandInPalace(character, x, y, map, width) {
  return canStand(character, x, y, (...region) => palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, ...region));
}

/** Reuse substepped collision and axis sliding from Stage 3. */
export function resolvePalaceMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, width) {
  return resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY,
    (...region) => palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, ...region));
}

/** Render only rows that intersect the camera, without allocating tile objects. */
export function drawPalaceWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width);
  const first = Math.floor((camera.y - map.originY - 2) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((camera.y + height - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    const x = Math.round(map.originX - camera.x);
    const y = Math.round(map.originY + row * metrics.stride - camera.y);
    const bottom = Math.round(map.originY + row * metrics.stride + metrics.height - camera.y);
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[palaceTileIndex(row)].image, x, y, Math.round(metrics.width), bottom - y);
  }
}

/** Redraw only a statue silhouette over an actor standing behind its pedestal. */
export function drawPalaceOcclusion(context, character, map, camera, width, opacity = 1) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width), size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const footY = character.y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
  const first = Math.floor((character.y - size - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((character.y + size - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    const index = palaceTileIndex(row), statue = palaceStatues[index];
    const originY = map.originY + row * metrics.stride;
    if (!statue || footY >= originY + statue.baseBottom * metrics.scale) continue;
    context.save();
    context.globalAlpha *= opacity;
    context.beginPath();
    context.rect(character.x - camera.x - size / 2, character.y - camera.y - size / 2, size, size);
    context.clip();
    context.beginPath();
    statue.polygon.forEach(([x,y], i) => {
      const px = map.originX + x * metrics.scale - camera.x;
      const py = originY + y * metrics.scale - camera.y;
      if (i === 0) context.moveTo(px, py); else context.lineTo(px, py);
    });
    context.closePath();
    context.clip();
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[index].image, map.originX - camera.x, originY - camera.y, metrics.width, metrics.height);
    context.restore();
  }
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/pickup-reentry.js | sha256=0bb4187ebdacb2de18a41849ff8380c74de723b7ff9517d38fceac3a18cc139d | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Per-pickup protection after leaving a menu. Timers advance only on game time. */
export function createPickupReentryGuard(delay=1.5) {
  const blocks=new Map();
  return {
    block(key){blocks.set(key,{waitingToLeave:true,remaining:delay});},
    blocked(key,touching,delta=0){
      const state=blocks.get(key);if(!state)return false;
      if(touching){state.waitingToLeave=true;state.remaining=delay;return true;}
      // The first fully separated frame starts the delay; time spent overlapping never counts.
      if(state.waitingToLeave){state.waitingToLeave=false;return true;}
      state.remaining=Math.max(0,state.remaining-Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(delta)?delta:0));
      if(state.remaining>1e-8)return true;
      blocks.delete(key);return false;
    },
    forget(key){blocks.delete(key);},
    clear(){blocks.clear();}
  };
}
