import { drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { planaSkillSettings } from './game-config.js';

const distance = (a,b) => Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);

/** Reduce pen jitter while preserving corners and line crossings. */
function simplify(points, tolerance) {
  if (points.length <= 2) return points;
  const a=points[0], b=points.at(-1), dx=b.x-a.x, dy=b.y-a.y, length=dx*dx+dy*dy;
  let maximum=0,index=0;
  for(let i=1;i<points.length-1;i++) {
    const t=length?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((points[i].x-a.x)*dx+(points[i].y-a.y)*dy)/length)):0;
    const d=Math.hypot(points[i].x-a.x-t*dx,points[i].y-a.y-t*dy);
    if(d>maximum){maximum=d;index=i;}
  }
  return maximum>tolerance
    ? [...simplify(points.slice(0,index+1),tolerance).slice(0,-1),...simplify(points.slice(index),tolerance)] : [a,b];
}

/** Clip into continuous sub-strokes; never join separate shape pieces across excluded ink. */
function splitStrokes(strokes, include) {
  const result=[];
  for(const stroke of strokes){let part=[];for(const p of stroke){
    if(include(p))part.push(p);else{if(part.length>1)result.push(part);part=[];}
  }if(part.length>1)result.push(part);}
  return result;
}

/** Find a proper interior crossing, distinguishing an X from a V or parallel lines. */
function crossing(a,b) {
  const ax=a.b.x-a.a.x,ay=a.b.y-a.a.y,bx=b.b.x-b.a.x,by=b.b.y-b.a.y;
  const determinant=ax*by-ay*bx;
  if(Math.abs(determinant)<1e-6)return null;
  const dx=b.a.x-a.a.x,dy=b.a.y-a.a.y;
  const t=(dx*by-dy*bx)/determinant,u=(dx*ay-dy*ax)/determinant;
  return t>.15&&t<.85&&u>.15&&u<.85?{x:a.a.x+t*ax,y:a.a.y+t*ay}:null;
}

/** Split and validate the ring, lower X and upper arrow, independent of stroke order. */
export function segmentPlanaPattern(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds=drawingBounds(strokes),s=planaSkillSettings;
  const fail=reason=>({valid:false,reason,parts:[]});
  if(!bounds)return fail('Draw a circle with an arrow above an X inside it.');
  const width=bounds.right-bounds.left,height=bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const diameter=Math.max(width,height),cx=(bounds.left+bounds.right)/2,cy=(bounds.top+bounds.bottom)/2;
  const radial=p=>Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(width/2),(p.y-cy)/(height/2));
  // Prefer actual curved ring strokes, so symbols drawn close to the circumference
  // retain their tips instead of being incorrectly absorbed into the circle crop.
  const circular = new Set(strokes.filter(stroke => {
    if (stroke.length < 6) return false;
    let length=0,error=0;
    for(let i=0;i<stroke.length;i++){error+=Math.abs(radial(stroke[i])-1);if(i)length+=distance(stroke[i],stroke[i-1]);}
    return length>diameter*.5 && length/Math.max(1,distance(stroke[0],stroke.at(-1)))>1.12 &&
      error/stroke.length<s.circleRadialTolerance;
  }));
  const circle=splitStrokes(circular.size?[...circular]:strokes,p=>radial(p)>=s.ringInnerRadius);
  const ring=circle.flat(),bins=new Set();let radialError=0,ringLength=0;
  for(const p of ring){bins.add((Math.floor((Math.atan2(p.y-cy,p.x-cx)+Math.PI)*8/(Math.PI*2))+8)%8);radialError+=Math.abs(radial(p)-1);}
  for(const part of circle)for(let i=1;i<part.length;i++)ringLength+=distance(part[i],part[i-1]);
  if(bins.size<7||!ring.length||radialError/ring.length>s.circleRadialTolerance||ringLength<diameter*1.9)return fail('Complete the outer circle around both symbols.');
  const inner=circular.size
    ? [...splitStrokes(strokes.filter(stroke=>!circular.has(stroke)),p=>radial(p)<1.05),
       ...splitStrokes([...circular],p=>radial(p)<s.ringInnerRadius)]
    : splitStrokes(strokes,p=>radial(p)<s.ringInnerRadius);
  const lines=[];
  for(const part of inner){const points=simplify(part,diameter*s.lineSimplifyRatio);
    for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++)if(distance(points[i-1],points[i])>diameter*.07)lines.push({a:points[i-1],b:points[i]});}
  const diagonal=line=>Math.abs(line.b.x-line.a.x)>diameter*.08&&Math.abs(line.b.y-line.a.y)>diameter*.08;
  const crosses=[];
  for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<lines.length;j++){
    const a=lines[i],b=lines[j],point=crossing(a,b);
    if(point&&point.y>cy-height*.08&&diagonal(a)&&diagonal(b)&&
      (a.b.x-a.a.x)*(a.b.y-a.a.y)*(b.b.x-b.a.x)*(b.b.y-b.a.y)<0)crosses.push({point,lines:[a,b]});
  }
  const tolerance=diameter*s.joinToleranceRatio;
  for(const cross of crosses)for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<lines.length;j++){
    const a=lines[i],b=lines[j];
    for(const tipA of [a.a,a.b])for(const tipB of [b.a,b.b]){
      if(distance(tipA,tipB)>tolerance)continue;
      const tip={x:(tipA.x+tipB.x)/2,y:(tipA.y+tipB.y)/2};
      const armA=tipA===a.a?a.b:a.a,armB=tipB===b.a?b.b:b.a;
      if(tip.y>=cross.point.y-height*.1)continue;
      const shaft=lines.find(line=>{
        if(line===a||line===b)return false;
        const near=distance(line.a,tip)<distance(line.b,tip)?line.a:line.b;
        const end=near===line.a?line.b:line.a;
        const dx=end.x-tip.x,dy=end.y-tip.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(distance(near,tip)>tolerance||length<diameter*.14)return false;
        const ux=dx/length,uy=dy/length;
        const av={x:armA.x-tip.x,y:armA.y-tip.y},bv={x:armB.x-tip.x,y:armB.y-tip.y};
        const sideA=ux*av.y-uy*av.x,sideB=ux*bv.y-uy*bv.x;
        return av.x*ux+av.y*uy>diameter*.035&&bv.x*ux+bv.y*uy>diameter*.035&&
          sideA*sideB<0&&Math.min(Math.abs(sideA),Math.abs(sideB))>diameter*.035;
      });
      if(!shaft)continue;
      const arrow=[a,b,shaft];
      if(Math.max(...arrow.flatMap(line=>[line.a.y,line.b.y]))>=cross.point.y)continue;
      return {valid:true,score:Math.max(.7,1-radialError/ring.length),parts:[
        {name:'circle',strokes:circle},{name:'x',strokes:cross.lines.map(line=>[line.a,line.b])},
        {name:'arrow',strokes:arrow.map(line=>[line.a,line.b])}]};
    }
  }
  return fail(crosses.length?'Draw an arrow above the X, inside the circle.':'Draw two crossing diagonal lines for the X below the arrow.');
}

import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import {tryWeakTuningHit} from './weak-tuning.js';
import {playTrumpetTuning} from './trumpet-tuning.js';

// SOURCE IMAGE crops: each opening pose is independent; unequal widths avoid adjacent-frame bleed.
export const umbrellaOpeningFrames = [
  [99,228,70,304],[308,228,109,304],[504,228,178,304],[727,228,222,304],
  [978,228,258,304],[1258,228,272,304],[1547,228,293,304],[1846,228,317,304]

/** Sweep a broad projectile capsule against an enemy's scaled body ellipse. */
export function umbrellaSkillHits(enemy, from, to, radius = planaSkillSettings.hitRadius) {
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + radius, ry: body.ry + radius }, from.x, from.y, to.x, to.y);
}

/** Open Plana's umbrella, then launch it forward with a path-clearing knockback/stun. */
export function createPlanaUmbrellaSkill() {
  const image = new Image(); image.src = new URL('../sprites/attacks/plana umbrella.png', import.meta.url).href;
  const ready = image.decode();
  let projectiles = [];
  return {
    ready,
    cast(player, angle, damageMultiplier = skillCastSettings.damageAverage, getLaunchAngle) {
      const tunedAngle=player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'plana-umbrella',angle):angle;
      const tunedLaunchAngle=getLaunchAngle?()=>{const aim=getLaunchAngle();return player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'plana-umbrella',aim):aim;}:undefined;
      const sizeScale=weaponSizeMultiplier(player)*(player.tuningParts?startingWeaponSizeScale(player,'plana-umbrella'):1);
      projectiles.push({ sizeScale, owner: player, angle:tunedAngle, getLaunchAngle:tunedLaunchAngle, x: player.x, y: player.y, elapsed: 0, tailElapsed: 0,
        damageMultiplier: Number.isFinite(damageMultiplier)
          ? Math.max(skillCastSettings.damageMinimum, Math.min(skillCastSettings.damageMaximum, damageMultiplier))
          : skillCastSettings.damageAverage,
        distance: 0, hits: new Set(), trail: [], baseDamage: umbrellaBaseDamage() });
    },
    reset() { projectiles = []; },
    update(delta,eraseProjectiles) {
      const s = planaSkillSettings;
      for (const projectile of projectiles) {
        const tunedKnockbackDistance=s.knockbackDistance*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(projectile.owner)*(projectile.owner.tuningParts?knockbackTuningMultiplier(projectile.owner):1);
        const previousTime = projectile.elapsed;
        const launchTime = s.openingSeconds + s.prelaunchSeconds;
        for (const point of projectile.trail) point.age += delta;
        projectile.trail = projectile.trail.filter(point => point.age < s.trailSeconds);
        if (projectile.distance >= s.maxDistance) {
          projectile.tailElapsed += delta;
          continue;
        }
        projectile.elapsed += delta;
        // Follow the arrow only during fade-in; the open-pose hold and flight use the locked angle.
        if (previousTime < s.openingSeconds && projectile.getLaunchAngle) {
          const aim = projectile.getLaunchAngle();
          if (Number.isFinite(aim)) projectile.angle = aim;
        }
        const ux = Math.cos(projectile.angle), uy = Math.sin(projectile.angle);
        if (previousTime < launchTime) {
          projectile.x = projectile.owner.x + ux * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius * projectile.sizeScale;
          projectile.y = projectile.owner.y + uy * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius * projectile.sizeScale;
        }
        const flightTime = Math.max(0, projectile.elapsed - Math.max(previousTime, launchTime));
        if (!flightTime) continue;
        if(previousTime<=launchTime&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)playTrumpetTuning(projectile.owner);
        const from = { x: projectile.x, y: projectile.y };
        const step = Math.min(s.maxDistance - projectile.distance, s.projectileSpeed * flightTime);
        projectile.x += ux * step; projectile.y += uy * step; projectile.distance += step;
        const to = { x: projectile.x, y: projectile.y };
        // Spatial sampling fills gaps even when a fast projectile travels far in one frame.
        const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(step / s.trailSpacing));
        for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
          const t = i / samples;
          projectile.trail.push({ x: from.x + (to.x - from.x) * t,
            y: from.y + (to.y - from.y) * t, age: (1 - t) * step / s.projectileSpeed });
        }
        projectile.trail = projectile.trail.slice(-s.maxTrailImages);
        if(projectile.owner.tuningParts&&eraseProjectiles)eraseProjectiles({player:projectile.owner,attack:projectile,
          intersects:b=>umbrellaSkillHits({x:b.x,y:b.y,spriteHurtbox:{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:b.radius*2,height:b.radius*2}},from,to,s.hitRadius*projectile.sizeScale)});
        for (const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
          if (projectile.hits.has(enemy.id) || !umbrellaSkillHits(enemy, from, to,s.hitRadius*projectile.sizeScale)) continue;
          projectile.hits.add(enemy.id);
          const hit = rollUmbrellaDamage(projectile.owner, projectile.baseDamage, Math.random, projectile.damageMultiplier, enemy,{skillAttack:true});
          const hpBefore=enemy.hp;
          const landed = damageEnemy(enemy.id, hit.damage, projectile.owner, hit.type, { canMiss: true,weaponId:'plana-umbrella' });
          if (landed === false) continue; // A dodged attack cannot apply stun or knockback.
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryWeakTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryNeutralizationHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)onTargetTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,projectile,enemy,damage:Math.min(hpBefore,hit.damage),hitType:hit.type});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryRepairTuningHit({player:projectile.owner});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryLuxeryTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy,damage:hit.damage});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)trySlowdownTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollUmbrellaDamage(projectile.owner,projectile.baseDamage,Math.random,projectile.damageMultiplier*multiplier,target,{skillAttack:true})});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryColdTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollUmbrellaDamage(projectile.owner,projectile.baseDamage,Math.random,projectile.damageMultiplier*multiplier,target,{skillAttack:true})});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryTuningExplosion({player:projectile.owner,projectile,enemy,
            rollDamage:(target,multiplier,options)=>rollUmbrellaDamage(projectile.owner,projectile.baseDamage,Math.random,projectile.damageMultiplier*multiplier,target,{...options,skillAttack:true}),
            onHit:target=>{
              const side=(target.x-from.x)*-uy+(target.y-from.y)*ux,sign=Math.sign(side)||1;
              applySkillControl(target,-uy*sign*tunedKnockbackDistance+ux*tunedKnockbackDistance*.25,
                ux*sign*tunedKnockbackDistance+uy*tunedKnockbackDistance*.25,0,s.knockbackSeconds,{ignoreKnockbackResistance:s.ignoreKnockbackResistance});
            }});
          const living = getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if (living) {
            // Push sideways away from the flight lane, with a smaller forward component.
            const side = (enemy.x - from.x) * -uy + (enemy.y - from.y) * ux;
            const sign = Math.abs(side) > .01 ? Math.sign(side) : projectile.hits.size % 2 ? 1 : -1;
            applySkillControl(living, -uy * sign * tunedKnockbackDistance + ux * tunedKnockbackDistance * .25,
              ux * sign * tunedKnockbackDistance + uy * tunedKnockbackDistance * .25, s.stunSeconds, s.knockbackSeconds, { ignoreKnockbackResistance: s.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
          }
        }
      }
      projectiles = projectiles.filter(projectile => projectile.distance < s.maxDistance || projectile.tailElapsed < s.trailSeconds);
    },
    draw(context, camera) {
      if (!image.naturalWidth) return;
      const s = planaSkillSettings;
      /** Draw one opening pose or blurred open-umbrella afterimage in world space. */
      function drawPose(projectile, point, index, opacity, blur = 0, scale = 1) {
        const [x, y, width, height] = umbrellaOpeningFrames[index];
        const length = s.displayLength * scale * projectile.sizeScale;
        context.save();
        context.globalAlpha = opacity;
        context.filter = blur ? `blur(${blur}px)` : 'none';
        context.translate(point.x - camera.x, point.y - camera.y);
        context.rotate(projectile.angle + Math.PI / 2);
        context.drawImage(image, x, y, width, height,
          -length * width / height / 2, -length / 2, length * width / height, length);
        context.restore();
      }
      for (const projectile of projectiles) {
        const launchTime = s.openingSeconds + s.prelaunchSeconds;
        if (projectile.elapsed < launchTime) {
          // Fade up as the sheet opens, then hold the open pose briefly before release.
          const progress = Math.min(1, projectile.elapsed / s.openingSeconds);
          const eased = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
          drawPose(projectile, projectile, Math.min(7, Math.floor(progress * 8)),
            eased, 0, .85 + .15 * eased);
          continue;
        }
        for (const point of projectile.trail) {
          const life = Math.max(0, 1 - point.age / s.trailSeconds);
          drawPose(projectile, point, 7, .085 * life * life, s.trailBlur);
        }
        // A soft continuous streak connects the sampled silhouettes into one swift blur.
        if (projectile.trail.length > 1) {
          context.save();
          context.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - projectile.tailElapsed / s.trailSeconds);
          context.filter = `blur(${s.trailBlur}px)`;
          const first = projectile.trail[0];
          const rainbow=projectile.owner.tuningParts&&rgbTuningActive(projectile.owner);
          const gradient = rainbow?rainbowTrailGradient(context,first.x-camera.x,first.y-camera.y,projectile.x-camera.x,projectile.y-camera.y):context.createLinearGradient(first.x-camera.x, first.y-camera.y,
            projectile.x-camera.x, projectile.y-camera.y);
          if(rainbow)context.globalAlpha*=.4;
          else {gradient.addColorStop(0, '#70dfff00');gradient.addColorStop(1, '#b9f4ff66');}
          context.strokeStyle = gradient;
          context.lineWidth = s.displayLength * .26 * projectile.sizeScale;
          context.lineCap = 'round';
          context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(first.x-camera.x, first.y-camera.y);
          context.lineTo(projectile.x-camera.x, projectile.y-camera.y);
          context.stroke();
          context.restore();
        }
        const headOpacity = Math.max(0, 1 - projectile.tailElapsed / .08);
        drawPose(projectile, projectile, 7, headOpacity);
      }
    }
  };
}

import { chiseDelayConfigured } from './game-config.js';
import { syncRacerPassHealth, syncLifeJacketShield, lifeJacketStats, totalPlayerShield, chiseImmediateFraction } from './item-catalog.js';
import { developmentSettings, damageReductionFormula } from './game-config.js';

export { startingLevelExp, expIncreasePerLevel } from './game-config.js';

// Level costs and formulas live in game-config.js.



/** Add round(15 + currentLevel / 2) to the next requirement on each level-up. */
export function experienceForLevel(level) {
  return levelExpFormula(level);
}

/** Initialize session stats once; Development defaults to invincibility on. */
export function ensurePlayerStats(character) {
  character.level ??= 1;
  character.pendingUpgrades ??= 0;
  character.exp ??= 0;
  character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  character.maxHp ??= 100;
  character.hp ??= character.maxHp;
  syncRacerPassHealth(character);
  syncLifeJacketShield(character);
  character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield ?? 0));
  character.invincible ??= developmentSettings.invincible;
  ensureCombatStats(character);
  return character;
}

/** Add experience, retaining overflow and supporting multiple level-ups per award. */
export function addPlayerExp(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  character.exp += Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(amount));
  while (character.exp >= character.maxExp) {
    character.exp -= character.maxExp;
    character.level++;
    character.pendingUpgrades++; // Each gained level gets its own choice, including overflow.
    character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
    character.hp = character.maxHp; // Every level-up fully restores health.
  }
}

/** Death protection allows zero HP; use this check when handling player defeat. */
export function isPlayerDefeated(character) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  return character.hp <= 0 && !character.invincible;
}

/** Add or remove shield points, capped by max HP without changing health. */
export function changePlayerShield(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount)) {
    character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield + Math.trunc(amount)));
  }
}

// The runtime item effect registers once; plain stat consumers need no world dependencies.
let playerDamageGuard=null;
export function setPlayerDamageGuard(guard){playerDamageGuard=guard;}
/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula([].concat(character.damageReductionPercent??[],lifeJacketStats(character)?.reduction??0)));
  if(damage<=0)return false;
  if(playerDamageGuard?.(character,damage)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};showDamageNumber(character,0,true,'miss');return false;}
  const initialFraction=chiseDelayConfigured()?chiseImmediateFraction(character):1;
  const immediate=Math.round(damage*initialFraction),deferred=damage-immediate;
  if(deferred>0){
    if(!(character.chisePendingDamage>0))character.chiseTickElapsed=0;
    character.chisePendingDamage=(character.chisePendingDamage||0)+deferred;
  }
  const taken=applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,immediate);
  character.lastDamageResult.deferredDamage=deferred;
  return taken||deferred>0;
}

/** Already-resolved damage bypasses attack-only negation, DR and Chise re-deferral. */
export function applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,damage){
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if(!Number.isFinite(damage)||damage<=0){character.lastDamageResult={negated:false,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};return false;}
  const jacket=character.lifeJacketState;
  const jacketAbsorbed=Math.min(jacket?.remaining??0,damage);
  if(jacket){jacket.remaining-=jacketAbsorbed;if(jacket.remaining<jacket.capacity)jacket.healElapsed=0;}
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage-jacketAbsorbed);
  character.shield -= absorbed;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - jacketAbsorbed - absorbed));
  const healthDamage=previous-character.hp;
  const taken = jacketAbsorbed + absorbed + healthDamage;
  character.lastDamageResult={negated:false,healthDamage,shieldDamage:jacketAbsorbed+absorbed};
  if (taken > 0) {
    if(healthDamage>0)character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    const shieldDamage=jacketAbsorbed+absorbed;
    if(shieldDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,shieldDamage,true,'shield');
    if(healthDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,healthDamage,true);
  }
  return taken > 0;
}

/** Heal without exceeding maximum HP; works while invincible. */
export function healPlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {
    character.hp = Math.min(character.maxHp, character.hp + Math.floor(amount));
  }
}

/** Wire admin progression/HP controls to the currently controlled character. */
export function createPlayerStatsTools(getPlayer, onChange) {
  const panel = document.querySelector('#player-stats-tools');
  const expAmount = panel.querySelector('[name="exp-amount"]');
  const hpAmount = panel.querySelector('[name="hp-amount"]');
  const shieldAmount = panel.querySelector('[name="shield-amount"]');
  const invincibility = document.querySelector('#player-invincibility');
  const status = document.querySelector('#player-stats-status');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#player-stats-feedback');
  const statInputs = [...panel.querySelectorAll('[data-combat-stat]')];
  let inspectedCharacter;

  // Apply on change so typing is not interrupted by per-frame HUD refreshes.
  for (const input of statInputs) {
    input.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const value = Number(input.value);
      const maximum = input.dataset.combatStat === 'critPercent' ? 100 : 1000;
      const stats = ensureCombatStats(getPlayer());
      if (Number.isFinite(value)) stats[input.dataset.combatStat] = Math.max(0, Math.min(maximum, value));
      input.value = stats[input.dataset.combatStat];
      onChange(getPlayer());
    });
  }

  /** Keep toggles and inspection values synchronized across character swaps. */
  function update() {
    const character = ensurePlayerStats(getPlayer());
    invincibility.checked = character.invincible;
    for (const input of statInputs) {
      if (inspectedCharacter !== character || document.activeElement !== input) input.value = character.combatStats[input.dataset.combatStat];
    }
    inspectedCharacter = character;
    status.textContent = `${character.label} | LV ${character.level} | EXP ${character.exp}/${character.maxExp} | HP ${character.hp}/${character.maxHp} | Shield ${totalPlayerShield(character)}/${character.maxHp}`;
  }
  invincibility.addEventListener('change', () => {
    getPlayer().invincible = invincibility.checked;
    feedback.textContent = invincibility.checked ? 'Death protection enabled; HP can still reach zero.' : 'Death protection disabled.';
    update();
  });
  panel.querySelectorAll('[data-player-stat]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const character = ensurePlayerStats(getPlayer());
      const action = button.dataset.playerStat;
      const amount = Number(action === 'exp' ? expAmount.value : action.startsWith('shield-') ? shieldAmount.value : hpAmount.value);
      if (['exp', 'damage', 'heal', 'shield-add', 'shield-remove'].includes(action) &&
          (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount < 1 || amount > 1000000)) {
        feedback.textContent = 'Enter an amount from 1 to 1,000,000.';
        return;
      }
      feedback.textContent = '';
      if (action === 'exp') addPlayerExp(character, amount);
      if (action === 'level') addPlayerExp(character, character.maxExp - character.exp);
      if (action === 'damage' && !damagePlayer(character, amount)) {
        feedback.textContent = 'HP is already zero.';
      }
      if (action === 'shield-add') changePlayerShield(character, amount);
      if (action === 'shield-remove') changePlayerShield(character, -amount);
      if (action === 'shield-clear') character.shield = 0;
      if (action === 'heal') healPlayer(character, amount);
      if (action === 'full-heal') healPlayer(character, character.maxHp);
      if (action === 'preview-crit') showDamageNumber(character, 23, false, 'critical');
      if (action === 'preview-supercrit') showDamageNumber(character, 23, false, 'supercritical');
      if (action === 'reset') {
        Object.assign(character, { level: 1, exp: 0, pendingUpgrades: 0, hp: character.maxHp, shield: 0, invincible: developmentSettings.invincible });
        character.combatStats = {}; // Reinitialize character defaults, including base CRT.
        delete character.damageFlashElapsed;
        delete character.chisePendingDamage;delete character.chiseTickElapsed;
        ensurePlayerStats(character);
      }
      update();
      onChange(character);
    });
  });
  update();
  return { update };
}

}

/** Share visibility checks between the displayed headcount and weighted cap usage. */
function visibleEnemies(enemies, camera, width, height) {
  return enemies.filter(enemy => {
    const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || 112) / 2;
    return enemy.x + radius >= camera.x && enemy.x - radius <= camera.x + width &&
      enemy.y + radius >= camera.y && enemy.y - radius <= camera.y + height;
  });
}

/** Elites consume three on-screen slots; ordinary actors consume one. */
export function visibleEnemySlots(enemies, camera, width, height) {
  return visibleEnemies(enemies, camera, width, height).reduce((total, enemy) =>
    total + (enemy.elite ? playtestSpawnSettings.eliteVisibleSlots : 1), 0);
}

/** Increase arrivals from 5 to 8/s as the crowd within 400px becomes sparse. */
export function adaptiveSpawnRate(enemies, player, visible) {
  if (visible >= playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit) return playtestSpawnSettings.crowdedPerSecond;
  const nearby = enemies.filter(enemy =>
    Math.hypot(enemy.x - player.x, enemy.y - player.y) <= playtestSpawnSettings.nearbyRadius).length;
  return spawnRateFormula(nearby, visible);
}

/** Rank legal entrances by enemy count relative to the player; randomize ties. */
export function leastCrowdedSides(stage, enemies, player, random = Math.random) {
  const sides = stage.availableSides || ['left', 'right', 'top', 'bottom'];
  const counts = Object.fromEntries(sides.map(side => [side, 0]));
  for (const enemy of enemies) {
    const dx = enemy.x - player.x, dy = enemy.y - player.y;
    if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) continue;
    // Count by actual direction, including short-axis entrances on strip maps.
    const directions = { left: [-1,0], right: [1,0], top: [0,-1], bottom: [0,1] };
    const side = sides.map(side => ({ side, score: dx * directions[side][0] + dy * directions[side][1] }))
      .sort((a,b) => b.score - a.score)[0]?.side;
    if (!side) continue;
    counts[side]++;
  }
  return sides.map(side => ({ side, count: counts[side], tie: random() }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.count - b.count || a.tie - b.tie).map(entry => entry.side);
}

/** Balance successful arrivals across all usable edges, with crowd density breaking ties. */
export function rankSpawnEntrances(stage, enemies, player, arrivals, random = Math.random) {
  const ranked = leastCrowdedSides(stage, enemies, player, random);
  if (playtestSpawnSettings.distribution === 'leastCrowded') return ranked;
  const densityRank = Object.fromEntries(ranked.map((side,index) => [side,index]));
  return [...ranked].sort((a,b) => (arrivals[a] || 0) - (arrivals[b] || 0) || densityRank[a] - densityRank[b]);
}

/** Reserve at most three arrivals per rolling second ahead; overflow uses cross-axis edges. */
export function createRunningSpawnRouter() {
  let seconds = 0, forwardCredit = 0, currentForward;
  let arrivals = [];
  return {
    advance(delta) {
      seconds += Math.max(0, delta);
      forwardCredit = Math.min(1, forwardCredit + Math.max(0, delta) * playtestSpawnSettings.forwardPerSecond);
      arrivals = arrivals.filter(entry => seconds - entry.seconds < 1 - 1e-8);
    },
    rank(ranked, motion) {
      currentForward = undefined;
      if (!motion || Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) < .001) return ranked;
      // Diagonal runs use their dominant axis; ties use X consistently.
      const horizontal = Math.abs(motion.x) >= Math.abs(motion.y);
      const forward = horizontal ? motion.x > 0 ? 'right' : 'left' : motion.y > 0 ? 'bottom' : 'top';
      currentForward = forward;
      const cross = ranked.filter(side => horizontal ? ['top', 'bottom'].includes(side) : ['left', 'right'].includes(side));
      const aheadCount = arrivals.filter(entry => entry.side === forward).length;
      const canSpawnAhead = aheadCount < playtestSpawnSettings.forwardPerSecond;
      if (cross.length) {
        // Do not fall back into the escape route when its allotted share is exhausted.
        return canSpawnAhead && forwardCredit >= 1 && ranked.includes(forward)
          ? [forward, ...cross] : cross;
      }
      // Strip maps may expose only the running axis: allow rear arrivals, cap the front.
      const rear = ranked.filter(side => side !== forward);
      return canSpawnAhead && forwardCredit >= 1 && ranked.includes(forward)
        ? [forward, ...rear] : rear;
    },
    record(side) {
      arrivals.push({ side, seconds });
      if (side === currentForward) forwardCredit = 0;
    }
  };
}

/** Pressure the escape route opposite the nearest boss, within legal map entrances. */
export function oppositeBossSide(stage, enemies, player, random = Math.random) {
  const boss = enemies.filter(isBossEnemy).sort((a,b) =>
    Math.hypot(a.x-player.x,a.y-player.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-player.x,b.y-player.y))[0];
  if (!boss) return undefined;
  const dx = player.x - boss.x, dy = player.y - boss.y;
  if (!dx && !dy) return undefined;
  const allowed = stage.availableSides || ['left', 'right', 'top', 'bottom'];
  const directions = [['left',-1,0],['right',1,0],['top',0,-1],['bottom',0,1]]
    .filter(([side]) => allowed.includes(side));
  if (!directions.length) return undefined;
  return directions.map(([side,x,y]) => ({ side, score: dx*x+dy*y, tie: random() }))
    .sort((a,b) => b.score-a.score || a.tie-b.tie)[0].side;
}

/** Build entrances only where a whole sprite fits offscreen inside map limits. */
function offscreenEntrances(stage, camera, width, height) {
  const bounds = stage.playableBounds || {};
  const radius = stage.spawnRadius ?? normalSpriteSize / 2;
  const margin = Math.max(radius + 1, stage.spawnMargin ?? playtestSpawnSettings.offscreenMargin);
  const left = (bounds.left ?? -Infinity) + radius;
  const right = (bounds.right ?? Infinity) - radius;
  const top = (bounds.top ?? -Infinity) + radius;
  const bottom = (bounds.bottom ?? Infinity) - radius;
  const xMin = Math.max(camera.x, left), xMax = Math.min(camera.x + width, right);
  const yMin = Math.max(camera.y, top), yMax = Math.min(camera.y + height, bottom);
  const entries = [];
  if (yMin <= yMax) {
    if (left <= camera.x - radius - 1) entries.push({ side: 'left', x: Math.max(left, camera.x - margin), yMin, yMax });
    if (right >= camera.x + width + radius + 1) entries.push({ side: 'right', x: Math.min(right, camera.x + width + margin), yMin, yMax });
  }
  if (xMin <= xMax) {
    if (top <= camera.y - radius - 1) entries.push({ side: 'top', y: Math.max(top, camera.y - margin), xMin, xMax });
    if (bottom >= camera.y + height + radius + 1) entries.push({ side: 'bottom', y: Math.min(bottom, camera.y + height + margin), xMin, xMax });
  }
  return entries;
}

/** Expose currently usable directions to crowd and boss-pressure ranking. */
export function offscreenSpawnSides(stage, camera, width, height) {
  return offscreenEntrances(stage, camera, width, height).map(entry => entry.side);
}

/** Choose a fully offscreen point; NPC placement additionally validates island shoreline. */
export function offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, width, height, random = Math.random, preferredSide) {
  const entries = offscreenEntrances(stage, camera, width, height);
  const entry = preferredSide ? entries.find(candidate => candidate.side === preferredSide)
    : entries[Math.floor(random() * entries.length)];
  if (!entry) return null;
  return { x: entry.x ?? entry.xMin + random() * (entry.xMax - entry.xMin),
    y: entry.y ?? entry.yMin + random() * (entry.yMax - entry.yMin) };
}

/** Stream individual arrivals with density-based direction priority and no catch-up bursts. */
export function createPlaytestSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnEnemy, slotsRemaining, onBatch, getEnemies, getPlayer, getSpawnRate = rate => rate }) {
  const button = document.querySelector('#toggle-random-spawning');
  const status = document.querySelector('#random-spawn-status');
  let running = developmentSettings.randomSpawning; // Development starts idle until explicitly enabled.
  let elapsed = 0;
  let lastStatus = '';
  let entranceSignature = '';
  let arrivals = {}; // Successful spawns, reset whenever the usable entrance set changes.
  let nextArrival = 1; // Accumulated spawn credit; rate changes do not restart the timer.
  const runningRouter = createRunningSpawnRouter();

  /** Slow new arrivals when the visible crowd reaches the testing threshold. */
  function crowdState() {
    const enemies = getEnemies();
    const visible = visibleEnemySlots(enemies, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const count = visibleEnemyCount(enemies, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    // The weighted cap also applies during event spawn-rate boosts.
    const rate = visible >= playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit ? playtestSpawnSettings.crowdedPerSecond
      : getSpawnRate(adaptiveSpawnRate(enemies, getPlayer(), visible));
    return { visible, count, rate };
  }

  /** Keep the sidebar button explicit about the next available action. */
  function updateControls(message = '') {
    button.textContent = running ? 'Stop random spawning' : 'Start random spawning';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(running));
    const crowd = crowdState();
    status.textContent = `${running ? 'Spawning' : 'Stopped'}: ${crowd.rate}/s\nOn-screen slots: ${crowd.visible}/${playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit} (${crowd.count} enemies)\n${message || 'Offscreen chase spawns'}`;
    lastStatus = `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}:${crowd.count}`;
  }
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    running = !running;
    elapsed = 0;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Emit at most one arrival per frame, with small timing variation around the current rate. */
  function update(delta, playerMotion) {
    const crowd = crowdState();
    if (lastStatus !== `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}:${crowd.count}`) updateControls();
    if (!running) return;
    runningRouter.advance(Math.min(.1, Math.max(0, delta)));
    // Discard long stalls instead of catching up with a wave after a suspended tab.
    elapsed += Math.min(0.1, Math.max(0, delta)) * crowd.rate;
    if (elapsed < nextArrival) return;
    elapsed = Math.min(0.5, elapsed - nextArrival);
    nextArrival = 1 + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * playtestSpawnSettings.streamJitter;
    if (slotsRemaining() <= 0) return;
    const stage = getStage();
    const enemies = getEnemies(), player = getPlayer();
    const legalSides = offscreenSpawnSides(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (!legalSides.length) return;
    const signature = `${stage.id || stage.axis}:${[...legalSides].sort().join(',')}`;
    if (signature !== entranceSignature) { entranceSignature = signature; arrivals = {}; }
    const ranked = rankSpawnEntrances({ ...stage, availableSides: legalSides }, enemies, player, arrivals);
    const preferred = playtestSpawnSettings.distribution !== 'leastCrowded' ||
      Math.random() < playtestSpawnSettings.leastCrowdedChance
      ? ranked[0] : legalSides[Math.floor(Math.random() * legalSides.length)];
    const sides = runningRouter.rank([preferred, ...ranked.filter(side => side !== preferred)], playerMotion);
    if (!sides.length) return;
    const attemptsPerSide = Math.ceil(playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts / sides.length);
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
      const side = sides[Math.min(sides.length - 1, Math.floor(attempt / attemptsPerSide))];
      const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, Math.random, side);
      if (point && spawnEnemy(point.x, point.y)) {
        arrivals[side] = (arrivals[side] || 0) + 1;
        runningRouter.record(side);
        onBatch(); // Refresh admin records only when an enemy is actually created.
        updateControls('Staggered arrivals');
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  updateControls();
  return { update, setRunning(enabled) { running = Boolean(enabled); elapsed = 0; updateControls(); }, get running() { return running; } };
}

/** Add prior beam damage once, after the normal per-hit damage roll. No percentage or cap. */
export function princessBeamTickDamage(base,previousBeamDamage) {
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(base+previousBeamDamage));
}

/** Gentle blue residue pulse, followed by an inward collapse at the four-second detonation. */
export function princessResiduePose(age) {
  const progress=Math.min(1,age/settings.residueSeconds);
  if(age>=settings.residueSeconds) {
    const t=Math.min(1,(age-settings.residueSeconds)/.4);
    return {radius:6+(settings.residueRadius-6)*(1-(1-t)**3),opacity:.24*(1-t)**2,exploded:true};
  }
  const collapse=Math.max(0,(age-(settings.residueSeconds-.4))/.4);
  return {radius:Math.max(1,24*(.96+.04*Math.sin(age*4))*(1-collapse*collapse)),
    opacity:.18*(1-progress*.5)*(.94+.06*Math.sin(age*4)),exploded:false};
}

/** Kei's temporary amplifier plus Supernova's aimable beam, with delayed impact residues. */
export function createPrincessKeySkill({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let state=null,residues=[];const buffKey='princess-key-ex';
  const weapon=player=>player.attackSlots?.find(w=>['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(w?.id));
  const beam=createArisAttack({getWeapon:weapon,specialHitCooldown:settings.hitCooldown,
    rollSpecialDamage(player,target,multiplier) {
      const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,weapon(player)?.id||'princess-key',arisWeaponSettings.damageMultiplier,[],
        {projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:settings.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target,damageMod:multiplier,skillAttack:true});

      residues.push({target,cast:state,owner:player,x:body.x,y:body.y,age:0,exploded:false});

      if(state.beamInProgress)state.beamDamageDealt+=Math.max(0,damage);
    }
  });
  function removeBuff(){if(state?.owner.combatBuffs)delete state.owner.combatBuffs[buffKey];}

    state={owner:player,elapsed:0,damageDealt:0,beamDamageDealt:0,tickBonus:0};beam.cast(player,angle,multiplier,getAngle);
  }
  /** Substep beam ticks and residue timers on simulation time, so pausing freezes everything. */
  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
    if(state&&(state.owner!==player||!weapon(player))){reset();return;}
    let left=Math.max(0,delta);
    while(left>1e-8) {
      const step=Math.min(left,1/60);left-=step;
      if(state){
        state.elapsed+=step;if(state.elapsed>=settings.buffSeconds)removeBuff();
        // All targets hit in this tick use the same prior total, independent of enemy iteration order.
        state.tickBonus=state.beamDamageDealt;state.beamInProgress=true;
        beam.update(step,player,aim);if(state)state.beamInProgress=false;
      }
      const accumulated=state?.damageDealt||0;
      const explosionTotal=Math.round(accumulated*itemSkillDamageMultiplier(player))+luminousNovaFinisherDamage(accumulated,player);
      for(const residue of residues) {
        residue.age+=step;
        if(!residue.exploded&&residue.age>=settings.residueSeconds) {
          residue.exploded=true;
          residue.damage=explosionTotal; // Full accumulated damage plus the old capped 10% charge.
          for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
            const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
            if(Math.hypot(body.x-residue.x,body.y-residue.y)<=settings.residueRadius+Math.max(body.rx,body.ry))
              damageEnemy(enemy.id,residue.damage,residue.owner,'normal');
          }
        }

      if(state&&state.elapsed>=settings.buffSeconds&&!residues.length){removeBuff();state=null;beam.reset();}
    }
  }

    get auraActive(){return Boolean(state&&state.elapsed<settings.buffSeconds);},get damageDealt(){return state?.damageDealt||0;},get residueCount(){return residues.length;}};

/** Despawn only after the complete head bloom and continuous tail clear the current camera. */
export function princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view) {

/** Two-second eligibility window, recorded before a lethal hit dispatches defeat listeners. */
export function recordRateUpHit(enemy,chance){
  if(!(chance>0))return false;

import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
export function rgbTuningActive(player,weaponId='plana-umbrella'){

export function rainbowTrailGradient(context,x1,y1,x2,y2){
  const gradient=context.createLinearGradient(x1,y1,x2,y2);
  ['#ff6090','#ffad57','#fff178','#73f7a7','#66e5ff','#9292ff','#ec80ff'].forEach((color,i)=>gradient.addColorStop(i/6,color));
  return gradient;
}
/** Tint only already drawn trail pixels; never recolor the world or the solid weapon. */
export function tintRainbowTrail(context,width,height){
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=1;context.globalCompositeOperation='source-atop';
  context.fillStyle=rainbowTrailGradient(context,0,height,width,0);context.fillRect(0,0,width,height);context.restore();
}

/** Recolor plasma while retaining its alpha falloff and pale luminous highlights. */
export function rainbowPlasmaColor(value,hue){
  const palette=[[255,75,90],[255,190,55],[200,255,70],[55,255,150],[65,195,255],[180,95,255]];
  const phase=((hue%360)+360)%360/60,index=Math.floor(phase),t=phase-index;
  const color=palette[index].map((v,i)=>v+(palette[(index+1)%6][i]-v)*t);
  const recolor=(r,g,b)=>{
    const bright=Math.max(+r,+g,+b)/255,white=Math.max(0,(Math.min(+r,+g,+b)-180)/75)*.65;
    return color.map(v=>Math.round((v*(1-white)+255*white)*bright));
  };
  if(value.startsWith('#'))return '#'+recolor(parseInt(value.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(value.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(value.slice(5,7),16)).map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')+value.slice(7);
  return value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/,(_,prefix,r,g,b)=>prefix+recolor(r,g,b).join(','));
}

import { scoreFormula } from './game-config.js';

/** Count real defeats and snapshot scores without inventing leaderboard/results placement. */
export function createRunScore() {
  let counts = { enemyDefeated: 0, miniBossDefeated: 0, bossDefeated: 0 };
  let endlessDefeatRecorded = false;
  const results = [];
  return {
    recordDefeat(enemy) {
      counts.enemyDefeated++;
      if (enemy.miniBoss) counts.miniBossDefeated++;
      else if (enemy.boss || (enemy.boss !== false && ['iroha','shiroko'].includes(enemy.type))) counts.bossDefeated++;
    },
    complete({ character, elapsedSeconds, stage, endless = false, hardcore = false }) {
      if (endless && endlessDefeatRecorded) return null;
      if (endless) endlessDefeatRecorded = true;
      const result = Object.freeze({ ...scoreFormula({ ...counts, playerLevel: character.level || 1,
        elapsedSeconds, hardcore }), ...counts, character: character.label, stage,
        mode: endless ? 'endless' : 'stage', elapsedSeconds });
      results.push(result);
      return result;
    },
    get results() { return [...results]; },
    get counts() { return {...counts}; }
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/run-seed.js | sha256=8662bfda80541895ee7a4d630fbf168badc8ee867976a1a5c08a2ad79388fe2d | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { developmentSettings } from './game-config.js';
/** Mix local start time with random entropy so each new run gets a fresh seed. */
export function createRunSeed(time = new Date(), entropy) {
  if (entropy === undefined) {
    entropy = globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues
      ? globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0]
      : Math.floor(Math.random() * 4294967296);
  }
  const localTime = [time.getFullYear(), time.getMonth(), time.getDate(),
    time.getHours(), time.getMinutes(), time.getSeconds(), time.getMilliseconds(),
    time.getTimezoneOffset(), entropy].join(':');
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (const character of localTime) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ character.charCodeAt(0), 16777619);
  return (hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0;
}

// Generated once per page/game start; map changes and scene resets reuse it.
export const runStartedAt = new Date();
/** Development starts in admin seed 0; the reroll control opts into a random run. */
export function selectRunSeed(search = '', time = runStartedAt, entropy) {
  const requested = new URLSearchParams(search).get('seed');
  return (requested === null && developmentSettings.adminSeedByDefault) || requested === '0' ? 0 : (createRunSeed(time, entropy) || 1);
}
export const runSeed = selectRunSeed(globalThis.location?.search || '');

// Admin seed bundles tile previews and the 1-HP enemy test configuration.
export const isAdminSeed = runSeed === 0;

   b.age+=step;b.x+=Math.cos(b.angle)*b.speed*step;b.y+=Math.sin(b.angle)*b.speed*step;
   const radius=s.radius*b.size;
   // Closest swept hit wins; each missile can deal damage to only one enemy.
   const candidates=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{if(!getEnemy(enemy.id))return false;const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...t,rx:t.rx+radius,ry:t.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);});
   candidates.sort((a,c)=>{const t=getEnemyHurtbox(a),u=getEnemyHurtbox(c);return Math.hypot(t.x-from.x,t.y-from.y)-Math.hypot(u.x-from.x,u.y-from.y);});
   if(candidates.length){const target=candidates[0],hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'saint-predator',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,
     {projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target,weaponId:'saint-predator'});
    damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});missiles.splice(i,1);
   }else if(b.age>=s.duration-1e-8)missiles.splice(i,1);
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='saint-predator');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(delta<=0)return;
  let left=delta;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,viewport);const stats=saintPredatorLevelStats(weapon.level);
    cooldown=attackTimeFormula(stats.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);left-=step;
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){context.save();for(const b of missiles){
  context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y);context.rotate(b.angle);context.scale(b.size,b.size);
  const length=s.length,flame=8+3*Math.sin(b.age*55);
  context.fillStyle='rgba(255,135,49,.35)';context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-length/2,-4);context.lineTo(-length/2-flame,0);context.lineTo(-length/2,4);context.fill();
  context.fillStyle='#ffd66c';context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-length/2,-2);context.lineTo(-length/2-flame*.7,0);context.lineTo(-length/2,2);context.fill();
  context.fillStyle='#d7e5e9';context.beginPath();context.moveTo(length/2,0);context.lineTo(length/2-6,-4);context.lineTo(-length/2,-4);context.lineTo(-length/2,4);context.lineTo(length/2-6,4);context.closePath();context.fill();
  context.fillStyle='#54636e';context.fillRect(-8,-5,5,10);context.fillStyle='#d5675c';context.fillRect(3,-3,3,6);context.restore();
 }context.restore();}
 return {ready:Promise.resolve(),update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return missiles.length;}};
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/seeded-events.js | sha256=8b94d5e2d17a2294b9aba7b21c892bc010caaae66681eba2680cb3d2f8d24b32 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { campaignEventChart, seededEventSettings, campaignEventSettings } from './event-config.js';
import { campaignEnemyRows, pickEndlessEnemy } from './campaign-config.js';
import { enemyTypeStats } from './game-config.js';

/** Stable per-slot random stream: frame rate, kills and unrelated RNG cannot change event choices. */
function eventRandom(seed, index) {
 let state=(Number(seed)^Math.imul(index+1,0x9e3779b9))>>>0;
 return ()=>{state+=0x6d2b79f5;let t=state;t=Math.imul(t^(t>>>15),t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61);return ((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};
}

/** Seeded event identity and bounded tuning; all regular/Mega variants cycle through the pool. */
export function generatedEvent(seed,index,internalSeconds) {
 const s=seededEventSettings,random=eventRandom(seed,index);
 const stage=internalSeconds<390?'first':internalSeconds<840?'second':internalSeconds<1080?'third':'fourth';
 const endless=pickEndlessEnemy(internalSeconds,()=>0);
 const available=endless ? [...new Set(Array.from({length:14},(_,i)=>pickEndlessEnemy(internalSeconds,()=>i/14).type))] :
  [...new Set(campaignEnemyRows.filter(r=>r.stage===stage&&r.kind==='regular'&&r.start<=internalSeconds&&internalSeconds<r.end).flatMap(r=>r.enemies))];
 const pool=available.length?available:campaignEnemyRows.filter(r=>r.stage===stage&&r.kind==='regular'&&r.start<=internalSeconds).at(-1)?.enemies||['mob'];
 const order=[...pool].sort((a,b)=>{
  const rank=name=>{let n=Number(seed)>>>0;for(const c of name)n=Math.imul(n^c.charCodeAt(0),16777619);return n>>>0;};
  return rank(a)-rank(b);
 });
 const enemy=order[index%order.length],pattern=s.patterns[Math.floor(random()*s.patterns.length)];
 const warning=['stampede','wave','fastball','ambush','airdrop','hordeRush'].includes(pattern);
 return {id:`seeded-${index}`,enemy,pattern,count:pattern==='cluster'?s.clusterCount:s.minCount+Math.floor(random()*(s.maxCount-s.minCount+1)),
  lifetimeSeconds:s.minLifetime+Math.floor(random()*(s.maxLifetime-s.minLifetime+1)),
  entrySide:Math.floor(random()*4),radius:220+Math.floor(random()*81),warningSeconds:warning?1:0,stats:'default',generated:true,timeSeconds:internalSeconds,
  ...(pattern==='hordeRush'?{repeatSeconds:2}:{}),
  nextInterval:s.minInterval+Math.floor(random()*(s.maxInterval-s.minInterval+1))};
}

/** Defaults come from the relevant campaign row, even outside that type's regular spawn window. */
export function eventEnemyProfile(event,type,internalSeconds,stage) {
 const endless=pickEndlessEnemy(internalSeconds,()=>0);
 const endlessProfile=endless && (type==='midori' ? (internalSeconds>=1800 ? pickEndlessEnemy(internalSeconds,()=>.999999)?.row : null) : endless.row);
 const matches=campaignEnemyRows.filter(row=>row.enemies.includes(type));
 const profile=matches.filter(row=>row.stage===stage&&row.start<=internalSeconds).at(-1)||
  matches.filter(row=>row.start<=internalSeconds).at(-1)||matches[0];
 const fallback=enemyTypeStats[type];
 const base=endlessProfile||profile||{hp:fallback?.baseHP||60,atk:fallback?.baseATK||1,spd:fallback?.baseSPD||.35,exp:fallback?.expValue||1,kind:'regular'};
 const stats=event.stats && typeof event.stats==='object'?event.stats:{};
 return {...base,id:event.id,enemies:[type],gate:false,freeze:false,
  hp:stats.hp??base.hp,atk:stats.atk??base.atk,spd:stats.spd??base.spd,exp:stats.exp??base.exp};
}

/** Internal time starts groups; active time controls firing cadence, lifetimes and generated events. */
export function createCampaignEvents({seed=0,getPoints,spawn,onEnd=()=>{},warn=()=>{},chart=campaignEventChart}) {
 let active=0,post17=0,nextGenerated=seededEventSettings.firstDelay,index=0;
 const groups=new Map(),prepared=new Map();
 const ended=new Set();
 const finish=group=>{if(ended.has(group.event.id))return;ended.add(group.event.id);onEnd(group.event.id);groups.delete(group.event.id);};
 function start(event,internalSeconds,stage,points=null,delay=0){
  if(ended.has(event.id)||groups.has(event.id))return;
  const actual={...event,groupId:event.id,runtimeManaged:true};
  groups.set(event.id,{event:actual,stage,started:active+delay,nextWave:0,waves:[],points,announced:false});
 }
 function runGroup(group,internalSeconds,stage,enabled){
  const e=group.event,age=active-group.started;
  if(e.lifetimeSeconds!=null&&age>=e.lifetimeSeconds){finish(group);return;}
  if(age<0){if(!group.announced){const points=group.points||getPoints(e);if(points){group.points=points;warn(e,points,group.started);group.announced=true;}}return;}
  const inWindow=e.endTimeSeconds==null||internalSeconds<=e.endTimeSeconds+1e-7;
  const stageActive=e.generated||group.stage===stage;
  if(enabled&&inWindow&&stageActive) {
   if(e.repeatSeconds){
    while(group.nextWave<=age+1e-7){group.waves.push({index:0,points:null,start:group.nextWave});group.nextWave+=e.repeatSeconds;}
   }else if(group.nextWave===0){group.waves.push({index:0,points:group.points,start:0});group.nextWave=Infinity;}
  }
  if(!inWindow||!stageActive){group.waves=[];if(e.lifetimeSeconds==null){ended.add(e.id);groups.delete(e.id);}return;}
  for(const wave of group.waves){
   if(!enabled)break;
   wave.points??=getPoints(e);
   if(!wave.points)continue;
   const due=e.spawnDuration?Math.min(e.count,1+Math.floor(Math.max(0,age-wave.start)/e.spawnDuration*e.count)):e.count;
   while(wave.index<due){
    const types=Array.isArray(e.enemy)?e.enemy:[e.enemy];
    const type=types[wave.index%types.length];
    const runtime={...e,stage:group.stage,internalSeconds,remainingLife:e.lifetimeSeconds==null?null:Math.max(0,e.lifetimeSeconds-age)};
    if(!spawn(runtime,{...wave.points[wave.index],enemyType:type}))break;
    wave.index++;
   }
  }
  group.waves=group.waves.filter(w=>w.index<e.count);
  if(!e.repeatSeconds&&!group.waves.length&&group.nextWave===Infinity&&e.lifetimeSeconds==null){ended.add(e.id);groups.delete(e.id);}
 }
 return {
  seek(seconds){
   for(const group of [...groups.values()])finish(group);
   groups.clear();prepared.clear();ended.clear();
   for(const event of chart)if(event.timeSeconds<seconds)ended.add(event.id);
  },
  get activeSeconds(){return active;},get activeGroups(){return groups.size;},get generatedSlots(){return index;},
  update(internalSeconds,delta,{stage,enabled=true}={}){
   active+=Math.max(0,delta);
   const allow=enabled&&campaignEventSettings.enabled;
   for(const event of chart){
    if(event.stage!==stage||ended.has(event.id)||groups.has(event.id))continue;
    if(event.endTimeSeconds!=null&&internalSeconds>event.endTimeSeconds+1e-7){ended.add(event.id);continue;}
    if(internalSeconds<event.timeSeconds-(event.warningSeconds||0))continue;
    if(!allow){if(internalSeconds>=event.timeSeconds)ended.add(event.id);continue;}
    if(internalSeconds<event.timeSeconds){
     if(!prepared.has(event.id)){const points=getPoints(event);if(points){prepared.set(event.id,points);warn(event,points,active+event.timeSeconds-internalSeconds);}}
     continue;
    }
    start(event,internalSeconds,stage,prepared.get(event.id)||null);prepared.delete(event.id);
   }
   if(internalSeconds>=seededEventSettings.startSeconds&&seededEventSettings.enabled){
    post17+=Math.max(0,delta);
    while(post17>=nextGenerated){
     const event=generatedEvent(seed,index++,internalSeconds);
     nextGenerated+=event.nextInterval;
     if(allow)start(event,internalSeconds,stage,null,event.warningSeconds);
    }
   }
   for(const group of [...groups.values()])runGroup(group,internalSeconds,stage,allow);
  }
 };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/skill-accuracy.js | sha256=7dfeb9f7cfa8cf7de8703aadb84a5d9cf79e1f5480a667c53df674cd6de9789c | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Canonical pattern matching the EX Skills reference diagram. */
export function planaReferenceStrokes() {
  return [Array.from({ length: 97 }, (_, i) => ({
    x: 100 + 86 * Math.cos(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2),
    y: 100 + 86 * Math.sin(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2)
  })), [{ x: 100, y: 94 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }],
  [{ x: 76, y: 67 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }, { x: 124, y: 67 }],
  [{ x: 75, y: 119 }, { x: 125, y: 160 }],
  [{ x: 125, y: 119 }, { x: 75, y: 160 }]];
}

/** Uniformly sample ink length, ignoring pen speed, stroke order and direction. */
function normalizedInk(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const size = Math.max(bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top, 1);
  const points = [];
  for (const stroke of strokes) for (let i = 1; i < stroke.length; i++) {
    const a = stroke[i - 1], b = stroke[i];
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / size * 180));
    for (let j = 0; j <= count; j++) points.push({
      x: (a.x + (b.x - a.x) * j / count - (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2) / size,
      y: (a.y + (b.y - a.y) * j / count - (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2) / size
    });
  }
  // Bound comparison work even for very long mouse strokes.
  const unique = [...new Map(points.map(p => [
    `${Math.round(p.x * 10000)},${Math.round(p.y * 10000)}`, p
  ])).values()].sort((a, b) => Math.round(a.x * 10000) - Math.round(b.x * 10000) ||
    Math.round(a.y * 10000) - Math.round(b.y * 10000));
  return unique.filter((_, i) => i % Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unique.length / 320)) === 0);
}

/** Symmetric ink distance rewards the entire reference, including missing/extra marks. */
export function drawingAccuracy(strokes, referenceStrokes = planaReferenceStrokes()) {
  const actual = normalizedInk(strokes), reference = normalizedInk(referenceStrokes);
  if (!actual.length) return 0;
  const nearestMean = (from, to) => from.reduce((total, p) => total +
    Math.min(...to.map(q => Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y))), 0) / from.length;
  const error = (nearestMean(actual, reference) + nearestMean(reference, actual)) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - error / skillCastSettings.accuracyDistanceTolerance));
}

/** Map successful reference accuracy to minimum/typical/perfect damage anchors. */
export function skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy) {
  const s = skillCastSettings;
  const value = Number.isFinite(accuracy) ? accuracy : s.accuracyAverage;
  const low = value <= s.accuracyAverage;
  const start = low ? s.accuracyMinimum : s.accuracyAverage;
  const end = low ? s.accuracyAverage : s.accuracyPerfect;
  const from = low ? s.damageMinimum : s.damageAverage;
  const to = low ? s.damageAverage : s.damageMaximum;
  return from + (to - from) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - start) / (end - start)));
}

import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  const superWeapon=character.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton');
  if(superWeapon&&!character.ultimateSkill)character.ultimateSkill={id:'decagrammaton-ultimate',name:'Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',icon:superWeapon.icon,exSkill:true,successCooldown:300};
  if(!superWeapon&&character.ultimateSkill?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate')delete character.ultimateSkill;
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));
  }
}

/** Drawing-cast state machine; async recognition responses must match the current token. */
export function createSkillCastState(onSubmit = () => {}) {
  let phase = 'idle', owner = null, weapon = null;
  let elapsed = 0, idle = 0, drawing = false, inkLength = 0, token = 0;
  return {
    get phase() { return phase; }, get owner() { return owner; }, get weapon() { return weapon; },
    get token() { return token; }, get inkLength() { return inkLength; },
    get remaining() { return Math.max(0, skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds - elapsed); },
    begin(character, item, adminTest = false) {
      if (phase !== 'idle' || !item?.icon || (!adminTest && item.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) return false;
      owner = character; weapon = item; elapsed = idle = inkLength = 0; drawing = false;
      phase = 'drawing'; token++;
      return true;
    },
    strokeStart() { if (phase === 'drawing') { drawing = true; idle = 0; } },
    addInk(length) { if (phase === 'drawing') { inkLength += Math.max(0, length); idle = 0; } },
    strokeEnd() { drawing = false; idle = 0; },
    update(delta) {
      if (phase !== 'drawing') return;
      const time = Math.max(0, delta);
      elapsed += time;
      if (!drawing && inkLength > 0) idle += time;
      if (elapsed >= skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds || idle >= skillCastSettings.idleSubmitSeconds) {
        if (inkLength <= skillCastSettings.minimumInkLength) { this.cancel('empty'); return; }
        phase = 'recognizing'; drawing = false;
        onSubmit({ token, owner, weapon });
      }
    },
    cancel(reason, target = weapon) {
      if (phase === 'idle') return false;
      const penalty = reason === 'pause' ? skillCastSettings.pauseCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'right' ? skillCastSettings.rightCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'empty' ? skillCastSettings.failureCooldown : 0;
      if (penalty && inkLength > 0 && target && equippedSkills(owner).includes(target) &&
          !(target.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) setSkillCooldown(target, penalty);
      token++; phase = 'idle'; drawing = false;
      return true;
    },
    resolve(requestToken, result) {
      if (requestToken !== token || phase !== 'recognizing') return false;
      let valid = Boolean(result && result.valid !== false && typeof result.label === 'string' && result.label.length > 0 &&
        Number.isFinite(result.score) && result.score >= skillCastSettings.minimumConfidence);
      if (valid && result.weapon) {
        if (!equippedSkills(owner).includes(result.weapon) || (!result.adminTest && result.weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) valid = false;
        else weapon = result.weapon;
      }
      // Unknown/ambiguous/failed recognition is free; never penalize a guessed weapon.
      if (valid) setSkillCooldown(weapon, weapon.successCooldown??skillCastSettings.successCooldown);
      if (valid) {
        weapon.lastSkillDrawing = { label: result.label, score: result.score, skillId: result.skillId, components: result.components,
          accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier, clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions };
      }
      phase = 'idle'; token++;
      return Boolean(valid);
    }
  };
}
