import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Normalize X/Y independently so canvas size and squashed proportions do not affect casting. */
export function normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (!(width > 0) || !(height > 0)) return [];
  return strokes.map(stroke => stroke.map(point => ({
    x: (point.x - bounds.left) / width * 200,
    y: (point.y - bounds.top) / height * 200
  })));
}

/** Measure the drawing alone, excluding the game, HUD, dimmer and decorative stroke glow. */
export function drawingBounds(strokes) {
  const points = strokes.flat();
  if (!points.length) return null;
  return points.reduce((bounds, point) => ({ left: Math.min(bounds.left, point.x),
    top: Math.min(bounds.top, point.y), right: Math.max(bounds.right, point.x),
    bottom: Math.max(bounds.bottom, point.y) }),
    { left: Infinity, top: Infinity, right: -Infinity, bottom: -Infinity });
}

/** Normalize a cropped sketch into a square black-on-white image for QuickDraw. */
export function drawingModelImage(strokes, createCanvas = () => document.createElement('canvas')) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const canvas = createCanvas(), size = skillCastSettings.modelInputSize;
  canvas.width = canvas.height = size;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  context.fillStyle = '#fff'; context.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
  const usable = size - skillCastSettings.modelPadding * 2;
  const scale = usable / Math.max(1, bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top);
  const centerX = (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2, centerY = (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2;
  context.strokeStyle = '#000'; context.lineWidth = skillCastSettings.modelLineWidth;
  context.lineCap = context.lineJoin = 'round';
  for (const stroke of strokes) {
    if (stroke.length < 2) continue;
    context.beginPath();
    stroke.forEach((point, index) => {
      const x = size / 2 + (point.x - centerX) * scale, y = size / 2 + (point.y - centerY) * scale;
      if (index) context.lineTo(x, y); else context.moveTo(x, y);
    });
    context.stroke();
  }
  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
}

/** Render the visible Schale-style cyan/blue/lilac line, retaining separate pen strokes. */
export function drawSkillStrokes(context, strokes, width, height) {
  context.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
  const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(0, height, width, 0);
  gradient.addColorStop(0, '#b7fbff'); gradient.addColorStop(0.35, '#45dcff');
  gradient.addColorStop(0.7, '#408dff'); gradient.addColorStop(1, '#d6acff');
  context.save();
  context.strokeStyle = gradient; context.lineWidth = skillCastSettings.lineWidth;
  context.lineCap = context.lineJoin = 'round'; context.shadowColor = '#62dfff'; context.shadowBlur = 9;
  for (const stroke of strokes) {
    if (!stroke.length) continue;
    context.beginPath();
    stroke.forEach((point, index) => index ? context.lineTo(point.x, point.y) : context.moveTo(point.x, point.y));
    context.stroke();
  }
  context.restore();
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/skill-pattern-recognition.js | sha256=83a2f02f5b4437974bf4dd337e6ce7647b6e0894e670e7bf721b4e12825e18e1 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { decagrammatonReferenceStrokes } from './decagrammaton-ultimate.js';
import { segmentPlanaPattern } from './plana-pattern.js';
import { drawingModelImage, drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { drawingAccuracy, skillDamageMultiplier } from './skill-accuracy.js';
import { skillCastSettings, luminousNovaSkillSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (!(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'){
    const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,decagrammatonReferenceStrokes());
    const valid=accuracy>=.72;return {valid,skillId:'decagrammaton-ultimate',label:'Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',score:accuracy,accuracy,matchAccuracy:accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,reason:valid?undefined:'Draw a square overlaid with a diamond.'};
  }
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if(weapon?.id==='princess-key')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'luminous-nova') return recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'aris-laser') return recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  // CLIP can confuse overlapping frames with Umbrella's enclosing circle. Local geometry wins.
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return {valid:false,reason:'This is a linked-frame pattern, not Umbrella.'};
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}


/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = ['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()):weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: result.matchAccuracy??accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || candidate.matchAccuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}


/** Three crown spikes with open underside; a diamond sits above the crown. */
export function supernovaReferenceStrokes() {
  const path = points => points.map(([x,y]) => ({x,y}));
  return [path([[45,165],[35,110],[67.5,142],[100,110],[132.5,142],[165,110],[155,165]]),
    path([[100,25],[126,60],[100,95],[74,60],[100,25]])];
}

/** Geometric whole-symbol matching plus isolated QuickDraw assistance, with offline fallback. */
export async function recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent) {
  const normalized = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(normalized);
  if (!bounds) return {valid:false,reason:'Draw the Supernova pattern.'};
  const width = bounds.right-bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const split = bounds.top + height*.53;
  const upper = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y<split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const lower = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y>=split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const diamondBounds=drawingBounds(upper), crownBounds=drawingBounds(lower);
  // The narrow diamond sits above the wider crown; reject enclosing circles/partial symbols.
  if (!diamondBounds || !crownBounds || diamondBounds.right-diamondBounds.left>width*.75 ||
      crownBounds.right-crownBounds.left<width*.75 || diamondBounds.bottom-diamondBounds.top<height*.25) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a diamond above an open-bottom three-spike crown.'};
  }
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes,supernovaReferenceStrokes());
  if (accuracy < .62) return {valid:false, reason:'Draw an open-bottom three-spike crown and a diamond.'};
  const components = [];
  for (const stroke of normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes)) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
    try { components.push({name:'Supernova component',predictions:await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage([stroke]))}); }
    catch { /* Local reference remains available when model inference is offline. */ }
  }
  return {valid:true,skillId:'supernova-beam',label:'Supernova',score:accuracy,accuracy,
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};
}


/** Choose a cancellation target locally; empty/unrelated ink never selects a default slot. */
export function closestDrawingSkill(strokes, skills) {
  if (!drawingBounds(strokes)) return null;
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return skills.find(w=>['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(w.id)&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0))||null;
  let best = null, score = .25, runnerUp = 0;
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    const reference = weapon.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'?decagrammatonReferenceStrokes():['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?princessKeyReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'luminous-nova'?luminousNovaReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? supernovaReferenceStrokes() : undefined;
    if (!reference && weapon.id !== 'plana-umbrella') continue;
    const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes, reference);
    if (accuracy > score) { runnerUp = score === .25 ? 0 : score; score = accuracy; best = weapon; }
    else runnerUp = Math.max(runnerUp,accuracy);
  }
  return score-runnerUp >= skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin ? best : null;
}


/** A circle enclosing a centered diamond; scale, stroke order and direction are unrestricted. */
export function luminousNovaReferenceStrokes() {
  return [Array.from({length:97},(_,i)=>({x:100+90*Math.cos(i/96*Math.PI*2),y:100+90*Math.sin(i/96*Math.PI*2)})),
    [[100,48],[152,100],[100,152],[48,100],[100,48]].map(([x,y])=>({x,y}))];
}

/** Vertically flipped triangle: left lower, right higher, third projecting upward between both. */
export function princessKeyReferenceStrokes() {
  const box=(left,top,right,bottom)=>[[left,top],[right,top],[right,bottom],[left,bottom],[left,top]].map(([x,y])=>({x,y}));
  return [box(15,90,115,190),box(95,70,195,170),box(55,10,155,110)];
}

/** Recognize closed, mostly horizontal/vertical frames without requiring exact reference spacing. */
export function linkedFrameEvidence(strokes) {
  const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);let frames=0,total=0,aligned=0;const frameBounds=[];
  for(const stroke of normalized) {
    if(stroke.length<4)continue;
    const bounds=drawingBounds([stroke]);if(!bounds)continue;
    const width=bounds.right-bounds.left,height=bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
    let length=0,axis=0;
    for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++) {
      const dx=Math.abs(stroke[i].x-stroke[i-1].x),dy=Math.abs(stroke[i].y-stroke[i-1].y),distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      length+=distance;if(Math.min(dx,dy)<=Math.max(dx,dy)*.45)axis+=distance;
    }
    total+=length;aligned+=axis;
    const endGap=Math.hypot(stroke[0].x-stroke.at(-1).x,stroke[0].y-stroke.at(-1).y);
    if(width>=20&&height>=20&&endGap<Math.hypot(width,height)*.3&&axis/Math.max(1,length)>.65&&length>1.5*(width+height)){frames++;frameBounds.push(bounds);}
  }
  const interlocked=frameBounds.some((a,i)=>frameBounds.filter((b,j)=>i!==j&&
    Math.min(a.right,b.right)>Math.max(a.left,b.left)&&Math.min(a.bottom,b.bottom)>Math.max(a.top,b.top)).length>=2);
  return frames>=3&&interlocked&&total>0&&aligned/total>.65;
}

/** Reference matching is scale/stroke-order independent; QuickDraw supplies supporting shape predictions. */
export async function recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()),frames=linkedFrameEvidence(strokes);
  if(accuracy<.88&&!frames)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw three interlocking squares.'};
  const components=[];
  try{components.push({name:'linked rectangles',predictions:await recognizer?.recognize(drawingModelImage(strokes))});}catch{}
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  return {valid:true,skillId:'princess-key-ex',label:'The Princess and the Key',score:Math.max(accuracy,frames ? .8 : 0),accuracy,matchAccuracy:Math.max(accuracy,frames ? .85 : 0),
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};
}

/** Separate enclosing ink from diamond ink before combining forgiving geometry and AI assistance. */
export async function recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes),points=[];
  for(const stroke of normalized)for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++) {
    const a=stroke[i-1],b=stroke[i],count=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)/3));
    for(let j=0;j<=count;j++)points.push({x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*j/count,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*j/count});
  }
  if(!points.length)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a circle with a diamond inside.'};
  const radius=p=>Math.hypot((p.x-100)/100,(p.y-100)/100);
  const outer=points.filter(p=>radius(p)>.87),inner=points.filter(p=>radius(p)<.84);
  const sectors=new Set(outer.map(p=>(Math.floor((Math.atan2(p.y-100,p.x-100)+Math.PI)/Math.PI*4)+8)%8));
  const bounds=drawingBounds([inner]);
  if(sectors.size<7||!bounds||bounds.right-bounds.left<40||bounds.bottom-bounds.top<40)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw an enclosing circle and a centered diamond.'};
  const cx=(bounds.left+bounds.right)/2,cy=(bounds.top+bounds.bottom)/2;
  const rx=(bounds.right-bounds.left)/2,ry=(bounds.bottom-bounds.top)/2;
  const error=inner.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+Math.abs(Math.abs(p.x-cx)/rx+Math.abs(p.y-cy)/ry-1),0)/inner.length;
  if(Math.abs(cx-100)>25||Math.abs(cy-100)>25||error>.23)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a diamond outline inside the circle.'};
  const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes());
  if(accuracy<luminousNovaSkillSettings.patternMinimumAccuracy)return {valid:false,reason:'Complete the circle and diamond.'};
  const components=[];
  for(const [name,ink] of [['circle',outer],['diamond',inner]]) {
    if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
    try{components.push({name,predictions:await recognizer?.recognize(drawingModelImage([ink]))});}catch{}
  }
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  return {valid:true,skillId:'luminous-nova-aura',label:'Luminous Nova',score:accuracy,accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,components};
}

import {tuningPerk,slowdownTuningSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
/** Temporary movement reduction, independent of permanent speed and knockback. */
export function applySlowdown(enemy,percent,seconds=5){
  if(enemy.hp<=0||!(percent>0)||!(seconds>0))return false;
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0,seconds);
  enemy.slowdownPercent=percent;return true;
}
export function updateSlowdown(enemy,delta){
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  if(enemy.slowdownRemaining<1e-6){enemy.slowdownRemaining=0;enemy.slowdownPercent=0;}
}
export function slowdownMultiplier(enemy){return enemy.slowdownRemaining>0?1-Math.min(100,Math.max(0,enemy.slowdownPercent||0))/100:1;}

/** Single bonus hit; does not recursively trigger itself or repeatedly tick. */
export function trySlowdownTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage,random=Math.random}){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(main!=='plana-umbrella'||!player.tuningParts||enemy.hp<=0)return false;
  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowChance');if(!chance||random()>=chance)return false;
  if(!applySlowdown(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowPercent'),slowdownTuningSettings.seconds))return false;
  const hit=rollDamage(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowDamagePercent')/100);
  damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{slowdownTuning:true});return true;
}

const cache=new WeakMap();
const animationCache=new WeakMap();

/** Average every aligned pose once, then share one stable oval across the animation set. */
export function animationSpriteHurtbox(character,getFrameRectangle,padding=8) {
  const identity=character.animationFrames||character.image;
  let sizes=animationCache.get(identity);if(!sizes){sizes=new Map();animationCache.set(identity,sizes);}
  const size=character.spriteSize||89.6,key=`${size}:${character.referenceSize||215}:${JSON.stringify(character.gifPoseAnchors||{})}`;
  if(sizes.has(key))return sizes.get(key);
  const scale=(size-padding*2)/(character.referenceSize||215),poses=[];
  if(character.animationFrames) {
    const clips=[['normal',character.animationFrames],...Object.entries(character.actionAnimations||{})];
    for(const [name,frames] of clips)for(const frame of frames) {
      const image=frame.image,anchor=character.gifPoseAnchors?.[name];
      poses.push({image,crop:{x:0,y:0,width:image.naturalWidth,height:image.naturalHeight,footY:anchor?.footY??image.naturalHeight,anchorX:anchor?.anchorX}});
    }
  } else {
    for(const direction of Object.keys(character.rows||{}))for(let frame=0;frame<character.layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++) {
      poses.push({image:character.image,crop:getFrameRectangle({...character,attack:null,moving:true,direction,facing:direction},frame)});
    }
    for(const name of Object.keys(character.attacks||{}))for(const facing of Object.keys(character.attacks[name].rows))
      for(let frame=0;frame<character.layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++)
        poses.push({image:character.image,crop:getFrameRectangle({...character,attack:{name,facing}},frame)});
  }
  if(!poses.length)return null;
  for(const pose of poses) {
    const c=pose.crop;pose.width=c.width*scale;pose.height=c.height*scale;
    pose.x=c.anchorX===undefined?-pose.width/2:-(c.anchorX-c.x)*scale;
    pose.y=size/2-padding-(c.footY-c.y)*scale;
  }
  const left=Math.min(...poses.map(p=>p.x)),top=Math.min(...poses.map(p=>p.y));
  const width=Math.max(...poses.map(p=>p.x+p.width))-left,height=Math.max(...poses.map(p=>p.y+p.height))-top;
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=32;
  const context=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  // Add equal alpha contributions instead of source-over, so every pose has equal weight.
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.globalAlpha=1/poses.length;
  for(const p of poses)context.drawImage(p.image,p.crop.x,p.crop.y,p.crop.width,p.crop.height,
    (p.x-left)/width*32,(p.y-top)/height*32,p.width/width*32,p.height/height*32);
  const mask=spriteDamageMask(canvas,{x:0,y:0,width:32,height:32});
  const result={offsetX:left+width/2,offsetY:top+height/2+(character.bossVisualOffsetY||0),width,height,mask};
  sizes.set(key,result);return result;
}
/** Fit one ellipse with at least 90% opaque-pixel coverage and the least empty area.
 * Diagnostics expose whether the requested <=5% empty-space target is geometrically possible.
 */
export function fitSpriteOval(runs) {
  const points=[];
  for(const run of runs)for(let i=0;i<Math.round(run.width*32);i++)
    points.push({x:run.x-run.width/2+(i+.5)/32,y:run.y});
  if(!points.length)return null;
  const xs=points.map(p=>p.x),ys=points.map(p=>p.y);
  const left=Math.min(...xs)-1/64,right=Math.max(...xs)+1/64,top=Math.min(...ys)-1/64,bottom=Math.max(...ys)+1/64;
  const width=right-left,height=bottom-top;
  const center={x:(left+right)/2,y:(top+bottom)/2};
  const centroid={x:xs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/points.length,y:ys.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/points.length};
  let best=null;
  for(const c of [center,centroid,{x:center.x,y:centroid.y}])
    for(let a=0;a<=10;a++)for(let b=0;b<=10;b++) {
      const rx=width*(.4+a*.05),ry=height*(.4+b*.05);
      let inside=0;
      for(const p of points)if(((p.x-c.x)/rx)**2+((p.y-c.y)/ry)**2<=1)inside++;
      const coverage=inside/points.length;
      if(coverage<.9)continue;
      const emptyFraction=Math.max(0,1-inside/(1024*Math.PI*rx*ry));
      if(!best||emptyFraction<best.emptyFraction)best={...c,rx,ry,coverage,emptyFraction,meetsTargets:emptyFraction<=.05};
    }
  return best;
}
/** Cache a compact alpha silhouette per animation crop; transparent sprite-sheet padding cannot take hits. */
export function spriteDamageMask(image,crop) {
  let frames=cache.get(image);if(!frames){frames=new Map();cache.set(image,frames);}
  const key=[crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height].join(':');
  if(frames.has(key))return frames.get(key);
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=32;
  const context=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  context.drawImage(image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,0,0,32,32);
  const pixels=context.getImageData(0,0,32,32).data,runs=[];
  for(let y=0;y<32;y++)for(let x=0;x<32;) {
    if(pixels[(y*32+x)*4+3]<32){x++;continue;}
    const start=x;while(x<32&&pixels[(y*32+x)*4+3]>=32)x++;
    runs.push({x:(start+x)/64,y:(y+.5)/32,width:(x-start)/32,height:1/32});
  }
  runs.ellipse=fitSpriteOval(runs);
  frames.set(key,runs);return runs;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/sprite-tester.js | sha256=6a9177a4ef149e97d8622e09e0156b09ac97dbff147ed2beaaeaa077f8101654 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
// Row input order used by the test controls; indices are zero-based.
const directions = ['down', 'downLeft', 'left', 'upLeft', 'up', 'upRight', 'right', 'downRight'];

/** Build a configurable-column/eight-row grid within editable source-image margins. */
export function makeGrid(width, height, margins, columns = 5) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(columns) || columns < 1 || columns > 64) {
    throw new Error('Columns must be an integer from 1 to 64.');
  }
  const { left, top, right, bottom } = margins;
  if (Object.values(margins).some(value => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) ||
      left + right >= width || top + bottom >= height) {
    throw new Error('Margins must leave a non-empty sprite area.');
  }
  const columnEdges = Array.from({ length: columns + 1 }, (_, i) => left + (width - left - right) * i / columns);
  const edges = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => top + (height - top - bottom) * i / 8);
  return { columnEdges, rowEdges: Array.from({ length: columns }, () => [...edges]) };
}

/** Decode a local image before replacing the currently working sprite. */
function loadImage(url) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Cannot read this image. Choose a PNG, WebP, or JPEG sprite sheet.'));
    image.src = url;
  });
}

/** Install session-only sprite swapping; built-in assets and crop settings stay intact. */
export function setupSpriteTester(characters, switchCharacter) {
  const form = document.querySelector('#sprite-tester');
  const target = form.elements.namedItem('target');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#sprite-feedback');
  const originals = new Map(Object.entries(characters).map(([name, character]) =>
    [name, { ...character }]
  ));
  const localUrls = new Map();

  /** Populate editable row/mirror controls from the chosen avatar's current setup. */
  function showSettings() {
    const character = characters[target.value];
    form.elements.namedItem('rows').value = directions.map(direction => character.rows[direction]).join(',');
    form.elements.namedItem('mirrors').value = (character.mirroredDirections || []).join(',');
    form.elements.namedItem('reference').value = character.referenceSize || 215;
    form.elements.namedItem('columns').value = character.layout.columnEdges.length - 1;
  }

  target.addEventListener('change', showSettings);
  showSettings();

  // Decode first, then atomically apply; failed uploads leave the old sheet usable.
  form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const name = target.value;
    const apply = form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
    let url;
    apply.disabled = true;
    feedback.textContent = 'Loading sprite settings…';
    try {
      const rows = form.elements.namedItem('rows').value.split(',').map(value => Number(value.trim()));
      if (rows.length !== 8 || rows.some(row => !Number.isInteger(row) || row < 0 || row > 7)) {
        throw new Error('Enter eight row indices between 0 and 7.');
      }
      const mirrors = form.elements.namedItem('mirrors').value.split(',').map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if (mirrors.some(direction => !directions.includes(direction))) throw new Error('Unknown mirrored direction.');
      const file = form.elements.namedItem('sheet').files[0];
      if (file) url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      const image = url ? await loadImage(url) : characters[name].image;
      const margins = Object.fromEntries(['left', 'top', 'right', 'bottom'].map(edge =>
        [edge, Number(form.elements.namedItem(edge).value)]
      ));
      const layout = form.elements.namedItem('layout').value === 'grid'
        ? makeGrid(image.naturalWidth, image.naturalHeight, margins, Number(form.elements.namedItem('columns').value))
        : originals.get(name).layout;
      if (layout.columnEdges.at(-1) > image.naturalWidth ||
          layout.rowEdges.some(edges => edges.at(-1) > image.naturalHeight)) {
        throw new Error('Built-in crops exceed this image. Choose the regular grid layout.');
      }
      const referenceSize = Number(form.elements.namedItem('reference').value);
      if (!Number.isFinite(referenceSize) || referenceSize <= 0) throw new Error('Display reference size must be positive.');
      Object.assign(characters[name], {
        image, layout, rows: Object.fromEntries(directions.map((direction, i) => [direction, rows[i]])),
        mirroredDirections: mirrors, idleRows: {}, referenceSize,
        walkFrames: Object.fromEntries(directions.map(direction => [direction, Array.from({ length: layout.columnEdges.length - 1 }, (_, i) => i)])),
        elapsed: 0, moving: false
      });
      if (url) {
        if (localUrls.has(name)) URL.revokeObjectURL(localUrls.get(name));
        localUrls.set(name, url);
        url = undefined;
      }
      switchCharacter(name);
      feedback.textContent = `${characters[name].label}: test sheet applied (${image.naturalWidth} × ${image.naturalHeight}).`;
    } catch (error) {
      feedback.textContent = error.message;
    } finally {
      if (url) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      apply.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  /** Restore the selected avatar's built-in sheet without moving the player. */
  document.querySelector('#restore-sprite').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const name = target.value;
    const { x, y, direction } = characters[name];
    Object.assign(characters[name], originals.get(name), { x, y, direction, moving: false, elapsed: 0 });
    if (localUrls.has(name)) URL.revokeObjectURL(localUrls.get(name));
    localUrls.delete(name);
    form.elements.namedItem('sheet').value = '';
    showSettings();
    feedback.textContent = `${characters[name].label}: built-in sprite restored.`;
  });

  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => {
    for (const url of localUrls.values()) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  });
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/stage-enemy-stats.js | sha256=78705e6bd62f290c80682fc9e12c10c5b9b16fed74cb69e6701d966509a43ad9 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { enemyLevelPreset, enemyStatsScalingFormula, campaignScalingTimeFormula, combatBalance } from './game-config.js';

/** BENCHED reference helper; not connected to live spawning or minute updates. */
export function stageEnemyStats(stageLevel, endlessSeconds = null, elite = false) {
  const base = enemyLevelPreset(stageLevel);
  const scaled = enemyStatsScalingFormula(base, campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds));
  return {
    stageEnemyLevel:stageLevel, stageScaled:true,
    maxHp:Math.round(scaled.hp * (elite ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1)),
    contactDamage:scaled.atk, contactDamageMultiplier:elite ? 2 : 1,
    stageSpeedFactor:scaled.spd, expReward:base.expValue,
    knockbackImmune:base.knockbackImmune
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/stage-progression.js | sha256=19e915f02fc431dc0dd7a4d4c8ba319326d6af77700d003d8f4242862fb95aa2 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { stageProgressionSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Progress the campaign in order, then choose a different available map per boss wave. */
export function nextStageAfterBoss(currentMap, endless, availableMaps, random = Math.random) {
  const settings = stageProgressionSettings;
  const regular = settings.order.filter(id => availableMaps.includes(id));
  const index = settings.order.indexOf(currentMap);
  if (!endless && index >= 0 && index < settings.order.length - 1) {
    const next = settings.order.slice(index + 1).find(id => availableMaps.includes(id));
    return { mapId: next || currentMap, endless: false, secretRolled: false };
  }
  const secretRolled = random() < settings.secretChance;
  if (secretRolled && availableMaps.includes(settings.secretStageId)) {
    return { mapId: settings.secretStageId, endless: true, secretRolled: true };
  }
  // An unimplemented secret stage falls back to a real map, without creating assets or routes.
  const choices = regular.filter(id => id !== currentMap);
  const pool = choices.length ? choices : regular;
  return { mapId: pool[Math.floor(random() * pool.length)] || currentMap,
    endless: true, secretRolled };
}

/** A wave ends only on an actual boss defeat with no living or queued bosses remaining. */
export function bossWaveIsDefeated(defeatedEnemy, enemies, hasQueuedBosses) {
  const boss = enemy => enemy.boss === true || (enemy.boss !== false && ['shiroko', 'iroha'].includes(enemy.type));
  return boss(defeatedEnemy) && !hasQueuedBosses && !enemies.some(boss);
}

import {stunnedFrames} from './stunned-animation.js';
import {loadGifAnimation,gifFrameAt} from './gif-animation.js';
import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
export const stunnedSettings={testSeconds:3,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/stunned.gif',headGap:2,headInset:.35};
const animation={gifFrames:stunnedFrames};
export const stunnedReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():loadGifAnimation(animation);
export function applyStunned(enemy,seconds=stunnedSettings.testSeconds){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  if(!(enemy.stunRemaining>0))enemy.stunVisualElapsed=0;
  enemy.stunRemaining=Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function stunVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyStunned(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawStunnedStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.stunRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!animation.animationFrames?.length)return;
  const stars=animation.animationFrames[gifFrameAt(animation.animationFrames,(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)*1000)].image;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),width=Math.max(32,Math.min(140,body.rx*1.6)),height=width*stars.naturalHeight/stars.naturalWidth;
  context.save();context.drawImage(stars,body.x-camera.x-width/2,body.y-camera.y-body.ry+body.ry*2*stunnedSettings.headInset-stunnedSettings.headGap-height,width,height);context.restore();
}
export function createStunnedAdmin({root,getEnemies,getCamera,getSize}){
  const status=root.querySelector('[role="status"]');
  root.querySelector('#admin-stun-visible').addEventListener('click',()=>{const {width,height}=getSize();const count=stunVisibleEnemies(getEnemies(),getCamera(),width,height);status.textContent=`Stunned ${count} onscreen enemies for 3 seconds.`;});
}

export function superSynergyProgress(player,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
  if(state.crafted)return {stage:'complete',frame:null};
  const weapons=(player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean),count=weapons.filter(w=>w.isSynergy&&!w.isSuperSynergy).length;
  const eligible=recipes.some(recipe=>weapons.some(w=>w.id===recipe.synergyId));
  if(state.hammer==='held')return {stage:'hammer',frame:2};
  if(!eligible&&!state.adminHammerPieces)return {stage:'hidden',frame:null};
  const pieces=Math.max(eligible?(count>=2?2:1):0,state.adminHammerPieces||0);
  return {stage:pieces>=2?'shaft':'half-shaft',frame:pieces>=2?1:0,
    earn:eligible&&!state.hammerCreated?(count>=3?'held':(player.level||1)>=50?'ground':null):null};
}
export function advanceSuperSynergyProgress(player,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
  const progress=superSynergyProgress(player,state,recipes);
  if(progress.earn){state.hammerCreated=true;state.hammer=progress.earn;}
  return superSynergyProgress(player,state,recipes);
}
/** Admin-only progression shortcut: each click adds one visual stage, without changing recipes. */

}

function validItem(item,id){
  return item&&(item.id===id||item.baseItemId===id)&&
    (item.isSuper===true||item.super===true||item.superItem===true||(Number.isFinite(item.maxLevel)&&(item.level||1)>=item.maxLevel));
}
export function superSynergyChoices(player,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
  if(state.crafted||state.hammer!=='held')return [];
  const choices=[];for(const recipe of recipes){
    if(!recipe.id||!recipe.result?.id||player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id===recipe.result.id))continue;
    for(let a=0;a<Math.min(6,player.attackSlots?.length||0);a++){
      if(player.attackSlots[a]?.id!==recipe.synergyId)continue;
      for(let b=0;b<Math.min(6,player.equipmentSlots?.length||0);b++){
        if(!validItem(player.equipmentSlots[b],recipe.itemId))continue;
        choices.push({id:`super-synergy:${recipe.id}:${a}:${b}`,name:recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id,label:'Super Synnergize',kind:'super-synergy',target:recipe.result,recipe,slots:[a,6+b],disabled:false,
          description:recipe.description||`Fuse ${player.attackSlots[a].name||recipe.synergyId} and ${player.equipmentSlots[b].name||recipe.itemId}.`});
      }
    }
  }return choices;
}
export function applySuperSynergyChoice(player,id,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
  const choice=superSynergyChoices(player,state,recipes).find(c=>c.id===id);
  if(!choice)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Super Synnergy requirements are not met.'};
  let result;try{result=choice.recipe.createWeapon?choice.recipe.createWeapon():{...choice.recipe.result};}catch{return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Super Synnergy unavailable.'};}
  if(result?.id!==choice.recipe.result.id)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Super Synnergy unavailable.'};
  const [weaponSlot,itemSlot]=choice.slots;
  player.attackSlots[weaponSlot]={...result,level:result.level||1,isSynergy:true,isSuperSynergy:true,consumedWeaponIds:[...new Set([...(result.consumedWeaponIds||[]),choice.recipe.synergyId,...(player.attackSlots[weaponSlot].consumedWeaponIds||[])])],consumedItemIds:[choice.recipe.itemId]};
  player.equipmentSlots[itemSlot-6]=null;
  state.hammer='used';state.crafted=true;state.hammerCreated=true;state.groundPosition=null;
  return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${result.name||result.id} created!`};
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/survival.js | sha256=b224a8ff9c935419f0d6a22c5cb346b33d598c106ce82d1ddad3af9d83f4d088 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { createBitmapText } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { survivalTimerSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Format active survival time as MM:SS, allowing minutes beyond 59. */
export function formatSurvivalTime(seconds) {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds));
  return `${String(Math.floor(total / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/** Track a run across map/character switches, pausing with gameplay and ending on death. */
export function createSurvivalClock() {
  let seconds = 0, ended = false;
  return {
    get seconds() { return seconds; },
    advance(delta, paused = false, alive = true) {
      if (paused) return;
      if (!alive) ended = true;
      if (!ended && Number.isFinite(delta)) seconds += Math.max(0, delta);
    }
  };
}

/** Draw survival time at the screen's top center, below the EXP bar. */
export function createSurvivalDisplay() {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const text = createBitmapText(canvas, { scale: survivalTimerSettings.fontScale });
  const expBar = document.querySelector('#hud-exp');
  return {
    draw(context, seconds, width, height) {
      text.setText(formatSurvivalTime(seconds));
      const x = Math.max(0, (width - canvas.width) / 2);
      // Read the HUD height so changing the EXP bar also moves the timer.
      const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - canvas.height,
        (expBar?.offsetHeight ?? 32) + survivalTimerSettings.offsetBelowExp));
      context.save();
      context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      context.drawImage(canvas, x, y);
      context.restore();
    }
  };
}

const imageCache=new Map();
/** Load the original PNGs once; compose crossed icons directly instead of embedding SVG images. */
export function drawSynergyIcon(canvas,item,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  if(item?.id!=='princess-key')return false;
  const layers=[
    {id:'aris-laser',name:'Arisu',angle:-Math.PI/4,color:'#65cfff',crop:[138,12,678,217]},
    {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Kei',angle:-3*Math.PI/4,color:'#ff71d5',crop:[130,2,716,226]}
  ];
  layers.sort((a,b)=>Number(a.id===item.synergyTopWeaponId)-Number(b.id===item.synergyTopWeaponId));
  Promise.all(layers.map(layer=>{
    const source=`../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_${layer.name}.png`;
    if(!imageCache.has(source)) {
      const image=new Image();image.src=source;
      imageCache.set(source,image.decode().then(()=>image));
    }
    return imageCache.get(source);
  })).then(images=>{
    if(!isCurrent())return;
    const context=canvas.getContext('2d');context.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    layers.forEach((layer,index)=>{
      const [x,y,width,height]=layer.crop;
      const bound=(width+height)/Math.SQRT2,scale=canvas.width*.86/bound;
      context.save();context.translate(canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2);context.rotate(layer.angle);
      context.shadowColor=layer.color;
      // Icons are composed once: layered silhouette glows remain vivid at small HUD sizes.
      for(const blur of [.09,.045,0]) {
        context.shadowBlur=canvas.width*blur;
        context.drawImage(images[index],x,y,width,height,-width*scale/2,-height*scale/2,width*scale,height*scale);
      }
      context.restore();
    });
  }).catch(()=>{});
  return true;
}

}

}

/** Produce a stable weighted tile index for positive or negative grid coordinates. */
function newyearRandom(column, row, seed, salt = 0) {
  let hash = Math.imul(column | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(row | 0, 0x5f356495) ^ seed ^ Math.imul(salt, 0x6c8e9cf5);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
  hash = (hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0;
  return hash / 4294967296;
}

/** Natural rare chances are independent of the weighted ordinary layout pool. */
export function newyearBaseTileIndex(column, row, seed = worldSeed) {
  const rare = newyearRandom(column, row, seed, 1);
  if (rare < newyearRareSpawns.grandShrine) return 10;
  if (rare < newyearRareSpawns.grandShrine + newyearRareSpawns.lanternStage) return 11;
  let value = newyearRandom(column, row, seed) * tileWeights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < tileWeights.length; i++) {
    value -= tileWeights[i];
    if (value < 0) return i;
  }
  return tileWeights.length - 1;
}

/** Guarantee a shared rare tile per grid-aligned 20x20 region, independent of visits. */
export function createNewyearTileSelector(seed = worldSeed,
  naturalIndex = (column, row) => newyearBaseTileIndex(column, row, seed)) {
  // A compact 4x3 repeating gallery places all twelve tiles around spawn.
  if (seed === 0) return (column, row) => ((row % 3 + 3) % 3) * 4 + ((column % 4 + 4) % 4);
  const emptyRegions = new Map(); // Only one boolean per inspected guarantee region.
  const rare = index => index === 10 || index === 11;
  return function tileAt(column, row) {
    const natural = naturalIndex(column, row);
    if (rare(natural)) return natural;
    const size = newyearRegionGuarantee.size;
    const regionX = Math.floor(column / size), regionY = Math.floor(row / size);
    const originX = regionX * size, originY = regionY * size;
    const forcedX = originX + Math.floor(newyearRandom(regionX, regionY, seed, 2) * size);
    const forcedY = originY + Math.floor(newyearRandom(regionX, regionY, seed, 3) * size);
    // Only the region's one fallback candidate needs to inspect its natural rolls.
    if (column !== forcedX || row !== forcedY) return natural;
    const key = `${regionX},${regionY}`;
    if (!emptyRegions.has(key)) {
      let empty = true;
      scan: for (let y = originY; y < originY + size; y++) {
        for (let x = originX; x < originX + size; x++) {
          if (rare(naturalIndex(x, y))) { empty = false; break scan; }
        }
      }
      emptyRegions.set(key, empty);
    }
    if (!emptyRegions.get(key)) return natural;
    const shrineRatio = newyearRareSpawns.grandShrine /
      (newyearRareSpawns.grandShrine + newyearRareSpawns.lanternStage);
    return newyearRandom(regionX, regionY, seed, 4) < shrineRatio ? 10 : 11;
  };
}

const newyearSelectors = new Map();
/** Stable coordinate choice for the shared run seed and its regional guarantee. */
export function tileIndex(column, row, seed = worldSeed) {
  if (!newyearSelectors.has(seed)) newyearSelectors.set(seed, createNewyearTileSelector(seed));
  return newyearSelectors.get(seed)(column, row);
}

/** Query obstacle rectangles only for tiles touched by a local world region. */
export function obstaclesIn(left, top, right, bottom) {
  const rectangles = [];
  for (let row = Math.floor((top - tileOverlap) / tileStrideY); row <= Math.floor(bottom / tileStrideY); row++) {
    for (let column = Math.floor((left - tileOverlap) / tileStrideX); column <= Math.floor(right / tileStrideX); column++) {
      for (const box of obstacleBoxes[tileIndex(column, row)]) {
        rectangles.push({
          left: column * tileStrideX + box[0] * sourceScale,
          top: row * tileStrideY + box[1] * sourceScale,
          right: column * tileStrideX + box[2] * sourceScale,
          bottom: row * tileStrideY + box[3] * sourceScale
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return rectangles;
}

/** Use a small foot-level rectangle for collision rather than transparent sprite padding. */
function footprint(character, x, y) {
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const halfWidth = size * 0.14;
  const halfHeight = size * 0.06;
  const groundY = y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
  return { left: x - halfWidth, right: x + halfWidth, top: groundY - halfHeight, bottom: groundY + halfHeight };
}

/** Return penetration depth; zero means no overlap. */
function penetration(a, b) {
  if (a.right <= b.left || a.left >= b.right || a.bottom <= b.top || a.top >= b.bottom) return 0;
  return Math.min(a.right - b.left, b.right - a.left, a.bottom - b.top, b.bottom - a.top);
}

/** Validate random/cursor placement without creating NPCs inside obstacles. */
export function canStand(character, x, y, getObstacles = obstaclesIn) {
  const body = footprint(character, x, y);
  return getObstacles(body.left, body.top, body.right, body.bottom).every(box => !penetration(body, box));
}

/** Substep motion and slide along blocked axes, preventing diagonal tunneling. */
export function resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, getObstacles = obstaclesIn) {
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(toX - fromX), Math.abs(toY - fromY)) / 8));
  const dx = (toX - fromX) / steps, dy = (toY - fromY) / steps;
  let x = fromX, y = fromY;
  const permitted = (nextX, nextY) => {
    const before = footprint(character, x, y);
    const after = footprint(character, nextX, nextY);
    return getObstacles(after.left, after.top, after.right, after.bottom).every(box => {
      const depth = penetration(after, box);
      // Switching maps preserves positions. If already inside a new obstacle,
      // allow escape motions that reduce overlap instead of teleporting the actor.
      const oldDepth = penetration(before, box);
      const centerX = (box.left + box.right) / 2;
      const centerY = (box.top + box.bottom) / 2;
      const distanceBefore = Math.hypot((before.left + before.right) / 2 - centerX,
        (before.top + before.bottom) / 2 - centerY);
      const distanceAfter = Math.hypot((after.left + after.right) / 2 - centerX,
        (after.top + after.bottom) / 2 - centerY);
      return !depth || (oldDepth > 0 && (depth < oldDepth || distanceAfter > distanceBefore));
    });
  };
  for (let step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
    if (permitted(x + dx, y)) x += dx;
    if (permitted(x, y + dy)) y += dy;
  }
  return { x, y };
}

/** Draw only visible seeded tiles; generation allocates no persistent tile cache. */
export function drawTileWorld(context, images, camera, width, height, debug = false) {
  for (let row = Math.floor((camera.y - tileOverlap) / tileStrideY); row <= Math.floor((camera.y + height) / tileStrideY); row++) {
    for (let column = Math.floor((camera.x - tileOverlap) / tileStrideX); column <= Math.floor((camera.x + width) / tileStrideX); column++) {
      const x = Math.round(column * tileStrideX - camera.x);
      const y = Math.round(row * tileStrideY - camera.y);
      const right = Math.round(column * tileStrideX + tileWidth - camera.x);
      const bottom = Math.round(row * tileStrideY + tileHeight - camera.y);
      context.drawImage(images[tileIndex(column, row)].image, x, y, right - x, bottom - y);
    }
  }
  if (debug) {
    context.save();
    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
    context.lineWidth = 2;
    for (const box of obstaclesIn(camera.x, camera.y, camera.x + width, camera.y + height)) {
      context.strokeRect(box.left - camera.x, box.top - camera.y, box.right - box.left, box.bottom - box.top);
    }
    context.restore();
  }
}

import { timedEnemyEvents, playerSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Filled circular cluster: golden-angle spacing avoids square rows and hollow rings. */
export function clusterSpawnPoints(anchor, count, spacing) {
  const radius=spacing*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,count-1))/2;
  const goldenAngle=Math.PI*(3-Math.sqrt(5));
  return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>{
    const distance=count>1?radius*Math.sqrt(i/(count-1)):0;
    const angle=i*goldenAngle;
    return {x:anchor.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:anchor.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance};
  });
}

/** Place each scheduled formation once; retry invalid anchors/full capacity without duplicates. */
export function createTimedEnemyEvents(getPoints, spawn, events = timedEnemyEvents, warn = () => {}) {
  const pending = new Map();
  return { update(seconds) {
    for (const event of events) {
      if (seconds<event.timeSeconds-(event.warningSeconds || 0)) continue;
      let state=pending.get(event.id);
      if (!state) { state={index:0,points:null};pending.set(event.id,state); }
      if (event.lifetimeSeconds != null && seconds >= event.timeSeconds+event.lifetimeSeconds) {
        state.index=event.count; continue;
      }
      if (state.index>=event.count) continue;
      state.points ??= getPoints(event);
      if (!state.points) continue;
      if (seconds<event.timeSeconds) {
        if (!state.warned) { warn(event,state.points);state.warned=true; }
        continue;
      }
      while (state.index<event.count) {
        if (!spawn(event,state.points[state.index])) break;
        state.index++;
      }
    }
  }};
}


/** Lock a horde's course at spawn; it never homes toward later player positions. */
export function hordeMotion(enemy) {
  const angle = enemy.chargeAngle ?? 0;
  const directions=['right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft','up','upRight'];
  return {direction:directions[(Math.round(angle/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8],
    target:{x:enemy.x+Math.cos(angle)*10000,y:enemy.y+Math.sin(angle)*10000}};
}


/** Two opposite straight walls; split odd counts without losing enemies. */
export function wallSpawnPoints(bounds, count, vertical = true) {
  const first=Math.ceil(count/2), second=count-first;
  return [first,second].flatMap((amount,side)=>Array.from({length:amount},(_,i)=>{
    const t=amount>1?i/(amount-1):.5;
    return vertical?{x:side?bounds.right:bounds.left,y:bounds.top+t*(bounds.bottom-bounds.top)}:
      {x:bounds.left+t*(bounds.right-bounds.left),y:side?bounds.bottom:bounds.top};
  }));
}

/** Only numeric overrides replace the enemy defaults; unspecified stats remain intact. */
export function timedEventStatOverrides(event, base = {}) {
  const stats=event?.stats;
  if (!stats || typeof stats!=='object') return {};
  return {...(Number.isFinite(stats.hp)?{hp:stats.hp,maxHp:stats.hp}:{}),
    ...(Number.isFinite(stats.atk)?{contactDamage:stats.atk}:
      Number.isFinite(stats.atkMultiplier)?{contactDamage:base.contactDamage*stats.atkMultiplier}:{}),
    ...(Number.isFinite(stats.spd)?{movementSpeedMultiplier:stats.spd*playerSettings.speed/playerSettings.movementBase}:Number.isFinite(stats.spdMultiplier)?{movementSpeedMultiplier:base.movementSpeedMultiplier*stats.spdMultiplier}:{}),
    ...(Number.isFinite(stats.exp)?{expReward:stats.exp}:{})};
}


/** Evenly spaced complete circle around the player's position at formation creation. */
export function ringSpawnPoints(center, count, radius) {
  return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>{
    const angle=i/count*Math.PI*2;
    return {x:center.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius,y:center.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius};
  });
}


/** One straight line perpendicular to its fixed charge direction. */
export function stampedeSpawnPoints(anchor, target, count, spacing) {
  const angle=Math.atan2(target.y-anchor.y,target.x-anchor.x);
  return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>{
    const side=(i-(count-1)/2)*spacing;
    return {x:anchor.x-Math.sin(angle)*side,y:anchor.y+Math.cos(angle)*side,chargeAngle:angle};
  });
}


/** Push a point beyond the viewport, including the full sprite and a safety gap. */
export function offscreenEventPoint(point, viewport, spriteSize, gap = 24) {
  const cx=viewport.x+viewport.width/2, cy=viewport.y+viewport.height/2;
  const hx=viewport.width/2+spriteSize/2+gap, hy=viewport.height/2+spriteSize/2+gap;
  let dx=point.x-cx, dy=point.y-cy;
  if (Math.abs(dx)>=hx || Math.abs(dy)>=hy) return {...point};
  if (!dx && !dy) dx=1;
  const scale=Math.min(dx?hx/Math.abs(dx):Infinity,dy?hy/Math.abs(dy):Infinity);
  return {...point,x:cx+dx*scale,y:cy+dy*scale};
}

export function drawTuningExplosions(context,camera){for(const effect of effects)drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,effect,effect.age);}
export function clearTuningExplosions(){effects.length=0;}

export function createTuningRun(){return {equipped:[null,null,null],excluded:new Set()};}
export function eligibleTuningParts(run,catalog=tuningPartCatalog){return catalog.filter(p=>!run.excluded.has(p.id)&&!run.equipped.some(e=>e?.id===p.id));}
export function rollTuningPart(run,enemy,random=Math.random,catalog=tuningPartCatalog,bonusChance=0){
  const extra=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,bonusChance)),chance=extra?1-(1-tuningPartSettings.dropChance)*(1-extra):tuningPartSettings.dropChance;
  if(enemy.type!=='yuuka'&&random()>=chance)return null;
  const pool=eligibleTuningParts(run,catalog);if(!pool.length)return null;
  const weight=part=>Math.max(0,part.weight??1),total=pool.reduce((sum,part)=>sum+weight(part),0);
  if(!total)return null;
  let pick=Math.min(1-Number.EPSILON,Math.max(0,random()))*total;
  for(const part of pool){pick-=weight(part);if(pick<0)return {id:part.id,level:1};}
  return null;
}
export function equipTuningPart(run,part,index){
  if(!part||!Number.isInteger(part.level)||part.level<1||part.level>tuningPartMaxLevel(part)||!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>=3||run.equipped.some((p,i)=>i!==index&&p?.id===part.id))return {ok:false};
  const previous=run.equipped[index];run.equipped[index]={...part};return {ok:true,previous};
}
export function tuningPartMaxLevel(part,catalog=tuningPartCatalog){
  const id=typeof part==='string'?part:part?.id,definition=catalog.find(item=>item.id===id);
  return definition?.maxLevel??definition?.levels.length??tuningPartSettings.maxLevel;
}

/** Fit source artwork into the ground footprint without distorting its proportions. */
export function tuningGroundSpriteBounds(image,x,y,size=tuningPartSettings.groundSize){
  const scale=size/Math.max(image.naturalWidth,image.naturalHeight);
  const width=image.naturalWidth*scale,height=image.naturalHeight*scale;
  return {x:x-width/2,y:y-size*.4-height/2,width,height};
}

/** Exact connectors from weapon bottom to each slot top, in diagram-local pixels. */
export function tuningLinkEndpoints(weapon,slots,diagram){
  const start={x:(weapon.left+weapon.right)/2-diagram.left,y:weapon.bottom-diagram.top};
  return slots.map(slot=>({x1:start.x,y1:start.y,x2:(slot.left+slot.right)/2-diagram.left,y2:slot.top-diagram.top}));
}

      if(x<0||x>width||y<0||y>height)drawCrafterMarker(ctx,x,y,width,height);
    }}
  };

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/umbrella-attack.js | sha256=6737566cd4da7b022c554f3b037ffadf20a4b143a4a2bd1ccb6838c3c146036b | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import {stationaryWeaponIntervalScale} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {tryWeakTuningHit} from './weak-tuning.js';
import {playTrumpetTuning} from './trumpet-tuning.js';
import {trySlowdownTuningHit} from './slowdown-tuning.js';
import {rgbTuningActive,tintRainbowTrail} from './rgb-tuning.js';
import {startingWeaponAim} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {tryNeutralizationHit} from './neutralization-tuning.js';
import {onTargetTuningHit} from './target-tuning.js';
import {tryRepairTuningHit} from './repair-tuning.js';
import {applyTuningKnockback} from './knockback-tuning.js';

export { umbrellaSettings } from './game-config.js';

// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start:
// 1.5 seconds total = 0.2 seconds swinging + 1.3 seconds before the next swing.
const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed, duration = umbrellaSettings.duration) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  const arc = umbrellaSettings.arcDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
  return aim - arc / 2 + eased * arc;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle, areaScale = 1) {
  areaScale *= umbrellaSettings.sizeScale;
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  const dx = body.x - player.x, dy = body.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = Math.max(body.rx, body.ry);
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale) return false;
  // Subdivide the swept sector into blade segments at most 2 degrees apart.
  const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(toAngle - fromAngle) / (Math.PI / 90)));
  for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
    const angle = fromAngle + (toAngle - fromAngle) * i / samples;
    const x = Math.cos(angle), y = Math.sin(angle);
    if (segmentHitsBody(body,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Load the umbrella and own its repeating attack, hit tracking, and motion trail. */
export function createUmbrellaAttack() {
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = '../sprites/attacks/plana umbrella.png';
  const ready = image.decode();
  // Composite the dense trail first, then blur once instead of per afterimage.
  const trailCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const trailCenter = Math.ceil(umbrellaSettings.reach + umbrellaSettings.trailBlur * 4 + 8);
  trailCanvas.width = trailCanvas.height = trailCenter * 2;
  const trailContext = trailCanvas.getContext('2d');
  let autoattackEnabled = true;
  let owner;
  let cycle = 0,stationaryScale=1;
  let swing;
  let clock = 0;
  const hitTimes = new Map();

  /** Cancel attacks on avatar/loadout changes and start one sweep per configured attack interval. */
  function update(delta, player, aim, eraseProjectiles) {
    if (!autoattackEnabled) return;
    const equipped = player.attackSlots?.some(item => item?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
    if (!equipped) { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); return; }
    if (owner !== player) { owner = player; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); }
    const intervalScale=player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1;
    cycle*=intervalScale/stationaryScale;stationaryScale=intervalScale;
    clock += delta;
    for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > umbrellaSettings.interval+umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown) hitTimes.delete(id);
    cycle = Math.max(0, cycle - delta);
    if (!swing && cycle <= 0) {
      if(player.tuningParts)playTrumpetTuning(player);
      const haste = 1; // Haste changes attack intervals, never swing duration or trails.
      const upgrades = umbrellaLevelStats(player);
      const swingAim=player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'plana-umbrella',aim):aim;
      swing = { aim:swingAim, areaScale: upgrades.areaScale, awakened: upgrades.awakened, elapsed: 0, previous: umbrellaSwingAngle(swingAim, 0), hits: new Set(), haste,
        duration: umbrellaSettings.duration / haste, linger: umbrellaSettings.trailLinger / haste };
      cycle = attackTimeFormula(umbrellaSettings.interval * upgrades.intervalMultiplier * stationaryScale, ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
    }
    if (swing) {
      const wasAttacking = swing.elapsed < swing.duration;
      swing.elapsed += delta;
      const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed, swing.duration);
      for (const enemy of wasAttacking ? getAllEnemies() : []) {
        if (!swing.hits.has(enemy.id) && clock - (hitTimes.get(enemy.id) ?? -Infinity) >= umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown - 1e-8 && umbrellaHits(player, enemy, swing.previous, angle, swing.areaScale)) {
          swing.hits.add(enemy.id);
          hitTimes.set(enemy.id, clock);
          const hit = rollUmbrellaDamage(player, undefined, Math.random, 1, enemy);
          const hpBefore=enemy.hp;
          const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id, hit.damage, player, hit.type, { canMiss: true,weaponId:'plana-umbrella' });
          if(landed&&player.tuningParts)onTargetTuningHit({player,projectile:swing,enemy,damage:Math.min(hpBefore,hit.damage),hitType:hit.type});
          if(landed&&player.tuningParts)tryWeakTuningHit({player,enemy});
          if(landed&&player.tuningParts)tryNeutralizationHit({player,enemy});
          if(landed&&player.tuningParts)applyTuningKnockback(player,enemy);
          if(landed&&player.tuningParts)tryRepairTuningHit({player});
          if(landed&&player.tuningParts)tryLuxeryTuningHit({player,enemy,damage:hit.damage});
          if(landed&&player.tuningParts)trySlowdownTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollUmbrellaDamage(player,undefined,Math.random,multiplier,target)});
          if(landed&&player.tuningParts)tryColdTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollUmbrellaDamage(player,undefined,Math.random,multiplier,target)});
          if(landed&&player.tuningParts)tryTuningExplosion({player,projectile:swing,enemy,
            rollDamage:(target,multiplier,options)=>rollUmbrellaDamage(player,undefined,Math.random,multiplier,target,options)});
        }
      }
      if(wasAttacking&&player.tuningParts&&eraseProjectiles)eraseProjectiles({player,attack:swing,
        intersects:b=>umbrellaHits(player,{x:b.x,y:b.y,spriteHurtbox:{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:b.radius*2,height:b.radius*2}},swing.previous,angle,swing.areaScale)});
      swing.previous = angle;
      if (swing.elapsed >= swing.duration + swing.linger) swing = null;
    }
  }

  /** Draw one handle-anchored closed umbrella pose, pointing along the swing. */
  function drawBlade(context, angle, alpha) {
    context.save();
    context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
    context.globalAlpha = alpha;
    const length = umbrellaSettings.reach - umbrellaSettings.baseRadius;
    const width = length * crop.width / crop.height;
    if (swing.awakened && alpha === 1) { context.shadowColor = '#ffe271'; context.shadowBlur = 5; }
    context.drawImage(image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
      -width / 2, -umbrellaSettings.reach, width, length);
    context.restore();
  }

  /** Blur original umbrella sprite afterimages across the full sweep, without color overlays. */
  function draw(outputContext, camera) {
    if (!swing || !image.naturalWidth) return;
    const context = trailContext;
    context.clearRect(0, 0, trailCanvas.width, trailCanvas.height);
    context.save();
    context.translate(trailCenter, trailCenter);
    const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed, swing.duration);
    const visualTime = Math.min(swing.elapsed, swing.duration);
    const fade = (1 - Math.max(0, (swing.elapsed - swing.duration) / swing.linger)) ** 1.5;
    // Sample by ANGLE, not time: fast parts of the swing need more overlapping
    // poses, otherwise evenly timed ghosts separate into individual umbrellas.
    // Retain sprite afterimages across the whole travelled sweep. Their natural
    // dark/magenta colors come directly from the umbrella artwork, with no tint.
    const trailStart = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, 0, swing.duration);
    const span = angle - trailStart;
    const samples = Math.min(umbrellaSettings.maxAfterimages,
      Math.ceil(span / umbrellaSettings.trailAngleStep));
    for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
      const weight = i / samples;
      drawBlade(context, trailStart + span * weight,
        (0.018 + 0.032 * weight * weight) * fade);
    }
    context.restore();
    if(owner.tuningParts&&rgbTuningActive(owner))tintRainbowTrail(context,trailCanvas.width,trailCanvas.height);
    outputContext.save();
    outputContext.translate(owner.x - camera.x, owner.y - camera.y);
    const size = swing.areaScale * umbrellaSettings.sizeScale;
    outputContext.scale(size, size);
    outputContext.filter = `blur(${umbrellaSettings.trailBlur}px)`;
    outputContext.drawImage(trailCanvas, -trailCenter, -trailCenter);
    outputContext.filter = 'none';
    // The actual umbrella ends on time; only its soft trail lingers afterward.
    if (swing.elapsed < swing.duration) drawBlade(outputContext, angle, 1);
    outputContext.restore();
  }

  /** Clear a pending swing when the scene is reset. */
  function reset() { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); }
  return { ready, update, draw, reset,
    /** Stop the current swing immediately; this toggle does not control EX skills. */
    setAutoattackEnabled(enabled) { autoattackEnabled=Boolean(enabled); if(!autoattackEnabled) reset(); }
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/viewport.js | sha256=1a3d7b1a064f552263b8556aed99f901c754d82c5f816f98c4447f9460c64326 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Keep one world/canvas pixel equal to one displayed CSS pixel on any screen. */
export function observeViewport(canvas, onResize = () => {}) {
  function resize() {
    const rectangle = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rectangle.width));
    const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(rectangle.height));
    if (canvas.width === width && canvas.height === height) return;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    onResize();
  }
  const observer = new ResizeObserver(resize);
  observer.observe(canvas);
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => observer.disconnect(), { once: true });
  return observer;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/weapon-progression.js | sha256=d405069cfe3389da6911dc9e31f04b090f2f09a8982bce6910fd70dcdd144480 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { weaponSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, umbrellaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage, startingWeaponTuning } from './combat-stats.js';

/** Locate Plana's equipped umbrella without selecting or switching active weapons. */
export function getUmbrella(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
}

/** Cumulative weapon-level bonuses; awakening is a separate state after level seven. */
export function umbrellaLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, getUmbrella(player)?.level || 1));
  const damageTiers = Number(level >= 2) + Number(level >= 5);
  const areaTiers = Number(level >= 3) + Number(level >= 6);
  return {
    level, damageMultiplier: (1 + umbrellaUpgradeSettings.damageIncrease) ** damageTiers,
    areaScale: weaponSizeMultiplier(player) * Math.sqrt(1 + areaTiers * umbrellaUpgradeSettings.areaIncrease) *
      (1+(player.tuningParts?startingWeaponTuning(player,'plana-umbrella','attackSizePercent'):0)/100),
    intervalMultiplier: (level >= 4 ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.intervalMultiplier : 1) *
      (1-(player.tuningParts?startingWeaponTuning(player,'plana-umbrella','attackTimeReductionPercent'):0)/100),
    guaranteedCritical: level >= 7,
    awakened: Boolean(getUmbrella(player)?.awakened)
  };
}

/** Nominal weapon damage only; all variation is applied after character ATK. */
export function umbrellaBaseDamage() {
  return umbrellaSettings.damage * umbrellaSettings.damageMultiplier;
}

/** Apply weapon upgrades first, then player ATK and the appropriate critical multiplier. */
export function rollUmbrellaDamage(player, base = umbrellaBaseDamage(), random = Math.random, damageMod = 1, target, {growthEligible=true,skillAttack=false} = {}) {
  const stats = umbrellaLevelStats(player);
  const hit=rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'plana-umbrella', base / 10,
    [ (stats.damageMultiplier - 1) * 100 ], { growthEligible, projectileCount: 1, hitCooldownFrames: umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, {
    damageMod, target, skillAttack, weaponId:'plana-umbrella', forceCritical: stats.guaranteedCritical,
    criticalMultiplier: stats.guaranteedCritical ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.finalCriticalMultiplier : undefined
  });
  if(stats.guaranteedCritical && hit.critical)hit.type='supercritical';
  return hit;
}

/** Boss identity is explicit, never inferred from an elite's enlarged sprite. */
export function isBossEnemy(enemy) {
  if(enemy.boss === false) return false;
  return enemy.boss === true || ['iroha', 'shiroko', 'arisu', 'neru'].includes(enemy.type);
}

/** Render special enemies above normal actors, while bosses always own the final layer. */
export function enemyRenderLayer(enemy) {
  if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) return 'boss';
  return enemy.special === true || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? 'special' : 'normal';
}

/** Measure distance from sprite edges to the gameplay viewport rectangle. */
export function enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) {
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2;
  const dx = Math.max(camera.x - (enemy.x + radius), enemy.x - radius - camera.x - width, 0);
  const dy = Math.max(camera.y - (enemy.y + radius), enemy.y - radius - camera.y - height, 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

const enemies = new Map();
const spawnListeners = new Set();
const defeatListeners = new Set();
const damageListeners = new Set();
let killCount = 0;

export const enemyTestConfig = { oneHp: isAdminSeed };
const savedEnemyHealth = new WeakMap();

/** Toggle 1-HP enemies for this session, including elites, bosses and future spawns. */
export function setOneHpEnemies(enabled) {
  enemyTestConfig.oneHp = Boolean(enabled);
  for (const enemy of enemies.values()) applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
}

/** Preserve normal health so disabling the test restores surviving enemies. */
function applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy) {
  if (enemyTestConfig.oneHp) {
    if (!savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, { hp: enemy.hp, maxHp: enemy.maxHp });
    enemy.hp = enemy.maxHp = 1;
  } else if (savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) {
    Object.assign(enemy, savedEnemyHealth.get(enemy));
    savedEnemyHealth.delete(enemy);
  }
}

/** Observe real spawns/defeats; cleanup removals never emit these events. */
export function onEnemySpawn(listener) {
  spawnListeners.add(listener);
  return () => spawnListeners.delete(listener);
}
export function onEnemyDefeat(listener) {
  defeatListeners.add(listener);
  return () => defeatListeners.delete(listener);
}

/** Count confirmed defeats for this session; admin removal does not count. */
export function getKillCount() {
  return killCount;
}

/** Return all session records, including enemies outside the camera view. */
export function getAllEnemies() {
  return [...enemies.values()];
}

/** Observe accepted HP damage, excluding misses, overkill and forced harmless-enemy removal. */
export function onEnemyDamage(listener) {
  damageListeners.add(listener);return ()=>damageListeners.delete(listener);
}

/** Explicitly clear the test population without affecting player state. */
export function clearEnemies() {
  enemies.clear();
}

/** Add or update an enemy's state without tying its lifetime to camera visibility. */
export function rememberEnemy(id, state) {
  const existed = enemies.has(id);
  const enemy = { ...enemies.get(id), ...state, id };
  const saved = savedEnemyHealth.get(enemies.get(id));
  if (saved) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, saved);
  applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
  enemies.set(id, enemy);
  if (!existed) for (const listener of spawnListeners) listener(enemy);
  return enemy;
}

/** Read a remembered enemy even after its background tile has left the screen. */
export function getEnemy(id) {
  return enemies.get(id);
}

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source, hitType = 'normal', options = {}) {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  if (options.instantKO && (isBossEnemy(enemy) || enemy.miniBoss || enemy.instantKOImmune)) return false;
  if (options.canMiss && midoriDodges(enemy, source)) {
    showDamageNumber(enemy, 0, false, 'miss');
    return false;
  }
  const mainWeaponId=source?.mainWeaponId??(source?.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(source?.tuningParts&&options.weaponId===mainWeaponId)recordRateUpHit(enemy,tuningPerk(source.tuningParts,'rateUpChance'));
  const harmless = ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type);
  if (harmless) {
    dropYuukaCredits(enemy); // Each accepted hit, including the final hit.
    enemy.receivedHits = (enemy.receivedHits || 0) + 1;
  }
  const requiredHits = harmless ? (enemy.hitsToDefeat ?? harmlessEnemySettings[`${enemy.type}HitsToDefeat`]) : null;
  const actualDamage=Math.min(enemy.hp,amount);
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  for(const listener of damageListeners)listener({enemy,source,damage:actualDamage,requestedDamage:amount,hitType});
  // Count accepted hits, not damage points; misses and rejected hits never reach this branch.
  if (Number.isFinite(requiredHits) && requiredHits >= 1 && enemy.receivedHits >= requiredHits) enemy.hp = 0;
  showDamageNumber(enemy, amount, false, hitType, options.damageGroup); // Include overkill and crit styling.
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    const bossesAliveBefore = [...enemies.values()].filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    killCount++;
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
    for (const listener of defeatListeners) listener({ enemy, bossesAliveBefore });
  }
  return enemy;
}

/** End only this event's enemies with visual deaths, without loot, kills or boss charge. */
export function endEventEnemies(eventKey, source) {
  if (!eventKey) return 0;
  let removed = 0;
  for (const [id, enemy] of enemies) {
    if (enemy.eventKey !== eventKey || isBossEnemy(enemy)) continue;
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source, { knockback: false });
    enemies.delete(id);
    removed++;
  }
  return removed;
}

/** Return enemies near the viewport for future rendering; retain all other records. */
export function getVisibleEnemies(cameraX, viewportWidth, margin = 160) {
  return [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy =>
    enemy.x >= cameraX - margin &&
    enemy.x <= cameraX + viewportWidth + margin
  );
}

/** Remove an enemy deliberately, for example after a confirmed defeat. */
export function removeEnemy(id) {
  enemies.delete(id);
}

/** Free population slots without kills, loot or death effects when enemies leave play. */
export function despawnDistantEnemies(camera, width, height, isPlayable) {
  let removed = 0;
  for (const [id, enemy] of enemies) {
    if (isBossEnemy(enemy) || enemy.campaignRowId || ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type)) continue;
    // Wide timed formations need to enter view before normal offscreen-distance cleanup.
    if (enemy.spawnArrivalPending) {
      if (enemyViewportDistance(enemy,camera,width,height)>0 && enemy.spawnArrivalGrace>0) continue;
      enemy.spawnArrivalPending=false;
    }
    if ((!['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type) && enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) > enemyPopulationSettings.despawnDistance) ||
        !isPlayable(enemy, enemy.x, enemy.y)) {
      enemies.delete(id);
      removed++;
    }
  }
  return removed;
}

/** At 90% capacity, remove farthest non-bosses until population reaches 70%. */
export function trimEnemyPopulation(player) {
  const settings = enemyPopulationSettings;
  if (enemies.size < Math.ceil(settings.limit * settings.trimAt)) return 0;
  const target = Math.floor(settings.limit * settings.trimTo);
  const candidates = [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy => !isBossEnemy(enemy) && !enemy.campaignRowId && !['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type))
    .sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(b.x - player.x, b.y - player.y) - Math.hypot(a.x - player.x, a.y - player.y));
  let removed = 0;
  for (const enemy of candidates) {
    if (enemies.size <= target) break;
    enemies.delete(enemy.id);
    removed++;
  }
  return removed;
}


/** Rescale health proportionally, keeping admin1HP baselines synchronized for later restore. */
export function rescaleEnemyHealth(enemy, maxHp) {
  const health = savedEnemyHealth.get(enemy) ?? enemy;
  const ratio = health.maxHp > 0 ? health.hp/health.maxHp : 1;
  const updated = {maxHp, hp:Math.max(1, Math.round(maxHp*ratio))};
  if (savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, updated);
  else Object.assign(enemy, updated);
}
